jobs.title: Product Manager / Director – GPU & AI Services
jobs.text:
ABOUT US:
Impossible Cloud is a fast-growing B2B cloud company headquartered in Hamburg, Germany. We have built a cloud object storage solution comparable to AWS S3, purpose-built and optimised for AI and compute workloads. Our commercial hyper-growth speaks for itself, powered by our channel-first go-to-market strategy.
We are now expanding beyond storage: we are building a high-performance compute platform, offering an end-to-end solution from GPU infrastructure to full GPU platform software stack. In doing so, we are redefining the cloud ecosystem by bridging the gap between decentralised infrastructure (DePIN), mainstream B2B cloud use cases, and AI applications.
Find out more about us here.
Please note that we can only consider candidates who have a valid, unrestricted work permit for the EU.
Your Impact
You will own the product and go-to-market strategy for our GPU and AI services, working directly with the founders to define what we build, how we price and package it, and which customer segments and use cases we go after first. Success in 12 months means a validated commercial model with thousands of AI B2B customers and a product roadmap with huge customer pull behind it.
WHAT YOU WILL DO:
Direct the end-to-end GPU and AI services strategy and roadmap, taking full commercial accountability.
Establish product-market fit by identifying high-advantage segments and use cases.
Design pricing, packaging, and GTM strategies alongside sales and channel partners.
Convert customer signals and research into clear, executable engineering backlogs.
Serve as the technical product lead for enterprise accounts, discussing GPUs, networking, and AI workloads.
Monitor competitors to ensure industry-leading positioning and features.
WHAT YOU BRING:
Proven success leading cloud infrastructure or AI product strategy and revenue growth.
Technical fluency in GPU architectures, AI/ML workloads, and cluster networking.
Strong commercial instincts with experience in pricing and defining ICPs.
Evidence-based approach, prioritizing customer data over personal opinion.
Proficiency in using AI tools to optimize research and execution.
Fluent English; additional European languages preferred.
WHAT WE OFFER:
Competitive salary coupled with direct engagement in your success through an enticing ESOP.
Clear and transparent career progression scheme inspired by the best performing organisations incl. fast track promotion opportunity for exceptional performance to support your growth ambitions.
Prime growth-stage company with proven revenue and a sharp edge in cloud — founded by serial entrepreneurs with multiple successful exits.
Experienced, passionate team working with cutting-edge cloud technology.
A vibrant office in a trendy location with free brain food and a canteen — plus a subsidized premium gym membership and monthly team meet-ups that bring the whole crew together!
OUR CULTURE:
We are committed to success. We embrace individuals from all backgrounds who share the goal of building a future European cloud champion, celebrated through a richly diverse team of 15+ nationalities and 10+ languages spoken.
OUR HIRING PROCESS:
Apply: Submit your CV or LinkedIn profile via the application form.
First response: We review every application carefully and get back to you within a few days. If your profile is a strong match, we'll invite you to an intro call via Google Meet.
Get to know us: We move quickly through two to four interview steps, including a meeting with our founders.
Offer: If it's a mutual fit, you'll receive a personal offer and feedback call, followed by a written offer document.

jobs.title: Head of Tech Solutions
jobs.text:
About Igloo
Igloo is the operating system for insurance in Southeast Asia. Headquartered in Singapore with operations across Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, and Malaysia, and technology centres in China and India, Igloo provides the AI-powered infrastructure that enables insurers and consumer platforms to build, distribute, and manage insurance products digitally.
The company's proprietary tech stack processes over 80 million policies per month and automates the full insurance value chain, from product configuration and underwriting to claims adjudication and financial reconciliation. Through Igloo Tech Solutions, the company licenses its modular technology solutions to insurers and enterprises, compressing product launch cycles from months to days.
With 1.6 billion cumulative policies facilitated, partnerships with Shopee, Lazada, Tokopedia, GCash, Telkomsel, and 100+ commercial and insurer partners Igloo is building the operating system for the future of insurance.
Igloo has raised over US$100 million in funding from investors including Eurazeo, Openspace Ventures, Tokio Marine, Cathay Innovation, and BlueOrchard. The company has been named Insurtech of the Year at the Asia Fintech Awards in 2023 and 2024, and won twin Insurance Asia Awards in 2025.
Role Overview
A commercial-technical operator who can move fluently between a CEO conversation, a product-prioritisation debate and an enterprise architecture review. This is not a pure product role, presales role or sales role. The successful candidate combines product judgment, enterprise selling and enough technical depth to earn credibility with sophisticated financial-services clients.
Job Responsibilities
· Own the enterprise solution portfolio: define target problems, buyer personas, use cases, modules, packaging and commercial positioning.
· Translate platform capabilities into plain-language business value for insurers, banks, fintechs, digital platforms and other large distribution partners.
· Shape the productisation roadmap with Product and Engineering, balancing client demand, regional reuse, platform integrity and speed to market.
· Create boardroom-ready narratives, demonstrations, proposals, solution blueprints, ROI cases and procurement responses.
· Build and manage the qualified enterprise pipeline with clear segment priorities, deal stages, conversion discipline and forecast accountability.
· Lead senior client discovery and solution design; diagnose distribution problems rather than simply responding to feature requests.
· Own the technical and commercial story in complex sales cycles, including architecture, integration approach, data flows, security posture and operating model - with specialist teams where needed.
· Define guardrails for configuration versus custom development; make no-code configuration a commercial advantage and not a promise of unlimited customisation.
· Create a repeatable handover from signed deal to implementation, with agreed scope, success criteria, owners, risks and governance.
· Capture market intelligence and client feedback; turn patterns into product priorities, sector propositions and sharper sales plays.
· Develop ecosystem routes to market with cloud, consulting, systems-integration and technology partners where strategically useful.
· Build and lead a high-calibre solutions and enterprise go-to-market team as the business scales.

jobs.title: Global Programme Director - Finance Technology
jobs.text:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
For more information, visit WPP.com.
Why we're hiring:
As part of WPPs Elevate28 strategy, we are accelerating a major Finance Technology transformation to simplify, modernise and standardise the platforms, data and processes that underpin Global Finance. This portfolio is critical to statutory reporting, management reporting, forecasting, planning, control, performance management, compliance, and executive decision-making.
The Global Programme Director - Finance Technology will shape, govern and drive WPP’s global Finance Technology transformation portfolio. This senior enterprise leadership role turns a complex, multi-year agenda into a coherent roadmap that simplifies the finance technology estate, strengthens control and resilience, and enables faster, more trusted business insight.
The role spans Finance ERP standardisation, consolidation platform replacement, enterprise performance management, revenue forecasting, analytics, finance data foundations and operating model change. It will work across Group Finance, Enterprise Technology, agencies, markets, regions and delivery partners to align priorities, secure decisions, manage trade-offs and ensure investment delivers measurable enterprise value.
This is a director-level role requiring strategic judgement, executive influence, commercial discipline and the ability to create clarity, momentum and delivery confidence across a high-profile transformation portfolio.
What you'll be doing:
Shape and sequence the global Finance ERP roadmap, moving WPP towards fewer platforms, common templates, harmonised controls and reduced process variation
Lead the transition from legacy consolidation tooling to a resilient enterprise performance management capability across consolidation, planning, forecasting, reporting and analytics
Strengthen delivery confidence, investment discipline and benefits realisation across a high-value portfolio with significant executive visibility and business risk
Define the global Finance Technology portfolio vision, investment narrative and multi-year roadmap across Finance ERP, consolidation, enterprise performance management, forecasting, analytics and finance data
Translate finance transformation priorities into a clear, sequenced and deliverable portfolio that balances strategic value, delivery capacity, affordability, risk and business disruption
Establish strong portfolio governance, investment controls, stage gates, assurance and executive reporting to support timely, evidence-based decisions
Lead and orchestrate a portfolio of finance transformation programmes, ensuring clear sponsorship, ownership, outcomes, funding, delivery accountability and benefits realisation
Manage portfolio risks, dependencies, resources, budgets, delivery confidence and executive escalations across Finance, Enterprise Technology, data, architecture, security, controls, suppliers, markets and agencies
Build trusted relationships with senior Finance, Enterprise Technology, agency, market and regional leaders to align priorities, resolve trade-offs and maintain enterprise momentum
Shape business cases, funding recommendations and portfolio choices using clear analysis of cost, benefit, risk, sequencing, control impact and business value
Manage system integrators, software vendors and delivery partners against commitments, outcomes, commercial levers and performance expectations
Lead and coach programme directors, delivery leads, PMOs and matrixed teams to raise delivery standards, strengthen transparency and build a culture of accountability.
What you'll need:
Extensive experience leading large-scale finance technology, ERP, enterprise performance management or corporate systems transformation in a global organisation.
Proven track record of leading multi-year transformation portfolios with significant budgets, multiple delivery partners, complex governance and senior executive sponsorship.
Strong understanding of finance operating models and core finance capabilities, including ERP, consolidation, planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, analytics, controls and finance data.
Director-level leadership presence, with the credibility to influence C-suite leaders, Finance executives, technology leaders, agencies, markets and external partners.
Strong capability in portfolio governance, investment management, business case development, budget ownership, benefits realisation, assurance, RAID and dependency management.
Commercially confident, with experience managing vendors, system integrators and delivery partners against commitments, outcomes and performance measures.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex finance, technology and delivery issues into clear executive insight, decisions and recommendations.
Ability to create clarity in ambiguity, resolve competing priorities and lead matrixed teams across geographies, functions and business units.
Strong understanding of change, adoption, business readiness, service transition, process ownership and operating model embedding.
Resilient, commercially minded and outcome-focused, with high integrity, strong judgement and the confidence to challenge constructively when value, control or delivery confidence is at risk.
Who you are:
You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
What we'll give you:
Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.
Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

jobs.title: Senior Product Director - Agentic Data Platform
jobs.text:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
For more information, visit WPP.com.
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Director, Product Management to lead the strategy and execution of WPP’s next-generation Agentic Data Platform.
Within Cohort Solutions, you will own product vision, strategy, roadmap development and execution across multiple products and initiatives. You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Data Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Governance and Market teams to deliver scalable, high-impact products that create measurable business value and strong adoption.
The successful candidate will combine disciplined product management with experience in data products, AI, commercialization, stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership. The final role level will reflect the scope of the position and the experience of the successful candidate.
Why we’re hiring
To establish and execute a clear product strategy for WPP’s Agentic Data Platform.
To turn complex data and AI capabilities into scalable products that solve meaningful business and customer problems.
To connect product investment, adoption and commercialization with measurable value across WPP’s global network.
What you’ll be doing
Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap across multiple data platform products and initiatives.
Translate customer, user, market and business needs into clear product priorities and outcomes.
Lead products through discovery, validation, development, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.
Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Data Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Governance and Market teams to deliver high-quality products.
Define success measures and use data to track adoption, value, quality, cost and commercial performance.
Develop product economics and commercialization approaches, balancing customer value, business objectives, speed, quality and scalability.
Advance AI, agent and workflow automation opportunities through responsible experimentation, while ensuring appropriate governance, privacy, security and data quality.
How your time may be focused
The role is expected to be approximately 70% individual contribution and 30% leadership/management, with the balance adapting to business needs.
In this role, you will:
Create alignment around a compelling product vision and prioritized roadmap.
Move complex data and AI initiatives from strategy into valuable, adopted products.
Establish clear measures for product performance, customer value and commercial impact.
Build strong partnerships across technical, commercial, governance and market teams.
Help develop product talent and strengthen product management practices across the organization.
Who you’ll be working with
You’ll work across a global, matrixed environment with colleagues in:
Engineering and Data Science
Data Operations and Governance
Commercial and Partnerships
Market and business teams
Product, technology and senior executive leadership
What you’ll need
Significant product management experience, including ownership of strategy, roadmaps and product lifecycles.
A track record of building or scaling products in one or more of the following areas: data, analytics, advertising technology, Martech, SaaS, AI or enterprise platforms.
Experience taking products from strategy and discovery through delivery, launch, adoption and iteration.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional product initiatives or teams within a matrixed or global organization.
Strong commercial judgment, including the ability to connect customer needs with product economics, revenue drivers, costs and adoption.
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and create alignment across technical and non-technical teams.
Strong working knowledge of enterprise data platforms and the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering and Data Science colleagues.
Experience that would be valuable
Experience building or launching agentic, AI-native or workflow automation products.
Working knowledge of LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent orchestration.
Experience working with responsible AI, data governance, privacy or security considerations in enterprise environments.
Experience leading, coaching or developing product managers.
We value relevant skills and experience gained through different career paths. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in place of rigid formal requirements.
How you lead
Strategic thinker: You connect product investments to business outcomes and build compelling, actionable roadmaps.
Commercially minded: You understand value creation, customer needs, product economics and adoption.
Influential collaborator: You build trust across functions, navigate competing priorities and resolve conflicts constructively.
Execution focused: You make informed decisions in ambiguous environments and balance speed, quality and scalability.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
What we'll give you:
Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.
Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

jobs.title: Chief Technology and Product Officer
jobs.text:
This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.
Profile Overview
We recently acquired Traject Data, home of SerpWow and Rainforest API, and now run an end-to-end data pipeline: from proxy and scraping infrastructure through to structured, ready-to-use data APIs. The next chapter is turning that into one coherent, AI-native platform and we're looking for a CTPO to lead the combined 25-person product and engineering org through it. You'll report directly to the CEO, sit at the leadership table, and be the person who understands the stack down to the proxy layer while also setting where the product goes next.
Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:
Get hands-on with the heart of the product: proxy dynamics and anti-bot evasion, working directly with our Head of Ops to optimise vendor relationships and build up capacity.
Build real fluency in the product and the backend so you can operate as a genuine technical sparring partner to the CEO, not just receive direction.
Start bringing the ScraperAPI and Traject Data infrastructure together on a coherent technical roadmap
Your responsibilities
Own end-to-end product and technology strategy across our scraping infrastructure, proxy networks, and structured data API products (ScraperAPI, SerpWow, Rainforest API).
Lead, scale, and develop a 25+ person product and engineering organisation spanning multiple countries and time zones, building the management structure it needs as it grows.
Set technical architecture direction for high-scale, high-reliability infrastructure, including proxy management, anti-bot evasion, and large-scale scraping systems.
Drive AI and modern ML tooling into both the product itself and how the team builds and ships it.
Define and execute one product roadmap across the merged ScraperAPI and Traject Data lines.
Represent product and technology to the board, and work closely with the CEO and commercial leadership to keep product direction and business strategy aligned.
Stay close enough to the code and infrastructure to go in and troubleshoot, fix, or challenge a technical decision yourself when it matters.
What You bring to the table
Experience leading product and/or engineering at a highly technical company (CTO, CPO, VP Engineering or similar), at a 25+ person org or larger
Real hands-on depth in web scraping, proxies, or closely adjacent infrastructure. You understand the operational reality of this space and you don't rattle when a source breaks overnight and it's suddenly all hands on deck
A genuine track record with AI/ML, both shaping AI-powered product capability and pushing AI-native ways of working through an engineering team
Experience owning product vision and technical architecture together, not just one side of that line
Comfort operating at board level: a clear communicator who can hold their own with an ambitious, hands-on CEO and knows when to push back
Bonus: experience integrating product lines after a merger or acquisition
What’s in it for You
Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.
ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.
What is saas.group?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.
We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!
—
saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.
We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Head of Design Operations
jobs.text:
Our client is an established architecture and design firm specialising in large-scale workplace projects across France and wider Europe. As the business enters its next phase of growth, they are seeking a Head of Design Operations to take operational ownership of the design function which includes leading a team of designers and technical staff, managing budgets and workload, and ensuring every concept and technical output meets the standard their international clients expect.
Key Responsibilities
Provide hands-on operational leadership to design professionals and external freelance resources, across concept development and technical design phases.
Manage workload allocation, resourcing and scheduling so the team delivers reliably and to deadline.
Own budget oversight and cost control across the design function.
Review, challenge and quality-check technical plans and design outputs before they go to clients, ensuring they meet required technical, accessibility and regulatory standards.
Act as a key client-facing point of contact on design quality and delivery for international clients on large-scale workplace projects.
Strategically deploy freelance and external resources for technical or lower-value tasks to support the team's ability to scale.
Coach, mentor and develop a team of creative and technical professionals, building a stable, high-performing team culture.
Partner closely with the pre-construction and delivery teams to ensure a seamless handover of projects from concept through to completion.
Report to senior leadership on team performance, project status and resourcing needs.
Requirements
Significant experience in an operational leadership role within architecture, interior design, workplace fit-out or construction, gained in a design, delivery or technical management capacity.
Proven track record managing and developing teams of design or technical professionals, including workload planning and resourcing.
Demonstrated experience overseeing project budgets and cost control.
Strong technical literacy, with the ability to read, review and challenge technical and design plans, even without personally producing creative concepts.
Client-facing experience, with the ability to build trust with international clients.
Professional working proficiency in French.
Eligibility to work in France, or to obtain the relevant right to work.
Preferred Qualifications
Background as an architect, interior designer, or in a related technical/design discipline. Candidates from construction or similar technical backgrounds are also encouraged to apply; a design qualification is not essential.
Working knowledge of Revit.
Fluency in English is valuable given the team's exposure to international projects across Europe.
Experience developing creative concepts and pitching to clients (an advantage, not a requirement).
Experience in workplace design, fit-out, or large-scale commercial interior projects.
Benefits
Base salary: €75,000 to €90,000 gross per annum, commensurate with experience, with flexibility for an exceptional candidate.
Variable incentive: To be confirmed and discussed with shortlisted candidates.
Working pattern: Hybrid, 2 days of remote work per week.
Travel: Approximately 5% of time, across European project sites.
Leave: French statutory annual leave entitlement (minimum 25 working days). Any additional leave or benefits to be confirmed with shortlisted candidates.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, SyncOS
jobs.text:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017. We build syncOS — the industry-first no-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands like Ford, Coca-Cola, and Kimberly-Clark — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks.
We started as roboticists ourselves. We know the pain of fragmented, proprietary systems that refuse to talk to each other. syncOS is our answer — and we believe it's what the industry has been waiting for. We are a young, passionate team chasing one big mission.
WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE FOR THIS ROLE
3 months:
Deep understanding of syncOS, the fleet it orchestrates, and how it runs in live customer environments
Release and deployment process owned end-to-end - every build clearly certified, every deployment owned and reversible
Established as the single technical point of contact for the delivery organisation
Team assessed, and the lead structure for scaling in place
6 months:
Site deployment reliability consistently at target across live customers — repeatable and process-driven
Interface contracts between syncOS and the fleet published and enforced; teams build to a clear spec
Manager layer running well, with depth behind every critical capability
Product discipline visible: platform work and custom work clearly separated, scoped, and priced
12 months:
SyncOS reliability is a competitive strength customers choose us for
A reusable integration catalog with owners and regression tests - each new integration cheaper and faster than the last
SyncOS engineering scales cleanly into new sites and geographies. A self-sufficient organisation with the bench strength to grow beyond you
Key Responsibilities:
Single technical owner of our software platform – SyncOS.
Lead the teams building fleet management, integrations, and the platform core, and own the discipline that gets our software running reliably at customer sites, at scale, across geographies.
The platform, end to end - You own syncOS engineering - fleet management, integrator and dashboard, integration modules, and the platform core and the technical definition of what syncOS is as a product.
Reliability and release quality - You own how software gets from a merged change to running dependably at a customer site: release gating, staged rollout, post-deploy verification, versioned and reversible deployments, and the observability that catches issues before customers do. Site deployment quality is a core measure of your success.
DevOps and site delivery of software - The syncOS DevOps function reports to you. Your team owns updates going onto customer sites as a controlled, repeatable release process.
Architecture and interfaces - You own the interface contracts and data models between syncOS and the integrations - published, enforced, and stable.
The team - You lead and grow the syncOS engineering organization through a layer of team leads: hiring, structure, mentorship, and building an org where no critical capability rests on a single person.
Product-mode engineering - You bring the discipline that keeps a platform a platform - a clear spec, a reusable integration catalog with owners and tests, and the judgment to keep bespoke, one-off work from fragmenting the product.
You will partner closely with:
Product: on what syncOS should do and for whom - you own how it's built and whether it's ready to ship.
Commissioning & Customer Success: who take your certified releases to customer sites - you are their single technical point of contact.
Quality: who independently certify releases - you build to the bar and ship what passes it.
Robotics Engineering: on the interface between the platform and the fleet.

blocks.text: Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017. We build syncOS — the industry-first no-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands like Ford, Coca-Cola, and Kimberly-Clark — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks.

We started as roboticists ourselves. We know the pain of fragmented, proprietary systems that refuse to talk to each other. syncOS is our answer — and we believe it's what the industry has been waiting for. We are a young, passionate team chasing one big mission.
WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE FOR THIS ROLE

items: 3 months:
Deep understanding of syncOS, the fleet it orchestrates, and how it runs in live customer environments
Release and deployment process owned end-to-end - every build clearly certified, every deployment owned and reversible
Established as the single technical point of contact for the delivery organisation
Team assessed, and the lead structure for scaling in place
6 months:
Site deployment reliability consistently at target across live customers — repeatable and process-driven
Interface contracts between syncOS and the fleet published and enforced; teams build to a clear spec
Manager layer running well, with depth behind every critical capability
Product discipline visible: platform work and custom work clearly separated, scoped, and priced
12 months:
SyncOS reliability is a competitive strength customers choose us for
A reusable integration catalog with owners and regression tests - each new integration cheaper and faster than the last
SyncOS engineering scales cleanly into new sites and geographies. A self-sufficient organisation with the bench strength to grow beyond you

blocks.text: Key Responsibilities:

items: Single technical owner of our software platform – SyncOS.
Lead the teams building fleet management, integrations, and the platform core, and own the discipline that gets our software running reliably at customer sites, at scale, across geographies.

The platform, end to end - You own syncOS engineering - fleet management, integrator and dashboard, integration modules, and the platform core and the technical definition of what syncOS is as a product.

Reliability and release quality - You own how software gets from a merged change to running dependably at a customer site: release gating, staged rollout, post-deploy verification, versioned and reversible deployments, and the observability that catches issues before customers do. Site deployment quality is a core measure of your success.
DevOps and site delivery of software - The syncOS DevOps function reports to you. Your team owns updates going onto customer sites as a controlled, repeatable release process.
Architecture and interfaces - You own the interface contracts and data models between syncOS and the integrations - published, enforced, and stable.

The team - You lead and grow the syncOS engineering organization through a layer of team leads: hiring, structure, mentorship, and building an org where no critical capability rests on a single person.

Product-mode engineering - You bring the discipline that keeps a platform a platform - a clear spec, a reusable integration catalog with owners and tests, and the judgment to keep bespoke, one-off work from fragmenting the product.

blocks.text: You will partner closely with:

items: Product: on what syncOS should do and for whom - you own how it's built and whether it's ready to ship.
Commissioning & Customer Success: who take your certified releases to customer sites - you are their single technical point of contact.
Quality: who independently certify releases - you build to the bar and ship what passes it.
Robotics Engineering: on the interface between the platform and the fleet.

jobs.title: Engineering Director, Storage
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox's infrastructure supports over 100M DAUs and recently supported a world record 45M players at the same time. The scale is real.
As Director of Engineering, you will own the technical strategy, design, delivery, and operation of Roblox's storage systems. The challenge is scale, efficiency, reliability, and innovation all at once. We are mostly on-prem but also in the cloud — yes, we're actually building a lot of this ourselves, and yes, we know how hard that is. We've got the scale and the talent to do it.
You've spent your career deep in storage: databases, caches, queues, object storage. You understand that reliability is the most important feature of any system. You care deeply about the success of the internal and external customers who depend on these systems. You're excited to shepherd a fast-growing platform from the nearly 1 exabyte we have today to a multi-exabyte deployment that will power some of the most interesting AI workloads in the industry.
You will
Own the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for Roblox's storage systems, including distributed databases, caches, queues, object storage, and encryption infrastructure
Ensure our storage platform scales by orders of magnitude while remaining reliable and efficient
Partner closely with Data Platform, Infrastructure, and product engineering teams to align storage capabilities with Roblox's technical and business needs
Build, grow, and retain a world-class storage engineering team — and develop the next generation of technical leaders within it
Drive operational excellence: define and hold the bar on reliability, on-call practices, and incident response
Own your systems end-to-end, including participation in on-call rotation for critical incidents
You have
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
10+ years of experience in storage, infrastructure, or distributed systems roles, including hands-on experience building and operating custom database systems - not just deploying off-the-shelf solutions - plus depth in at least several of: caching systems, object storage, message queues, or data streaming
5+ years in engineering leadership, managing teams through ambiguity to deliver critical, production-scale systems
A track record of building reliable, high-availability systems at significant scale (millions of users, petabyte-scale data, or equivalent)
Strong operational instincts — you raise the bar on reliability and execution, not just vision
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and earn trust across engineering, product, and leadership
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward learning: you go deep on tech stacks that are new to you and bring others along
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$399,420—$457,970 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, AI Takeoff Team
jobs.text:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Director of Engineering, AI takeoff team
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Job Description
The AI Takeoff Team at Okta is the tip of the spear, creating a rapid, high-bandwidth feedback loop from our customers to product and engineering. We are customer-first by design: working directly with customers to understand real-world problems, rapidly build and validate solutions, and accelerate the capabilities that ultimately become part of the Okta platform.
We move at startup speed, operate with intensity, obsess about customer outcomes, and own our numbers — from pipeline generation to sales, adoption and retention. You’ll operate like an engineering leader at a startup within a larger enterprise: moving quickly, staying close to customers, and delivering with urgency while bringing the broader Okta organization with you.
In this context, we are seeking a driven, customer-focused engineering leader to accelerate our roadmap delivery. This is a career-defining role for the right leader looking to directly impact the growth trajectory of the industry leader in identity and AI security.
Responsibilities
Work closely with our top customers and AI Forward Deployed Engineering to rapidly translate customer needs into differentiated AI capabilities and deliver them to production.
Partner closely with broader Okta Engineering, Product and Design to ensure capabilities are production-ready and meet Okta standards for security, reliability, scalability and quality.
Build, grow and mentor a small, highly focused team of AI Takeoff engineers operating with high autonomy and urgency.
Serve as a senior technical SME in customer engagements, technical evaluations and complex sales processes.
Lead complex customer escalations with a bias toward rapidly identifying root causes and delivering durable solutions.
Own the technical strategy, architecture, and execution for the AI Takeoff engineering roadmap, balancing customer urgency with long-term scalability and production quality.
Qualifications
8+ years building and shipping identity, security, infrastructure or developer-focused products in a high-growth organization.
Proven engineering leadership and team management experience, including hiring, developing and motivating high-performing teams.
Strong executive communication and influencing skills, with a track record of driving outcomes across organizational boundaries and bringing cross-functional teams together.
Proven experience working directly with enterprise customers and translating customer problems into technical solutions.
Deep identity domain expertise — you know, or can quickly get up to speed on, the latest identity protocols, standards, architectures and patterns.
Experience operating in high-ambiguity, high-velocity environments where priorities evolve quickly and execution matters.
Strong product and customer orientation, with the ability to balance customer urgency, technical quality and long-term scalability.
Experience with AI/agentic systems, AI security or emerging identity patterns is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Drive delivery and operational excellence.
Millennium is seeking a Director of Engineering. As the operational leader for the Engineering Business Unit, the Director of Engineering holds end-to-end accountability for delivery execution, unit economics, and operational scaling. Partnering directly with the VP of Strategic Solutions in a balanced commercial/operational dynamic, this role owns the business unit’s operational and financial performance—driving gross margin, EBITDA, cost structure, resource allocation, and talent development. While the commercial organization focuses on revenue growth and market strategy, the Director of Engineering ensures that delivery operations excel in precision, efficiency, client retention, and long-term profitability.
What You’ll Do
Own gross margin and EBITDA performance for the Engineering Business Unit
Own annual budget, forecasting, and staffing plans for the unit, translating project-level staffing input from the Head of Strategic Engineering and Engineering Manager(s) into a unit-wide plan.
Own cost structures and delivery economics, working with the VP where these connect to client-facing rate cards.
Design and monitor the unit's departmental KPIs — backlog strength, on-time delivery, unit cost per fiber-kilometer (KFM), margin by project — reported through NetSuite/Domo, with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for producing the underlying measures.
Own backlog, workload forecasting, and resource allocation across projects, with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for day-to-day backlog and workload monitoring, and Engineering Manager(s) consulted.
Own client retention — relationship health and proactive response to client needs — with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for day-to-day relationship management.
Own tool and technology evaluation and recommendation for the unit, incorporating Engineering Manager(s) input as it matures.
Own monthly reporting to management on status, performance, and metrics, with the Head of Strategic Engineering and Engineering Manager(s) responsible for generating the underlying reports.
Own succession planning and leadership development pipeline, including senior engineer training and technical development.
Partner with the VP on strategic planning and provide input on client retention risk that touches sales-facing accounts.
What You Bring
10+ years in telecom, fiber/broadband infrastructure, or a comparable capital-project environment, including direct accountability for a unit's margin, budget, and cost structure.
Direct experience coordinating OSP engineering, design, and permitting workflows with major national carriers (e.g., AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile).
Demonstrated experience owning KPI design and monthly management reporting for an operating unit.
Fluency with ERP/BI tools (NetSuite, Domo, or equivalent) and comfort presenting financial and delivery performance to executive and Board audiences.
Experience building and developing a leadership bench (director- and manager-level) and running succession planning.
Comfort operating as a peer to a commercially-focused VP without overlapping accountability
Why Join Millennium?
Millennium helps our clients to build broadband networks to connect communities across America. But we’re more than that – we offer our clients enterprise resources to plan out their builds, supplement their funding, manage their materials, and get the equipment they need to get networks up and running.
A collaborative work environment where you can influence the overall success of the company through your efforts and expertise. The growth mode we operate in provides tremendous opportunities for your career path and personal development.
Apply Today!

jobs.title: Director, Field Engineering Emerging Enterprises & Startups
jobs.text:
Req ID FEQ327R163
Director, Field Engineering Emerging Enterprises & Startups
About the Role
As a Director, Field Engineering, you will lead a multi-team Field Engineering organization and own strategy, talent, operating model, and execution for a significant business area. You will scale customer and business impact through other leaders while influencing broader go-to-market, partner, Product, Engineering, and company priorities.
This role typically oversees a leadership team of approximately 3–5 leaders or an equivalent multi-team scope. Depending on the assignment, you may lead a broad business unit, multiple segments or countries, a major portfolio, or another strategically significant area.
The Impact You Will Have
Build and lead a strong leadership team that attracts, develops, and retains exceptional Field Engineering talent.
Own an end-to-end strategy across talent, customer coverage, technical priorities, operating model, execution, and business impact.
Translate customer, market, competitive, and technical trends into clear priorities and 6–12+ month plans.
Scale impact beyond individual teams through leaders, cross-functional GTM initiatives, partner ecosystems, and repeatable operating mechanisms.
Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including VP-level and equivalent audiences, and guide complex programs, escalations, and transformation roadmaps.
Establish operating norms and inspection cadences across the organization that create visibility, accountability, predictable execution, and fast course correction.
Shape resourcing and organizational design to support growth, customer outcomes, technical quality, and long-term business value.
Upgrade hiring rigor, talent practices, leadership development, performance management, and succession planning across the organization.
Influence broader Sales, Professional Services, Marketing, Partners, Product, Engineering, Support, and executive priorities through a clear point of view and strong cross-functional relationships.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, Endpoint Security & XDR
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
Elastic Security is hiring a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Endpoint Security & XDR business. This role reports to the GM of Elastic Security. You will be paired with our most senior engineering leader, a VP who leads all of Elastic Security engineering and whose day-to-day focus is endpoint, sharing accountability for the line's outcomes with you. You will also peer with the product lead of our SIEM and analytics business as we build one platform together. The endpoint is where we meet the adversary directly, and where the people we serve, the analysts and defenders protecting hospitals, banks, and government networks, need us most. Their mission is our mission, and this role carries that responsibility for the endpoint and XDR market. Like Elastic itself, the role is distributed by design.
This business was born when Elastic acquired Endgame in 2019, a pioneer in endpoint prevention, detection, and response with roots in defending national security networks. We extended that protection philosophy to Linux and cloud-native environments with the Cmd acquisition in 2021. The result today is Elastic Defend, and its record in independent testing reflects the quality of the work: Elastic Security was the only vendor to score 100% protection in both the AV-Comparatives Real-World and Malware Protection Tests for all of 2025, and the only vendor among 16 to earn a perfect malware protection score in the 2026 Business Security Test, with zero false alarms on the software businesses actually run. And unlike most of this market, we do that work in the open: our protection artifacts and detection rules are public for anyone to inspect.
This role is open for a straightforward reason. Our product leader is retiring, and we are organizing product management around our two core businesses: SIEM and analytics, which will be led by a proven leader already at Elastic, and endpoint, where we are looking outside for someone who brings a fresh perspective from this market. The timing is deliberate in another way as well: security operations are shifting toward agentic workflows, and as a challenger in this market we can move faster than the incumbents. Our focus with this role is business expertise: we are looking for a business owner who understands endpoint security deeply and who will grow this line with the care of someone who owns the outcome. You will have genuine room to lead. The strategy, the priorities, and how we compete are yours to shape with your engineering partner.
What You Will Be Doing
Drive the business-driven OKRs for the Endpoint Security & XDR line: revenue contribution, competitive win rate, platform attach, retention, and expansion.
Set the product strategy for the line and represent it with sales leadership, customers, and analysts: a clear diagnosis of the market, a guiding policy, and coherent actions that follow from it.
Own the agentic detection and response strategy for the endpoint: where AI-driven and autonomous capabilities genuinely help prevention, detection, and response at the edge, working closely with the SIEM and analytics line so customers experience one agentic platform, not two roadmaps.
Shape where we invest and where we choose not to, building the case with data and customer evidence.
Own how endpoint and XDR fit the broader Elastic Security platform story, so a customer who lands with endpoint expands into the platform and a SIEM customer sees why our endpoint belongs next to it.
Put customers first. Visit them where they are, participate in deals and win/loss reviews, enable the field, and represent Elastic at tradeshows and industry events. This work requires regular travel.
Partner with your engineering counterpart as a true pair, sharing one set of outcomes for the line.
Lead and develop a team of product managers, helping each of them connect their work to the customer's mission and the business.
What You Bring
Genuine care for the people this product protects. Customers can tell whether the person across the table is invested in their mission, and this business runs on the trust you earn by caring consistently over time.
Business expertise running a product line or business unit in security, with comfort in the full picture: revenue, win rates, retention, pricing and packaging, and competitive positioning.
Earned credibility in endpoint security: EPP, EDR, XDR, and enough understanding of what an agent does on a machine to have real conversations with engineers and practitioners.
A strong working partnership with go-to-market teams, including experience enabling sellers and supporting deals alongside the field.
A habit of deciding with evidence: win/loss data, customer conversations, and market signals inform your calls.
A point of view on how a challenger competes and differentiates against well-funded incumbents.
Clear executive communication with executive leadership, CISOs, sales leadership, and industry analysts.
Bonus Points
Experience competing with or working at endpoint-focused security vendors, with perspective on the strengths and gaps across the market.
Experience helping a security business scale from a few hundred million toward $1B.
Familiarity with public efficacy testing (AV-Comparatives, MITRE ATT&CK evaluations) and how to participate in the open.
Experience serving customers in hard environments: regulated industries, classified networks, air-gapped and OT deployments.
A thoughtful position on AI and agentic capabilities at the endpoint, with healthy skepticism of silver bullets and a clear sense of where they genuinely help the defender.
Contributions to open source or the security community. Our work is public, and we value people who build in the open.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below.
These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.
An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.
The typical starting salary range for this role is:
$192,500—$304,500 CAD
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.
Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster; Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster)

If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic.

blocks.text: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role

Elastic Security is hiring a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Endpoint Security & XDR business. This role reports to the GM of Elastic Security. You will be paired with our most senior engineering leader, a VP who leads all of Elastic Security engineering and whose day-to-day focus is endpoint, sharing accountability for the line's outcomes with you. You will also peer with the product lead of our SIEM and analytics business as we build one platform together. The endpoint is where we meet the adversary directly, and where the people we serve, the analysts and defenders protecting hospitals, banks, and government networks, need us most. Their mission is our mission, and this role carries that responsibility for the endpoint and XDR market. Like Elastic itself, the role is distributed by design.

This business was born when Elastic acquired Endgame in 2019, a pioneer in endpoint prevention, detection, and response with roots in defending national security networks. We extended that protection philosophy to Linux and cloud-native environments with the Cmd acquisition in 2021. The result today is Elastic Defend, and its record in independent testing reflects the quality of the work: Elastic Security was the only vendor to score 100% protection in both the AV-Comparatives Real-World and Malware Protection Tests for all of 2025, and the only vendor among 16 to earn a perfect malware protection score in the 2026 Business Security Test, with zero false alarms on the software businesses actually run. And unlike most of this market, we do that work in the open: our protection artifacts and detection rules are public for anyone to inspect.

This role is open for a straightforward reason. Our product leader is retiring, and we are organizing product management around our two core businesses: SIEM and analytics, which will be led by a proven leader already at Elastic, and endpoint, where we are looking outside for someone who brings a fresh perspective from this market. The timing is deliberate in another way as well: security operations are shifting toward agentic workflows, and as a challenger in this market we can move faster than the incumbents. Our focus with this role is business expertise: we are looking for a business owner who understands endpoint security deeply and who will grow this line with the care of someone who owns the outcome. You will have genuine room to lead. The strategy, the priorities, and how we compete are yours to shape with your engineering partner.
What You Will Be Doing

items: Drive the business-driven OKRs for the Endpoint Security & XDR line: revenue contribution, competitive win rate, platform attach, retention, and expansion.
Set the product strategy for the line and represent it with sales leadership, customers, and analysts: a clear diagnosis of the market, a guiding policy, and coherent actions that follow from it.

Own the agentic detection and response strategy for the endpoint: where AI-driven and autonomous capabilities genuinely help prevention, detection, and response at the edge, working closely with the SIEM and analytics line so customers experience one agentic platform, not two roadmaps.
Shape where we invest and where we choose not to, building the case with data and customer evidence.
Own how endpoint and XDR fit the broader Elastic Security platform story, so a customer who lands with endpoint expands into the platform and a SIEM customer sees why our endpoint belongs next to it.

Put customers first. Visit them where they are, participate in deals and win/loss reviews, enable the field, and represent Elastic at tradeshows and industry events. This work requires regular travel.
Partner with your engineering counterpart as a true pair, sharing one set of outcomes for the line.
Lead and develop a team of product managers, helping each of them connect their work to the customer's mission and the business.

jobs.title: Director of AI Engineering
jobs.text:
Location: Remote - United States only.
About the role:
Ottimate is building the AI-native future of accounts payable. Our platform processes millions of invoices across hundreds of enterprise customers, powered by a suite of ML models and agentic workflows. As Director of AI Engineering, you will own the full AI and ML layer of our product — from invoice understanding and vendor intelligence to our conversational AP Copilot and the next generation of autonomous AP agents.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will spend at least half your time writing code, architecting systems, and driving technical decisions alongside your team. You will also set the AI roadmap, partner cross-functionally with Product, Data, and Platform Engineering, and manage a distributed team of 8–10 engineers across Data and ML.
We are looking for a senior technical manager or director — ideally someone who has thrived at a smaller company and is ready for a career step up into broader ownership. If you are energized by shipping real AI products, working with noisy real-world financial data, and building the systems that will define how enterprises automate AP, this role is for you.
Responsibilities
Technical Leadership
Architect and ship production AI/ML systems — you write code, not just review it
Own the AI roadmap end-to-end: prioritization, trade-offs, delivery
Set technical standards for model quality, evals, observability, and reliability
Drive adoption of agentic coding tools to multiply team velocity
Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent — measure and improve PR throughput
Partner with Platform Engineering on infrastructure, data pipelines, and APIs
People & Cross-Functional
Manage a distributed team of 8–10 engineers across Data and ML disciplines
Hire, develop, and retain engineers at all levels; build a high-trust remote culture
Partner with Product on roadmap sequencing and scope trade-offs
Work directly with customer-facing teams to close feedback loops on model quality
Communicate AI capabilities and limitations clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Model & Systems Ownership
Own model performance metrics and drive continuous improvement pipelines
Build and maintain evals frameworks — regression suites, human review, A/B testing
Oversee training data collection, curation, and labeling operations
Manage the full ML lifecycle: experimentation, deployment, monitoring, iteration
Define and enforce quality bars for agentic workflows entering production

jobs.title: Director, UX and Product Design
jobs.text:
Drug Hunter is a B2B scientific intelligence platform for biotech/pharma R&D scientists that empowers them to discover the medicines of the future. We serve most of the top global biotech & pharma companies including Dow 30 and S&P500 companies. We're a mission-driven, product-focused company backed by top-tier investors and trusted by the world's leading R&D organizations.
The Director, UX and Product Design will own the overall user experience, UI/UX architecture, and product design direction across the product portfolio. This individual will be responsible for translating complex user needs and workflows into intuitive, high-quality product experiences while contributing meaningfully to product strategy. The role will work closely with Product, Engineering, Science, and Commercial teams to ensure product experiences are grounded in user evidence, aligned with business objectives, and designed to drive adoption, engagement, retention, and growth.
The Director will also establish scalable design systems and design processes and will have the opportunity to build and lead the UI/UX design organization as the company grows.
Key Responsibilities
Own the overall UI/UX architecture and product design direction across the product portfolio.
Develop information architecture, navigation structures, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity product designs.
Translate complex user needs, workflows, and product requirements into intuitive, efficient, and compelling user experiences.
Conduct user research, usability testing, and customer discovery to inform product decisions, value propositions, and product requirement specifications.
Contribute to the direction of product strategy through well-structured proposals grounded in user evidence, customer needs, and product insights.
Drive alignment between product experiences and user workflows to increase adoption, engagement, stickiness, retention, and ultimately business growth.
Identify opportunities to improve existing products and systematically improve usability, discoverability, consistency, and overall product quality.
Establish and evolve processes for design reviews, UX critique, prototyping, user validation, and design decision-making.
Work cross-functionally as a product leader with Science, Commercial, Product, and Engineering teams to define user requirements and validate desired outcomes from early product definition through implementation.
Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, Scientific/Content, and other creative teams where product and brand experiences intersect, ensuring visual brand standards are applied coherently across the customer experience.
Partner closely with Engineering to establish and maintain a scalable design system, including reusable components, interaction patterns, and UX principles, while maintaining a high bar for design quality and implementation fidelity.
Recruit, hire, manage, and mentor UI/UX and product design professionals as the Product Design organization grows.

jobs.title: Managing Director - Data & AI (Montreal, Canada)
jobs.text:
Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organisations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 400 projects and have grown to 175+ talented individuals across 7 office locations.
Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes. You can learn more about what we are passionate about at and on our you can find more useful information about our business and recruiting process.
Are You the Leader We're Looking For?
As a Managing Director at Unit8, success isn't just about closing deals — it's about becoming a cornerstone of how we grow and deliver in the DACH market. You will own both sides of the equation: originating high-value client relationships and ensuring the work we deliver actually moves the needle for our clients. If you've built your career at the intersection of commercial impact and technical credibility, and you're ready to operate with real autonomy in an expert-led environment, this is the role.
What Success Looks Like in This Role
This is a senior leadership position for someone as comfortable originating a complex engagement as overseeing its delivery. You shape and close the deal, build relationships and trust, and you stay close enough to ensure the technical execution actually delivers value. You will succeed by:
Building and converting a pipeline of high-value opportunities in the DACH market — primarily in pharma, insurance, or chemicals — through a network earned over years of credible work in data & AI
Selling from expertise: clients engage with you because you understand their problem because of your deep problem solving skills and experience not because you have a polished pitch
Staying embedded in delivery long enough to set the right pace, challenge client assumptions, and keep teams focused on the actual business problem
Bridging the gap between a senior data scientist and a C-suite conversation — translating technical constraints into strategic decisions and vice versa
Raising the delivery bar by knowing what good looks like and holding teams to that standard
What You'll Do
Leverage your existing network to source, shape, and close high-value engagements in the DACH region (new logos, not just expansions)
Translate complex business problems into concrete Data & AI solutions: identify where value can be created, make sure the team is building toward it, and hold the client accountable to realising it
Lead and shape complex, tech-enabled transformations — from early problem definition through to scaled delivery — ensuring the right technology choices serve the business outcome, not the other way around
Act as the senior point of contact for key clients throughout delivery, ensuring technical execution stays anchored to business value
Challenge clients when necessary — on scope, pace, and ambition
Work closely with our engineering and data science teams, providing business context, removing blockers and coaching them.
