jobs.title: Platform & Data Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.
We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.
We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.
Role
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.
You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on
Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS.
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery.
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint.
Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like.

blocks.text: Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.
Role

As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.

You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on

items: Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS.
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery.
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint.

Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Data
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
We are seeking a visionary and execution-focused Senior Director of Enterprise Data to lead the transformation and maturity of our data ecosystem. Having recently scaled to $2 billion in annual revenue, we are actively building the infrastructure, governance, and operational models required to sustain our trajectory to $4 billion and beyond.
In this role, reporting to the CIO, you will own the end-to-end data strategy, evolving our data platform architecture, scaling our Master Data Management (MDM) systems into an active operational hub, and institutionalizing federated data governance. You will bridge the gap between complex engineering and business execution, transforming data from a utility into a high-octane product that powers real-time decision-making, predictive analytics, agentic AI and operational efficiency across the global enterprise.
What You Will Be Doing
Data Strategy & Platform Evolution
Architect the Future: Design, execute, and evolve a scalable data platform roadmap capable of handling a multi-billion dollar enterprise’s volume, velocity, and variety of data.
De-bottleneck Legacy Infrastructure: Transition our centralized pipelines into a modern, decoupled data architecture.
Data as a Product: Implement a "Data as a Product" mindset across engineering teams, ensuring datasets have strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs), rigorous uptime, and high catalog discoverability.
Streaming & Real-Time Analytics: Drive the evolution from purely batch-oriented processing to real-time event streaming for critical business domains like Engineering, Finance, and Customer Experience.
Enterprise Master Data Management (MDM)
Build the Golden Record: Evolve our current cross-referenced registry into a highly integrated, multi-domain operational MDM hub (Customer, Product, Vendor/Supplier).
Operational Syncing: Ensure mastered data seamlessly flows bidirectionally between analytic environments and core operational execution systems (ERP, CRM, eCommerce).
M&A Readiness: Standardize ingestion frameworks to quickly harmonize data from future acquisitions or new business units without interrupting daily operations.
Data Governance, Quality, & Compliance
Federated Governance: Establish an enterprise-wide data governance council. Move governance away from gatekeeping and toward a collaborative data stewardship model owned by business units.
Automated Observability: Implement modern, automated data lineage, cataloging, and quality testing tools to monitor data health and proactively catch pipeline degradation before it hits business dashboards.
Security & Compliance: Partner with Security and Legal teams to ensure the enterprise data platform natively adheres to global regulatory frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) through robust RBAC/ABAC and automated data masking.
Team Leadership & Operating Model
Scale the Organization: Restructure and grow a high-performing data team consisting of data engineers, MDM specialists, platform architects, and data governance managers.
Centralized Infrastructure, Embedded Analytics: Champion a hub-and-spoke operating model, providing a central platform layer while enabling embedded data analysts within business units to move fast safely.
Cultivate Data Ops: Instill software engineering rigor into data workflows, including CI/CD deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and comprehensive automated test suites.
What You Bring
Proven Scale Experience: Minimum of 12+ years of progressive leadership in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data management, with explicit experience inside an organization operating in a B2B environment at a $1B to $5B+ revenue scale.
Architectural Fluency: Deep hands-on and strategic familiarity with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, AWS/Azure data suites) and enterprise MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica, Reltio, Semarchy, Profisee).
Change Management Mastery: Documented success in leading complex corporate data migrations or massive MDM implementations across multi-business-unit enterprises.
Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex technical jargon into clear business value, financial ROI, and strategic alignment for C-suite executives.
People Leadership: Minimum of 5 years managing manager-level and architect-level direct reports, with a track record of hiring, mentoring, and retaining top-tier engineering talent.
Bonus Points
Experience navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments characterized by rapid organizational restructuring or frequent Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).
Expertise in setting up a Data Mesh or federated data architecture in a hybrid or multi-cloud environment.
Active engagement or understanding of integrating AI/ML infrastructure readiness into core enterprise data platforms.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.
The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.
These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.
An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.
The typical starting salary range for this role is:
$212,100—$335,600 USD
The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is:
$254,900—$403,200 USD
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.
Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster; Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster)

jobs.title: Director of Product, Logistics
jobs.text:
We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Overview
About the Team
Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the Logistics product organization and take it to its next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with executive sponsorship, owning a pillar with company-wide impact on Instacart’s long-term growth and profitability. You will set the multi-year vision and strategy for Logistics, lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner closely with engineering, machine learning, data science, and operations to build products that generate value for all sides of the marketplace. You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.
About the Job
Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.
Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.
Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.
Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.
Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.
Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.
Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.
About You
Minimum Qualifications
10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).
Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.
Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).
Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence executive leadership and align cross-functional teams in a complex domain.
Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing PMs and build healthy, high-trust teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a multi-sided dynamic marketplace-oriented role, envisioning or evaluating algorithms-based products and services.
Background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or operationally complex physical environments.
Experience with e-commerce or grocery technology.
#LI-Remote
Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.
Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.
For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

$291,000—$307,000 USD
WA

OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI
$266,000—$281,000 USD
All other states
$242,000—$255,500 USD

Kudos Services is a specialist facilities management provider delivering high-quality Hard FM services across complex healthcare environments. We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Head of Engineering to lead our Engineering & Maintenance team across our Healthcare LIFT portfolio.
Key Requirements
Significant experience managing Hard FM services across complex, multi-site estates within a PPP/PFI environment, ideally healthcare.
Strong technical knowledge of building services engineering, statutory compliance and healthcare maintenance requirements, including HTMs and HBNs.
Proven leadership experience managing engineering teams, contractors and multiple stakeholders.
Commercially aware, with experience of performance management, contract delivery and budget accountability.
HNC/HND (or equivalent) in a Mechanical, Electrical or Building Services Engineering discipline.
About the Role
Reporting directly to the CEO, this is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic and operational management of Engineering & Maintenance services across our Healthcare LIFT portfolio.
You will lead the Engineering Team, ensuring the safe, compliant and effective delivery of Hard FM services whilst maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and contractual performance. Working closely with Contract Managers and the Compliance Team, you will oversee statutory compliance, technical governance, engineering performance and quality assurance across the estate.
You will act as the lead representative for engineering audits and technical reviews, ensuring robust processes, clear audit trails and full compliance with contractual and statutory obligations. The role will also take ownership of engineering reporting, resource planning, contractor performance, asset management and lifecycle activities.
As a key member of the senior leadership team, you will contribute to commercial and financial performance, supporting budget setting, forecasting, procurement activities and business-wide continuous improvement initiatives.

You are an experienced engineering leader who combines strong technical expertise with excellent people management and stakeholder engagement skills. jobs.title: Director of Analytics
jobs.text:
Lyst is a global fashion shopping platform founded in London in 2010 and catering to over 160M shoppers per year. We offer our customers the largest assortment of premium and luxury fashion products in one place, curating pieces from 27,000 of the world's leading brands and stores. In 2025, Lyst joined Zozo, operators of Zozotown, the leading fashion e-commerce platform in Japan. This partnership marks a bold new era for Lyst, as we accelerate our vision and work together to transform the future of fashion shopping through AI and technology.
At Lyst, we obsess over the customer, providing a search and discovery experience which offers inspiration, fulfilment, and personalisation. We believe that fashion is amazing but shopping for fashion often isn't, and we use our technology, data and creativity to bring more joy, greater choice and fewer fails. Our mission is to help fashion shoppers make better decisions and help fashion partners find better audiences as the category-leading destination for every fashion shopper.
The Role
We're looking for a Director of Analytics to lead our lean, multi-disciplined, best-in-class analytics team. As director, you will set the mission, technical direction, and culture of the analytics function. You will provide technical direction on product analytics, experimentation, attribution, forecasting, and manage analytical frameworks. You will promote a culture of discovering and communicating insights, as well as enabling self-service analysis capabilities for stakeholders. You will also evangelise and inspire best practices across the company.
You will report to the Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with the Director of Data Platform and Directors in other functions such as Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Finance and Marketing. Our stack includes AWS, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Python, R and other best in class, modern tooling for business reporting, experimentation, and analysis. We are heavily invested in advanced AI-enhanced analytics tools across the company, and you will drive the evaluation, deployment and adoption of more powerful tools to scale self-serve analytics.
Responsibilities
Leadership and Team Management:
Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing, diverse analytics team
Foster a culture of deep analysis, commercial sense, innovation, best practices and evangelizing non-obvious insights (not simply reporting data)
Align team objectives with company goals and strategic initiatives
Apply strong commercial intuition, customer-focus and data analysis to drive strategic decision-making
Technical Direction and Innovation:
Provide expert guidance on horizontal technical analytical areas, including experimentation, attribution, forecasting, predictive analytics, and observability
Continuously identify opportunities for advanced analytics and data methodologies and enable implementation
Identify and track appropriate metrics to measure success across all areas of the business
Ensure trustworthiness and timeliness of data used by stakeholders from all departments of the company
Analytics and Strategy:
Collaborate with senior leadership to provide insights for decision-making around key initiatives and strategic objectives
Work with FP&A and product leads to align customer impact with commercial outcomes - working to a common growth-model/metric tree
Stay abreast of industry trends, the competitive landscape, advances in technology, methodologies and tools, and market dynamics to inform commercial strategies
Data Strategy and Governance:
Partner with the Director of Data Platform to define and execute the vision for how data can be leveraged effectively across the business
Work alongside the Data Platform team to ensure high data quality and robust data governance
Develop and maintain analytics roadmaps to support the progress of the data strategy
Crossfunctional Collaboration:
Empower the team to execute on reporting, analytics, and experimentation
Drive with product development to identify and apply new data opportunities
Drive understanding of key metrics and their importance across the business
Evangelize opportunities and trends discovered through insights across all stakeholders and ensure that insights and data leads to sound decision-making
Empower stakeholders through increased self-service usage of analytics tools, while freeing up analysts to contribute deeper insights requiring greater analytical skills

jobs.title: Senior Manager / Assistant Director (Programme Evaluation), Data Office
jobs.company: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI)
jobs.text:
The Programme Evaluation (PE) team in MDDI’s Data Office oversees the MDDI Family’s Programme Evaluation framework and collaborates across MDDI-Family divisions to design, plan, and conduct programme evaluation, as well as to deepen capabilities in programme evaluation.
Job Responsibilities
As a member of the PE team in MDDI’s Data Office, you will be given the opportunity to partner with a diverse mix of stakeholders in varying stages of evaluation across a range of programmes in the digital, communications and information domains.
You will provide guidance to programme owners in planning, designing and evaluating projects of strategic importance to the organisation. You may be directly involved in working with programme owners to conduct evaluation deep-dives. As the central PE unit for MDDI Family, you will also have the opportunity to connect with other central PE units across whole-of-government and refine standards and guidelines for MDDI-Family to keep pulse with developments in programme evaluation.
This role includes but may not be limited to the following responsibilities:
Monitor key performance indicators for MDDI and its agencies’ programmes within the scope of the MDDI-Family Programme Evaluation Framework
Conduct in-depth evaluations of selected programmes (during planning and post-implementation) and identify opportunities to optimise policy implementation. This will involve:
o Using frameworks such as Theory of Change to clarify programme goals and desired outcomes
o Collating and analysing relevant data to assess performance indicators and desired outcomes, as well as derive evaluation insights
o Scope and participate in programme walk-throughs and field observations alongside programme owners to identify process improvements
o Making data-informed recommendations to senior management, programme and policy owners
Provide guidance and support to MDDI-HQ and agencies in designing appropriate programme evaluation approaches. This includes:
o Engaging policy and programme owners to understand programme intent and design, identify needs for evaluation and the suitability of evaluation methods
o Reviewing and providing input to programme owners’ Theory of Change frameworks based on their programme goals
o Reviewing implementation plans for proposed solutions, which includes setting S.M.A.R.T (Specific, Measurable, Attainable, Relevant and Time-bound) key performance indicators, data collection plans and evaluation plans
Strengthen MDDI-Family Capability Development in Programme Evaluation, which requires
o Developing learning materials on evaluation methodologies and principles,
o Leading internal communications of Ministry PE resources and workshops and brownbag sessions
o Building a networking of evaluation practitioners within the MDDI family

jobs.title: Director, Security Engineering
jobs.text:
Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.
The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and is trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.
About the Role
As Director of Security Engineering, you will lead the modernization of Fireblocks’ security infrastructure — across both our in-house-built tooling and the SaaS platforms we rely on. You will own the architecture behind security operations, our security data lake, SaaS security, and cloud security, and build the infrastructure that makes Fireblocks’ security tooling faster, more efficient, and ready for an agentic operating model.
This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the technical direction, build out a team and processes, and personally drive projects from architecture through implementation and measurable impact.
What You’ll Do
Security Infrastructure Strategy & Modernization
Own the multi-year modernization roadmap for Fireblocks’ security infrastructure, spanning in-house tooling and SaaS.
Analyze the needs across security domains, ensure we have the appropriate architecture for a centralized security data lake, and propose and drive optimized designs for agentic flows.
Security Data & Detection Engineering
Build and evolve Fireblocks’ security data lake and the logging, detection, and analytics pipelines built on top of it.
Optimize security data infrastructure to support faster detection, detailed investigation and automated response.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Coordinate and align with Security, R&D, and DevOps stakeholders to drive infrastructure projects end-to-end.
Lead projects from concept to delivery, and define the metrics that demonstrate their impact.
Requirements
7+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including leadership roles in SecOps, Application Security, or DevSecOps.
At least 3–4 years in a formal leadership or management capacity.
Security Engineering background — hands-on experience implementing and optimizing security systems is a must.
Proven experience building security systems and workflows that handle large-scale data (e.g., security data lakes, SIEM), including hands-on work with security auditing, logging, and cloud infrastructure.
Hands-on experience implementing AI processes, workflows, and tools to optimize security operations and workflows, and familiarity with AI security tooling.
Strong track record coordinating across Security, R&D, and DevOps stakeholders.
A builder mentality: the desire and ability to create infrastructure from scratch, lead projects end-to-end, and measure their impact.
Nice to Have
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP).
Fireblocks’ mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Institutional Product
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own institutional partner products such as Custody, Brokerage, and Fees & Incentive Programs (including MM/MT structures, VIP tiering, and rebate frameworks). Final scope will weigh your background, but the mandate is consistent: build institutional-grade products that compete on infrastructure, economic design, and reliability — and translate that into measurable growth in client adoption, trading volume, and revenue. You will partner with engineering, operations, sales, compliance, and external service providers to ship complex changes that institutional counterparties trust and rely on.
What You’ll Be Doing
Clearly define product direction and roadmaps for Custody OES, drive its evolution and turn client and partner requirements into shipped features. Grow the client and partner base. Optimize operations through self-service portals and process automation.
Own the fee schedule and incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates), balancing market dynamics, competitor moves, and institutional needs against company strategy, revenue, and competitive position. Build and continuously evolve AI agents for competitor intel, liquidity analysis, fee and rebate simulation, and program operations.
Own the commercial logic of your product lines. Build ROI-grounded business cases for product and partnership investments; quantify revenue and AUM impact to drive prioritisation;
Articulate strategy, progress, and trade-offs to internal leadership and external institutional clients.
Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, compliance, and legal to ship complex changes. Navigate multi-jurisdictional regulatory constraints (HK, SG, EU, US) and balance trade-offs between speed, scalability, and compliance.
What We Look For In You
PM experience at a crypto exchange on Custody OES, or at a custody, or background from traditional finance on Collateral / Tri-party / CCP solutions. Deep market knowledge and an end-to-end grasp of how counterparties, custody, execution, and settlement connect.
Solid understanding of liquidity dynamics and how institutional crypto markets actually work. Prior hands-on experience managing fee schedules or designing incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates) is a strong plus.
Proven experience of leading strategic business reviews, facilitating on-site requirement discovery, and converting client feedback into prioritized product initiatives. Strong track record of partnering with Sales, BD, and Relationship Management teams in a B2B institutional setting.
Proven ability to bring structure and clarity to complex problems, align senior stakeholders across functions, and drive decisions and execution. Able to communicate complex strategies and trade-offs with clarity and influence, producing high-quality strategy documents, product plans, roadmaps, and executive-level presentations. Demonstrated effectiveness leading and influencing globally distributed teams across time zones and diverse cultural contexts.
Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools for market research and product operations. Building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features.
Candidates with more experience will be considered as Product Director (P7-1). Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development

jobs.title: Product Director, Localisation & AI Evals
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"
Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.
We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:
A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.
A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.
This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.
This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.
What You’ll Be Doing
You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.
Own the agentic translation system
Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.
Build the agentic QA and quality automation
Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.
Make it self-improving
Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.
What We Look For In You
PM leader who has taken a frontier agentic product from 0 to 1, beyond translation.
Proven ability to ship genuinely novel products at the edge of LLM capabilities—and repeat that success here.
Accountable for business outcomes and measured on business metrics, not delivery volume.
Deep hands-on experience building large-scale, frontier-LLM agentic systems from 0 to 1.
Experience with harness/orchestration layers, multi-agent workflows, and LLM-as-a-judge or automated evaluation pipelines.
Has built quality systems, automated evaluations, or release gates that enable confident autonomous-system launches.
International product experience serving users across multiple languages and regions.
Nice to Haves
Built an agentic system from scratch
Shipped agentic / LLM applications in production
Finance, payments or another highly regulated industry.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: VP of Product Development & Manufacturing
jobs.text:
Can you walk into a factory in Shenzhen, China and know within the first hour whether they can actually build what you need?
Can you look at a failed EVT unit and know immediately whether it's a design problem, a supplier problem, or a tooling problem?
Have you actually taken a sophisticated electromechanical product from a sketch to millions of units in market - not managed a roadmap, but built something?
Freebird® is a 9-figure DTC brand serving over 2 million customers and redefining shaving for the modern consumer. We've built a loyal subscriber base, a portfolio of best-in-class grooming products, and one of the strongest direct-response engines in the space. Now we're entering our next stage of growth and investing significantly in the evolution of our physical product platform - and we're looking for the person who will own it.
We're looking for a VP, Product Development & Manufacturing to lead the development, engineering, sourcing, validation, and commercialization of Freebird's physical products. You'll serve as Freebird's senior product development authority, working closely with the CEO, President/COO, and broader leadership team to translate consumer and business needs into exceptional physical products.
This is not a program-management role. This is a builder role. If you've taken sophisticated hardware from concept through mass production before and want to do it again - keep reading.
Key Responsibilities
Product Development
Lead end-to-end development of Freebird's hardware and personal care products from concept through commercialization.
Translate consumer needs, market opportunities, and business objectives into clear product requirements and development priorities.
Define product architectures, specifications, performance requirements, and development plans.
Evaluate potential development paths and determine when to build, adapt, source, customize, or partner.
Lead product benchmarking, prototyping, testing, and iterative improvement.
Make clear recommendations on technology, partners, resources, timing, cost, and development tradeoffs.
Ensure product programs remain focused on delivering meaningful improvements to the customer experience.
Bring structure, urgency, technical rigor, and strong judgment to product-development decisions.
Product Design & Engineering
Lead and coordinate industrial design, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and technical development across Freebird's product portfolio.
Provide technical leadership across sophisticated electromechanical systems, including:
Motors and drivetrains
Batteries and charging systems
Electronics and PCBs
Mechanical systems and interfaces
Cutting and grooming mechanisms
Blades, foils, and precision components
Waterproofing and sealing
Materials and tolerances
Tooling and molded components
Ergonomics
Reliability and manufacturability
Establish clear engineering requirements, design reviews, technical milestones, and validation standards.
Ensure products are designed for performance, durability, manufacturability, quality, and cost from the beginning.
Select and manage the appropriate internal and external industrial design, engineering, and technical partners.
Challenge engineering assumptions and supplier recommendations where necessary to ensure the strongest product outcome.
You do not need to personally engineer every component, but you must have the technical fluency and judgment to effectively lead and challenge internal teams, external engineers, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.
Sourcing & Manufacturing
Build and manage a high-performing network of factories, ODMs, component suppliers, engineering partners, and specialist manufacturers.
Develop strong direct relationships with China-based manufacturing and technology partners.
Lead supplier identification, qualification, RFQs, negotiations, tooling, production readiness, and manufacturing ramp.
Improve supplier performance, cost, quality, transparency, and supply-chain resilience.
Establish appropriate second-source strategies and reduce unnecessary dependency on individual suppliers or intermediaries.
Travel to China and other manufacturing locations as required.
New Product Introduction & Execution
Own the development process from concept through engineering, prototype, validation, EVT, DVT, PVT, tooling, pilot production, and mass production.
Improve the speed, predictability, and quality of Freebird's product development process.
Establish clear milestones, development gates, critical paths, risk management, and launch-readiness criteria.
Lead multiple concurrent hardware-development programs while maintaining strong execution discipline.
Quality, Reliability & Validation
Establish rigorous engineering, reliability, and consumer-validation standards.
Ensure products meet high standards for performance, durability, safety, usability, and customer experience.
Build strong processes around lifecycle testing, supplier quality, factory quality controls, failure analysis, and corrective actions.
Use consumer testing and competitive benchmarking to validate products before commercialization.
Drive continuous improvement based on customer feedback, returns, warranty data, and product performance.
Product Economics
Ensure products achieve strong customer outcomes while supporting competitive mass-market pricing and attractive economics.
Own or influence target COGS, BOM architecture, DFM/DFA, tooling economics, manufacturing yields, supplier negotiations, and value engineering.
Identify opportunities to improve cost without compromising product quality or customer experience.
Team & Partner Leadership
Lead and develop Freebird's product-development capabilities across engineering, sourcing, NPI, quality, program management, and manufacturing.
Build the right combination of internal talent and specialized external expertise.
Select and manage high-quality industrial design, engineering, testing, manufacturing, and technology partners.
Create organizational confidence through clear recommendations, strong technical judgment, and consistent execution.

jobs.title: Director of Data Management
jobs.text:
Founded by the Sisters of Charity of New York, the University of Mount Saint Vincent is an academically excellent, authentically inclusive, Catholic and ecumenical liberal arts university. The University combines a strong core curriculum with a full array of majors in the liberal arts and, within the tradition of liberal education, selected professional fields of study.
At Mount Saint Vincent, a student’s education extends beyond knowledge, skills, and preparation for work. We seek the development of the whole person. In the spirit of Vincent de Paul and Elizabeth Ann Seton, we foster an understanding of our common humanity, a commitment to human dignity, and a full appreciation of our obligations to each other.
Position Summary:
The Director of Data Management serves as the School of Nursing's lead administrator for data analytics, reporting, compliance, and institutional effectiveness. Working closely with the Dean and academic leadership, this position oversees the collection, management, analysis, and reporting of data related to student success, faculty productivity, program outcomes, accreditation, and regulatory compliance. The Director transforms complex data into actionable insights that support strategic planning, continuous quality improvement, accreditation activities, and evidence-based decision-making across the School of Nursing.
Responsibilities:
Accreditation, Compliance, and Regulatory Reporting
Manage data collection and reporting processes required for accreditation, state, and federal regulatory agencies.
Prepare and submit reports for organizations including the New York State Education Department (NYSED), Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE), and other regulatory bodies.
Monitor program outcomes, including retention, graduation, licensure and certification pass rates, employment outcomes, and student learning outcomes.
Ensure accuracy, integrity, and compliance of institutional data in accordance with FERPA, HIPAA, and university policies.
Maintain and validate data reported on School of Nursing websites, publications, and external reports.
Data Analytics and Strategic Decision Support
Develop dashboards, reports, and performance metrics that support academic and operational decision-making.
Analyze trends related to enrollment, retention, progression, graduation, licensure outcomes, faculty workload, and resource utilization.
Provide data analyses and reports to support strategic planning, budgeting, program development, and growth initiatives.
Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and operational effectiveness.
Data Systems Management
Oversee the integration and management of institutional and program-specific data systems.
Coordinate data collection, validation, and reporting across academic and administrative departments.
Develop efficient processes for data entry, retrieval, analysis, and reporting.
Maintain data dictionaries, reporting procedures, and documentation standards.
Evaluate and implement technologies that enhance reporting and analytics capabilities.
Training and Collaboration
Serve as a resource to faculty and staff on data reporting requirements, dashboards, and data management practices.
Provide training and support related to data systems and reporting tools.
Collaborate with university offices including Institutional Research, Information Technology, Admissions, Registrar, Finance, and Academic Affairs to ensure data quality and consistency.

jobs.title: Director of Hardware Engineering & Manufacturing
jobs.text:
About Us
InnerPlant is on a mission to transform farming as never before imagined: We give crops a voice by turning plants into living sensors that signal the onset of stress, enabling farmers to increase yields and reduce costs by optimizing inputs.
The Director of Hardware Engineering & Manufacturing is responsible for the hardware systems that power InnerPlant's commercial product, CropVoice. The CropVoice platform translates signals from our living sensors to pinpoint stress well before visible symptoms, giving farmers and agronomists critical and timely insights and removing the guesswork behind key in-season decisions. The Director owns the hardware product lifecycle—from architecture and engineering through prototyping, validation, manufacturing, deployment, and continuous improvement—as InnerPlant turns breakthrough technology into scalable, reliable products that can operate across millions of acres.
The Director of Hardware Engineering & Manufacturing will be based in Des Moines, IA, and reports to the Chief Operating Officer.
Your Role
As the Director of Hardware Engineering & Manufacturing, you will lead the development, production, and integration of the hardware behind CropVoice—working at the cutting edge of precision agriculture, electronics, optical sensing, mechanical design, and manufacturing. You will shape how InnerPlant's hardware function grows. As the CropVoice platform scales across crops and geographies, you will have the mandate to build and lead the hardware engineering organization. To achieve success, you will:
Lead hardware product design and development, including:
Owning the hardware engineering roadmap and system architecture for CropVoice's optical, electrical, embedded, mechanical, and data-acquisition systems;
Leading development from concept and rapid prototyping through design verification, validation, production, and field deployment;
Overseeing design of hardware that meets product and field requirements and operates reliably through heat, cold, moisture, dust, vibration, variable power conditions, long operating hours, and limited opportunities for maintenance;
Overseeing equipment operation to ensure the efficiency and reliability of CropVoice hardware and troubleshoot when needed; and
Using field data and customer feedback to continuously improve product performance.
Drive efficient and scalable manufacturing processes, including:
Owning the transition of hardware products from engineering prototypes into repeatable and scalable manufacturing, anchored in design-for-manufacturing and design-for-assembly practices;
Developing and managing relationships with contract manufacturers, suppliers, and strategic technology partners, and building scalable and cost-effective supply-chain strategies for critical components and assemblies;
Establishing manufacturing processes, quality standards, test procedures, and production controls, and leading root-cause analysis and corrective action for manufacturing and field failures; and
Establishing reliability and environmental testing programs and verification and validation strategies.
Build the hardware engineering team:
Establish engineering processes that enable rapid development without compromising product quality or reliability; and
Recruit, develop, mentor, and lead a high-performing hardware engineering team with clear technical ownership, accountability, priorities, and development processes.
What Makes You Stand Out
The successful Director of Hardware Engineering & Manufacturing is both a technical leader and a builder: someone who can establish engineering discipline while moving quickly, solve difficult problems personally when necessary, and work across the organization to turn ambitious technology into products that work reliably in the real world. In particular, you will have demonstrated the ability to:
Solve technically challenging projects with strategic management of people, programs, and resources and be willing to dive deeply into technical problems when needed.
Translate between highly technical disciplines and business objectives, working closely with software and data engineering, plant science and biotechnology, agronomy, product, commercial, and field operations teams so that hardware development remains tightly connected to customer value and commercial priorities.
Champion the company's mission to transform farming and create an engineering culture that values speed, technical excellence, experimentation, ownership, and learning.
Drive continuous improvement in product quality, cost, and reliability as InnerPlant's commercial footprint grows.

jobs.title: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
jobs.text:
📋 DESCRIPTION (About Norbloc + Why This Role Matters + What You'll Own)
Norbloc builds the trust infrastructure behind modern financial compliance. Our RegTech and blockchain platform powers Know Your Customer (KYC) and secure data-sharing for banks, financial institutions and government bodies, replacing slow, fragmented, manual onboarding with a shared, distributed-ledger-backed ecosystem that regulators, banks and customers can all rely on.
Our clients are not forgiving of shortcuts: systemic banks, regulators and government bodies across Europe and the Middle East operate under some of the strictest security, resilience and compliance standards in the industry. Building for them means every architectural choice has to hold up under real scrutiny.
We're now looking for a Chief Technology Officer to take that foundation and scale it, leading technology through Norbloc's next phase of growth.
Why This Role Matters Now
Norbloc sits where two worlds meet: the pace and ambition of blockchain and data innovation versus the risk tolerance of enterprise banking. Few technology leaders are fluent in both. This role exists to be that bridge, someone who can architect for scale and security, lead engineering teams through rapid growth and sit across the table from a bank's CIO or a regulator's compliance officer and speak their language fluently.
This is a board-level seat with real ownership: over architecture, over the technology organization and over how Norbloc is perceived by the institutions that matter most to our growth.
What You'll Own
Technology Strategy & Architecture
Set Norbloc's end-to-end technology strategy and multi-quarter roadmap, in step with company vision and enterprise client needs
Architect secure, cloud-native systems that bridge banking-grade infrastructure with blockchain/DLT, cryptography and modern data and AI capabilities
Own the platform's operating model, including SLAs, observability, incident response and on-call practices, to a standard that satisfies regulated financial clients, not just internal targets
Make build-vs-buy and vendor/platform calls backed by clear-eyed cost, scalability and governance analysis. Be willing to defend the "boring" choice when it's the right one
Data, Governance & Compliance
Build the data governance, lineage, metadata and quality foundations that make the platform auditable and trustworthy at scale
Own technology risk management and IT governance, including compliance with KYC/AML, data residency and audit requirements across our operating jurisdictions
Work with Compliance and external legal counsel so that technical decisions are made with regulatory consequences already priced in, not discovered afterward
Team & Delivery Leadership
Lead, mentor and scale Engineering, Data, DevOps and QA, building strong managers under you, not just individual contributors
Instill the delivery discipline that enterprise clients expect: code quality, CI/CD, testing rigor, predictable roadmaps
Take ownership of any externally delivered components and bring them fully in-house where it makes sense to do so
Executive & Client Engagement
Be Norbloc's senior technical voice to C-level executives, IT leadership and compliance officers at bank and government clients
Represent Norbloc's technology vision to investors, partners and prospective enterprise clients
Translate technical trade-offs (cost, risk, scalability) into terms a systemic bank's leadership can act on with confidence

jobs.title: Interior Designer/ Head of Product
jobs.text:
About SQ1 Living
SQ1 Living is the furniture and interiors arm of the Square One Group. We sell turnkey, whole-apartment furniture bundles — designed, delivered, assembled and staged in seven days — to buyers (increasingly overseas investors) who would otherwise spend three to six months sourcing furniture from a dozen separate suppliers across Cyprus.
One package, one price, one week, with a single warranty and a single point of contact.
The Role
This is the founding design hire and the first of two people who start the business. It is best understood as an FF&E Design Manager with a commercial side, rather than a pure interior designer: you specify and curate what SQ1 Living sells, but you also own its cost, margin and roadmap as a product. You define what the company actually sells — a small number of curated, fully-specified apartment packages rather than an open catalogue — and you own that product end-to-end, from supplier selection through to the visual assets customers buy from, through to the eventual transition to our own manufactured designs.
What You'll Do
Design and specify six to eight curated FF&E packages covering every room, across multiple unit sizes — furniture, lighting, rugs, textiles, art, styling and kitchenware.
Source, shortlist and negotiate directly with suppliers and factories; agree trade terms and order and approve samples.
Own each package as a product: cost it, price it, and manage the margin and trade-offs between design intent and commercial viability.
Produce or direct the visual assets (renders, styling, photography direction) that let a remote buyer purchase an apartment's worth of furniture having only seen it visualised online.
Set and hold the quality bar: sample approval and field testing in live rental units before any item enters a package.
Own the long-term roadmap from imported packages to SQ1's own manufactured product line, including early input on sourcing and tooling as the company moves toward direct production in Asia.
Partner closely with the Business Development Manager to keep packages priced, buildable and sellable.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
This role is on-site, 5 days a week, working from our Flatiron office in NYC.
About Seated
Seated exists to help restaurants thrive in an industry defined by thin margins and underutilized capacity. We connect thousands of restaurants with millions of high-intent diners through demand-driven pricing and rewards, helping restaurants fill empty tables, reach new guests, increase visit frequency, and drive profitable incremental revenue.
Since launching, billions of dollars in restaurant spend have flowed through Seated, and hundreds of millions of dollars in rewards have been paid to Seated consumers. Today, Seated operates across 20+ U.S. markets and continues to expand nationally.
Our core marketplace is thriving. Now, we’re focused on expanding the value Seated creates for restaurants and consumers and building the company’s next major growth engine.
See it for yourself: seatedapp.io (restaurant side) · getseated.seatedapp.io (diner side) · Seated on iOS · Seated on Android
Role Overview
Seated is hiring a VP of Product to own product strategy and execution across our consumer and restaurant businesses.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this person will be responsible for helping determine where Seated makes its next major product investment, strengthening critical parts of our underlying product infrastructure, and identifying new ways for product to drive growth.
This is a hands-on leadership role. We’re looking for someone who can operate credibly with executives and the board while staying close to the work - talking to customers, digging into data, writing requirements, testing ideas, and working directly with Design and Engineering to ship great products.
The VP of Product will lead a Product and Design team and work as a close partner to Engineering. Scope may expand based on the individual, potentially including Analytics, Consumer, or broader GM responsibilities.
Responsibilities
Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across Seated’s consumer and restaurant products
Partner with the CEO and executive team to identify, evaluate, and validate Seated’s next major product bets
Lead product discovery, customer research, experimentation, business-case development, and validation
Evaluate opportunities across consumer marketplace expansion, restaurant software, AI, and adjacent products
Strengthen critical product infrastructure, including merchant identification and transaction recognition
Partner closely with Engineering on technical tradeoffs, prioritization, and execution
Identify opportunities for product-led growth across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization
Build and lead a small, high-performing Product and Design team
Translate company strategy into a focused product roadmap with clear priorities and measurable outcomes
Develop a deep understanding of consumer behavior, restaurant operator needs, unit economics, and marketplace dynamics

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Personal Loans Growth
jobs.text:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.
We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.
We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.
About the Role
Upgrade is seeking a Director of Product Management to help drive the next phase of growth for our Personal Loans business. In this role, you’ll identify and develop high-impact growth opportunities across the customer journey — from acquisition and conversion to new loan programs, partnerships, market expansion, and deeper relationships with existing customers. You’ll operate as an individual contributor, working closely with Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Risk, Credit, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Operations. You’ll combine customer insights, data, and business economics to identify opportunities, build the case for investment, and lead cross-functional teams from strategy through execution. This is an ideal role for a highly analytical and commercially minded product leader who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and turning new ideas into measurable business results.
This is a hybrid role based in either our San Francisco, CA, or Wilmington, DE, office, with onsite work on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
What You’ll Do:
Own and evolve the growth product strategy for Personal Loans, identifying opportunities to grow funded volume, expand our addressable market, improve economics, and increase customer lifetime value.
Develop a deep understanding of the Personal Loans funnel, customer behavior, acquisition channels, credit and fraud constraints, and key drivers of business performance.
Identify, size, and prioritize new growth opportunities, including new loan programs, customer segments, credit capabilities, distribution partnerships, and conversion improvements.
Partner closely with Marketing to connect product strategy with acquisition, customer segmentation, lifecycle marketing, and channel performance.
Partner with Partnerships to identify new distribution opportunities, develop partner-specific experiences, and improve performance across existing relationships.
Work with Risk, Credit, Finance, and Analytics to evaluate opportunities based on customer impact, credit performance, economics, and incremental profitability.
Lead high-impact initiatives that span multiple product and functional teams, creating alignment and driving execution from concept through launch.
Use experimentation, customer research, competitive insights, and data to identify growth constraints and uncover new opportunities.
Define clear hypotheses and success metrics, evaluate performance after launch, and determine where to iterate, scale, or change direction.
Serve as a senior thought partner to Personal Loans leadership on product strategy, prioritization, and investment decisions.
What We Look For:
9+ years of product management experience, including experience operating at a Principal or Director level and a track record of driving meaningful business outcomes.
Proven ability to identify growth opportunities and translate ambiguous problems into clear product strategies, prioritized roadmaps, and successful products.
Strong analytical and commercial instincts, with experience using data to understand customer behavior, conversion funnels, unit economics, and business tradeoffs.
Experience in consumer lending, credit cards, fintech, or another data-intensive consumer financial product strongly preferred.
Experience partnering closely with Marketing, Growth, Business Development, or Partnerships teams.
Familiarity with credit decisioning, payments, funding infrastructure, or loan origination is a plus.
Strong quantitative skills and comfort with experimentation, financial analysis, funnel analytics, and SQL.
Ability to understand and navigate tradeoffs across growth, customer experience, risk, fraud, compliance, and economics.
Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Risk, Finance, and other functions without direct authority.
Experience working with external partners or vendors to develop and test new capabilities is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex problems, develop compelling business cases, and create alignment around strategic decisions.
High degree of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment.
Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, quantitative, or technical degree a plus.
What We Offer You:
Competitive salary and stock option plan
Paid coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible PTO
Opportunities for professional growth and development
Paid parental leave
Health & wellness initiatives
The compensation range for this position is USD $190,000–$250,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. An individual’s base salary within this range will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience.
Environmental & Working Conditions
Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.
Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.
The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.
Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.
Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.
Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement. English is required for all positions, as it involves interacting with staff at Upgrade's offices worldwide.

Strong quantitative skills and comfort with experimentation, financial analysis, funnel analytics, and SQL.

Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Risk, Finance, and other functions without direct authority.
Experience working with external partners or vendors to develop and test new capabilities is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex problems, develop compelling business cases, and create alignment around strategic decisions.
High degree of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment.
Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, quantitative, or technical degree a plus.
