jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
Reports to:
Chief Product Officer
Location:
United States
About Ottimate
Ottimate is an AI-native accounts payable (AP) automation and payments platform serving mid-market, multi-location operators across hospitality, healthcare, grocery and retail, and client accounting services (CAS). We help finance teams capture, code, approve, and pay invoices with AI handling the repetitive work — across AP automation, Vendor Pay payments, and spend management.
We're PE-backed (FTV Partners) and moving fast toward a more autonomous, agentic future for B2B finance. It's a great time to join and own real surface area early.
About The Role
You'll own the strategy and roadmap for Ottimate's newest product initiatives — the categories that extend our platform beyond AP automation and into the rest of the purchasing lifecycle. This portfolio includes procurement, budgeting and spend planning, contract management, and adjacent capabilities that connect what our customers buy to what they ultimately pay. These are 0-to-1 and early-stage products: you'll define the vision, validate it with customers, and take it to market.
This role also leads our Design and UX function. You'll manage product managers and designers as one team, setting a high bar for craft and ensuring that new products feel coherent, intuitive, and unmistakably Ottimate from day one.
This is a leadership role. You'll set direction for the new-initiatives portfolio, manage and grow a team of product managers and designers, and partner directly with engineering, data science, and go-to-market to expand what Ottimate does for the finance teams who depend on us.
Responsibilities
Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ottimate's new-initiatives portfolio, including procurement, budgeting and spend planning, and contract management.
Lead customer discovery and market validation for new product categories — identify the problems worth solving, size the opportunity, and build the business case for investment.
Take new products from concept through launch: define MVPs, set success metrics, and iterate quickly based on customer and market feedback.
Manage, mentor, and grow a team of product managers and designers; set clear goals, develop talent, and build a culture of craft and accountability.
Lead the Design and UX function — own design quality, consistency, and the evolution of Ottimate's design system across new and existing products.
Partner with engineering and data science leadership on prioritization, sequencing, and delivery; ensure the team ships predictably against committed milestones.
Collaborate with sales, marketing, and customer success on positioning, pricing inputs, launch readiness, and early customer adoption.
Define and track portfolio-level metrics; use data to make build/kill/pivot decisions and communicate progress to executive leadership.
Represent the voice of the customer in executive planning, and represent the product externally with customers, prospects, and partners.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Location: Bangalore, India (Hybrid) — regular travel expected, primarily to China, with occasional travel to the UK
Department: Technology
WHO WE ARE
At Acclaro, we're more than a localization company — we're a content intelligence solutions company, and a global team of language enthusiasts, cultural connectors, and technology innovators. Our mission is to help brands speak the world's languages and resonate deeply across cultures by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology, delivered through a follow-the-sun model that keeps our teams moving around the clock and around the globe.
With over two decades of experience, we support some of the world's most recognizable brands in expanding their global reach. And we're scaling: we've been making material investments in our own AI-native platform, one that's already reshaping how our business — and the localization industry more broadly — works. Join us on our journey to be the model localization company of the next decade, one that's loved by clients, colleagues, and communities alike.
YOUR NEXT ROLE
As VP of Engineering, you'll lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of Acclaro's technology organization with the visibility and mandate to shape engineering as a core driver of the business. You'll lead a globally distributed engineering team across China and India.
You're joining at a pivotal moment, Acclaro is undergoing a major structural transformation, building our own proprietary AI platform to stay competitive, and evolving into a truly tech-enabled company. This role sits at the center of that shift — you'll help build new technology from the ground up while keeping our existing systems running reliably through the transition.
This is not a delegation-only leadership position. You'll stay connected to architecture, technical decision-making, and day-to-day engineering reality while building high-performing global teams. If you thrive at the intersection of technology, leadership, and business impact, and want the kind of ownership that comes from building something rather than inheriting it, this is that opportunity.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Lead the engineering organization, providing strategic direction while staying hands-on in architecture, system design, and technical decision-making — including participating directly in code reviews and technical debugging when it matters
Lead the build-out of Acclaro's new proprietary AI platform alongside the modernization of existing systems, balancing green-field development with operational continuity through a major technology transformation
Partner with Product, Design, and business leaders to translate company priorities into scalable execution plans and technology roadmaps
Drive architectural reviews and major technology decisions, balancing innovation, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability
Establish and continuously improve engineering standards, development practices, CI/CD processes, and quality frameworks
Own engineering performance, reliability, uptime, delivery predictability, and platform health through measurable goals and KPIs
Build, develop, and mentor engineering leaders, creating clear career paths, growth opportunities, and succession plans across the organization
Lead workforce planning, organizational design, and hiring for critical engineering leadership and senior technical positions
Be personally present during major incidents — not just briefed afterward — and own disaster recovery planning, security readiness, and business continuity
Manage engineering budgets, infrastructure investments, vendor relationships, and build-versus-buy decisions
Ensure technology practices align with security, privacy, and data protection requirements across global markets
Represent engineering at the executive level, providing visibility into progress, risks, capacity, and investment priorities
Serve as a trusted technical voice with clients, partners, and external stakeholders when required
THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF YOU
Have 10+ years in engineering leadership, including 5+ years at the senior executive level
Hold a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience
Bring a strong, current technical foundation that lets you engage confidently in architecture discussions, technical reviews, and critical production incidents — not just receive summaries of them
Have a proven track record building and scaling enterprise-grade platforms or integrated technology ecosystems
Are experienced with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), APIs, microservices, and modern development practices like CI/CD
Bring expertise integrating enterprise systems such as TMS, CMS, CRM, or workflow automation tools
Have led distributed engineering teams across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones, and thrive leading remote, globally distributed teams
Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments where strategy and execution go hand-in-hand
Are an exceptional communicator who can adapt complex technical concepts for executive, customer, and non-technical audiences, and who leads with clarity and empathy
YOU’LL STAND OUT IF YOU
Have hands-on experience with localization technologies or global content platforms
Bring knowledge of AI/ML-driven automation and its application to localization or content workflows
Have led modernization projects that transformed legacy systems into scalable, integrated solutions
Are multilingual or have deep experience working across distributed, multicultural teams
Understand global compliance and security frameworks such as GDPR, SOC 2, or ISO certifications
Have launched and scaled a new platform within a transformative business environment
INCLUSION & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY - Acclaro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

jobs.title: Field CTO, Public Sector
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As a Field CTO, Public Sector at GitLab, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor for public sector customers and prospects, helping them connect DevSecOps strategy, security, and compliance goals to real business and mission outcomes. You will work closely with executive stakeholders during the pre-sales process, offering strategic guidance on how GitLab can support secure software delivery, modernization efforts, and platform adoption across complex environments.
In this role, you will combine technical depth with executive communication. You will build relationships with leaders such as Chief Information Security Officers, Chief Security Officers, Chief Technology Officers, and chief security architects, while also partnering across GitLab with sales, marketing, and product teams. Your perspective from the field will help shape customer conversations, influence go-to-market strategy, and inform how GitLab continues to serve public sector organizations.
Note: This is an individual contributor, customer-facing technical advisory role; it does not include direct people management responsibilities.
This role is well suited for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology strategy, customer engagement, and market leadership. You will help customers understand the value of a single DevSecOps platform, contribute to industry conversations around standards and guidance, and represent GitLab in a way that reflects our values of transparency, collaboration, and results.
Some examples of our projects:
Supporting strategic public sector opportunities with executive-level DevSecOps and security guidance
Contributing to government working groups, standards discussions, and public sector thought leadership content
What you'll do
Engage with customers in a technical consulting and advisory role during the pre-sales process, providing technical assistance and strategic guidance.
Deliver executive-level thought leadership on DevSecOps, security, and compliance for strategic public sector opportunities, including new and growth accounts.
Build and maintain relationships with customer leaders such as Chief Information Security Officers, Chief Security Officers, Chief Technology Officers, and chief security architects.
Partner with the marketing team to develop content and support media engagement opportunities that increase awareness of GitLab in the public sector market.
Educate customers on the value of the GitLab platform and related technologies, and support conversations across multiple levels of the organization to help enable successful deployment.
Assist with requests for information and responses related to government publications and public-private partnership opportunities.
Participate in and contribute to working groups connected to government publications, standards, and demonstrations.
Curate and communicate public sector field feedback, collaborate on prioritization with marketing and product teams, and contribute to sales strategy, playbooks, enablement, and reusable technical content for the field.
What you'll bring
Demonstrated expertise in DevSecOps strategy, application security, and compliance for regulated environments, including providing risk-based guidance.
Experience selling to, supporting, or working within the public sector.
Experience creating and delivering technical thought leadership content (presentations, demos, written materials) independently.
Working knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including CI/CD and modern engineering and operations practices.
Experience with cloud computing and modern platform architectures that support secure software delivery.
Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical strategy effectively to audiences ranging from executives to engineers.
Comfort working in a fully remote, distributed, and asynchronous environment.
Ability to coordinate across time zones and adapt schedules to customer and internal stakeholder needs.
Experience in technical pre-sales, consulting, solutions architecture, or comparable customer-facing IT roles, including using GitLab (and willingness to learn quickly) to support customer conversations and demonstrations.
Living in the Washington D.C. Metro area preferred
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by applicable law.
About the team
The Field CTO, Public Sector role works across customer-facing and internal teams to help GitLab meet the needs of public sector organizations with clarity, credibility, and deep technical insight. This role partners closely with sales, solutions, marketing, and product stakeholders to represent customer priorities, strengthen technical strategy in the field, and support GitLab's position in a highly regulated and mission-driven market.
The team environment is collaborative, remote, and asynchronous, with a strong focus on sharing knowledge and turning field insight into action. The work is especially meaningful because it brings together executive advisory skills, platform expertise, and an understanding of security and compliance expectations that matter in public sector environments. Success in this role comes from being able to translate complex technical topics into clear guidance, while also helping GitLab improve how we serve this market over time.
At GitLab, you'll do this work in a values-driven culture built on collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.
How GitLab will support you
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental leave
Home office support

If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

jobs.text:
About Us
Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.
Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.
The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.
At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.
About The Position: As the Vice President of Product – EOR at G-P, you will be the executive product leader responsible for the commercial growth, portfolio strategy, market expansion, and product scale of our flagship EOR business. This leader will identify and drive the highest-impact product opportunities to accelerate revenue growth, customer expansion, retention, and competitive differentiation. Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, you sit at the strategic intersection of executive vision and commercial scale, leading a multi-pillar product organization by steering senior functional leaders—including the Sr. Director of Core EOR Product and the Head of Integrations & Partner Development.
In this high-impact executive role, you will serve as the executive product lead driving commercial growth of our flagship EOR business. You will partner with executive peers across Revenue, Partnerships, Legal, Operations, and Engineering to ensure our product portfolio aligns with growth priorities, customer needs, distribution strategy, optimizes unit economics, and positively influences overall financial performance.
What You Will Do:
Product Growth Strategy: Partner with the CPO to translate corporate strategy into a cohesive EOR growth and portfolio thesis, identifying the highest-impact opportunities across core EOR, enterprise capabilities, AI, integrations, partnerships, and new distribution models, and directing investment toward the strongest revenue, retention, and margin outcomes.
Customer & Market Growth: Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, buyer priorities, competitive dynamics, and market opportunities, translating these insights into product strategies that drive acquisition, expansion, retention, and increased product adoption.
Business Performance: Establish and drive clear product outcomes across revenue growth, customer expansion, retention, adoption, activation, time-to-value, and gross margin, ensuring product investment translates into measurable business performance.
AI Transformation: Define the executive strategy for leveraging AI and agentic capabilities across the platform portfolio to fundamentally improve gross margins, accelerate operational velocity, and create structural product differentiation.
Executive Alignment: Serve as the primary product peer to executive leaders in Partnerships, Revenue, Global Operations, Legal, and Marketing to harmonize go-to-market execution, channel product enablement, and customer experience.
Organizational Leadership: Scale and empower a multi-tiered product organization, managing Sr. Directors and Directors to foster deep commercial rigor, operational accountability, and cross-functional velocity across distinct product pillars.
Margin Optimization: Positively influence unit economics and gross margin performance through platform automation, self-service capabilities, operational efficiency gains, and high-margin growth models.
Executive Market Leadership: Act as the senior product executive with key enterprise customers, prospects, strategic partners, and industry stakeholders, using direct market engagement to shape product strategy, unlock growth opportunities, and strengthen G-P’s competitive position.
What We Are Looking For:
Executive Leadership: 15+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, HR Tech, FinTech, Global Mobility, or Global Payroll platforms, with multiple years in executive leadership (VP level) managing multi-pillar product organizations.
Commercial Acumen: Proven experience identifying and executing product-led growth opportunities that drive revenue, expansion, and retention. Ideally, experience taking an already scaled, high-growth product to its next level of growth. Strong understanding of SaaS unit economics, margin expansion levers, partner monetization structures, and how product portfolio decisions influence financial performance.
Team Leadership: Demonstrated success managing and scaling senior product leaders (Sr. Directors / Directors) across distinct functional product domains.
Customer & Market Orientation: Proven ability to translate customer, buyer, and competitive insights into product strategies that drive market share, adoption, expansion, and retention.
AI Strategy: Strategic vision for leveraging AI, agentic systems, and automation to drive enterprise business transformation, margin expansion, and platform leverage.
Executive Influence: Exceptional executive presence with a track record of driving strategic consensus alongside executive peers across Sales, Revenue, Partnerships, Operations, Legal, and Engineering.
Domain Context: High-level strategic understanding of complex, highly regulated multi-jurisdictional SaaS platforms, global HR tech, or compliance-driven enterprise software.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related technical field; MBA or equivalent executive experience strongly preferred.

Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.
Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary.

G-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more.

jobs.title: Design Director
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
VML Detroit is seeking an award-winning Design Director to serve as the visual lead across a major automotive account. In this role, you will elevate both big-picture brand storytelling and day-to-day creative output across all workstreams, including Brand, Retail, and Services. You will maintain graphic standards while pushing visual boundaries across global campaigns, retail communications, and digital touchpoints for an iconic American brand.
You are a hands-on leader skilled in brand design, digital experiences, motion graphics, and next-gen AI video generation. Partnering closely with creative teams, you will oversee visual quality across all deliverables to ensure exceptional craft. You must bring strong presentation skills, a passion for mentoring, and hands-on experience building case studies, award submissions, and executive pitch decks.
What you’ll do:
Craft | You’ll lead design territories and set the visual benchmark for major brand campaigns from concept through final execution. You will be directly hands-on in crafting visual languages, brand systems, advanced typography, motion graphics, and leveraging next-gen AI video generation tools to explore cutting-edge concepts. You will oversee all creative output across various account workstreams (including Retail and Automotive Financial Services), ensuring strict adherence to graphic standards while continually elevating the overall look and feel.
Collaborate | You’ll partner closely with workstream leads to integrate visual storytelling seamlessly across every channel. You’ll inspire the team to push creative boundaries, explore innovative visual techniques, and raise the bar on daily output. You will also lead the design of award show case studies, agency reels, and high-stakes executive presentations that showcase our best work on a global stage.
Partner | You will serve as a trusted visual design authority for internal leadership and senior client partners. You’ll articulate complex design choices with authority and clarity, advocate for visual innovation, and champion design excellence across every brief. Additionally, you will assist with recruitment, portfolio screening, and mentoring senior and mid-level design talent.
Who you are:
Visual Master & Master Typographer | You possess an exceptional eye for visual aesthetics, layout, grid systems, and typography. You see design as a fundamental storytelling tool and have a proven track record of creating iconic visual work on a global scale. You are fluent in static, interactive, and motion design, with an active mastery or deep exploration of emerging technologies like AI video generation.
Hands-On Leader & Craft Obsessor | You don’t just direct from a distance—you roll up your sleeves and lead by example. You are obsessed with the details, from pixel-perfect UI and motion keyframes to brand guidelines and production fidelity, ensuring that both high-profile campaign work and daily retail assets maintain an award-winning standard of craft.
Inspiring Storyteller & Presenter | You excel at presenting design concepts, building persuasive pitch decks, and crafting compelling case studies that win awards and executive buy-in. You have an infectious passion for design that motivates creative teams to take risks, innovate, and produce career-defining work.
What you’ll need:
A minimum of 7+ years specializing in visual design, brand design, and art direction within a progressive, top-tier creative agency or global design studio.
An award-winning portfolio featuring iconic work and absolute mastery of craft, typography, brand identity systems, motion design, and digital experiences.
Hands-on expertise in design applications (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, After Effects/motion software) and demonstrated experience using or directing next-gen AI image and video generation tools.
Proven experience overseeing visual work across diverse brand touchpoints, including brand campaigns, retail, and financial services divisions.
Demonstrated track record of upholding, evolving, and maintaining brand graphic standards across large-scale accounts.
Proven ability to build and deliver compelling presentations, award show submissions, and case studies.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate design decisions clearly and confidently to executive clients and internal partners.
Strong leadership, collaboration, and mentorship abilities to inspire a multi-disciplinary creative department.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to VML. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Agentic Software Delivery
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Today, these are separate stages with a human making the call at each handoff. As agents take on more coding, pipeline, and deployment work, you'll set the three-year vision for how much of that judgment the system can make safely and how quickly a production signal can turn into a fix without waiting for a human to notice it first. You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.
What you’ll do
Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.
Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.
Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.
Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.
A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.
Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.
Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.
Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.
Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.
Executive-level communication and influence.
Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.
About the team
The team brings together senior product leaders across GitLab's software delivery platform and works closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market partners so customers experience these capabilities as one connected system. The team helps customers manage today's delivery complexity while shaping how AI-powered and AI-native workflows influence the next generation of software delivery. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, the team collaborates asynchronously across regions with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decision-making.

blocks.text: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

An overview of this role

As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Today, these are separate stages with a human making the call at each handoff. As agents take on more coding, pipeline, and deployment work, you'll set the three-year vision for how much of that judgment the system can make safely and how quickly a production signal can turn into a fix without waiting for a human to notice it first. You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.
What you’ll do

items: Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.
Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.

Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.

Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.

Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.

blocks.text: What you’ll bring

items: Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.
A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.
Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.
Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.
Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.
Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.
Executive-level communication and influence.

Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on, and battle-tested Head of Engineering to lead our core engineering teams as we scale our real-time verification and decision engines across Southeast Asia. In this role, you will bridge high-level system architecture with deep operational rigor.
You are not an abstract manager—you are an active technical leader who regularly participates in system design reviews, inspects critical PRs, fine-tunes performance bottlenecks, and drives incident management alongside your team. You will set the high mark for execution speed, engineering craftsmanship, system resilience, and clear communication across cross-functional product and business units.
Key Responsibilities
Lead system design, high-availability architecture, and API scalability across microservices, eKYC/eKYB pipelines, and database infrastructure.
Debug high-severity production incidents, conduct root-cause analysis, and improve database efficiency, lock contention, and system latency.
Lead live system migrations and zero-downtime maintenance strategies, including dual-write backfills and atomic cutovers.
Establish engineering guardrails around secure coding, security, and AI-assisted code generation.
Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, and precision.
Establish standard operating procedures for incident response, security compliance, continuous deployment, and logging.
Communicate complex technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders.
Ensure compliance with regional privacy and security requirements, including PDPA and GDPR.
Oversee identity management, automated testing, edge-case analysis, and third-party data integrations.

jobs.title: Sr. Director of Manufacturing, New Product Introduction
jobs.text:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.
OUR MISSION
True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.
OUR VALUES
Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.
YOUR MISSION
True Anomaly is seeking a Senior Director of Manufacturing, New Product Introduction to own how our new product lines get built, translating product designs into fully operational, qualified production lines that deliver quality hardware at rate. This individual will build the facilities, teams, and manufacturing processes required to industrialize new products, serving as the connective tissue between engineering, programs, and facilities.
This is a fast-paced, dynamic role with broad scope and deep technical content. The right person thrives in ambiguity, builds systems where none exist, and leaves behind durable teams, culture, and best practices across manufacturing and test.
Key Responsibilities
Own accountability for how new products are manufactured, from influencing a product design through a completed, qualified production line producing quality products at rate.
Develop and mature production processes, defining, specifying and building manufacturing and test equipment required for each new product line.
Design and stand up manufacturing and testing facilities to support new product introduction.
Collaborate with Facilities on near- and long-term facility requirements for manufacturing, including facility design, production flow, equipment requirements, and equipment maintenance plans.
Build teams from the ground up, defining the near term organizational structure required to set the foundation, hiring, and developing talent across manufacturing and test disciplines.
Establish culture, processes, and lasting best practices spanning manufacturing and test operations.
Partner closely with Engineering to translate design and quality specifications into manufacturable, testable processes.
Collaborate with Programs to forecast production rate requirements and align capacity to demand.
Transition mature, qualified production lines to the production organization for ongoing operations and continuous improvement.
Qualifications
12+ years of manufacturing experience, including extensive new product introduction and production ramp leadership, with a track record of leading at the director level or above.
Demonstrated success standing up multiple production lines and/or manufacturing facilities from concept to full-rate production.
Strong technical background—an engineering degree or hands-on technical experience in manufacturing environments.
Strong background in production process development, equipment definition, and manufacturing/test operations.
Proven ability to build, scale, and lead multi-disciplinary organizations, including hiring leaders and developing talent at scale.
Executive-level cross-functional collaboration skills across engineering, program management, and facilities.
Deep understanding of quality systems and translating design specifications into repeatable, high-quality production.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth, ambiguous environment with significant autonomy and ownership.
Experience in aerospace, defense, or other complex, high-reliability hardware environments strongly preferred.
Preferred
Bachelor's or Master's in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
Experience with rate-driven manufacturing and capacity planning.
Lean/Six Sigma or equivalent operational excellence expertise.
COMPENSATION
Base Salary: $180,000-$285,000
Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave
Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Denver or Long Beach. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.
Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.
Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.
This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite
To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us.

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
At ITRS, we make society’s critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.
We believe when our team thrives, so do our customers. With us, you’ll find:
• A culture that backs you – We’re proud to be a Great Place to Work for multiple years in a row due to our inclusive, supportive environment.
• Work that matters – Make a real difference with 1,000s of global customers in industries that keep the world running, including 9 out of 10 top investment banks.
• Room to grow – Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, we’re committed to your development. Just ask our team members who’ve been excelling here for 10+ years.
With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity–backed global partner
Scope
ITRS is looking for an experienced and accomplished, or aspiring, Director of Platform Engineering to join our collaborative and inclusive team. Reporting to our Global Head of Platform Engineering, this is a hybrid-working role, typically requiring 2 days per week in the office. The role will also include leadership of our Forward Deployed Engineers, ensuring this team is closely aligned with platform engineering practices, customer delivery priorities and operational standards.
The ITRS engineering teams are building a next-generation observability platform with the capability to collect, store and analyse the vast amount of data generated by banks and financial institutions.

jobs.title: Director of Product, AI
jobs.text:
The Elevator Pitch:
Evolv Technology is looking for a Director of Product, AI, a senior individual contributor who will work at the center of our AI engineering and research teams to build the industry's best weapons detection and computer vision capabilities. You will get deep into the mechanics of how we collect data, define annotation standards, evaluate models, run field trials, and deploy detection systems into the real world, translating that work into product decisions to keep people safe.
You will embed directly with AI engineering as the product lead for our detection capabilities, operating with the technical depth to make and defend decisions about data, models, and evaluation methodology.
What Winning Looks Like
In the first 30 days, you will: Pressure-test how we collect data, set annotation standards, evaluate models, and run field trials. Come back with a sharp read on the biggest gaps, risks, and decisions, and a plan to move on them.
Within 90 days, you will: Ship a prioritized data collection strategy across the scenarios and threats that matter most. Lock annotation, dataset quality, and validation standards with AI engineering. Define the release-readiness bar, including accuracy, false positive/negative rates, latency, throughput, and real-world load, then get alignment on it. Turn field-trial results into real product and model decisions. Build the operating cadence and decision framework that keeps detection performance moving.
Within 6 months, you will: Own detection. You're the accountable product lead driving data priorities, model evaluation, release readiness, trade-offs, in lockstep with AI engineering and research. Shape the roadmap, balancing performance against latency, compute cost, hardware limits, and customer experience. Make sure every external claim about detection performance is accurate and defensible, and push hard with legal and compliance to get there.
By the end of the first year, you will: Demonstrate measurable improvement in detection performance and release predictability across priority use cases. Show that the operating mechanisms you established are consistently identifying performance gaps, driving timely decisions, and improving deployed models. Influence the longer-term detection roadmap through clear evidence about customer needs, technical trade-offs, and business impact.
What you’ll own
AI/ML Lifecycle Ownership
Define data collection strategy: what scenarios, environments, and threat types need more or better training data
Own annotation guidelines in partnership with AI engineering
Partner with AI engineering on training methodology and validation approach
Define and own model evaluation metrics specific to weapons detection (false positive/negative rates, detection latency, throughput under real-world load) and the standards for when a model is ready to ship
Design and run field trials with prospects and customers; use real-world trial results for product iteration
Product & Technical Strategy
Collaborate closely with AI researchers and engineers to define product vision and technical roadmaps
Evaluate diverse AI models and technical approaches to select the optimal solution for specific security challenges
Analyze trade-offs across latency, accuracy, compute cost, and hardware constraints, and make explicit decisions
Oversee feature development from early experimentation through full production deployment
Work with design and product teams to integrate AI capabilities into intuitive customer- and operator-facing workflows
Partner with legal/compliance on how detection performance is represented externally to customers and the market
What We’re Looking For
8+ years of product management experience, including ownership of AI, machine learning, or computer vision products from strategy through production
Experience bringing AI or computer vision systems to production in security, safety-critical, or other detection applications where accuracy and reliability matter
Strong understanding of AI and computer vision architectures, model evaluation, data pipelines, and technical trade-offs
Experience defining data collection, annotation, validation, and dataset quality standards
Experience deploying and improving ML systems on physical or edge hardware
Track record of leading cross-functional decisions across research, engineering, field operations, legal, and customer-facing teams
Ability to translate technical complexity and business constraints into clear product decisions and priorities
Experience designing field trials and using customer and performance data to inform product and release decisions
Bonus points: experience with regulatory/compliance considerations around representing AI performance externally; embedded or edge hardware background; time spent in physical security, public safety, or critical infrastructure.
Leadership, Team Structure & Culture
You will report directly to the Chief Product Officer and operate as an individual contributor within the Product organization. This role will work closely with cross-functional partners and require travel to customer sites and field-trial locations to gather insights, support testing, and help translate real-world needs into product decisions.
The team's culture is high-accountability, candid, and action-oriented: risks are surfaced early, decisions are driven to closure, and individuals are expected to take ownership of outcomes. You will have meaningful autonomy and visibility, with the opportunity to directly influence Evolv’s product strategy and execution.
Where is the role located?
Our ideal candidate is based out of Evolv’s HQ in Waltham, Massachusetts, with limited flexibility for remote work. We may consider exceptional candidates who are based elsewhere. Domestic travel is expected to be approximately 25% to customer sites and field-trial locations.
Compensation and Transparency Statement
The base salary range for this full-time position is $162,000- $258,000. In addition to base salary, this role offers a competitive target bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and equity, in alignment with applicable state laws. Our compensation ranges are determined based on factors such as role, level, location, market benchmarks, and internal equity. The posted range represents the good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role across U.S. locations. Actual compensation within the range will be based on the candidate’s skills, experience, education, and geographic location.
In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws—including those in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, New York, New Jersey, and others—we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request.
We are committed to fair pay practices, and we regularly review our compensation programs to ensure they are competitive, equitable, and aligned with our values.

Oversee feature development from early experimentation through full production deployment
Work with design and product teams to integrate AI capabilities into intuitive customer- and operator-facing workflows

blocks.text: Partner with legal/compliance on how detection performance is represented externally to customers and the market
What We’re Looking For

items: 8+ years of product management experience, including ownership of AI, machine learning, or computer vision products from strategy through production
Experience bringing AI or computer vision systems to production in security, safety-critical, or other detection applications where accuracy and reliability matter
Strong understanding of AI and computer vision architectures, model evaluation, data pipelines, and technical trade-offs
Experience defining data collection, annotation, validation, and dataset quality standards
Experience deploying and improving ML systems on physical or edge hardware
Track record of leading cross-functional decisions across research, engineering, field operations, legal, and customer-facing teams
Ability to translate technical complexity and business constraints into clear product decisions and priorities

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering
jobs.text:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment. We are hiring a Sr. Director of Engineering to lead the people, systems, and practices behind reliable products.
Why it matters: This leader will develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders while closely guiding teams using AI to build and experiment. Working closely with the CTO, you will turn company technology direction into clear engineering decisions and execution.
Go deeper: The role spans engineering across Axios products, platforms, and workflows, from our CMS and axios.com to newsletters, Local products, internal tools, and systems supporting the Newsroom and business teams. Product, Newsroom, and business leaders set the goals. Engineering builds the systems and capabilities that help achieve them. The right leader will speed decisions, shorten the path from idea to product, spot risks early, and escalate issues before they grow. Responsibilities include:
Partner closely with the CTO and engineering leaders to shape engineering strategy and technical direction.
Lead and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, supporting clear accountability and a healthy culture. Develop and retain strong talent, and hire thoughtfully as needs evolve.
Strengthen planning, delivery, quality, and reliability. Help teams make faster decisions, move ideas into products, spot risks, and escalate issues early.
Partner with Product, Design, Newsroom, and business leaders to turn priorities into technical plans and match engineering capacity to the most important work.
Bring strong judgment to architecture, platforms, and reliability, especially when tradeoffs span teams.
Own the operating standards, guidelines, and practices that help engineering teams plan, build, test, release, operate, and learn effectively.
Establish shared benchmarks and baselines for engineering health.
Lead vendor evaluation and selection for engineering tools, platforms, and services, balancing capability, cost, security, reliability, support, and long-term fit.
Help define modern engineering leadership inside an AI-native media company and shape how Axios builds, learns, and delivers at speed.
Worthy of your time: This leader must be a close partner to the CTO and senior leaders who can explain technical details clearly and dive deep with engineers on technical and architectural questions. Success means faster decisions, a shorter path from idea to product, strong engineering leadership, reliable systems, and an organization that sees around corners. What we’re looking for:
You have led and developed engineering managers and senior technical leaders, setting clear expectations and addressing performance directly.
You have helped teams use AI to improve how they build, test, and operate software and to experiment with new product capabilities.
You translate technical details for executives and nontechnical partners while going deep with engineers on technical and architectural questions.
You quickly understand unfamiliar areas, ask the right questions, and know when to bring in expertise, invest in platforms, simplify systems, or accept a short-term tradeoff.
Ideally, you have led teams responsible for high-traffic digital products and the platforms behind them.
You have a strong vision for how AI and technology will change engineering practices, product development, platforms, and internal workflows.
Starting salary for this role is in the range of $250,000 - $270,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.
Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.
What Axios brings to the table besides salary:
401(k) with employer match
Robust PPO and high-deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high-deductible health plan option
Dental and vision coverage
Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave
Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
One mental health day per quarter
Annual learning and development stipend
$100 monthly work-from-home stipend
Tele-mental health services through Headspace
OneMedical membership, including telehealth services
Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate
Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family-forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
Access to the Axios “Family Fund”, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies
Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers
Virtual company-sponsored social events
A strong and positive work environment
A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture
Equal Opportunity Employer Statement
Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.title: Venture Lead / Head of Gtrons (Product and Commercial)
jobs.text:
Gtrons is a joint venture between 2 main market listed companies - Solarvest Holdings Berhad and Agmo Holdings Berhad, formed to build the region's clean energy superapp: a single digital platform through which households and businesses discover, adopt, manage and pay for clean energy products and services.
Two solutions are already in market and form the foundation of the platform:
PowerBee — an electric vehicle charging platform serving site owners and drivers.
Vestech — a residential solar solution for homeowners.
The mandate is to grow both into profitable businesses, add further clean energy solutions to the platform over time, and extend the platform beyond Malaysia into the wider region.
This role exists to run that business. The successful candidate carries commercial accountability for the joint venture, owns the direction of the platform, and holds the appointed technology partner to account for delivery. It is a general management role with a strong product core, suited to someone who wants to build a category-defining business from an early base rather than administer an established one.
.
Key Responsibilities
.
1. Commercial Ownership and Financial Performance
Hold full profit and loss accountability for the joint venture, covering revenue, gross margin, operating cost and cash position.
Own and deliver the annual revenue and profitability targets approved by the Board, with quarterly forecasting and clear explanation of variance.
Build and maintain the operating budget; control spend against approved envelopes and seek Board approval for material variances.
Own the unit economics of every solution — cost to acquire, cost to serve and contribution margin — and drive them toward agreed targets.
2. Channel Partnerships and Market Development
Identify, negotiate and manage channel and distribution partnerships that give the platform reach across the clean energy value chain.
Structure commercial terms for partnerships — revenue share, exclusivity, service levels — and manage partner performance against them.
Develop the approach to markets beyond Malaysia, including partner selection, market-entry sequencing and the business case for each market.
Represent the joint venture externally with regulators, industry bodies and the wider clean energy ecosystem.
3. Customer Acquisition and Pricing
Own the customer acquisition strategy across all solutions, with accountability for acquisition volume, cost per acquisition and retention.
Set and execute pricing and packaging for each solution, testing and revising against demand, competitor movement and margin targets.
Own the customer lifecycle beyond acquisition: onboarding, engagement, cross-sell between solutions on the platform, and churn reduction.
Establish the customer insight and analytics capability that informs acquisition, pricing and roadmap decisions.
4. Market Understanding and Product Strategy
Proactively research, interrogate and build a deep working understanding of the market the product serves — customers, buyers, competitors, substitutes, pricing dynamics and the regulatory conditions that shape demand.
Ground every product decision in market and user evidence rather than internal opinion or stakeholder preference; be able to demonstrate the evidence behind any position taken.
Validate demand before development commitment and re-validate at each major roadmap checkpoint.
Define and maintain the product vision and strategy for the digital solutions portfolio, aligned to the business objectives approved by the Board.
Develop and own the business case for each product initiative, including target market, value proposition, revenue model and investment required.
5. Roadmap and Portfolio Management
Own, publish and maintain the product roadmap across the solution portfolio, with clearly sequenced releases, dependencies and decision gates.
Prioritise across competing initiatives and stakeholder requests using a transparent, criteria-based framework that stakeholders can see and challenge.
Define phased delivery with a minimum viable product for each solution, so that value is validated early rather than at the end of a full build cycle.
Recommend to the Board when an initiative should be continued, re-scoped, paused or stopped, with supporting evidence.
6. Requirements and Specification Governance
Translate business needs into clear, testable product requirements — user stories, functional and non-functional specifications, and process flows.
Define measurable acceptance criteria for every deliverable and milestone before development commences. Ensure acceptance criteria trace directly back to the agreed specification.
Maintain a single controlled source of truth for scope, and operate a formal change control process: all variations documented, impact-assessed for cost, timeline and quality, and approved at the appropriate level before work proceeds.
Maintain a requirements traceability matrix linking each specified requirement through to design, build, test and acceptance.
7. Delivery Oversight and Acceptance
Manage overall project delivery against roadmap, budget and quality expectations, coordinating resources across all contributing parties.
Chair regular delivery governance forums; maintain visibility of progress, risks, issues, dependencies and decisions.
Design and govern the testing and acceptance regime: define test scenarios against specification, coordinate user acceptance testing with named business owners of appropriate authority, and ensure results are documented and retained.
Formally accept or reject deliverables against acceptance criteria. Ensure sign-off is executed by an authorised representative and recorded, and that sign-off is understood to confirm conformance to specification.
Ensure all source code, documentation, technical materials and knowledge transfer are delivered to and retained by the business at each milestone.
8. Stakeholder Management and Reporting
Act as the primary bridge between business domain experts and the engineering delivery teams, ensuring domain knowledge is fully captured, understood and reflected in what is built.
Secure and structure input from subject matter experts and end users throughout the development lifecycle, not only at testing stage.
Manage expectations proactively across all stakeholders; surface misalignment early and drive it to resolution rather than allowing it to emerge at delivery.
Report to the Board on product performance, roadmap status, financial position, risks and decisions required.

jobs.title: Head of App Development
jobs.text:
Releaf Dispensary Ltd is a pioneering medical cannabis clinic committed to providing high-quality, safe, and effective cannabis-based products. Headquartered in the UK, we aim to enhance the quality of life for our patients through cutting-edge solutions and outstanding patient service. We are a fast-growing team of passionate professionals on a mission to put patients back in control of their health journey — we have seen first-hand how alternative treatments can change lives.
About the Role
Releaf is looking for an experienced Head of App Development to lead the strategy, architecture and delivery of our native iOS and Android applications. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has built and scaled consumer-facing health or wellness apps, and who understands how to turn complex clinical and patient data into simple, trustworthy mobile experiences.
You will own our app roadmap end to end from technical architecture through to App Store and Google Play release. A core part of this role is our use of health and wearable data: you will need deep, practical experience working with Apple HealthKit, the Apple Health app, and Apple Watch data, alongside equivalent experience on Android with Health Connect and Wear OS.
This is a rare opportunity to shape the mobile experience for a fast-growing healthcare business, working at the intersection of clinical care, patient engagement and consumer-grade product design.
You'll work with a designer to create the UI/UX and then develop it with the developers to connect it to the backend of our bespoke system.Using API. We have a team of over 20 developers.
What You'll Be Doing
Owning the technical strategy, development and roadmap for Releaf's native iOS and Android applications
Leading the design and implementation of features built on Apple HealthKit and the Apple Health app, including reading, writing and visualising health data
Integrating Apple Watch data — including activity, heart rate, sleep and other relevant metrics — into patient-facing features in a clear, intuitive UI
Building equivalent health data experiences on Android using Health Connect and Wear OS, ensuring feature parity across platforms
Working closely with Product, Design, Clinical and Data Protection teams to ensure features are clinically sound, intuitive, and fully compliant with healthcare data regulations
Owning app performance, stability, release management and the end-to-end App Store / Google Play submission process
Establishing engineering best practice across testing, CI/CD, code review and security for mobile
Staying ahead of platform changes from Apple and Google — particularly around HealthKit, Health Connect, privacy frameworks and wearable APIs — and advising the business on their implications
Contributing to the wider technology strategy as a senior member of the engineering leadership team
What We're Looking For
Essential
Proven experience leading native app development for both iOS and Android, ideally including time as a senior or lead engineer before moving into management
Hands-on experience building features using Apple HealthKit and integrating with the Apple Health app
Direct experience working with Apple Watch/health data (healthkit) — reading and presenting metrics such as heart rate, activity rings, sleep or workout data within a consumer app
Working knowledge of the Android equivalent stack — Health Connect and Wear OS — and experience building comparable cross-platform health features
Portfolio of apps that we can test the UI and functionality.
Strong understanding of mobile UI/UX principles, particularly around presenting health data in a way that is clear, reassuring and easy to act on
Experience managing the full app lifecycle, including App Store and Google Play submission, review processes, and ongoing release management
A track record of building, leading and growing high-performing engineering teams
Comfortable working in a regulated environment, with an understanding of data protection and patient privacy considerations (UK GDPR, or equivalent)
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical decisions for non-technical stakeholders
Desirable
Experience in healthcare, digital health, or a regulated consumer product environment
Familiarity with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose at a technical depth sufficient to review architecture and code where needed
Experience with remote patient monitoring, chronic condition management apps, or similar health-tracking products
Exposure to clinical safety standards or medical device software regulations (e.g. UKCA/MHRA, IEC 62304) is a strong plus, though not required
Experience working alongside clinical teams to validate the safety and accuracy of health-related features
We’re looking for someone who is excited to join a busy growing organisation - our team culture is based on support and respect and we take a proactive approach to employee progression and development. The ideal candidate for this role will be happy to roll their sleeves up and can take ownership of this role. In return, we offer flexible working; personalised training and development; private health insurance, Employee Assistance Programmes; access to employee perks and Releaf staff patient benefits.
Our application process starts off with an informal remote meeting followed by a written test. We are an inclusive employer and would welcome applications from a diverse range of applicants; if there is anything we can do to help support you during the interview process, please let us know.
At Releaf, we believe that diverse teams build better businesses. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — and we're happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process if you need them. If you'd like to discuss this, please don't hesitate to get in touch.
