jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
jobs.text:
Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Poland
Poland is a new and deliberate addition to our engineering map. We recently made our first technology hire in the country, and we see it as a long-term strategic location for senior hires, particularly within engineering. Joining now means joining early, and helping shape what our presence here becomes.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in Poland.
About The Role
Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.
Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.
The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.
This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader.
Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.
You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:
Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.
Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.
Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.
Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.
Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.
Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.
Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.
Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.
Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.
Who You Are
Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.
Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.
Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.
At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.
Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.
10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.
Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.
Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.
Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.
Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.
Cultural Alignment
As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
What Success Looks Like In The Role
The existing cashback product performing measurably better — faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.
A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.
A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.
An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.
Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.
Clear architecture standards and engineering processes in place across the product units.
Why Join Us
A rare blank page. The platform exists, but almost everything it could become is still ahead of it, and you will define what that is.
Direct influence on retention across a base of roughly 23 million users, at one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa.
Full autonomy as the CTO of your domain, with the backing to build the organisation you think the problem needs.
Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.
What To Expect In The Hiring Process
60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).
Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.
#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Executive Director, Data Engineering
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
About the Role
We’re seeking a Executive Director of Data Engineering to lead the architecture, infrastructure, and engineering standards that power our global marketing intelligence capabilities. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Intelligence Officer, this leader will modernize our AI infrastructure, accelerate how we build and deliver, and set global data standards across every domain we touch — creative, CX/site, CRM, audience, and media data. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technologist and a strategic leader who can build best-in-class engineering practices at global scale while driving the move toward agile, automated, and AI-native data delivery.
What You’ll Do
AI Infrastructure & Engineering Modernization
Design and evolve scalable AI and data infrastructure that supports predictive, prescriptive, and generative use cases across the function.
Establish standards and tooling for accelerated delivery and faster coding — including AI-assisted development, reusable components, and automation that compresses time-to-value.
Evaluate and introduce new technologies that enable innovation across creative, CX/site, CRM, audience, and media data domains.
Mature our MLOps and deployment practices so models and data products move from prototype to production reliably and repeatably.
Data Standards, Taxonomies & Governance
Develop comprehensive, future-proof data taxonomies and data standards that bring consistency and interoperability across domains and regions.
Set and govern global data standards — architecture, quality, lineage, documentation, and metadata — that scale across the network and agency partners.
Embed data governance, privacy, and security by design, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and responsible AI practices.
Create a single, trusted foundation for data that improves accuracy, accessibility, and reuse across teams.
Delivery Excellence & AI Integration
Drive continuous progress toward agile, automated, and effective data delivery, embedding DevOps/DataOps practices and CI/CD across engineering workflows.
Define and uphold best-in-class standards for AI integration, from data pipelines through model deployment and monitoring.
Build and lead a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization, raising the bar on technical excellence, velocity, and reliability.
Partner with product, analytics, and agency teams to ensure infrastructure and standards translate into faster, higher-quality outcomes.
What You’ll Bring
20+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or platform engineering, including senior leadership of global or distributed engineering teams.
Deep expertise in modern data infrastructure, cloud platforms, and AI/ML engineering, with hands-on command of scalable pipeline and platform design.
Proven success establishing data taxonomies, standards, and governance frameworks across complex, multi-domain environments.
Experience modernizing engineering practices toward automation, agile delivery, and AI-assisted development.
Strong understanding of marketing and media data domains — creative, CX/site, CRM, audience, and media — ideally within automotive, broader industry, or agency/media agency contexts.
Track record of integrating AI responsibly and at scale, with fluency in MLOps, DataOps, and data governance.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills at the executive level.
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.
_
$155,000—$390,000 USD
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Privacy, Product and Platform Security
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox is looking for a Senior Director, Privacy, Product and Platform Security to lead the teams responsible for protecting the systems, products, services, and data that power the Roblox platform. This is an opportunity to define how security and privacy are engineered into one of the world’s largest and most ambitious platforms. You will work on problems that span product design, distributed systems, infrastructure, data, privacy, and emerging technology—helping protect the data and systems relied on by tens of millions of users and creators.
You will bring Product Security, Platform Security, and Privacy Engineering together around a unified vision to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Roblox’s products, infrastructure, and data systems. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and other business leaders to make security and privacy durable properties of how Roblox designs, builds, deploys, and operates.
Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will oversee a high-impact organization of security engineering leaders and senior individual contributors. You will operate as a peer to Infrastructure and Engineering leadership, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and well-executed engineering solutions.
You Will
Set the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Product Security, Platform Security, and Privacy Engineering.
Lead and grow a high-performing organization of managers and senior technical leaders, while building a culture of accountability, inclusion, and technical excellence.
Establish security and privacy architecture principles for Roblox products, services, production platforms, cloud environments, and data systems.
Raise the security bar across the software development lifecycle through security reviews, threat modeling, secure design, testing, vulnerability management, and risk-based remediation.
Drive the design and adoption of hardened, secure platforms at Roblox scale, partnering with Infrastructure Engineering on foundational security controls.
Advance Privacy Engineering by embedding privacy-by-design practices and scalable technical controls into product and platform architecture, data flows, and operating processes.
Translate regulatory and company privacy commitments into clear engineering requirements, measurable controls, and durable solutions.
Own cross-functional priorities, metrics, executive reporting, and delivery for product security, platform security, privacy engineering, and related risk-reduction programs.
You Have
15+ years of experience in security engineering, privacy engineering, infrastructure security, or a related technical field, including 8+ years leading and developing engineering or security organizations.
Deep technical expertise in at least one security or engineering discipline, with the breadth and judgment to lead across product, platform, infrastructure, cloud, data, and privacy domains.
A track record of setting strategy and delivering measurable security outcomes across large-scale products, platforms, or distributed systems.
Experience embedding security and privacy into the software development lifecycle through architecture, standards, tooling, automation, and risk-based prioritization.
Strong systems thinking and technical judgment across modern production environments, including cloud, hybrid, distributed, containerized, and data-intensive systems.
A people-centered, results-oriented leadership style, with the ability to build high-performing teams, lead complex cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, and communicate technical risk and tradeoffs clearly.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$457,970—$525,510 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

This is an opportunity to define how security and privacy are engineered into one of the world’s largest and most ambitious platforms. You will work on problems that span product design, distributed systems, infrastructure, data, privacy, and emerging technology—helping protect the data and systems relied on by tens of millions of users and creators.

You will bring Product Security, Platform Security, and Privacy Engineering together around a unified vision to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Roblox’s products, infrastructure, and data systems. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and other business leaders to make security and privacy durable properties of how Roblox designs, builds, deploys, and operates.

Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will oversee a high-impact organization of security engineering leaders and senior individual contributors. You will operate as a peer to Infrastructure and Engineering leadership, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and well-executed engineering solutions.
You Will

items: Set the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Product Security, Platform Security, and Privacy Engineering.
Lead and grow a high-performing organization of managers and senior technical leaders, while building a culture of accountability, inclusion, and technical excellence.
Establish security and privacy architecture principles for Roblox products, services, production platforms, cloud environments, and data systems.
Raise the security bar across the software development lifecycle through security reviews, threat modeling, secure design, testing, vulnerability management, and risk-based remediation.
Drive the design and adoption of hardened, secure platforms at Roblox scale, partnering with Infrastructure Engineering on foundational security controls.
Advance Privacy Engineering by embedding privacy-by-design practices and scalable technical controls into product and platform architecture, data flows, and operating processes.
Translate regulatory and company privacy commitments into clear engineering requirements, measurable controls, and durable solutions.
Own cross-functional priorities, metrics, executive reporting, and delivery for product security, platform security, privacy engineering, and related risk-reduction programs.

blocks.text: You Have

items: 15+ years of experience in security engineering, privacy engineering, infrastructure security, or a related technical field, including 8+ years leading and developing engineering or security organizations.
Deep technical expertise in at least one security or engineering discipline, with the breadth and judgment to lead across product, platform, infrastructure, cloud, data, and privacy domains.
A track record of setting strategy and delivering measurable security outcomes across large-scale products, platforms, or distributed systems.
Experience embedding security and privacy into the software development lifecycle through architecture, standards, tooling, automation, and risk-based prioritization.
Strong systems thinking and technical judgment across modern production environments, including cloud, hybrid, distributed, containerized, and data-intensive systems.

A people-centered, results-oriented leadership style, with the ability to build high-performing teams, lead complex cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, and communicate technical risk and tradeoffs clearly.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Business Banking
jobs.text:
In 1851, a New York bookkeeper named George D. Lyman observed the same absurd ritual each afternoon: porters carried bags of coins and bundles of checks bank to bank down Wall Street, settling by hand, a fortune exposed to error and theft. Lyman's fix: send everything through one central office and settle the net. On October 11, 1853, in the basement of 14 Wall Street, 52 banks cleared $22.6 million in a single sitting. Money between banks had stopped being an event and became seamless infrastructure.
A century and a half later, the hard part is unchanged: moving money once is easy; making it work every time, for hundreds of thousands of businesses, across every rail, is hard. The bank account is where a company's financial life happens - payroll clears or it doesn't; a wire lands or a deal slips; the month closes clean, or someone loses a weekend to it. Mercury is building a business banking* product at a scale better than anything else in the market.
Business Banking is the heart of Mercury. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving deposit and payment growth, and owning business performance.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.
Key responsibilities:
Own the P&L, strategy, and product offering: accounts, user experience, payments, new rails, and agents
Build AI - and data-driven user experiences at scale better than the alternatives
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set an operating cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
Deepen the core account and take new products 0-1 to scale: optimize what businesses run on, and invest in new rails, capabilities, and agents so customers can focus on building their companies
Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
Align the banking ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, sales, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy
Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:
A leader with great product chops, commercial instinct to grow the business, and discipline to run it safely
A high bar for craft – leading a creative, customer-centered, data-driven and experimentation-oriented approach
Enthusiasm for building AI- and agent-powered products that drive spectacular customer experiences
Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, risk, compliance, finance, and partners
10+ years' experience, ideally in banking, payments, platforms, or financial products
5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management
Command of how business banking works: account opening and KYB, deposits and liquidity, payment rails (ACH, wire, check, international, FedNow, RTP)
Experience launching and scaling 0-1 financial products, ideally in fintech or another high-growth environment, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it
Sound judgment in a regulated, risk-sensitive environment: balance a delightful experience with the controls a banking product requires, and know which corners are never worth cutting
Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

jobs.text:
This role is responsible for solution architecture, code quality, engineering standards, and technical execution. This role is not focused on high-level strategy alone — it requires deep involvement in code, architecture decisions, and technical problem-solving on a daily basis.
Solution Architecture & System Design
Own and drive solution architecture across all projects and products
Design scalable, high-performance, and maintainable systems
Lead architecture decisions, including frameworks, integrations, and platforms
Conduct architecture reviews and enforce quality, scalability, and security standards
Define and enforce architectural patterns (Microservices, DDD, Event-Driven, CQRS)
Evaluate build vs. buy decisions with strong technical justification

Actively participate in code reviews across all engineering teams
Ensure high standards in code quality, performance, and maintainability

Mentor engineers through structured and constructive code reviews

Database design and performance optimization
Testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E)
Documentation practices
Establish quality gates for code, releases, and deployments
Drive adoption of automated code quality tools and best practices
Ensure consistency across Backend, Frontend, and Mobile teams
CI/CD & DevOps Excellence

Ensure fully automated build, test, and deployment processes
Drive DevOps best practices, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Automated testing within pipelines
Blue-green and canary deployments
Environment and configuration management

jobs.title: Head of Product - Personal Banking
jobs.text:
In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money. In the bath that evening, he thought of a chocolate bar dispenser and swapped the chocolate for cash. On 27 June, outside a Barclays branch on Enfield High Street, an actor named Reg Varney drew £10 from the world's first cash machine. It took a four-digit code (originally six, until his wife told him nobody remembers six). The bank's hours had stopped being the customer's problem.
Nearly sixty years later, the bar has moved, but the test hasn't: a personal financial product is judged on whether it fits the life of the person using it. People do not read documentation, forgive a confusing screen, or care how the ledger works. They want one place that makes sense of everything — spending, saving, planning, investing — and that anticipates rather than reports: where they stand, what deserves attention, what to do next. Mercury is building personal banking* to that standard.
Personal Banking is how Mercury earns a place in someone's financial life. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving growth and engagement, and owning business performance.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.
Key responsibilities:
Build a personal banking experience so good that people tell their friends and colleagues about it
Own the metrics, product strategy and the propositions we take to our customers, covering personal money management, banking, savings, investments, money movement, and in the future, lending
Set the craft bar: sweat the details — copy, latency, empty states — that decide whether a consumer product feels inevitable rather than adequate
Drive the use of AI in products where it makes the experience meaningfully better
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set a cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
Grow the business: own acquisition, activation, retention, and the loops that compound, including how personal banking connects to the businesses Mercury already serves
Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
Align the ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy
Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:
A consumer product leader with taste: you have built products millions of people chose to use, and can point to the decisions that made them work
You have shipped AI-led products to real consumers and have opinions about what AI makes possible and where it fails
An exceptionally high bar for craft, and a customer-centered, data-driven, and experimentation-oriented approach
10+ years building consumer products, including time owning a product's growth and economics, not only its roadmap
5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management
Experience launching and scaling 0-1 products, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it
Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, and partners
Nice to have: banking, payments, or fintech experience. We can teach you the rails; we cannot teach product judgment
Sound judgment in a regulated environment: you balance a delightful experience with the controls a banking product requires, and know which corners are never worth cutting

jobs.title: Head of Information Technology
jobs.text:
The Opportunity
We're looking for a Head of Information Technology who can shape the technology strategy of a rapidly growing defence engineering business - leading our IT team while driving secure, resilient and scalable technology across our UK and international operations.
This is an opportunity for an experienced IT leader who enjoys being close to the business, making things happen and balancing strategic thinking with practical delivery. You’ll have the scope to shape how we use technology, data, automation and AI as we continue to grow, while ensuring our infrastructure and security are ready for what comes next.
Who We Are
OpenWorks is a rapidly growing business operating globally with a passion for exceptional engineering and building on a legacy of defence innovation in the North East of England.
Our products provide ultra-high performance, real-time detection, tracking, identification and targeting of dynamic aerial threats. They have been deployed internationally to protect high profile military and civilian assets, and contribute towards the defeat of nuisance, misguided and maliciously deployed drones during operations.
We are very proud to have supported a wide range of law enforcement and military operators, protecting many of the most high profile sites and individuals around the world.
The amazing things we do are only possible because of a dedicated and passionate team.
Security Vetting Information
OpenWorks Engineering operates within the defence sector. As part of our recruitment and onboarding processes, we collect information that may be required to support future security vetting and clearance requirements, should these become necessary during employment.
Why You’ll Love Working With Us
Join a high-energy, collaborative team where great ideas thrive, challenges are embraced, and people genuinely love what they do.
Here’s what our benefits have to offer:
Rewarding Success - Competitive salary, starting from £80,000, plus a discretionary annual bonus of up to 25% of salary alongside a structured pay progression framework.
Enhanced Pension - Up to 8% employer-matched contributions to help you plan for the future.
More Time to Recharge - 25 days’ holiday plus public holidays, long-service rewards, and the option to buy up to 5 extra days.
Breakfast & Lunch on Us - Enjoy team breakfasts and freshly prepared lunches every day courtesy of Chef Mark and his team.
Health & Wellbeing - Private healthcare and life assurance for added peace of mind.
Sustainable Travel - Salary sacrifice schemes, including EV car and Cycle to Work options.
Team Socials - Regular events, from quiz nights and football to board games and more.
Learning & Growth - A culture that empowers you to challenge, grow and make an impact, plus a £250 annual learning budget to invest in the development that matters most to you.
What you’ll be doing:
Team Leadership
Lead and develop the IT team: Build a high-performing team with clear priorities, accountability and ownership.
Manage delivery: Balance day-to-day IT support with proactive improvement and longer-term technology development.
Lead technology change: Oversee key IT projects and external technology partners, ensuring effective delivery.
IT Strategy
Shape our technology strategy: Work with the CIO and leadership team to ensure IT supports OWE’s growth and future direction.
Understand business needs: Partner with departments across the business to identify technology priorities and deliver practical solutions.
IT Infrastructure
Build for growth: Ensure our infrastructure, networks, systems and workplace technology are secure, reliable and scalable.
Improve how we work: Drive improvements across systems integration, data, automation, collaboration and user experience.
Support international growth: Oversee UK and US technology requirements, connectivity and country-specific considerations.
Information Security
Strengthen our security: Provide leadership and direction to the Security & Compliance function, ensuring security, resilience and compliance are embedded across IT and the wider business.
Manage technology risk: Ensure security priorities align with our business objectives, risk appetite and future growth.
Systems & AI
Drive smarter technology: Oversee the selection, integration and development of business systems, ensuring they deliver genuine business value.
Lead AI adoption: Identify practical opportunities to use AI, automation and data to improve efficiency and decision-making, with appropriate security and governance.
Budgeting & Resource Management
Plan for the future: Manage IT budgets, resource planning and investment proposals, providing clear reporting and recommendations to the CIO and Board.
What we’re looking for:
Experienced IT leader: Significant experience leading an IT function and developing high-performing teams.
People focused: Able to build strong relationships, set clear direction and create accountability across a team.
Broad technical expertise: Strong experience across IT infrastructure, hardware, software systems and technology platforms.
Security-conscious: Experience working in a regulated or security-focused environment, ideally within defence, aerospace or another complex engineering sector.
Commercially minded: Able to understand business requirements and translate them into practical, scalable technology solutions.
Growth experience: Experience scaling IT operations within a growing technology, engineering or similarly complex organisation.
Future focused: Experience or strong interest in AI, automation, data integration and emerging technologies.
Essential: Able to obtain Security Clearance
What else would be great
Defence experience: Experience working within the defence industry or a similar security-focused environment.
AI implementation: Experience developing or delivering an AI implementation strategy.
Data integration: Demonstrable experience integrating data from separate systems into effective reporting and management tools.
International IT: Experience managing IT across operational sites, including US requirements.
Cyber security: Knowledge of defence cyber-security standards and experience handling classified information.
Security clearance: Current UK Security Clearance
More about us:
Vision
Help protect the territory and airspace of NATO countries and their allies.
Mission
Be a world-leading provider of autonomous technology for Surveillance applications and Defence
Values
Be a Good Egg: Earn respect, have mutual trust and be honest
Do cool stuff: We develop cool tech with an awesome team, and we get stuff done
Be empowered: We are autonomous, reliable and take personal responsibility
We are one team: Look out for each other and the team
Things go wrong: Fail fast, learn and move on
Have fun: We’re doing amazing things with passionate people
We Get It Done: Focus on what matters and work with energy to bring ideas to life

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
About Freedom
Freedom Digital Bank France will form part of Freedom Holding Corp., a diversified international financial services group publicly listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker FRHC. The Group operates across Europe, the United States and Central Asia, with activities spanning banking, brokerage, investment services, insurance, payments and digital consumer services.
About the role
We are looking for an experienced Chief Technology Officer to define and lead the technology strategy of Freedom Digital Bank France.
The CTO will be responsible for technology architecture, infrastructure, engineering, cybersecurity, data governance, IT operations and digital transformation. The role will work closely with the wider Freedom Holding Corp. technology organisation to develop a secure, resilient and scalable digital banking platform.
As a member of the founding executive team, the CTO will contribute to the bank’s regulatory authorisation, establishment and launch in France. Define and execute the technology strategy for Freedom Digital Bank France.
Design and maintain a secure, scalable and resilient technology architecture.
Lead infrastructure, cloud, engineering, integration and IT operations initiatives.
Ensure the availability, performance and security of digital banking platforms.
Establish IT governance, technology controls and architecture standards.
Oversee cybersecurity, information security and technology risk management programmes.
Ensure compliance with financial-sector technology requirements and operational resilience requirements.
Implement effective ICT incident detection, incident response, recovery and regulatory reporting processes.
Develop business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities.
Support the development and launch of digital banking products and customer journeys.
Partner with Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Business teams.
Oversee technology outsourcing and relationships with cloud providers, vendors and strategic partners.
Manage technology budgets, resources and delivery priorities.
Build and develop high-performing technology teams.
Support the preparation of technology, cybersecurity and outsourcing documentation required for the regulatory authorisation process.
Drive automation, innovation and continuous improvement across the bank.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
jobs.text:
Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why the UK
The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based, with team members joining us from companies like Tide, Klarna, Revolut, Capital One, Teya, Wise, Starling, Monzo, and many others! Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in UK.
About The Role
Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.
The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.
We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.
That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.
There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.
As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:
Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.
Who You Are
You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Poland
Poland is a new and deliberate addition to our engineering map. We recently made our first technology hire in the country, and we are looking at Poland as a long-term strategic location for senior hires, particularly within our engineering organisation. Joining now means joining early, and helping shape what our presence here becomes.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales & Marketing Tools, to join us in Poland.
About The Role
Sales and Marketing Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.
A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.
Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.
Who You Are
You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.
You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.
You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.
A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.
Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.
Cultural Alignment
As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
What Success Looks Like
The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
The platform ready to support a new market.
A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.
Why Join Us
A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.
What To Expect in The Hiring Process
A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).
Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive organisation.

jobs.title: SVP, Product
jobs.text:
The big picture: Axios is a media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment.
Axios is hiring an SVP, Product to lead how Axios builds products across the company, strengthening Product and Design while turning promising AI-enabled ideas into durable, supported products.
Why it matters: Axios builds and ships at multiple levels. Product and Design lead the development of durable, company-wide products and shared platforms. AI Enablement partners with departments to identify opportunities, prototype AI-enabled tools and workflows, and help teams put useful solutions into practice.
The SVP, Product will connect these levels by making decision rights, prioritization, and handoffs clear: what should remain a local workflow, what AI Enablement should support, and what Product and Design should develop into a durable, supported product or shared capability. The role spans the products, platforms, and workflows that power Axios, from the CMS, axios.com, newsletters, and Local products to internal tools and shared platforms supporting editorial, revenue, and company operations, as well as the growing set of AI-enabled solutions being developed closer to the work.
As Axios becomes more capable of building with AI, more teams will identify and prototype solutions for their own needs. This leader will establish the product operating model that allows Axios to evaluate, prioritize, and scale those ideas without creating fragmented, duplicated, or unsupported systems.
What you’ll do:
Lead Product, Design, and AI Enablement, setting strategy, priorities, decision rights, and operating cadence.
Look ahead: turn a clear point of view on emerging technologies, behaviors, and opportunities into credible product choices and experiments.
Partner with business leaders to translate company and functional goals into clear product opportunities, outcomes, and investment choices.
Raise the product management bar through clear expectations, coaching, and accountability.
Create a clear path from promising experiments to durable, supported products.
Go deeper: This leader must be a trusted partner to senior leaders, with a clear point of view on where technology is moving, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the judgment to turn ambiguity into decisions.
Success means a clear company-wide model for deciding what Axios should build and why, stronger and faster Product and Design decisions, and a repeatable path from promising AI experiments to durable, supported products.
What we’re looking for:
A trusted partner to senior leaders who can challenge assumptions, form a clear point of view, make hard tradeoffs, and keep decisions moving.
A clear vision for where product development is headed and how Axios can succeed as the technology landscape rapidly evolves.
Demonstrated AI fluency: you personally use AI to accelerate your work and prototype ideas, and you know how to turn AI capabilities into useful products and workflows.
Senior product leadership experience in software, information services, media, or another fast-moving environment, with a record of bringing Product and Design together.
Technical fluency across product strategy, workflows, tooling, data, and production tradeoffs.
Experience with prioritization and portfolio management across multiple stakeholders.
A track record of turning prototypes and experiments into durable, supported products.
The judgment to create useful governance without becoming a bottleneck.
The ability to distinguish a meaningful product opportunity from an interesting AI demo.
Worth your time: This is an opportunity to help define what modern product leadership looks like inside an AI-native media company. You’ll help shape not only what Axios builds, but how Axios operates.

jobs.title: VP of Technology Delivery & Transformation
jobs.text:
Kurt Geiger | About Us
We are an inclusive, creative footwear and accessories brand powered by kindness. We want to empower our talent to be confident and true to themselves, the London way. London is our home, our heartbeat, and we draw inspiration from the energy and spirit of the city; its diversity and creativity. For over fifty years our team of in-house shoe and accessory designers have been creating authentic, distinctive designs from our London headquarters. The rainbow is our signature. It represents the good energy and love we have for our community and the many ways we collectively express our individual style.
Kurt Geiger Digital
Kurt Geiger’s Digital Team is a leading edge, multichannel, global, fully integrated function within the business. We have built an inclusive and diverse team that operates across 4 layers of the Business: Back End Systems and Engineering; Platforms; Marketing; Customer Service.
Our in-house team of over 100 Digital experts are augmented with expertise from partners across the globe to deliver the very best in Retail Technology with a firm eye on the future. We operate in a fully Agile, fast paced environment, with a strong focus on individual leadership talent and development through an integrated Excellency Framework to ensure every member of the team develops the very best leadership development for themselves whilst delivering business objectives in line with growing our Global Digital Brands.
Purpose of the Role
This role is responsible for the successful delivery and operation of the organisation’s technology platforms and engineering capability. It ensures that technology programmes are executed effectively, engineering teams are high performing, and operational systems continue to meet business needs throughout a period of significant transformation.
The role provides leadership across software engineering, enterprise applications and major business systems, overseeing the transition from the current technology landscape to the organisation’s future operating model. It works closely with the SVP of Architecture, Data & AI to ensure all delivery aligns with approved technology strategy, architecture principles and transformation roadmaps.
Initially, the role will oversee IT Operations, ERP, Wholesale & Warehouse Systems, and Software Engineering. As organisational responsibilities transition to the parent company, the role will increasingly focus on two strategic delivery domains:
ERP Transformation (Retail Express → Infor M3)
Digital Engineering Transformation (Adobe Commerce → Shopify)
The role is deliberately focused on execution, delivery, operational excellence and engineering leadership rather than defining long-term technology strategy or enterprise architecture.

jobs.text:
The CTO will drive the group’s technology vision, strategy, and execution. As a key member of the executive team, the CTO will lead the digital transformation journey, enhance technological capabilities across all business units, and ensure that technology aligns with overall business goals, enhancing operational efficiency and customer engagement.

• Define and execute the group’s technology roadmap in alignment with strategic business goals.

performance.

infrastructure.

across brands.

journey.

• Develop and maintain robust cybersecurity policies, risk management strategies, and disaster
recovery plans.

• Manage relationships with external technology vendors and service providers.
• Optimize the technology budget, ensuring cost-effectiveness and strategic investments.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Content Platform (Catalog)
jobs.text:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.
As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.
We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Supply Chain
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Spain
Some of our most mission-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Supply Chain to join us in Spain.
About The Role
POS Hardware and Device Platforms owns the software behind the physical side of Moniepoint's business: the systems that track, move, maintain and account for millions of POS terminals in the field. That covers inventory and warehouse management, logistics and distribution, repair and maintenance workflows, and the operational tooling the business runs on day to day. It is a backend and distributed systems challenge at real scale - making operational data about millions of physical devices visible, trustworthy and consistent across every market we operate in. It is not a hardware engineering role.
The Head of Engineering, POS Supply Chain, oversees that software estate and is vital as Moniepoint expands internationally and scales device operations globally. The position involves leading the technical strategy for the domain and managing a large engineering organisation in a remote, distributed environment. As Head of Engineering, Supply Chain, your responsibilities will include:
Owning the technical strategy and architecture for inventory and logistics tools and repair management software.
Leading an engineering organisation of approximately 25 engineers, including managers, QA, SRE and Data Engineering.
Driving platformisation of inventory and supply chain systems so operational data is visible, trustworthy and consistent across millions of terminals.
Bridging the gap between operational practice and software systems by building operationally disciplined solutions.
Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics across squads to ensure reliability and data integrity.
Collaborating with business and operational stakeholders to translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
Hiring, mentoring and developing engineering managers and senior engineers to support team growth up to 30+ members.
Who You Are
10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
Deep hands-on experience in supply chain, inventory, warehouse or logistics software at scale.
Fintech or regulated-industry experience, with an understanding of the operational stakes of device management in a payments environment.
Strong backend engineering skills for data-intensive, distributed, operational systems.
Proven system design ability at large scale, managing hundreds of thousands of devices or more.
Experience managing and developing large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
Excellent stakeholder management, translating complex technical concepts for non-technical leaders.
A product-minded approach to solving operational problems with engineering solutions.
Cultural Alignment
As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
What Success Looks Like In The Role
Scalable inventory and logistics systems delivered, supporting millions of devices across multiple countries.
A high-performing, motivated engineering team aligned with company growth.
Operational data visibility and trust established across multiple global markets.
Robust architecture standards enabling reliability and data integrity.
Effective collaboration with business and operational teams to meet rapid expansion needs.
What we can offer you
Lead engineering for one of Africa's largest POS networks and directly influence our global expansion.
Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment at the intersection of fintech and hardware operations.
Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.
What to expect in the hiring process
A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders, 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project/system you built in the past. 30 minutes will be focused on testing for leadership attributes.
60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management, collaboration skills with product/business.
60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).
Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Head of Developer Relations, SEA and OCE
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As the Head of Developer Relations you will own the strategy, execution, and outcomes for Roblox developer growth strategies of Southeast Asia (SEA). You will work directly with publishers, developers, emerging studios, and industry partners across SEA to drive adoption, accelerate development, and build long-term ecosystem relationships.
You will serve as a strategic partner to developers, represent Roblox at industry events, and collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Creator, and International teams to scale Roblox as a destination for high-quality, game development.
You Will:
Proactively set team goals, monitor progress and conversation trends with key partners.
Partner with data scientists, product, engineering and leaders across the company.
Become the voice of your partners, identifying and quantifying the critical action items that will impact our product growth in the region.
Communicate risk factors of the region and make difficult decisions.
Actively share reports to reflect the impact of your work with the company.
Requirements:
Residency in Singapore or willing to relocate.
10+ years of experience in technical project management.
Able to proactively communicate with all key stakeholders.
Experience with launching a technical product in international markets.
Experience with using Roblox Studio or another game development engine. (eg. Unity or Unreal)
A researcher with a unique skill set to quickly ramp up and understand your target audience needs.
Passionate, full of positive energy, and a role model to others.
Driven by teamwork, naturally encourages people to work together.
Able to lead by example, building a clear high-level strategy and holding yourself and others accountable to the long-term company vision.
Data and feedback driven, your decisions are inspired by the product usage, the users’ qualitative insights, and your expertise.
Communication focused with excellent verbal and written skills.
Self-Directed with the ability to establish your work and processes.
Advance Educational degree or equivalent practical experience
