jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Poland
Poland is a new and deliberate addition to our engineering map. We recently made our first technology hire in the country, and we see it as a long-term strategic location for senior hires, particularly within engineering. Joining now means joining early, and helping shape what our presence here becomes.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway to join us in Poland.
About The Role
Monnify is Moniepoint's online payment acceptance platform: the gateway layer connecting merchants to card networks, banks and payment aggregators, and the tools that let businesses and developers accept and send money digitally. The division owns transaction reliability, routing and throughput at scale, together with the developer experience that sits on top of it - APIs, SDKs, documentation and ease of integration. Built first for Nigerian businesses and developers, the platform is now scaling internationally and moving towards multi-currency, multi-market support.
The Head of Engineering owns the technical direction and architecture of that platform, ensuring scalability, security and developer experience for both technical and non-technical users. The role involves leading multiple engineering teams through their managers, setting strategic architecture, and ensuring platform reliability, security and scalability across Payment In, Payout, Commerce Tools and developer-facing features. As the Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway, your responsibilities will include:
Own the full technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Monnify platform across all capability areas.
Lead multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, setting quality standards and building organisational capability.
Own the developer experience end-to-end, including APIs, documentation, SDKs and integration ease.
Drive platform evolution towards multi-currency and international scalability.
Ensure platform reliability, scalability and security within a regulated environment.
Partner with product, commercial and operations teams to align technical investments with business goals.
Hire, mentor and develop engineering managers and senior engineers to support growth.
Who You Are
Over 10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering leadership roles.
5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not only years spent overseeing teams who write it.
At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
Experience in payments, fintech or financial services products, with a working understanding of payment flows and compliance.
Deep knowledge of API-first products, developer platforms and API integration.
Proven leadership of multiple engineering teams via managers in a scaling organisation.
Strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, distributed transactional systems.
Experience building or operating a payment gateway or multi-currency payment platform is a strong plus.
Cultural Alignment
As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
What To Expect In The Hiring Process
A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
A Panel interview session with two of our VPs of Engineering
A Technical Assessment with our Group CTO / Co-founder
A Behavioral and technical interview with our Group CEO / Founder
Technical Workshop with our Group CTO / Co-founder
Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with
Java (latest versions)
Spring and Spring Boot
Docker and Kubernetes
PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elastic search
Microservices architecture on AWS
What we can offer you
Own the payments infrastructure that thousands of businesses and developers build on, at a company processing hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually.
Work in a fast-paced, technically demanding environment at the core of how money moves in high-growth markets.
Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.
Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management - Risk & Quality (Payer)
jobs.text:
About the Role
Reporting to executive leadership, the Senior Director of Product Management – Risk & Quality is a key leader within Innovaccer’s Payer vertical. In this role, you will hold end-to-end accountability for the product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market (GTM) execution across our Risk Adjustment, RADV/Audit Readiness, Quality (HEDIS/Stars), and Compliance solution portfolio.
We are looking for a seasoned product leader who possesses deep domain expertise in clinical and financial risk operations across Commercial (ACA), Medicare Advantage, and Managed Medicaid markets. You will translate complex regulatory requirements, coding workflows, and risk-capture dynamics into a market-leading, AI-native product platform that drives verifiable revenue accuracy, audit defensibility, and operational efficiency for our health plan partners.
A Day in the Life
1. Product Strategy & Domain Leadership (Risk & Quality)
End-to-End Portfolio Vision: Own the multi-year product strategy for Risk Adjustment (Prospective, Concurrent, and Retrospective), RADV Audit Management, Risk Analytics, and integrated Quality/HEDIS products.
AI-First Innovation: Translate market needs into an AI-native product roadmap—leveraging NLP, LLMs, and automated chart retrieval/coding engines to eliminate manual touchpoints and maximize risk accuracy.
Regulatory Agility: Stay ahead of evolving CMS, HHS, and state regulatory landscapes (e.g., V28 model updates, RADV audit rule changes, submission deadlines) to ensure continuous product compliance and market differentiation.
Strategic Alignment: Partner with VP Payer, CPO, and Market President- Payer Growth to shape the overall Payer product narrative and co-own revenue targets for your products.
2. Execution, Architecture & AI-Native Product Craft
Harmonized Suite: Direct and develop product managers to unify risk analytics, suspecting, chart review, coding workflows, and audit trail tools into a single, seamless product experience.
AI-Native Operational Rigor: Enforce an AI-first development lifecycle—from discovery and automated feedback synthesis to generative prototyping and intelligent backlog management.
Delivery & Quality: Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Clinical SMEs, and Platform teams to build scalably on Innovaccer's Healthcare Intelligence Cloud, maintaining a predictable release cadence.
Impact & ROI Metrics: Establish strict outcome-based success metrics (e.g., chart review accuracy, suspecting yield rates, RADV audit mitigation rate, coding velocity) and track customer value realization.
3. Customer, GTM & Market Engagement
Executive Single Point of Contact (SPOC): Build direct relationships with plan executives (CMOs, Chief Risk Officers, Actuarial Leads, VPs of Risk Adjustment) to understand operational pain points and serve as the product authority for strategic discussions and escalations.
GTM Enablement & Revenue Co-Ownership: Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success to refine sales pitches, participate in key customer pursuits, support upsell/cross-sell initiatives, and validate product-market fit.
Industry Representation: Represent Innovaccer’s Risk Adjustment perspective in external forums, industry advisory boards, and regulatory consultations.
What You Need
Experience: 10+ years in Product Management or related technology leadership roles, with at least 5+ years of direct experience building and scaling Risk Adjustment, RADV/Audit, or Quality solutions for health plans/payers.
Domain Mastery: Deep expertise in Risk Adjustment methodologies (CMS-HCC, RxHCC, HHS-HCC), coding workflows (ICD-10, MEAT criteria), retrospective chart reviews, prospective point-of-care nudges, and RADV audit prep.
AI & Data Fluency: Proven track record of shipping AI/ML capabilities into healthcare workflows (e.g., NLP for unstructured clinical documentation, predictive suspecting models, generative summaries for coders).
Enterprise Scale: Demonstrated success in shipping and embedding SaaS products within complex payer environments and multi-payer enterprise systems.
People Leadership: Strong track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product management teams while fostering a culture of ownership and AI adoption.
Communication & Influence: Exceptional memo-writing and executive presentation skills; comfortable discussing risk models with actuaries, NLP accuracy with data scientists, and ROI with CFOs.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Business, or related quantitative field required; Master’s/Advanced degree preferred.
We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.
Here’s What We Offer
Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.
Innovaccer Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered regardless of any characteristic protected by federal, state or local law including, without limitation, race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, medical condition, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status. Innovaccer Inc. participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility of all newly hired employees based out of the U.S. and employed by Innovaccer Inc.
For any additional information, please visit the below websites:
E-Verify
Right to Work (English)
Right to Work (Spanish)

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer/Co-Founder Digital Health, Computer Vision, Ambient AI
jobs.text:
Chief Technology Officer & Co-Founder
Location: Remote
Alloy Partners is a venture builder with a radical thesis: that we can build and scale advantaged companies in partnership with corporations and entrepreneurs. Alloy Partners and the University of Notre Dame partnered to establish a first-of-its-kind venture studio and venture fund — the 1842 Studio and 1842 Fund — aligned with Notre Dame's mission of serving as a "Force for Good" in the world. In close partnership with the University and its vast network of alumni, corporate, community, and academic leaders, the 1842 Studio co-creates startups that address critical societal challenges, including improving health outcomes for vulnerable patient populations.
Healthcare professionals spend much of every shift documenting care they have already delivered, manually and from memory, hours after the fact. That time competes directly with patient care, and the record it produces captures only a fraction of what actually happened in the room. Making that care visible gives healthcare professionals back their time at the bedside and shows care teams, for the first time, an accurate picture of the care being delivered. That picture lets healthcare leaders staff, train, and support their people on evidence rather than estimation.
Co-developed with a leading academic medical center, StealthCo is an ambient AI platform that transforms medical care. By deploying AI models that continuously monitor patients and care teams through existing hospital camera and sensor infrastructure, StealthCo delivers real-time protocol and actionable clinical decision support to healthcare professionals at the point of care.
We are seeking a hands-on computer vision architect and builder to join as CTO and Co-Founder and personally build the StealthCo platform from the ground up alongside the founding CEO. This is a builder role, not a research role. First-year output is a working pilot and a viable product — not papers, not a hiring plan, not a research agenda.
What You'll Own
Computer vision. Build detection and activity recognition that works on commercially available cameras in real clinical environments, whether a hospital already has them installed or is deploying them for the first time.
Data as the asset. Start from off-the-shelf models to move fast, then build a proprietary dataset that gets better over time. You own that pipeline end to end.
Annotation. Stand up the labeling operation and the quality bar behind it. Domain experts say what matters clinically. You decide what is reliably detectable.
Deployment. Help us architect the right distribution of technology, from cloud to on-premise. You have been through enterprise IT security review before.
Architecture. Own the technical design and set the boundaries between components so specialists can be brought in later without breaking it.
Lean resource management. You will build using an intelligent mix of your own hands-on work, AI agents, and targeted contractors — minimizing full-time headcount until revenue and milestones warrant it.
Future technical hiring. As StealthCo grows, you will help recruit and evaluate future engineering headcount growth.
Customer and investor presence. You will be in the room with the design partner's clinical and IT teams, at Seed investor pitches, and at future health system customer meetings. You need to hold substantive technical conversations across the table from a hospital IT leader or clinical informatics team and be taken seriously by them.

About the Role
This level is for developing leaders who make significant contributions through deep expertise and strategic execution. It spans three related titles: Associate Director and Lead on the management path, and Principal on the senior individual-contributor path. Individuals here lead teams or operate as senior ICs, spearheading complex projects aligned to long-term objectives, providing input into strategy within their function, and beginning to carry account-economics accountability - workstream profitability, scope discipline, and growth signals - ahead of full P&L ownership at Director. On the individual-contributor path, Principal is the senior technical-authority apex of the practice - a peer in influence to the management titles - creating value through methodology leadership, productized IP, and delivery economics rather than through P&L ownership.
The work differs by team - Global Accounts, Content, Media-First, or Marketing/Web/CRM/Tech - but the standard is consistent: own complex, high-stakes work; influence outcomes across functions or client portfolios; and start to think and act like an owner of the relationship, not just the deliverable.

Complex Program & Engagement Leadership
Lead complex projects or programs end to end across one or more accounts - shaping the approach, orchestrating the team, and owning the outcome at a senior level.
Early Account Economics

Strategic Input & Influence
Provide input into strategy within your function and influence outcomes across functions or client portfolios. Connect the analytics to the client’s broader business agenda.
Principal Track – Senior Expert
For the senior-IC path: serve as a senior expert and authority whose depth shapes the practice, leads the most demanding work, and sets methodological direction.
AD / Lead Track – Team Leadership
For the management path: lead a team, own delivery quality across multiple workstreams, develop talent, and manage performance within your remit.
Client Advisory & Growth Signals
Hold senior working relationships and at least one executive-adjacent relationship. Identify and qualify growth opportunities, and bring them to account leadership with a defined client need and rough scope.
AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation
Identify qualified AI use-cases, build early business cases, and integrate Monks.Flow and partner platforms into how the team delivers and how clients measure.

7+ years in analytics, consulting, or strategic advisory across agency, holding company, or in-house at scale
Track record leading complex projects or programs, or recognized as a senior expert in domain

jobs.title: Director Of Engineering - Platform Services
jobs.text:
About Truveta
Truveta is the world’s first health provider-led data platform, with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care.
Achieving this vision requires a talented and diverse team with expertise across healthcare, software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and artificial intelligence. We are looking for people who are motivated by purposeful work and committed to building technology that can improve healthcare outcomes.
This position is based in Hyderabad, India.
Who We Need
Truveta is expanding its engineering presence in India to solve complex healthcare and technology challenges at global scale. We are seeking a collaborative and experienced engineering leader who can operate effectively across ambiguity, scale, and evolving requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong software and infrastructure fundamentals with the ability to build high-performing teams, influence technical direction, and deliver reliable platforms. You should be comfortable balancing hands-on technical leadership with people management and working with distributed teams across India and the United States.
If you are motivated by purposeful work, enjoy building teams and platforms from the ground up, and want to shape how data, AI, and engineering systems are powered internally, Truveta may be the right fit for you.
This Opportunity
We are seeking a Director Of Engineering (POD Lead) to lead the Platform Services team in India.
The Platform Services team will build, manage, and operate the infrastructure that supports engineering teams across India and globally. The team will also own critical backend and platform services, including authentication, authorization, customer and consumer identity and access management, CI/CD, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, developer productivity tools, observability, and shared engineering services.
These services form the backbone of Truveta’s engineering platform and have dependencies across multiple Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Product, and Security teams.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role with people-management responsibilities. You will be accountable for technical direction, delivery excellence, platform reliability, and team growth. You will work closely with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams in India and the United States.
What You’ll Do
Technical and Platform Leadership
Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Platform Services and internal engineering platforms.
Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure and backend services.
Guide architecture decisions across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, identity, security, developer tooling, and shared services.
Build and operate platforms that support engineering, data, machine learning, annotation, and internal workflow requirements.
Lead the development and management of Kubernetes-based platforms and cloud-native services.
Build and improve authentication, authorization, identity management, and access control services.
Drive the development of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, infrastructure-as-code, and developer self-service capabilities.
Establish engineering standards for system design, API development, testing, code quality, observability, and operational readiness.
Improve platform availability, scalability, performance, security, disaster recovery, and operational efficiency.
Provide hands-on technical guidance through design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, production-readiness reviews, and incident responses.
Balance near-term delivery commitments with long-term platform scalability, maintainability, and technical health.
Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce operational overhead, and improve engineering productivity.
Product and Delivery Leadership
Partner with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and define priorities.
Translate business and engineering needs into clear technical strategies, milestones, and delivery plans.
Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery across multiple platform initiatives.
Manage cross-team dependencies and proactively address execution risks.
Define and track success metrics related to platform adoption, reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity.
Communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and technical decisions to stakeholders and senior leadership.
POD and People Leadership
Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team in India.
Provide technical direction, coaching, and support to engineers at different career levels.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and succession planning.
Establish effective processes for planning, execution, prioritization, and retrospective learning.
Encourage engineers to take ownership of services throughout their lifecycle, from design and development through production operations.
Create an inclusive environment where team members can contribute, learn, and grow.
Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration
Work closely with engineering teams across India and the United States to develop shared platforms and services.
Partner effectively with U.S.-based stakeholders across time zones.
Represent the India Platform Services team in architecture, planning, and organizational forums.
Serve as a key technical voice in discussions about platform strategy, engineering effectiveness, and future growth.
Build strong relationships with internal customers and ensure that platform services meet the needs of the broader organization.
Key Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
3+ years of experience in technical leadership, engineering management, or people management.
Experience leading engineering teams responsible for shared platforms, infrastructure, backend services, or developer tooling.
Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and production-grade backend services.
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and cloud-native technologies.
Strong understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, service discovery, and infrastructure operations.
Experience building engineering infrastructure, internal platforms, workflow-heavy systems, or developer productivity tools.
Experience with authentication, authorization, identity management, or security-focused backend services.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Go, Python, or similar.
Experience with modern API architectures, microservices, event-driven systems, and service integration patterns.
Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence.
Familiarity with open-source technologies and the ability to evaluate and adopt open-source solutions.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices and Agile delivery methods.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, clinical data, or other highly regulated domains.
Experience building platforms that support data engineering, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or annotation workflows.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or other major cloud platforms.
Experience with identity and access management technologies and protocols such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
Experience with service mesh, API gateways, secrets management, policy enforcement, and zero-trust security models.
Experience defining service-level objectives, reliability standards, and platform maturity models.
Experience leading teams through significant organizational or platform growth.
Experience working with globally distributed engineering organizations.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, cost management, and optimization.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering & Operations
jobs.text:
At Tatum, we're looking for a Head of Engineering & Operations – a hands-on leader who likes working closely with engineers and helping them do good work. At its core, the job is about people: supporting the team, removing the blockers in their way, keeping priorities clear, and making sure what we ship is reliable and useful to our customers.
The role spans a few areas – infrastructure, engineering, blockchain operations, and quality management. It's broad, and you'll be close to the work rather than managing from a distance: you'll be leading engineers directly and shaping how it all fits together.
At Tatum, we value ownership, flexibility, respect, and practical execution. We work in a fast-paced blockchain environment with flat hierarchies, informal communication, and a strong focus on individual contribution and autonomy.
What we need help with
Leading the team
Run team planning, prioritization, estimates, backlog, and delivery.
Support people management, coordination, and day-to-day operational decisions.
Improve collaboration across Product, Engineering, Support, and Security.
Infrastructure & platform
Own infrastructure reliability, observability, monitoring, and on-call.
Find and fix reliability, performance, and operational issues before they reach customers.
Research, integrate, and operate blockchain networks in the Tatum ecosystem.
Support work on Tatum's Dashboard, API platform, backend services, and internal tools.
Handle production operations, debugging, and incident resolution.
Standards & quality
Set technical standards and improve documentation and engineering processes.
Define and improve quality and release quality.
Cost & commercial
Keep an eye on infrastructure and vendor costs, and their impact on COGS and margins.
Assess technical feasibility and cost impact for new deals, trials, and commitments.
Guide vendor decisions – reliability, SLAs, pricing, and operational fit.
Our technology stack
Cloud & infrastructure: GCP, OVH
Ops & CI/CD: Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform
Frontend: TypeScript, React.js, Tailwind CSS
Backend: Node.js, Nest.js
Data: MongoDB, Firestore, Redis
Messaging: RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub
Blockchain: 200+ blockchain networks
Observability & on-call: Grafana, BetterStack
Code quality & security: Snyk, SonarCloud
Cooperation: ClickUp, Notion

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.
We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're hiring a VP of Engineering to take full ownership of one of our core engineering domains. You'll report to our CTO and own your domain outright, including strategy, architecture, delivery, and the team. This is a hands-on leadership role.

Build and lead the engineering team in your domain, including hiring, structure, and standards
Set technical direction alongside the CTO and the wider leadership team
Ship alongside your team on the hardest problems

jobs.title: Engineering Director - Platform
jobs.text:
We are looking for an Engineering Director to own the technology platform behind the GoMining ecosystem.
This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines deep engineering expertise with strong product and business thinking.
You will own the Platform end-to-end — technology strategy, architecture, engineering organization, roadmap, reliability, delivery, and its impact on the wider business.
The Platform powers multiple GoMining products and includes core application infrastructure, authentication and authorization, integrations, shared services, analytics infrastructure, user restrictions, native applications, reliability, and other foundational capabilities.
This is not a role where success is measured simply by uptime, delivery, or engineering output.
We expect the Engineering Director to understand where technology creates or limits business value, make trade-offs between long-term architecture and immediate commercial priorities, and build a platform that allows the entire company to move faster.
Responsibilities
Platform Strategy & Architecture
Own the technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GoMining Platform.
Build scalable shared infrastructure used across multiple products and engineering teams.
Define which capabilities should be centralized at Platform level and which should remain within individual product teams.
Drive major architectural and technical decisions.
Identify scalability and architectural bottlenecks before they become business-critical.
Balance long-term platform investments with immediate product and commercial priorities.
Reliability & Engineering Excellence
Own platform reliability, availability, latency, scalability, and operational performance.
Define and improve SLAs, DORA metrics, engineering performance, and incident-management practices.
Improve release stability, engineering velocity, and system resilience.
Lead post-incident improvements and eliminate systemic reliability issues.
Maintain a high engineering bar without unnecessary bureaucracy.
Core Platform Capabilities
Own shared authentication, authorization, registration, and 2FA infrastructure.
Develop common account controls, user restrictions, and security mechanisms.
Own integrations and shared backend capabilities required across GoMining products.
Develop shared analytics and event infrastructure.
Support common infrastructure across web and native applications.
Partner with Product, Design, Security, and engineering teams on cross-company capabilities.
Product & Business Impact
Platform at GoMining is not an isolated infrastructure function.
You will work directly with product leaders, General Managers, and C-level stakeholders to understand where technology can unlock growth and where platform limitations are holding the business back.
Prioritize engineering initiatives based on technical risk and business impact.
Understand how platform decisions affect revenue, conversion, customer experience, and product velocity.
Identify technical changes that can unlock meaningful business results.
Balance competing priorities across multiple product teams.
Make clear trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, security, and business value.
Measure Platform not only through technical metrics, but through how effectively it accelerates the company.
Engineering Leadership
Lead and develop the Platform engineering organization.
Own team structure, hiring, performance, priorities, and execution.
Build a culture of strong engineering ownership and accountability.
Stay close enough to architecture and technology to challenge decisions and make informed trade-offs.
Develop strong technical leaders within the team.
Raise the technical and execution bar across the organization.
AI-First Engineering
Actively use AI tools and agents in your own work.
Introduce AI-assisted workflows across engineering, specifications, QA, analytics, and operations.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering work.
Use AI to increase engineering velocity and quality.
Build a team where AI becomes part of the engineering operating model.

jobs.title: Directeur·rice des produits et de l'ingénierie | Head of Product and Engineering
jobs.text:
ProgressionLIVE développe des logiciels web et mobiles de gestion des opérations de service sur le terrain, utilisés par des centaines d’organisations canadiennes dans les secteurs du CVC, de la plomberie, de l’électricité, de la construction, du transport et de la maintenance.
Votre rôle
Relevant du directeur général, vous dirigerez toute l’équipe produit et technologie et serez responsable de la feuille de route et de la livraison. Vous définirez avec le directeur général les orientations produit, les priorités majeures et les investissements structurants, tout en exerçant votre autonomie sur les décisions courantes et l’exécution.
Vous combinerez jugement produit, leadership et contribution technique directe : accompagner les développeurs, renforcer leurs compétences avec l’IA et programmer certaines fonctionnalités jusqu’à leur mise en production. Vous vous appuierez sur les expertises de l’équipe pour les décisions techniques spécialisées.
Vos responsabilités
Piloter la feuille de route à partir des échanges clients, des données d’utilisation et des objectifs commerciaux. Collaborer avec les ventes et le service client, puis mesurer l’adoption et l’impact.
Diriger l’exécution : définir la portée, organiser les priorités, lever les obstacles et accompagner l’équipe jusqu’à la mise en production et à la validation des résultats.
Programmer et livrer certaines fonctionnalités, en respectant les exigences de tests, de revue de code et de sécurité. Créer aussi des prototypes et des outils internes.
Recruter et développer l’équipe. Accompagner les développeurs par le travail en binôme, les revues de code, la formation et le partage des connaissances.
Définir et diriger un modèle opérationnel activé par l’IA pour le produit et l’ingénierie. Habiliter les développeurs, l’assurance qualité et les DevOps à utiliser l’IA efficacement tout au long du cycle de vie du développement, de la recherche et des spécifications à la mise en œuvre, aux tests, à l’examen du code, à la documentation, au débogage, au déploiement et à la réponse aux incidents.
Identifier et automatiser les activités répétitives ou à faible valeur ajoutée. Prototyper les flux de travail agentic à fort impact et les outils internes, les évaluer en fonction des améliorations mesurables dans la vitesse de livraison, la qualité, la fiabilité et la capacité de l’équipe, pas seulement les taux d’adoption.
Établir des normes pratiques pour l’utilisation responsable de l’IA (sécurité, confidentialité, propriété intellectuelle, qualité, responsabilité). Créer une culture d’expérimentation tout en veillant à ce que les gens restent responsables de l’exactitude et de la sécurité.
Identifier les opportunités d’IA orientées client qui créent une valeur significative et différenciée, distinguant les capacités authentiques des features motivées par la nouveauté. Partenaire avec les clients et l’équipe pour valider et hiérarchiser.
Équilibrer nouvelles fonctionnalités, dette technique, fiabilité et sécurité. Évaluer les compromis avec l’équipe et maintenir des exigences claires de qualité et de confidentialité.
Votre profil
8+ années de leadership en développement logiciel, incluant la construction et la mise à l’échelle d’équipes d’ingénierie.
Expérience pratique en développement logiciel et capacité actuelle à comprendre une base de code, programmer, tester et livrer des fonctionnalités en production.
Expérience de direction d’une équipe de développement, avec responsabilité de la livraison et capacité à recruter, coacher et faire progresser les développeurs.
Solide jugement produit : comprendre les problèmes clients, piloter une feuille de route, prioriser les investissements et mesurer les résultats.
Maîtrise pratique des outils de développement assisté par l’IA et capacité à transmettre des méthodes efficaces, avec validation critique du code généré.
Bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais pour collaborer avec les équipes et utiliser la documentation technique.
Notre environnement technologique
Java, Spring, Hibernate, Vue 3, TypeScript, AWS, GitHub Actions et Terraform. Nos applications mobiles fonctionnent hors ligne et se synchronisent. La maîtrise de chaque technologie n’est pas requise.
Nos avantages (et ils valent le détour!)
Chez ProgressionLIVE, on croit que la performance passe par le bien-être.
Voici ce qu'on t'offre :
Semaine de 4 jours
Télétravail
Assurances collectives après 3 mois (50 % payé par l'entreprise, option famille)
Programme d'aide aux employés (PAE)
Programme de médecine corporative
REER collectif (RPDB)
3 semaines de vacances dès la première année (accessibles après 3 mois)
Activités sociales et sportives régulières
Budget annuel pour de la formation
Budget personnel annuel (équipements sportifs ou de télétravail)
Cafés, collations et bonne humeur garantis au bureau
____________________________________________________________________________________
ProgressionLIVE develops web and mobile software for field service operations, used by hundreds of Canadian organizations across HVAC, plumbing, electrical, construction, transportation, and maintenance.
Your role
Reporting to the General Manager, you will lead the full product and technology team and own the roadmap and delivery. You will jointly agree with the General Manager on product direction, major priorities, and significant investments, while exercising autonomy over day to day product decisions and execution.
You will combine product judgment, team leadership, and direct technical contribution. Your software development experience will enable you to coach developers, build their AI skills, and personally code and ship selected product features. You will draw on the team’s expertise for specialized technical decisions.
Your responsibilities
Own the roadmap, drawing on customer conversations, usage data, and business objectives. Collaborate with sales and customer service, then measure adoption and impact.
Lead execution: define scope, sequence priorities, remove obstacles, and guide the team through release and validation of results.
Personally code and ship selected features, meeting testing, code review, and security standards. Build prototypes and internal tools as needed.
Recruit and develop the team. Coach developers through pair programming, code reviews, training, and knowledge sharing.
Define and lead an AI enabled operating model for product and engineering. Empower developers, QA, and DevOps to use AI effectively across the full development lifecycle, from research and specification through implementation, testing, code review, documentation, debugging, deployment, and incident response.
Identify and automate repetitive or low-value activities. Prototype high-leverage agentic workflows and internal tools, evaluating them based on measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, reliability, and team capacity, not just adoption rates.
Establish practical standards for responsible AI use (security, privacy, IP, quality, accountability). Build a culture of experimentation while ensuring people remain accountable for correctness and security.
Identify customer-facing AI opportunities that create meaningful, differentiated value, distinguishing genuine capabilities from novelty-driven features. Partner with customers and the team to validate and prioritize.
Balance new capabilities, technical debt, reliability, and security. Evaluate tradeoffs with the team and maintain clear quality and privacy standards.
Our technology environment
Java, Spring, Hibernate, Vue 3, TypeScript, AWS, GitHub Actions, and Terraform. Our mobile applications support offline use and synchronization. Experience with every technology is not required.

jobs.title: Head of Product - B2C
jobs.text:
Renmoney Microfinance Bank is on a mission to empower individuals and businesses across Nigeria by building a comprehensive financial ecosystem. From lending and savings to insurance, remittances, payments, and lifestyle services, we are creating innovative solutions that drive financial inclusion and economic growth.
Your Mission
As Chief Product Officer (CPO), you will own the vision and strategic direction of Renmoney’s retail product ecosystem. This includes core lending and banking products, as well as adjacent services such as insurance, remittances, and lifestyle solutions. Given the seniority of the CPO position and its strategic impact on the business, the role requires relocation to Lagos, Nigeria for the on-site work in the headquarters of the company.
You will work closely with the executive team to:
Drive product innovation and profitability.
Enhance customer experience and adoption.
Ensure products are competitive, compliant, and scalable in Nigeria’s fast-evolving financial services landscape.
You will lead multidisciplinary teams across Product Management, Design, Data, and Technology — ensuring that what we build creates measurable value for customers, partners, and the business.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Vision
Define and deliver Renmoney’s ecosystem product strategy, balancing growth, profitability, and risk.
Translate market opportunities into scalable product roadmaps across lending, banking services, insurance, remittances, payments, and lifestyle.
Stay ahead of regulatory requirements and competitive dynamics in Nigeria.
Product Development & Execution
Lead the design and rollout of customer-centric products tailored to Nigeria’s retail segments.
Champion research, data analytics, and customer feedback to shape product decisions.
Drive adoption of AI, automation, and digital channels to improve efficiency and customer experience.
Establish robust product governance and compliance processes.
Ecosystem & Partnerships
Build and manage strategic partnerships with fintechs, telcos, insurers, remittance providers, and lifestyle platforms.
Develop cross-sell, bundled, and embedded finance opportunities that expand customer value.
Negotiate favorable commercial terms that balance growth and cost efficiency.
Leadership & Performance
Lead and grow a high-performing product team with a culture of accountability, innovation, and delivery.
Partner with Risk, Finance, and Collections to optimize pricing, yields, impairments, and capital allocation.
Track and report KPIs: adoption, profitability, NPS/CSAT, revenue contribution, and ecosystem expansion.

jobs.text:
Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française
Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !
Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.s
HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-ups françaises les plus prometteuses !

jobs.title: Co-Founder & CTO - AI Catalyst Discovery Venture
jobs.text:
The Venture
Discovering a better catalyst still runs on trial and error: form a hypothesis, synthesise a few candidates, test, repeat, for years, at a cost measured in millions. Most of the search space is never touched. It is one of the slowest, most expensive bottlenecks between the chemicals industry and a lower-carbon future.
We're building the company to change that. Spun out of A*STAR, our platform closes the loop between computation and the lab: machine learning proposes catalyst compositions worth making, simulation screens them, and an automated experimental workflow validates the winners, feeding every result back to sharpen the next cycle. It reaches candidates a traditional programme never would, in a fraction of the time and cost.
The beachhead is CO₂ to methanol and green chemicals, where industry pull is real and the economics work. Most catalyst work is improving a recipe that already exists, and the incumbent supplier usually keeps that business. The opportunity is a new process with no incumbent catalyst, and an unusual number of those are arriving between now and 2030. The core discovery IP is being licensed from A*STAR, with the inventor on board as an advisor. What the venture needs now is a founding technical leader to own the science and build the company around it.
The Role
You'll be the founding CTO. You'll own everything from the discovery campaign to a catalyst a customer can actually run in their process, taking a validated workflow and turning it into the engine of a real business. You'll work alongside a commercial co-founder (CEO), a dedicated ATUM venture team, and the inventor-advisor.
Together, we'll:
Direct the catalysis: which chemistries we pursue, how we design the discovery campaigns, how we read the results
Own the licensed workflow and the automated experimental loop end to end
Take candidates from prediction to a manufacturable, deployable catalyst, not a paper
Build defensible IP the company owns, including new catalyst compositions worth patenting
Sit across the table from chemical customers and turn their process problems into targets we can solve
Build the lab foundation and the science team behind it
This is not a job. It's a founding journey where you share the risk, the upside, and the impact.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering Operations
jobs.text:
Infleqtion is seeking a Director of Engineering Operations within the Quantum Sensing Solutions (QSS) group. This leader will own and continuously improve the engineering operating system that enables multidisciplinary teams to develop, control, review, release, and transition complex quantum technologies and products from concept through manufacturing. The role will initially serve QSS, while establishing practices, systems, and capabilities designed for broader enterprise adoption as the organization grows.
Reporting to the QSS Chief Engineer, the Director will translate expectations for technical rigor into scalable processes, stage-appropriate governance, quality and configuration controls, engineering tools, laboratory operations, equipment strategies, and technical infrastructure. The Director will lead Quality, Configuration Management and Document Control, and Laboratory Operations, and will work across business areas, programs, engineering disciplines, sites, and corporate functions to create a consistent and usable environment for engineering execution.
The Director will have authority to establish mandatory engineering processes, approve process tailoring within delegated authority, govern major lifecycle gates, and pause reviews or releases when required evidence, configuration integrity, quality readiness, or compliance conditions have not been met. The QSS Chief Engineer remains the ultimate technical authority and may delegate technical authority to Program Chief Engineers or other qualified leaders. Engineering Operations will enable sound technical decisions and verify the integrity of the decision process without routinely substituting for program or discipline-level technical judgment.
The successful candidate will combine broad engineering leadership with practical experience building operating systems for complex hardware and firmware development. This leader must be comfortable applying lightweight controls to exploratory work, increasing rigor as designs mature, and directly engaging at major baseline, release, qualification, and manufacturing-transition points. The role requires a service mindset, independent judgment, and the ability to make compliance and rigor practical in a fast-moving advanced-development environment.
Key Responsibilities
Engineering Operating System and Lifecycle Governance
• Own the QSS engineering lifecycle from concept development through transition to manufacturing, including defined phases, maturity expectations, decision points, required evidence, and accountable roles.
• Establish, implement, and continuously improve mandatory engineering processes that are scalable across programs, products, business areas, technical disciplines, and maturity levels.
• Define and administer a stage-appropriate tailoring model that preserves speed during exploratory development while increasing control, traceability, and assurance as solutions mature.
• Translate practices demonstrated on high-value and high-risk programs into repeatable standards, templates, training, and reusable infrastructure for the broader QSS portfolio.
• Ensure QSS engineering processes remain compatible with enterprise operating models, contractual requirements, customer expectations, and future company-wide adoption.
Technical Gate Reviews and Release Governance
• Own and enforce the technical gate-review process, including review purpose, entrance and exit criteria, required participants, evidence packages, decisions, actions, and closure expectations.
• Provide direct governance at major lifecycle transitions, technical baseline events, product releases, qualification milestones, and manufacturing-transition decisions; delegate routine review and release activities based on product maturity and demonstrated organizational capability.
• Partner with the responsible Chief Engineer, Program Chief Engineer, Program Manager, and technical leads so technical adequacy and operational readiness are evaluated as complementary but distinct decisions.
Quality Management and AS9100 Readiness
• Lead the quality organization and establish an effective, service-oriented quality system supporting the delivery of advanced prototypes, qualification units, low-rate builds, and run-rate products.
• Lead QSS preparation for and maintenance of AS9100 certification, including process definition, deployment, training, internal audits, management review, corrective action, records, and continuous improvement.
• Ensure quality personnel provide practical support to engineering and manufacturing teams while retaining independent authority to identify, document, escalate, and stop work or release when quality or mission-assurance requirements are at risk.
• Maintain an independent quality escalation path to the QSS Chief Engineer and appropriate executive leadership.
Configuration Management, Document Control, and Technical Data
• Lead Configuration Management and Document Control as responsive service functions that enable teams to establish, maintain, and retrieve accurate technical baselines and records.
• Own configuration-management policy and implementation for hardware and firmware, with a roadmap to expand coverage as software and integrated product needs mature.
• Establish controlled processes for requirements, specifications, drawings, bills of material, firmware and software items, test evidence, calibration records, technical reports, customer deliverables, and other product-definition data.
• Ensure configuration and document-control practices integrate effectively with Quality, Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, program controls, and customer data requirements.
Engineering Tools, Digital Workflows, and Knowledge Management
• Serve as the engineering business-process owner for PLM, requirements management, design software, development issue tracking, and knowledge-management environments.
• Define common workflows, data models, integrations, access patterns, governance, and adoption expectations across QSS business areas and sites.
• Partner with IT as the technical system owner to implement reliable, secure, supportable, and usable engineering tools and integrations.
• Lead tool rationalization and roadmap development, balancing enterprise standardization with legitimate discipline, program, customer, and regulatory needs.
• Enable effective capture, reuse, and transfer of engineering knowledge, including standards, templates, libraries, design practices, review findings, and lessons learned.
Laboratories, Technical Facilities, and Equipment
• Lead laboratory operations across QSS and define the technical use, allocation, access, readiness, and evolution of shared engineering spaces, while Facilities retains responsibility for the physical space and building systems.
• Own the lifecycle management of engineering equipment, including requirements, acquisition, configuration, calibration, preventive maintenance, scheduling, utilization, readiness, and retirement.
• Develop coordinated laboratory, test, prototyping, and equipment roadmaps across business areas and geographic locations to reduce duplication, improve utilization, and enable future program and product needs.
• Own consolidated capital-equipment planning and budget governance across engineering and manufacturing, while Engineering Operations and Manufacturing retain operational ownership of their respective equipment.
• Partner with Facilities and EH&S to ensure laboratories, equipment, and technical work practices satisfy applicable safety, environmental, security, and operational requirements.
Engineering Technical Security and Export-Controlled Data
• Define engineering workflow, tool, access, collaboration, storage, transfer, and retention requirements for sensitive and export-controlled technical information.
• Partner with IT, Legal, Trade Compliance, Security, and program leadership to ensure engineering systems and working practices are compliant, auditable, and practical for day-to-day use.
• Ensure engineers understand and consistently apply requirements for handling controlled technical data across sites, programs, suppliers, partners, and customer interfaces.
• Identify and resolve conflicts between engineering usability, collaboration needs, contractual restrictions, cybersecurity controls, and export-control requirements.
Cross-Functional Leadership and Manufacturing Transition
• Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, and technical leadership to define and continuously improve engineering-release and manufacturing-transition criteria.
• Ensure major transition decisions consider product-definition maturity, configuration baselines, verification evidence, unresolved technical and quality risks, tooling and test readiness, material constraints, training, and post-transfer ownership.
• Work closely with Execution and Staffing Operations to identify emerging capability needs, critical operational gaps, and priorities for hiring, development, partnering, or outsourcing.
• Coordinate engineering operating practices across the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia, accounting for local regulatory, contractual, security, and operational needs while preserving common QSS expectations.
• Provide leadership with clear visibility into systemic engineering risks, process health, quality performance, configuration integrity, laboratory readiness, equipment constraints, release quality, rework, and improvement priorities.
Organizational Leadership
• Build, lead, develop, and retain a high-performing Engineering Operations organization, initially including Quality, Configuration Management and Document Control, and Laboratory Operations.
• Identify existing process and capability owners, clarify their authority and accountabilities, and integrate their work into a coherent QSS operating model.
• Establish a culture of service, technical rigor, independent judgment, accountability, pragmatic compliance, continuous improvement, and constructive cross-functional partnership.
• Develop leaders and subject-matter experts capable of scaling Engineering Operations practices across business areas, sites, and future enterprise applications.

• Own consolidated capital-equipment planning and budget governance across engineering and manufacturing, while Engineering Operations and Manufacturing retain operational ownership of their respective equipment.
• Partner with Facilities and EH&S to ensure laboratories, equipment, and technical work practices satisfy applicable safety, environmental, security, and operational requirements.
Engineering Technical Security and Export-Controlled Data
• Define engineering workflow, tool, access, collaboration, storage, transfer, and retention requirements for sensitive and export-controlled technical information.
• Partner with IT, Legal, Trade Compliance, Security, and program leadership to ensure engineering systems and working practices are compliant, auditable, and practical for day-to-day use.
• Ensure engineers understand and consistently apply requirements for handling controlled technical data across sites, programs, suppliers, partners, and customer interfaces.
• Identify and resolve conflicts between engineering usability, collaboration needs, contractual restrictions, cybersecurity controls, and export-control requirements.
Cross-Functional Leadership and Manufacturing Transition
• Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, and technical leadership to define and continuously improve engineering-release and manufacturing-transition criteria.

• Ensure major transition decisions consider product-definition maturity, configuration baselines, verification evidence, unresolved technical and quality risks, tooling and test readiness, material constraints, training, and post-transfer ownership.
• Work closely with Execution and Staffing Operations to identify emerging capability needs, critical operational gaps, and priorities for hiring, development, partnering, or outsourcing.

• Coordinate engineering operating practices across the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia, accounting for local regulatory, contractual, security, and operational needs while preserving common QSS expectations.

• Provide leadership with clear visibility into systemic engineering risks, process health, quality performance, configuration integrity, laboratory readiness, equipment constraints, release quality, rework, and improvement priorities.
Organizational Leadership
• Build, lead, develop, and retain a high-performing Engineering Operations organization, initially including Quality, Configuration Management and Document Control, and Laboratory Operations.
• Identify existing process and capability owners, clarify their authority and accountabilities, and integrate their work into a coherent QSS operating model.
• Establish a culture of service, technical rigor, independent judgment, accountability, pragmatic compliance, continuous improvement, and constructive cross-functional partnership.
• Develop leaders and subject-matter experts capable of scaling Engineering Operations practices across business areas, sites, and future enterprise applications.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, AI Agents
jobs.text:
We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to lead and scale Asana’s flagship AI Teammates Pillar within our Core/AI Organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Engineering, AI & AWM, you will oversee an engineering area encompassing four key teams: AI Teammates Platform (AITP), AI Teammates Experience (AITX), AI Chat Experience, and Agent Orchestration. In this role, you will lead engineering managers and senior technical leaders to drive the end-to-end strategy, execution, and architecture that define how humans and AI collaborate in Asana, turning frontier LLM capabilities into trusted, reliable, high-value product workflows for enterprise customers worldwide.
This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What you’ll achieve
Drive Strategy & Execution Across the AI Teammates Pillar: Lead, set direction, and align goals/metrics across four core engineering teams (Platform, Experience, Chat, and Agent Orchestration) to execute on Asana’s flagship AI vision while balancing business, customer, and technical needs.
Architect Enterprise-Grade AI Platforms & Systems: Own the end-to-end technical strategy across model rollouts, eval infrastructure, tool orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and proactivity engines—enabling Asana to operate reliable agentic systems for top-tier enterprise customers.
Define Next-Generation Human-AI Collaboration: Lead product and platform engineering teams delivering full-screen and docked chat surfaces, discovery/onboarding flows, in-product explainability, human-in-the-loop workflows, and ROI/governance experiences for administrators.
Pioneer Multi-System Agent Orchestration: Build integrations, Agent Skills, and MCP frameworks that allow AI Teammates to act as the central control point for complex, multi-step workflows across external tools like Slack, Salesforce, coding agents, and internal systems.
Scale Engineering Leadership & Culture: Plan and implement the scaling of your engineering organization. Recruit, close, and retain top engineering talent and managers, develop leadership capabilities across teams, and foster an inclusive environment centered on engineering excellence and psychological safety.
Bridge Cross-Functional & External Strategic Alignment: Align technical, product, and business perspectives across R&D, Product, Design, Security, and Legal, while maintaining close strategic partnerships with frontier AI labs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).
About you
Proven Leadership Experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience with 4+ years leading multiple engineering teams or managers, with a track record of driving multi-team strategy and delivering complex production systems.
AI & Agentic Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of applied AI, LLM evaluation frameworks, agent/tool orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), proactivity models, and production observability.
Systems & Product Engineering Mastery: Experience spanning backend/systems reliability, complex full-stack product interfaces, and enterprise governance/permissions models operating at scale.
Strategic Trade-off & Risk Management: Proven ability to balance short-term customer deliverables with long-term architectural investments and navigate ambiguity over multiple quarters.
Excellence in People & Organizational Growth: Demonstrated commitment to attracting, hiring, and mentoring senior engineers and managers while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion.
Exceptional Communication: Strong capability to bridge business, product, and technical contexts to align executive stakeholders, internal engineering partners, and enterprise clients.
At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
What we’ll offer
Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.
For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $306,000 - $360,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.
In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.
We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:
Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences
These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, Core Product
jobs.text:
The Opportunity
As a Senior Director of Engineering, Core Product at Coursedog, you'll own the day-to-day execution and engineering health of Coursedog's three core product clouds — Assessment, Curriculum, and Scheduling — so they ship reliably, hit their commitments, and defend the revenue base. You'll work closely with engineering managers, product leadership, and cross-functional partners to translate the roadmap into reliable, high-quality software. This is a delivery-and-execution leadership role — focused on building and running the products customers pay for today.
This role will be the single accountable leader for how core product engineering executes, week over week and quarter over quarter. You'll pioneer an AI-augmented development model where clear specifications unlock high-quality, AI-accelerated delivery. You'll be responsible for predictable shipping, quality, and reliability, and driving a step-change in engineering velocity through AI and spec-driven practices, while building a strong bench of engineering leaders in a fast-moving, mission-driven environment.
This role reports directly to the SVP, Software Engineering and collaborates cross-functionally. This role is well-suited for someone who operates with both strategic vision and operational rigor, takes ownership of hard problems, and is motivated by building systems and teams that scale sustainably.
If you're excited by the chance to lead a major engineering function, shape how a critical part of the product organization executes, and transform how an entire engineering org builds software through AI-augmented, spec-driven practices, this is an opportunity to have outsized impact at a high-growth company.
This position offers a competitive base salary between $175,000 - $200,000, based on experience and qualifications. The role also includes a performance-based variable compensation component, bringing total on-target earnings (OTE) to $210,000 - $250,000 when performance objectives are achieved.
What You'll Own:
Lead the AI transformation into a spec-driven development org: Own the shift from ad-hoc coding to a spec-driven model where well-defined specifications drive design, implementation, review, and testing — and where AI tooling is used to accelerate delivery without eroding quality. Set the standard for how specs are written, versioned, and used as the contract between product intent and shipped code. Make AI-assisted development a durable competitive advantage across all three clouds, and raise the quality bar as AI-generated code volume grows.
Lead through metrics: You run the org on data, not anecdote. Define the metrics that tell the truth about delivery, quality, and reliability; make them visible; and use them to drive decisions, expose risk early, and focus the teams. You model metric-driven leadership for your EMs and know when a number is a floor, a goal, or a distraction.
Hold teams accountable: You are the single accountable leader for core product delivery, and you build that same accountability into every team. Set clear commitments and a clear definition of done, make ownership unambiguous, follow through on outcomes, and address underperformance directly and fairly. Commitments mean something on your teams.
Build a continuous-improvement culture: Create an engineering culture that gets measurably better every quarter — where retros lead to change, standards rise over time, experimentation is safe, and improving the system is everyone's job. You partner with your engineering managers to make continuous improvement a habit, not an event.
Multi-cloud engineering leadership: Set the standard for how the Assessment, Curriculum, and Scheduling teams plan, build, review, test, and release. Hold the line on consistency across all three without flattening what makes each cloud distinct.
Day-to-day execution: Sprint health, throughput, and delivery against quarterly commitments are yours. Run the cadence through your engineering managers, clear blockers fast, and make the trade-off calls when scope, quality, and timeline collide.
Quality and reliability: Own the quality bar for core product — driving down Change Failure Rate and Escaped Defect Rate, keeping the bug backlog contained, holding SLA compliance across all severity tiers, and protecting production availability. Quality is a first-class outcome, not a cleanup task.
People leadership: Lead and grow a team of engineering managers and their pods. Hire, level, coach, and develop EMs; run calibration and performance cycles; build a bench. You are a manager of managers.
Cross-functional partnership: Operate as the engineering counterpart to product, design, and customer-facing leadership for the three clouds. Translate roadmap into deliverable specs and plans, surface risk early and honestly, and keep commitments realistic and met.
Engineering operating system: Strengthen the practices that make delivery compound rather than erode — spec quality, estimation discipline, definition of done, code review standards, release process, and metrics that tell the truth about where teams actually stand.
Outcomes you'll be measured on:
AI and spec-driven adoption — teams operating on a spec-driven model, with measurable velocity and quality gains from AI-assisted development
Epic completion rate across the three clouds against quarterly goals
Bug backlog containment — resolved-vs-created trending the right way, total open issues controlled
Quality signals — Change Failure Rate and Escaped Defect Rate, severity-weighted
SLA compliance across Urgent / High / Medium / Low tiers
Delivery predictability — DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, change failure rate) and consistent sprint commitment hit-rates
Production reliability and availability for core product
Team health — retention, engagement, and EM growth
Continuous improvement — quarter-over-quarter gains in delivery and quality metrics that show the system is getting better, not just holding

jobs.title: Senior Director - Data Platform and Cloud Services
jobs.text:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant.
We're seeking a Senior Director to lead and transform our data platform and cloud services architecture. This role is not about incremental improvements – we need someone who can lead and execute a leap forward in our data infrastructure capabilities, positioning Samba at the forefront of TV data analytics and AI-driven insights.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
At Inventi, we build payment infrastructure technology for payment service providers. Our payments platform connects customers to SEPA, SWIFT, TARGET2, and other payment systems through a single API.
We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer to set our technology direction and shape what we build next.
Why this could be interesting for you
There's no fixed roadmap waiting for you here - you'd build it yourself. You'd shape both the technology and the team, staying hands-on, on infrastructure banks and PSPs actually depend on. And you'd get real room to experiment with AI along the way.
The role:
Own our technology strategy and make the big architectural decisions.
Drive AI adoption across engineering - make it part of how we build.
Set the bar for technical quality and engineering standards.
Own reliability, security, and technical risk across the platform.
Build a delivery process the whole company can rely on.
Drive company wide engineering culture and strive for quality, passion and learning.
Be the technical voice with product, leadership, and key clients.
Protect our fast-moving culture as we grow - build the kind of org you'd want to work in yourself.
What you bring:
Technical depth - you can challenge architecture decisions.
AI is part of your daily toolkit - and something you've brought into your team's way of working.
Experience owning reliability and uptime for systems that can't go down.
You know how to handle a production incident with structure.
A track record of building or scaling an engineering team, with a high bar for who joins it.
You're comfortable in a fast-paced environment.
Fluency in English.
Fintech, payments, or regulated infrastructure experience is a plus.
Our offer:
Ownership: shape the technology strategy of a growing fintech company and have a direct impact on how we build, scale, and operate.
Room to experiment: try new tools, new combinations, new ways of working.
Continuous learning: access to courses, conferences, and books.
Team culture: events, sports challenges, team-building.
Flexible & remote work: enjoy flexible hours and remote work options.
Private health insurance and optional 3rd pillar pension contributions.
Little perks that make a difference: pet-friendly office, snacks, free parking and a lot of ways to take a break - from board to digital.
Gross salary starting from 8000 Eur/month, depending on experience.
🔓Unlock your value! Shape the technology behind payments for banks and PSPs across Europe.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role
Igloo is expanding its product engine and establishing a dedicated Tech Solutions hub in Pune. We are looking for a hands-on Lead Solutions Architect & Site Lead to drive platform architecture, govern technical design, and manage our multidisciplinary engineering organization in India.
In this dual-impact role, you will balance deep technical ownership—reviewing architecture, guiding system design, and auditing code—with people leadership across Engineering, QA, DevOps/SRE, and Integration teams. You will ensure our high-throughput insurance and direct-to-consumer platform remains scalable, secure, and resilient.
Key Responsibilities:
Architecture & System Design
Architect, design, and govern high-availability, microservices-based platform solutions for global direct-to-consumer and partner-facing lines of business.
Conduct architecture, design, and code reviews; establish quality benchmarks, security controls, and robust release mechanisms.
Stay hands-on with system design and technical troubleshooting, guiding engineers through complex algorithmic and infrastructural challenges.
Team & Site Leadership
Lead overall strategy, capacity planning, and operating rhythm for the Pune technology hub.
Recruit, mentor, and scale multidisciplinary teams across backend, frontend, QA, DevOps/SRE, and platform integration.
Drive engineering culture, career pathing, succession planning, and retention initiatives across the India site.
Product Delivery & Operations
Partner with global product, architecture, and business teams (UAE, India, China) to align platform roadmap with technical execution.
