jobs.title: Director, Data & Insights
jobs.text:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues. We do that by knowing fans best. We work with clients to help them understand & influence what their fans are doing – the way fans spend their money, the events that fans attend, the channels fans respond to, the content fans watch and more. And we use the understanding this gives us to help our clients grow. Grow their audiences and grow their revenues - both direct to consumer and business to business revenues. Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1000 people, based out of 15 offices, and we deliver work for sports and entertainment businesses of all shapes and sizes all over the world.
Our Marketing and Consulting expertise help sports rights holders, build relationships with their audiences, partners and sponsors to drive business growth. We do it by using data to help our clients better understand their fans. We then create and implement data-led digital marketing and technology solutions that improve fan experience, grow revenues and build commercial efficiency. By knowing fans best, we break down the traditional barriers between sports organizations and their customers.
Role Overview
The Director, Data & Insights will own the intersection of data platform architecture, strategic insight, and consulting delivery connecting data and technology to commercial value, and turning complex data into strategies that help clients grow. This role requires deep technical fluency across enterprise data infrastructure (AWS Redshift, dbt).
You will independently manage senior executive client relationships leading roadmap conversations, defining KPIs, while delivering structured consulting engagements within data governance and CI/CD constraints.
You will lead a sizeable cross-functional team, and drive change management and alignment across stakeholder groups spanning data governance, analytics, and marketing.
The ideal candidate should be excellent at distilling complex data into clear and actionable insights that balance impact to underlying business performance goals and feasibility.
Duties and Responsibilities
Data Platform Architecture & Data Modeling
Own the ongoing evolution of enterprise-scale data infrastructure (e.g., AWS Redshift, dbt), ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability.
Set standards for data pipeline development, testing, and documentation across the team.
Partner with engineering to ensure architecture decisions align with downstream activation, reporting, and analytics needs.
Strategy & Insight
Connect the dots between data, technology, and commercial value, translating technical capability into strategies that drive client growth.
Derive clear, actionable insights from complex, cross-channel data to inform client strategy and roadmap priorities.
Distill complex analysis into recommendations that balance business impact with delivery feasibility.
Partner with clients and internal teams to shape data-driven growth strategies, not just technical solutions.
Client Leadership & Consulting Delivery
Independently manage senior executive client relationship, serving as the primary strategic point of contact.
Run roadmap conversations, define and track KPIs, and lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with minimal oversight.
Translate business and technical challenges into clear recommendations and delivery plans.
People & Team Leadership
Lead a cross-functional team spanning multiple offices and time zones.
Set team structure, priorities, and performance standards; mentor and develop direct reports and their teams.
Skill Requirements
Required
Proven experience (5+ years) owning enterprise-scale data infrastructure (e.g., AWS Redshift, dbt) and data modeling for real-time activation use cases.
Demonstrated ability to manage a senior executive client relationship independently, including roadmap conversations, KPI definition, and QBRs.
Experience leading a sizeable cross-functional team across multiple offices and time zones.
Experience with structured consulting or project delivery within data governance and CI/CD constraints.
Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling and cloud data warehouses.
Strong ability to connect data and technology decisions to commercial outcomes, translating complex analysis into insights that shape client strategy.
Preferred / Nice to Have
Experience in sports, media, entertainment, or consumer-focused industries.
Familiarity with Adobe platforms (e.g., AEP, CJA, AJO, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target) or comparable BI tools (e.g., Tableau).
Experience with experimentation frameworks, attribution, and advanced analytics techniques.
The range below represents the low and high end of the base salary someone in this role may earn as an employee of Two Circles in the United States. Salaries will vary based on various factors including but not limited to professional and academic experience, training, associated responsibilities, and other business and organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of our total compensation package for employees. Salary decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each hire.
$120,000-$160,000

We then create and implement data-led digital marketing and technology solutions that improve fan experience, grow revenues and build commercial efficiency. By knowing fans best, we break down the traditional barriers between sports organizations and their customers.
Role Overview

The Director, Data & Insights will own the intersection of data platform architecture, strategic insight, and consulting delivery connecting data and technology to commercial value, and turning complex data into strategies that help clients grow. This role requires deep technical fluency across enterprise data infrastructure (AWS Redshift, dbt).

You will independently manage senior executive client relationships leading roadmap conversations, defining KPIs, while delivering structured consulting engagements within data governance and CI/CD constraints.
You will lead a sizeable cross-functional team, and drive change management and alignment across stakeholder groups spanning data governance, analytics, and marketing.
The ideal candidate should be excellent at distilling complex data into clear and actionable insights that balance impact to underlying business performance goals and feasibility.

Data Platform Architecture & Data Modeling

items: Own the ongoing evolution of enterprise-scale data infrastructure (e.g., AWS Redshift, dbt), ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability.

jobs.title: Head of Web Production (DTC Growth Technology) Digital Production Director
jobs.text:
About Us
HarZa Group is a fast-growing operator of direct-to-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote-first, async-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.
The Role
We are a direct-to-consumer business where technology is a direct function of marketing. Our marketing team can develop a campaign idea and write the copy for it in a single day, but that idea only starts producing revenue once it has become a live, accurate and fully functioning landing page, checkout or funnel. The speed of our production function therefore sets the speed of the entire business.
We are hiring a Head of Web Production to build and own the operating system through which marketing requirements become live digital experiences. Your responsibility is not to manage tasks, chase deadlines or add project management meetings. It is to redesign how the work gets done. You will examine every stage of production, remove unnecessary handoffs, improve requirements, manage dependencies, install effective quality controls, and decide where AI, automation, page builders, reusable components or traditional development should be used.
For every requirement you should be asking whether this genuinely needs a developer, whether it can be built from an existing component or template, whether an AI-enabled page builder can complete most of it, whether the marketing team can safely complete it without engineering, whether the requirement can be eliminated or standardized, whether the quality check can be automated, and why it is taking as long as it is. Your job is to protect the business objective while continuously challenging the method used to achieve it.
To be explicit about scope, this is not a cloud infrastructure or site reliability role. This is web production and development operations for a high-volume direct response marketing business.

jobs.title: Head of Policy Design, Societal Harms
jobs.text:
About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic's Safeguards organization builds the policies, evaluations, and detection and enforcement systems that define and hold the limits on how Claude can be used. In this role, you'll lead our policy design team, managing the teams responsible for radicalization, child safety, user well-being, harmful manipulation, and election integrity, among other harm areas.
The team is responsible for understanding and defining the risks that come with engaging with Claude, how those risks materialize in the real world, and the mitigations needed to prevent them. As the manager, you'll work with your team to draw the boundaries between what is and is not allowed, then partner with research, product, and engineering to build the right interventions. Mitigating these harms takes the whole stack: the values and judgment trained into the model itself, the policies and detection systems we enforce on top of it, and the interventions we build into our products. More capable models, new product surfaces, and new user behaviors will keep testing these boundaries, so the team's policies have to keep pace.
You'll work closely with product to develop and iterate on the strategy and vision for how our safety layers fit together, and with your team and cross-functional partners to decide which mitigations make the most sense and how to implement them. You'll also coordinate policy decisions across the portfolio: ensuring they're made with the right stakeholders in the room, tracked over time, and applied consistently across harm areas and product surfaces.
This is a leadership role for someone who combines expertise in the harm areas themselves with fluency in how frontier models are actually developed and deployed, and who does their best work across team boundaries. You'll spend as much time developing the leads who own each harm area as you will on the policy questions themselves.
*Important context for this role: some of the work involves exposure to explicit content, including material of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature.
Key responsibilities
Lead, develop, and grow the managers and teams responsible for the consumer harms portfolio, including child safety, user well-being, harmful manipulation, and election integrity
Coordinate policy decisions across the portfolio, and build the mechanisms that keep them tracked, consistent, and legible — so stakeholders know what was decided, why, and who owns what
Set the strategy for how mitigations built on top of the model — policies, detection and enforcement systems, and product interventions — complement what is trained into the model itself, partnering closely with the alignment training team that owns Claude's character
Prioritize across harm areas competing for the same resources, and make those tradeoffs and their rationale clear to leadership
Serve as the escalation point for high-severity and ambiguous consumer harms decisions, including rapid response to emerging risks
Partner with engineering, data science, product, legal, and research across the model development cycle so consumer harms considerations are represented from training through launch, on every surface where Claude is deployed
Engage external experts, civil society organizations, and regulators, and translate that engagement into stronger policy and enforcement
Minimum qualifications
Experience leading teams — including managing managers or senior specialists — in AI safety, product policy, or a related field
Deep, applied familiarity with consumer harm areas such as child safety, mental health and well-being, manipulation, or election integrity, and good judgment about how these harms differ in mechanism, severity, and mitigation
A track record of exceptional cross-team collaboration: building durable working relationships with teams you don't control, and getting to shared decisions where ownership is genuinely distributed
Working understanding of how frontier models are developed and deployed — the training and fine-tuning cycle, evaluations, and launch processes — and how different model environments (consumer products, APIs, agentic tools) change both risk and the mitigations available
Experience translating policy positions into mechanisms that can be enforced and measured, and communicating the reasoning to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives
Sound judgment in ambiguous, high-consequence decisions, and comfort making a call and escalating appropriately on incomplete information
Preferred qualifications
Subject-matter depth in one or more of the portfolio's harm areas, from academia, clinical practice, civil society, government, or trust & safety work
Experience working directly with model training or research teams on model behavior, or shaping the character of a deployed AI system
Experience with generative AI safety systems, including LLM-based classification, evaluation, or enforcement pipelines
Experience engaging external stakeholders in these domains — child safety organizations, election authorities, mental health experts, or regulators
Experience using agentic AI tools to scale a team's analysis and operations
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
Annual Salary:
$330,000—$395,000 USD
Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: VP, Global Solution Engineering
jobs.text:
See what you can do with Prophix
At Prophix, we’re building the platform that helps finance teams stop managing spreadsheets and start driving strategy. Prophix One™ brings planning, reporting, consolidation, and automation together in a single place, and we are expanding its AI capabilities faster than ever. If you want to work on a product that genuinely changes how finance teams operate, and do it alongside people who care about getting it right, this is where you want to be.
We’re headquartered in the Greater Toronto Area, with teams and offices across North America, Europe, and Australia. Trusted by more than 3,000 finance teams across 100+ countries, Prophix One™ is built for organizations that want to plan smarter and move faster.
As VP, Global Solutions Engineering, you will lead the presales function that powers Prophix's growth across every market we operate in. You will build and develop a unified, high-performing team of Solutions Engineers who consistently demonstrate the value of Prophix One to finance leaders worldwide — accelerating pipeline, shaping deals, and influencing how buyers experience our platform. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Customer Success, making it central to how Prophix wins and scales globally.
What You Will Do
· Lead and develop a global team of Solutions Engineers, setting clear performance standards, coaching talent at every level, and building a culture rooted in technical excellence and genuine customer focus
· Partner closely with Sales leadership to align Solutions Engineering capacity and strategy to pipeline goals, territory plans, and revenue targets across all regions
· Own the end-to-end presales process — from discovery through proof-of-concept — ensuring every engagement communicates compelling, differentiated value to multi-stakeholder buying teams
· Design and continuously improve scalable demo frameworks, discovery methodologies, and enablement resources that equip the SE team to perform consistently and confidently in any market
· Drive cross-functional alignment with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success, ensuring field insights shape the product roadmap and go-to-market messaging stays sharp and current
· Deliver regular reporting on presales performance metrics, win/loss trends, and team capacity to senior leadership, using data to identify patterns and drive meaningful improvements
· Lead hiring, onboarding, and development programs that grow the Solutions Engineering function in step with Prophix's expansion into new markets and customer segments
· Analyze competitive positioning and evolving customer needs to continuously refine how the team positions Prophix One across diverse buyer personas, industries, and deal sizes
· Establish Competitive Differentiation: Build and maintain the tools, talk tracks, and proof points that equip SEs to win against key competitors, and serve as an executive escalation point in high-stakes evaluations.
· Tool Optimization: Utilize tools such as Claude and Navattic to scale the reach and effectiveness of the organization.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Job Title: Head of Engineering
Location: Cumbernauld
Contract and working pattern: On site, permanent
Are you ready to Be Your Best Barr None?
Lets Grow!!!
We are all about Being Your Best Barr None and having a career with real Moments that Matter!
Employing around 950 people across the UK, we are proud to be a responsible business that takes care of our people, values diversity, gives something back to our communities and works to minimise our environmental impact.
For 150 years AG Barr has been building great brands and is home to some of the nations favourite flavours.
At our core is IRN-BRU, launched in 1901 and still going strong today, the vibrant RUBICON fruit based brand, Boost making every moment better with a caffeine kick, hydration hit or tasty treat, and FUNKIN where real fruit means authentic taste.
We also have a number of exciting owned brands within our portfolio including MOMA, which crafts quality oats into great tasting oat drinks and porridges.
There's never been a better time to join us!
What we’re looking for…
As Head of Engineering, you will lead site engineering strategy, drive best-in-class high-speed manufacturing performance, and pioneer continuous improvement across our production operations!
Reporting directly to the Site Director and serving as a key member of the Site Leadership Team, you will partner closely with Production to maximise line efficiencies, optimise planned maintenance, and deliver high-impact capital projects. If you are an empowering, results-driven engineering leader who excels at driving safety, engineering excellence, and multi-format line flexibility in a fast-paced FMCG environment, we want to hear from you.
Your responsibilities will include...
Strategic & Financial Leadership: Assist the Site Director in preparing and executing the annual engineering budget, optimising resources to deliver manufacturing best practices and business goals.
Maintenance & Asset Reliability: Drive plant uptime and asset performance through effective PPM scheduling, overhaul planning, and proactive engineering stores management.
Capital Project Delivery: Formulate capex proposals and feasibility studies, taking ownership of procurement, installation, and commissioning within agreed project criteria.
Collaborative CI Integration: Partner with Production Managers to embed continuous improvement, maximise line efficiencies, enhance reliability, and support stock reduction strategies.
Safety, Quality & Compliance: Champion QSE as a non-negotiable priority, ensuring site operations, site services, and external contractors strictly adhere to all regulatory and safety standards.
Site Services & Utility Management: Oversee site services, utilities, property maintenance, and contractor/OEM relationships, including regular performance reviews and specialised training.
Team Leadership & Culture: Lead, coach, and develop the site engineering support team - while matrix-managing embedded engineering teams—to build an inclusive, high-performing culture.
What you’ll bring...
The successful candidate will have;
Extensive engineering management experience leading people within a complex, high-speed FMCG or Food & Beverage production facility.
Deep technical knowledge of high-speed packaging equipment, production techniques, and QSE standards in a manufacturing setting.
Proven track record in developing and executing PPM systems, asset reliability strategies, and managing multi-million-pound capital projects.
Strong leadership, coaching, and influencing capabilities with a track record of driving cultural change and high-performing teams.
NEBOSH qualification alongside a solid understanding of legislative compliance and contractor management.
And it would also be great if you can demonstrate:
An engineering degree with working knowledge of ISO standards (9001, 14001), AutoCad, and CMMS software (e.g., Mainsaver).
Expertise in continuous improvement toolkits (Lean/TPM) to uncover root causes and drive sustained year-on-year gains.
A results-driven, tenacious mindset with exceptional communication skills to construct compelling business cases and influence across all business levels.
What we offer…
We believe in creating a diverse and inclusive culture where your voice can be heard. Our skilled, loyal and committed people are critical to the future success of AG Barr which is why we are continually investing in our employees to develop their talent.
We look after our employees by offering a competitive salary and benefits package which includes;
Uncapped bonus linked to business performance
Defined contribution Pension
Up to 34 days holiday (depending on shift pattern)
Flexible holiday trading
Flexible cash pot to spend on benefits
Healthcare Cash Plan
Flexible benefits e.g. discounts & cashbacks, gym memberships, technology purchases etc
Life assurance
Save as you earn scheme
Staff sales discount

jobs.title: Head of U.S. Derivatives Trading Technology
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
About The Opportunity
We are seeking a senior trading-technology leader to design and deliver the technology stack connecting customers to a regulated US derivatives market.
The ideal candidate will have built an FCM operation from the ground up or led the technology function at a leading FCM or service provider for FCMs and broker-dealers.
They will bring deep knowledge of the vendor landscape and a strong track record of making strategic technology, operational, and build-versus-buy decisions.
You will report to the OKX Core Trading Product Management leadership with a dotted line to the CEO and COO of the local entity.
The essential profile is someone who can make architecture and vendor decisions — Not someone hired merely to implement a vendor choice already made.
What You’ll Be Doing
Design the end-to-end US derivatives trading architecture.
Lead the selection of the clearing FCM, OMS and market-access providers.
Deep familiarity with leading OMS, risk-management, and market-data vendors in the U.S. derivatives ecosystem.
Decide between vendor-provided, direct-exchange and hybrid connectivity.
Define the long-term build-versus-buy roadmap.
Lead internal and vendor integrations across OMS, margin, liquidation, funding, UI, and KYC.
Lead exchange connectivity, certification and production readiness.
Define pre-trade risk, kill-switch, drop-copy and reconciliation requirements.
Establish 24/7 monitoring, incident response and disaster recovery.
Own vendor technical diligence, contracts, SLAs and delivery.
Recruit and lead the US trading-technology team.
First-Year Objectives
Define the target architecture and systems of record.
Select the DCM connectivity model, clearing FCM and technology providers.
Deliver exchange certification and production readiness.
Establish reconciliation, risk controls and 24/7 support.
Produce a roadmap for increasing internal ownership of the stack.
What We Look For In You
10+ years in electronic trading or capital-markets technology.
Deep knowledge of listed derivatives and US futures market structure.
Experience with OMS, FIX, exchange connectivity, market data and pre-trade risk.
Prior experience working at an FCM is preferred.
Understanding of the complete execution, clearing and settlement lifecycle.
Track record delivering mission-critical trading platforms.
Ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into technical architecture.
Strong leadership across engineering, product, risk, compliance and operations.
Preferred Background
Candidates may come from:
Futures execution technology at a bank or FCM.
An exchange or clearinghouse.
An OMS or market-access technology provider.
A futures-native brokerage or regulated digital-asset platform.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
OKX Statement:
OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
The salary range for this position is $313,055 to $450,799.
The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Applicants should apply via OKX internal or external careers site.

jobs.title: Senior Director Product Management, Growth
jobs.text:
About the Role
We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to help define and drive our next phase of growth. Our team owns the end-to-end product-led growth journey, from developer acquisition and onboarding through activation, adoption, monetization, retention, expansion, and sales handoffs. We use customer insight, data, and experimentation to reduce friction, accelerate time-to-value, grow revenue, and increase long-term customer value. This is a high-impact, strategic role that requires strong leadership, creativity, strong product sense, and the ability to mentor a team of high-performing Product Managers. You’ll be expected to lead your team, but also influence across the Product and Technology and Marketing teams, build cross-functional relationships, and elevate the team’s overall strategic thinking and execution.
What You’ll Do
Develop a clear, cohesive product-led growth strategy for both MongoDB Community Edition and MongoDB Atlas translating that strategy into testable hypotheses, measurable growth outcomes, and a prioritized experimentation roadmap
Identify and validate opportunities to expand into new user segments, improve onboarding and activation, accelerate time-to-value, and strengthen product education across the developer journey
Own the growth measurement and experimentation framework across acquisition, activation, adoption, retention, expansion, and sales handoffs, using product and customer insights, rapid testing, and structured learning loops to identify friction, prioritize investments, measure impact, and scale what works
Mentor and guide Product Managers to think more broadly and creatively about the customer journey, instilling a culture of innovation and strategic problem-solving
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and other go-to-market teams to shape and launch growth initiatives, align product and GTM strategy, and identify opportunities across packaging, pricing, and monetization that accelerate self-service adoption and broader customer expansion
Collaborate with engineering leaders beyond the dedicated Growth team to align technical roadmaps, resource allocation and cross-product investments required to deliver growth outcomes
Work closely with product leadership in other areas of the organization to build consensus, identify cross-product growth opportunities, and rally support for initiatives that span the MongoDB developer journey
Present updates and learnings in monthly and quarterly business reviews, influencing executive stakeholders and guiding critical decisions
Stay close to developers and customers through direct research, feedback, usage insights, and market engagement, translating those signals into differentiated product opportunities and growth priorities
What We Look For
Passion for MongoDB with a strong understanding of software engineering concepts and the developer audience
10+ years of Product Management experience, including 4+ years leading Product-Led Growth, Growth Product, or adjacent self-service growth motions at SaaS, cloud or developer-centric companies
Deep understanding of product-led growth mechanics across acquisition, onboarding, activation, retention, expansion, and monetization, ideally within self-service, freemium, subscription, or consumption-based products
Background in engineering (computer science, electrical, software)
Strategic Vision & Creativity - A track record of crafting innovative growth strategies that expand market reach and build long-term product differentiation
Influential Leadership - Ability to lead cross-functional teams and develop your team. You’re skilled at aligning diverse stakeholders around a shared vision
Passion for deeply understanding developer needs and delivering seamless onboarding, education, adoption and product experiences
Familiarity with open-source software, self-service, subscription, and consumption based cloud models
Excellent written and verbal communication skills — you’ll need to distill complex product ideas, rally teams, and evangelize new growth initiatives across the org
Data-driven and business-minded — you can define meaningful growth metrics, interpret funnel and usage behavior, evaluate experiments, and connect product decisions to key metrics
Strong research and analytical skills with the ability to identify insights, uncover opportunities, and translate findings into actionable strategies
Experience building programmatic product experiences with a deep understanding of developer-centric requirements, including IAM, integrations, and automation use cases
Experience with how to leverage UI/UX design and/or user research teams
Familiarity with AI/ML products or cloud-based platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure. Comfort using AI-native tools and workflows to accelerate research, experimentation, prototyping, and product decision-making is a plus
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
MongoDB, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and makes all hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Compensation at the time of offer is unique to each candidate and based on a variety of factors such as skill set, experience, qualifications, and work location. Salary is one part of MongoDB’s total compensation and benefits package. Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings. jobs.title: Engineering Director, Application Security
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Founded in 2012 by 3 expert hackers with no investment capital, Trail of Bits is the premier place for security experts to boldly advance security and address technology’s newest and most challenging risks. It has helped secure some of the world's most targeted organizations and devices. Our combination of novel research with practical solutions reduces the security risks that our clients face from emerging technologies. Our work helps drive the security industry and the public understanding of the technology underlying our world.
Cybersecurity preparedness is a moving target. Companies like ours are the tip of the spear in the fight against attackers. Our research-based and custom-engineering approach ensures that our client’s capabilities are at the forefront of what’s available. For companies and technologies that live and die by their security, a proactive, tailored approach is required to keep one step ahead of attackers.
Democratizing security information is essential. As part of our business, we provide ongoing informational support through blogs, whitepapers, newsletters, meetups, and open-source tools. The more the community understands security, the more they’ll understand why a company like ours is so unique and valuable.
Role
You will lead Trail of Bits' Application Security practice: a team of 12 security engineers who perform code audits, vulnerability research, and secure design reviews for some of the most technically demanding clients in the industry.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will personally review audit findings, guide technical approaches, and maintain the credibility to engage with sophisticated clients who expect their security partner to operate at their level. You will own the practice's financial performance, project staffing, and team development.
Your team works on source code. They do static analysis, manual code review, fuzzing, and protocol-level vulnerability research across Rust, Go, C/C++, Python, Solidity, and JavaScript. You need to be able to do this work yourself, not just manage people who do it.
What You’ll Achieve
Lead technical delivery. Own the quality and profitability of every engagement your team ships. Review findings, guide technical direction on complex audits, and step in when projects need senior expertise. Maintain direct relationships with your most important clients.
Staff and grow the practice. Make project assignment decisions that balance engineer development, client needs, and profitability. Manage utilization, identify when to hire, and build the pipeline through the intern program and recruiting. Own the practice's P&L.
Develop your engineers. Create space for your team to present at conferences, publish research, contribute to open source tools, and advance their careers. Identify and remove obstacles. Your success is measured by their output, not yours.
Set technical direction. Decide where the practice invests in tooling, methodology, and capability development. Stay hands-on enough to know what's working and what isn't. Ensure the team's approach evolves with the threat landscape and client needs.
Integrate AI into the practice. Champion and model the use of AI tools across your team's workflows. Help engineers adopt AI-assisted auditing, reporting, and research practices that amplify their effectiveness.
What You’ll Bring
10+ years in security, including significant time performing source code audits, not only penetration testing
Recent, demonstrable hands-on security work (code review, vulnerability research, tool development) within the last 12 months
Experience leading a team of 8+ engineers through client engagements with direct financial accountability
Proficiency in at least 4 of: Rust, Go, Python, C/C++, Solidity, JavaScript/TypeScript
Track record of managing project profitability, utilization, and staffing decisions in a consulting environment
Experience building team members' careers and external visibility (conference talks, publications, open source contributions)
Proficiency with AI coding and analysis tools in your own work
Active contributions to the security community (research, tools, advisories, publications)
The base salary for this full-time position ranges from $250,000 to $300,000. This position will come with great benefits and strong bonus potential in addition to the salary above. Various factors influence our salary ranges, including the specific role, level of seniority, geographic location, and the nature of the employment contract. An individual's specific work location, unique skills, experience, and relevant educational background will determine the final offer within this range. The presented salary range encompasses the starting salaries for all U.S. locations. For a precise salary estimate tailored to your preferred location, please discuss it with your recruiter during the hiring process.

For companies and technologies that live and die by their security, a proactive, tailored approach is required to keep one step ahead of attackers.

Democratizing security information is essential. As part of our business, we provide ongoing informational support through blogs, whitepapers, newsletters, meetups, and open-source tools. The more the community understands security, the more they’ll understand why a company like ours is so unique and valuable.
Role

You will lead Trail of Bits' Application Security practice: a team of 12 security engineers who perform code audits, vulnerability research, and secure design reviews for some of the most technically demanding clients in the industry.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will personally review audit findings, guide technical approaches, and maintain the credibility to engage with sophisticated clients who expect their security partner to operate at their level. You will own the practice's financial performance, project staffing, and team development.

Your team works on source code. They do static analysis, manual code review, fuzzing, and protocol-level vulnerability research across Rust, Go, C/C++, Python, Solidity, and JavaScript. You need to be able to do this work yourself, not just manage people who do it.
What You’ll Achieve

items: Lead technical delivery. Own the quality and profitability of every engagement your team ships. Review findings, guide technical direction on complex audits, and step in when projects need senior expertise. Maintain direct relationships with your most important clients.

Staff and grow the practice. Make project assignment decisions that balance engineer development, client needs, and profitability. Manage utilization, identify when to hire, and build the pipeline through the intern program and recruiting. Own the practice's P&L.

Develop your engineers. Create space for your team to present at conferences, publish research, contribute to open source tools, and advance their careers. Identify and remove obstacles. Your success is measured by their output, not yours.

Set technical direction. Decide where the practice invests in tooling, methodology, and capability development. Stay hands-on enough to know what's working and what isn't. Ensure the team's approach evolves with the threat landscape and client needs.

Integrate AI into the practice. Champion and model the use of AI tools across your team's workflows. Help engineers adopt AI-assisted auditing, reporting, and research practices that amplify their effectiveness.

blocks.text: What You’ll Bring

items: 10+ years in security, including significant time performing source code audits, not only penetration testing
Recent, demonstrable hands-on security work (code review, vulnerability research, tool development) within the last 12 months
Experience leading a team of 8+ engineers through client engagements with direct financial accountability
Proficiency in at least 4 of: Rust, Go, Python, C/C++, Solidity, JavaScript/TypeScript
Track record of managing project profitability, utilization, and staffing decisions in a consulting environment
Experience building team members' careers and external visibility (conference talks, publications, open source contributions)
Proficiency with AI coding and analysis tools in your own work
Active contributions to the security community (research, tools, advisories, publications)

jobs.title: Director of Product Strategy
jobs.text:
About MyUtilities
MyUtilities make moving easier by helping consumers establish essential home services, including electricity, internet, security, insurance, gas, and water.
Behind that customer experience is an enterprise technology platform integrated into mortgage and real estate workflows. Our products include a proprietary CRM, a data insights layer, partner APIs, and AI agents that automate lead-to-close processes. We are expanding the platform and looking for a product leader who can turn customer needs into scalable products and measurable commercial results.
The Opportunity
Exemplify our Core Values: Grit, Integrity, Excellence in Everything, and are Others-Focused.
As Director of Product Strategy, you will own the strategy and commercial performance of our core product portfolio: the CRM platform, data products, integrations, and AI agents.
This is a hands-on, subject matter expert role for someone who is equally comfortable setting product direction, working directly with customers, partnering closely with engineering, and helping Sales and Customer Success bring products to market. You will translate the needs of mortgage, real estate, and home-services partners into a focused roadmap that improves adoption, retention, revenue, and operational efficiency.
What you’ll own
Set the product vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap across the CRM, data, integrations, and AI-agent portfolio.
Conduct customer discovery with mortgage, real estate, and home-services partners to identify high-value workflow problems.
Prioritize investments using clear customer and commercial outcomes, including adoption, retention, revenue expansion, conversion, and automation.
Partner with Engineering from discovery through launch, defining requirements, success measures, release plans, and quality expectations.
Lead the development of partner-facing APIs and integrations that are reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt.
Own product commercialization, including packaging and pricing input, pilots, go-to-market planning, sales enablement, and adoption programs.
Establish a disciplined product analytics practice using cohort analysis, controlled rollouts, experiments, and customer feedback.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and external partners to increase product adoption and identify expansion opportunities.
Represent MyUtilities in strategic customer conversations, partner presentations, and selected industry events.
Ensure product decisions account for relevant security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

jobs.title: (Senior) Director UX, Operations
jobs.text:
About the role
HelloFresh is reorganising UX to work AI-native — practitioners either go deep as platform and skills experts, or broad as generalists who move fluidly across product, design and engineering to drive experience quality and innovation. This role leads UX for our Operations organisation: the part of the business that bridges technology with physical fulfilment, procurement, quality assurance and supply chain, across every market and brand we operate in.
You'll take over from a Director who spent two years shifting this function from reactive delivery to a high-leverage, AI-native strategic partner — including building an internal design platform, integrated with AI tooling, that other parts of the business have since adopted. You inherit that trajectory, not a finished product: some of our highest-stakes bets for 2026, including how we plan menus algorithmically at scale and how we run the internal tools that power supply-chain decision-making, are still being actively designed, not maintained.
This is a Berlin-based, in-person leadership role. Operations is one of several major, Berlin-anchored parts of our technology organization, and regular physical presence — with peers, with your team, and in the room for cross-functional decisions — is a deliberate requirement of how we want this function led going forward.
What you'll own
UX strategy and quality across four core areas of Operations: menu planning and food systems (algorithmic menu planning, ranking, demand forecasting, assortment), fulfillment (production, order management, inventory, logistics, manufacturing, supplier reliability), an internal operations-research platform that runs dozens of optimization models across the supply chain, and the technology backbone that keeps our warehouses and production sites running.
Continued build-out of an AI-native design practice: extending our design system directly into AI-assisted workflows, and using that as proof that UX can lead — not just support — the company's AI-first agenda.
Service design for the internal-facing tools that operators, planners and analysts depend on every day — often the least glamorous and highest-impact surface area in the company.
Talent leadership for a distributed team spanning multiple geographies: hiring, career development, and consistent design-quality standards.
A seat at the Operations leadership table, partnering directly with the senior Product and Engineering leaders for the organization, and representing UX's interests in company-wide strategy.
What we're looking for
10+ years in UX/product design, including several years leading design for complex, operational, or B2B/enterprise-grade systems — supply chain, logistics, marketplace operations, or similar domains are a strong plus.
A track record of shifting a design function from reactive delivery to strategic, AI-native practice — not just familiarity with AI tools, but experience redesigning how a team works because of them.
Experience building or scaling design systems/platforms that other teams adopt, and comfort operating at the intersection of design, product and engineering.
Strong stakeholder management — this role sits at the table with senior product, engineering and exec leadership and needs to hold its own there.
Comfort with ambiguity and unglamorous domains: this is service design for internal operators and planners, not consumer-facing polish, and the highest-value problems here are rarely the most visible ones.
Location & ways of working
Based in our Berlin office, with an expectation of regular in-person presence — this is one of the small number of senior UX roles at HelloFresh where onsite leadership is a deliberate requirement rather than a preference.
Reporting line
Reports to HelloFresh's VP of UX, who also leads UX for two other major parts of the business and reports into senior Product leadership. UX holds a more central, cross-functional reporting line than is typical for Product or Engineering here, reflecting the company's investment in design and experience quality as a differentiator — with visible sponsorship at the executive level.
What we offer
Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.
Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

jobs.title: Director of Product Development
jobs.text:
POSITION SUMMARY
The Director of Product Development is a senior scientific, technical, and functional leader responsible for setting the direction and leading the end-to-end development, formulation, commercialization, and continuous improvement of new and existing products across the Company’s portfolio.
This role provides leadership throughout the complete product development lifecycle from concept and technical feasibility through ingredient evaluation, formulation, reformulation, prototype and pilot-scale development, scale-up, validation, technology transfer, commercial manufacturing, product costing, launch, and post-launch optimization. The Director is accountable for ensuring that product concepts are successfully translated into scientifically sound, commercially viable, and consistently manufacturable products.
Working closely with the Founder & CEO and cross-functional partners including Research, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Planning, Regulatory, and other business functions, the Director provides scientific direction, evaluates technical and commercialization risks, and drives cross-functional execution to ensure products meet the Company’s standards for quality, efficacy, stability, manufacturability, cost, regulatory compliance, and consumer experience.
The ideal candidate will bring significant scientific and technical depth within nutraceutical or dietary supplement product development, including a strong understanding of biochemistry, ingredient functionality and interactions, formulation science, stability, and manufacturing processes. Experience across adjacent categories including functional foods and nutrition bars, chocolate and confectionery products, cosmetics and personal care products, or environmentally responsible and sustainability focused products is highly desirable.
This position requires a hands-on leader who combines scientific rigor, sound technical judgment, and practical commercialization experience with the ability to establish priorities, lead technical teams, influence cross-functional partners, and drive multiple product development initiatives through successful execution in a fast-paced, vertically integrated manufacturing environment.

jobs.title: Group Director, Analytics-First Party Data & Loyalty
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
ABOUT US
The WPP l Ford Team is an integrated operating network made up of a dynamic multi-agency ecosystem that serves Ford Motor Company and its many diverse units around the world. This operating team provides a breadth of marketing experience for Ford across Communications, Marketing, Brand and Customer Experience, A.I., Creative, Production, Media, Strategy, Analytics, Commerce & Technology and more.
Operated under a central leadership team, it draws best-in-class talent from leading WPP agencies including VML (Brand & Customer Experience), WPP Media (Media), GTB (Precision Retail Marketing), WPP Production (Brand Design & Production), Zubi & UWG (Multicultural), and Burson (Corporate Communications/ Public Relations), among other key WPP specialists. WPP l Ford team members work in a highly integrated environment, with direct exposure across virtually every discipline of modern marketing.
This role is imbedded within VML agency as part of the WPP network. At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration.
About the Role
This role will oversee and advise on Ford's first-party customer data, including ownership history, customer journey behavior, and loyalty program activity across Ford Rewards and Lincoln Access Rewards. This is an increasingly important source of competitive differentiation for Ford — loyalty programs generate rich behavioral signals that can meaningfully improve targeting precision, message sequencing, personalization, and ultimately customer retention and lifetime value.
The Group Director, First-Party Data & Loyalty Analytics will serve as WPP Ford's US subject matter expert for first-party customer data, responsible for building the analytical bridge between Ford's loyalty programs and its owner marketing communications. This is a net-new leadership position, established to create a domestic center of expertise. The role will be part of WPP Ford's Marketing Intelligence team, but partners closely with other global WPP business units.
The emphasis of this role is on insight and business impact rather than reporting volume. Success is measured by the quality of the recommendations produced and their influence on marketing decisions — identifying what matters in the data and translating it into clear, actionable guidance for Ford's marketing leadership.
What You'll Do
Own the first-party data agenda
Analyze ownership and customer journey data to identify the behavioral patterns that predict loyalty, retention, and customer lifetime value
Work directly within Ford's first-party data and martech ecosystem — including customer data platforms (e.g., Adobe Real-Time CDP), Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and adjacent identity and audience management tools — to access, structure, and interrogate customer-level data
Advise on data architecture and readiness for first-party use cases: unified customer profiles, identity resolution, audience schemas, consent and preference signals, and the data quality required to support them
Build and maintain measurement frameworks for loyalty program performance and its downstream effect on owner marketing outcomes
Identify opportunities where personalization and targeting performance can be improved through better integration of loyalty and owner marketing data, and quantify the associated business value
Integrate loyalty and owner marketing analytics
Serve as the analytical link between Ford Rewards, Lincoln Access Rewards, and owner marketing communications
Develop evidence-based recommendations for targeting, message sequencing, and personalization informed by loyalty behavior signals
Translate loyalty behavior insights into activation-ready guidance — audience definitions, segmentation logic, suppression rules, and journey triggers — that CRM and platform teams can implement in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and the CDP
Identify areas of duplication or misalignment between the loyalty and owner marketing workstreams and drive their resolution
Lead client engagement and strategic narrative
Translate analytical findings into clear, compelling narratives that enable marketing executives to make informed decisions
Present recommendations directly to Ford marketing stakeholders; this is a client-facing leadership role with regular executive engagement
Support Enterprise Solutions with first-party data expertise on broader customer experience and personalization initiatives, and build the delivered-work case for expanded CX investment
How You'll Work
You will operate at the intersection of several teams:
WPP Ford Marketing Intelligence — your home team, reporting to the Global Data & Analytics Officer, with proximity to the broader measurement agenda (unified data modeling, MTA/MROI, geographic analysis)
Audience Intelligence & Martech — partnering on first-party audience strategy, identity, and activation across the martech stack, including the CDP and marketing automation platforms
Ford CRM and loyalty program teams — your primary client stakeholders and the owners of the data assets central to this role
Platform and data engineering teams — collaborating on data pipelines, schemas, and platform configurations (Adobe Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, cloud data environments) so that analytical requirements are reflected in how first-party data is captured, unified, and made available
APAC loyalty analytics team — an established WPP team supporting Ford loyalty in the region; you will serve as their domestic counterpart, sharing methodologies and frameworks across markets
This role serves as the analytical connective tissue across these groups. Success requires hands-on analytical depth, working fluency in the enterprise martech and customer data platforms where first-party data lives, and executive presence — the ability to conduct rigorous analysis directly, and to present the resulting insights and recommendations credibly to senior marketing stakeholders.
What You'll Bring
Required
10+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or customer data strategy, with deep hands-on experience in first-party/owned customer data (not primarily ad platform or media data)
Specific experience in loyalty, retention, or customer lifecycle analytics — not general-purpose marketing analytics
Fluency querying, joining, and analyzing data with reproducible code (SQL required; Python or R a plus)
Hands-on experience with enterprise customer data and marketing platforms — Adobe Experience Platform / Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or comparable CDP and marketing automation tools — including how customer profiles, identity resolution, segmentation, and activation work within them
Demonstrated experience building measurement frameworks from raw behavioral or transactional data, not just reporting against existing dashboards
Ability to connect business and marketing context to data strategy — identifying and prioritizing use cases, asking the questions that matter, and translating findings for executives
Track record of presenting analytical findings directly to marketing executives and having those findings change a decision
Experience working across and influencing matrixed, cross-functional teams, both internally and with clients
Proactive ownership: the initiative to work through ambiguity and drive issues to resolution
Preferred
Automotive or considered-purchase category experience (long consideration cycles, ownership data, dealer/retail hybrid models)
Direct exposure to loyalty program mechanics — points and rewards structures, tiering, redemption behavior
Experience within a holding company or agency model, balancing client-facing credibility with internal delivery accountability
What Good Looks Like in 12 Months
Loyalty program data and owner marketing targeting are demonstrably connected, with at least one measurable change in targeting or sequencing driven by loyalty behavior insight
Ford stakeholders treat you as the default first call on first-party data questions
Your recommendations have directly changed a marketing decision, with the outcome tracked
A working operating rhythm exists with the APAC loyalty analytics team, with shared frameworks in use across markets
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.
_
$100,000—$230,000 USD
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to VML. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Director, Global WMS Software Engineering and Product Design
jobs.text:
Join our R&D Tech Hub in Warsaw
We’re building a new R&D Tech Hub in Poland and are looking for people who want to make a real impact from day one. You’ll be part of a globally connected team, helping to shape the culture and ways of working at our new location. This is a hands-on role in a supportive environment, where collaboration, learning, and adaptability are key.
We value practical problem-solving, diverse perspectives, and people who take ownership. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and help lay the foundation for a growing team, we’d like to hear from you.
About the role: What's in the Box
HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Software Engineering and Product functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.
You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across technology, operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.
The Director of WMS Engineering and Product will work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.
What you’ll do: The Recipe
WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations
Integration Architecture & Reliability: Drive WMS application layer Integration architecture to upstream tooling and host systems via CI/CD pipelines [Debezium/Kafka to Snowflake/Databricks]
Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS
Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate
CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments
Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods
Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership
Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning
Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability
People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development
International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally
Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level
What you’ll bring: The Ingredients
Technical/Engineering Experience
10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment
3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server
3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines
Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks
Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact
Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting
Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies
Product Experience
Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties
Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization
Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh Group better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.
What we offer: The Toppings
Health - You’re covered from your first day with private health insurance.
Flexible Working - We work in-office 3 days a week to align on goals, with flexible hours to support work-life balance and personal needs
Time Off - You receive 26 days of paid vacation each year, providing you time to rest and recharge.
Learning and Development - An annual Learning & Development budget and a Mentoring Program to support your ongoing professional growth.
Employee Referral Program - Our team members can take part in our internal employee referral program and receive a bonus for recommending successful candidates to open roles.
Daily Comforts - Free coffee, drinks, and fresh fruit are available to keep you refreshed throughout the day.
