jobs.title: Associate Director- AI Product Strategist
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
ABOUT US
The WPP l Ford Team is an integrated operating network made up of a dynamic multi-agency ecosystem that serves Ford Motor Company and its many diverse units around the world. This operating team provides a breadth of marketing experience for Ford across Communications, Marketing, Brand and Customer Experience, A.I., Creative, Production, Media, Strategy, Analytics, Commerce & Technology and more.
Operated under a central leadership team, it draws best-in-class talent from leading WPP agencies including VML (Brand & Customer Experience), WPP Media (Media), GTB (Precision Retail Marketing), WPP Production (Brand Design & Production), Zubi & UWG (Multicultural), and Burson (Corporate Communications/ Public Relations), among other key WPP specialists. WPP l Ford team members work in a highly integrated environment, with direct exposure across virtually every discipline of modern marketing.
This role is imbedded within VML agency as part of the WPP network. At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration.
ABOUT FORD AND THE OPPORTUNITY
This is an exciting opportunity to join the team dedicated to WPP’s critically important client, Ford Motor Company. The AI Product Strategist is the connective layer between WPP | Ford business and capability owners and the central AI team, ensuring that AI product development aligns to Ford's strategic priorities rather than evolving as disconnected, parallel efforts. This is a cross-functional, discovery-led role: it bridges the operational needs of the business (Shopper, Media, Web, Production, Creative SMEs) with the technical build capacity of the AI program, translating requirements into a shared architecture and roadmap.
Ford is in a period of rapid transformation, modernization, and evolution. This exciting challenge is about more than just marketing vehicles. It’s about lifestyle, experiences, technology and helping to build a better world, where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams. Ford is a global company founded on powerful shared ideals - valuing service to the world as much as they do to their customers. After 123 years, this iconic brand has learned to adapt and change, continuously evolving to focus on services, experiences and software, in addition to vehicles.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary strategic interface between WPP | Ford business and capability owners and the central AI team
Conduct structured discovery and requirements-gathering across SME teams (Shopper, Media, Production, Creative), mapping current-state workflows before recommending AI-enabled solutions
Re-engineer and document business processes as a precondition to any agent or AI build — ensuring solutions are architected around real workflows, not assumptions
Translate business needs into clear, technically actionable briefs for the AI Architect and Applied AI Product Manager
Partner with the AI Architect and Development on feasibility assessments, ensuring SME-identified needs are properly scoped and prioritized into the product roadmap
Ensure workstreams build toward a shared AI architecture rather than in silos — flagging duplication, misalignment, or gaps early
Track execution of SME-requested builds through to deployment; manage timelines and communicate status to stakeholders
Partner with the AI Value Engineering & Measurement function to ensure every use case sourced from SMEs is logged, centralized, and routed to measurement
Flag blockers, risks, and architectural gaps to Rachel Beecroft; maintain visibility into AI program status across all business-facing workstreams
Act as a change-sensitive advocate for the business — ensuring the AI program builds with the business, not in a vacuum
Required Experience
6–8 years in solutions consulting, technical product management, business process consulting, or delivery management
Comfortable operating across creative, media, production, and shopper/retail domains simultaneously
Experience translating ambiguous business requirements into structured technical briefs for engineering/product teams
Familiarity with AI/ML tools and platforms in a marketing, content, or commercial environment
Strong stakeholder management skills; ability to build trust with both SME teams and technical product owners
Comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving program with incomplete information and shifting priorities
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.
_
$75,000—$180,000 USD
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. jobs.text:
About Our Company
Designer Group is a leading international mechanical & electrical provider specialising in turnkey packages for the design, supply, and installation of M&E services. Headquartered in Dublin, we employ a large team of experienced and dedicated colleagues across the Group. As an industry leader, we work with some of the world's largest multinational companies and our common purpose is delivering ambitious, innovative and sustainable engineering solutions, building client partnerships that bear testament to the standards we uphold.
Our approach to everything we do is underpinned by our Values of:
Safe
Trust
Respect
Challenge
Deliver
This is an exciting time for Designer Group, with the fruits of our Engineering Our Future Strategy 2025 reflected in our substantial pipeline of work in Ireland, Europe, Africa and South America.
Reporting to the Operations Director the role, requirements and personal specifications for the position of Project Director are outlined below:
The Role
As part of an exciting company expansion projects, Designer Group are seeking for a Project Director (Electrical) to join our Operations team in our data centre business.
As PD you will provide leadership to project operations across various contracts that run concurrently. You will be responsible to ensure the projects are delivered on time, on budget, to the highest quality standards and exceeding our client's expectations. Your role will involve the management of senior project personnel, in the delivery of the contracts under your control. jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Trading Risk Engine
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
Our Trading Product Group leads the design of all the products on OKX's derivatives trading exchange, including spot trading, spot margin, futures, leveraged tokens, trading options, etc.
We seek a senior trading product manager to join the Trading team.
The successful candidate will manage the development and delivery of our product, including defining and executing product strategy, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring that our product meets the needs of traders in onboarding and Spot & Derivatives trading experience.
What You’ll Be Doing
Plan and design risk monitoring and risk-related solutions for our crypto asset trading products, including mark price, liquidation system, insurance fund, etc.
Optimize risk control rules, improve the efficiency of the risk control system, reduce the probability of and losses from abnormal events, and increase the amount and growth rate of the insurance fund.
Monitor risks and collect feedback on our risk control system after its launch, and continue to optimize the system based on effective iterative mechanisms.
Monitor project progress and coordinate with developers, designers, market team, operation team and other departments.
Instruct junior product managers to form a methodology on risk control products.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor's degree with product manager experience, preferably from a well-known internet or blockchain company.
Have a strong interest in trading, blockchain and the financial industry.
Solid product design and project management knowledge, especially skilled at discovering user demands through data analysis.
Ability to think logically, work in a team and communicate effectively. Be able to organize and coordinate resources to solve problems and achieve goals in collaboration with different departments.
Proactive, enthusiastic, responsible to our customers and your team.
Proficient in English language, Chinese Language is an added bonus but not a requirement (to work cross functionally with the tech team).
Nice-To-Haves
Experience in designing or trading financial products such as stocks, funds, forex, futures, options is preferred.
Having in-depth insight based on data analysis, with extensive experience using Excel, SQL, Python and other tools for data processing and analysis is preferred.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Trading Risk (Parameter Management & Price Protection)
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
The Core Trading Risk Product team builds the core trading infrastructure and platform-level risk capabilities that support OKX’s spot and derivatives businesses across multiple account and margin modes.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the delivery of trading risk workflow automation, agentic parameter governance, agent-driven execution, and foundational price-protection capabilities. Your scope will also include margin-tier rules, collateral haircuts, price limits, index price, and mark price across spot, derivatives, and Perp DEX scenarios.
You will work closely with Risk Management, Quantitative Research, Engineering, Data, Trading Operations, Legal, Compliance, and regional market teams to translate risk-control methodologies into configurable, verifiable, and observable platform capabilities. Success in this role means continuously improving liquidity, users’ capital efficiency, and the trading experience while safeguarding platform resilience and market integrity.
What You’ll Be Doing
Drive product planning and roadmap execution. Own product discovery and delivery across risk parameter governance, AI-agent workflow automation, controlled execution, and price protection. Translate risk-control needs and operating SOPs into product requirements, priorities, 3-12-month delivery plans, and success metrics; partner with engineering, risk, quant, data, and operations teams to launch, measure adoption, and iterate.
Research and iterate on risk-control methodologies. Research, formulate, and continuously improve risk-control methodologies, including pricing logic, risk-scoring models, and approaches for handling market volatility.
Build platform-level risk controls. Build and optimize platform-level risk-control mechanisms to ensure stability under extreme market conditions.
Drive effective implementation of risk systems. Collaborate with engineers, quants, data analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure risk systems are effectively implemented and continuously monitored.
Drive continuous improvement. Continuously improve the product through feedback loops and retrospective analysis of past market incidents or system performance.
Stay close to markets and users. Maintain regular communication with traders, institutional clients, and market-making teams. Continuously study crypto and traditional financial market structures, competitor mechanisms, and regulatory changes; determine when to lead and when to fast-follow; and adjust product priorities accordingly.
Strengthen team methodologies and AI leverage. Codify risk product methodologies, decision records, parameter dictionaries, and incident case libraries, and mentor other product managers. Design automation and AI-native workflows to improve efficiency in analysis, configuration review, monitoring and troubleshooting, documentation, and product operations..
What We Look For In You
Five or more years of product management experience in trading-related domains. Be familiar with trading system principles, understanding users' trading, and be able to identify risky scenarios.
An AI-native approach to work, with the ability to design multi-step automation or agentic workflows incorporating tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and human-review checkpoints, together with an understanding of the access-control and audit boundaries required in risk-control contexts.
Strong systems thinking and technical judgment, with the ability to work closely with engineering and quantitative teams on real-time, highly available, data-intensive systems and the related configuration, monitoring, resilience, and audit requirements.
Experience in data-driven product decision-making and risk change management, with the ability to define effective metrics and drive continuous improvement through simulation, backtesting, stress testing, production monitoring, and incident reviews.
Mature cross-functional leadership and project execution capabilities.
Rigorous logical thinking, clear written and verbal communication, and fluency in both Chinese and English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and cross-functional teams across global and Chinese-language working environments.
A bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Finance, Engineering, or Mathematics.
Nice-To-Haves
A deep understanding of the trading and risk mechanisms for spot, margin, perpetuals, expiry futures, or options, with familiarity with core concepts including the order lifecycle, margin, leverage, liquidation, position tiers, index price, mark price, and price limits.
Experience working at a digital asset exchange, securities or futures exchange, brokerage, clearing platform, market-making firm, quantitative trading firm, or another high-throughput trading environment.
Experience scaling automation, AI agents, or human-in-the-loop workflows in safety-critical environments.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: VP of Product, Growth and Monetization
jobs.text:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and even though we've made a lot of headway, we still have work to do — and that’s where you come in!
Our Product Managers (PMs) have ownership over product optimizations and features, from independently run experiments to major product decisions. Backed by strong analytical skills and business acumen, and inspired by access to senior leadership and transparency into how they make product decisions, our PMs develop insights that lead to new product ideas and Duolingo’s next beloved feature.
Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
About the role...
Duolingo’s business runs on two numbers: Daily Active Users and revenue. This role owns both. As VP of Product for Growth and Monetization, you'll lead our largest product organization through a team of experienced pillar leads. Your teams shape how learners come back every day and why they choose to pay. You'll run one of the highest-velocity experimentation engines in consumer tech, with a mandate to grow DAUs and revenue sustainably and never at the expense of learners. This role reports to the Chief Product Officer, joins Duolingo's Product Leadership and Senior Leadership Team (SLT), and is based in New York, NY or Pittsburgh, PA on a hybrid (4+1) schedule.
🧠 You will...
Own DAUs and revenue, Duolingo's two hero metrics, and deliver both against forecast.
Manage the pillar leads who run Growth and Monetization, an org of roughly 20 PMs and our largest.
Coach and develop senior product leaders, and raise the bar for product talent across the company.
Partner with Engineering and Design leadership to make clear tradeoffs and ship quickly.
Build world-class product operating mechanisms: Clear north star metrics, planning and review rituals, and rigorous A/B testing.
Allocate resources across Growth and Monetization, balancing steady optimization with bigger swings.
Be the single voice for Growth and Monetization at the executive level: progress, risks, and the plan to hit both numbers.
✅ You have...
Executive product leadership in consumer tech, with multi-year measurable impact on DAUs or revenue at scale.
High judgment and operational rigor, with a record of hitting forecasts without sacrificing user experience.
A track record of leading managers of managers and developing strong product leaders.
Experience leading through change: reorgs, new operating models, faster execution.
Cross-functional range, aligning Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and Marketing on clear priorities.
Deep fluency in growth and monetization for freemium and subscription products, grounded in experimentation.
Ability to work from or relocate to New York, NY or Pittsburgh, PA on a hybrid (4+1) schedule.
⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...
Delivered stellar results growing a leading consumer app, whether in DAUs or revenue.
Demonstrated success balancing user growth and revenue expansion without degrading core user experience in a mission-driven product.
Experience communicating product strategy and results to executive and board-level audiences.
Developed product leaders who've gone on to run product orgs of their own.
Familiarity with ads, subscriptions, and in-app purchase ecosystems, including experimentation at scale across these surfaces.
The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!
Salary Range:
$367,500—$612,500 USD
Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here.
Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here.
Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com.
Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.
By applying for this position your data will be processed as per the Duolingo Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director, Analytics
jobs.text:
WHO WE ARE
Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
THE ROLE
Zeta Global is seeking a strategic, client-facing Director to join our ZX Data Science & Analytics team. This role is ideal for an experienced analytics leader who excels at transforming complex data into compelling narratives, influencing client strategy, and driving measurable business outcomes.
The Director will serve as a trusted analytics partner to clients and internal teams, bringing together marketing measurement, advanced analytics, media strategy, and data storytelling to make insights actionable. This individual will also help scale analytics best practices across clients and categories, strengthen partnerships with Sales and cross-functional teams, and contribute to the continued evolution of ZX Analytics solutions and measurement products.
This position reports to the VP of Data Science & Analytics.
Responsibilities:
Lead with Storytelling: Translate complex analytics and media performance into clear, persuasive narratives that connect insights to client business priorities and inspire action.
Shape Client Strategy: Develop analytics approaches aligned with client objectives, using insights to inform acquisition, retention, lifetime value, media, and optimization strategies. Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal partners.
Drive Measurement Excellence: Apply and advocate for best-in-class measurement methodologies, including Test/Holdout-based incrementality measurement. Help clients and internal teams understand the strengths, limitations, and business implications of different measurement approaches.
Scale Best Practices: Identify learnings across clients, campaigns, and categories and translate them into repeatable best practices, frameworks, and recommendations that improve the quality and consistency of analytics deliverables.
Team Leadership: manage and develop a team of analysts, including coaching, onboarding, workload prioritization, performance management, feedback, recognition, and career development. Mentor mid-level analysts in both technical and client-facing skills.
Lead Strategic Initiatives: Serve as analytics lead and subject matter expert for select strategic initiatives, helping define solutions, align stakeholders, and move work from concept through implementation.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner effectively with Sales, Client Services, Client Development, Operations, and other teams to solve client challenges, improve processes, and deliver high-quality analytics solutions with limited senior leadership intervention.
Innovate with AI: Support the development, application, and adoption of predictive and adaptive ML/AI solutions, helping translate model outputs into clear business recommendations and client value.
REQUIREMENTS
10+ years of professional experience in analytics, marketing measurement, data science, media analytics, or a related discipline, with demonstrated progression in responsibility and client impact.
Proven ability to translate complex analytics into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for client and business audiences.
Strong client-facing experience with excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to command an audience and serve as a model for effective client communication.
3+ years in analytics leadership roles, ideally with team management experience.
Demonstrated subject matter expertise in one or more analytics, measurement, media, or industry domains, with the ability to share knowledge and elevate the capabilities of others.
Working familiarity with Python, SQL, Tableau or comparable analytical and visualization tools, as well as experience working with predictive analytics and/or ML/AI models.
Ability to operate independently, make sound decisions in support of clients and the business, give and receive feedback effectively, and challenge existing approaches constructively.
Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred in Business Analytics, Data Science, Economics, or related fields.
Experience in Retail, Financial Services, Telecom, or Travel verticals is a plus.
This is a remote role based out of the United States.
BENEFITS & PERKS
Flexible PTO
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
Employee Equity and Stock Purchase Plan
Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance
SALARY RANGE
The compensation range for this role is $170,000-$190,000 depending on location and experience.
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/
ZETA IN THE NEWS!
https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

jobs.title: Director of Product, Search and Curated Experiences
jobs.text:
About AlphaSense:
The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
About the Team
AlphaSense's Product team stands at the forefront of innovation, developing AI-powered solutions that enable professionals to make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions. Our team, a diverse and global collective of operators, craftspeople, innovators, and visionaries, shares a passion for solving complex problems and delivering exceptional user experiences.
If you're passionate about creating industry-leading tools that shape the future of business intelligence, we'd love to meet you.
About the Role
We are seeking a senior, deeply technical product leader to own Search and Curated Experiences AlphaSense. Search is the front door to a corpus of hundreds of millions of business documents, and the relevance, ranking, document-type coverage, filtering, and performance you own sit underneath every product surface. Curated Experiences define how AlphaSense’s content, functionality, and intelligence show up in pre-built experiences that act as a launchpad for our customers’ research - everything from company profiles and industry profiles, to monitoring and beyond.
This is a leadership role, not a feature role. You will set the search strategy, own the metrics, and be the person the organization turns to drive impact with both Search and Curated Experiences. You will lead a small team, including a domain-expert for Curated Experiences. We expect you to own these programs end to end, with the judgment, drive, and initiative to take them all the way.
What You'll Do
Own both Search and Curated Experiences: Relevance, ranking, query understanding, document-type coverage, filters, latency, and reliability across every surface that depends on search are your ownership areas, alongside adoption and engagement of company profiles and future new curated experiences.
Define the strategy: Set and defend a roadmap that balances relevance quality, coverage, and performance against clear business priorities.
Build evaluation and measurement: Stand up the metrics, benchmarks, and experimentation needed to know whether search is getting better, and to prove it.
Collaborate across teams: Partner closely with Knowledge Graph, SuperAnalyst / AI, Engineering, and Design so that search and the experiences built on top of it move together.
Lead and grow a team: Manage and mentor the curated-experiences / domain-expert PM, set clear ownership, and raise the bar for the search org as it grows.
Execute and deliver: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle - from strategy and experimentation through launch, post-launch analysis, and iteration.
Who You Are
Deeply Technical: You have built search and relevance systems at scale - e.g., a Google Search-caliber background or equivalent depth in ranking, retrieval, query understanding, and evaluation. You can reason fluently about representation, freshness, quality, and system-design tradeoffs.
Strong Ownership & Drive: You take programs end to end and operate autonomously. You set direction, make the calls, and are accountable for the outcome.
A People Leader: You can manage and grow PMs, set clear lines of ownership, and resolve ambiguity rather than create it.
Analytical & Data-Driven: You balance business goals with technical capability and let metrics, not opinion, settle questions of search quality.
Strong Customer Orientation: You understand how sophisticated users search and form conviction, and you use interviews, usability testing, and behavioral data to validate hypotheses.
Clear Communicator: You can align engineering, design, and product marketing around a roadmap and gain buy-in to drive high-impact work.
Domain Experience a Plus: Direct experience in financial services, capital markets, or with our core customers (financial services, corporate strategy, consulting) is a plus, but not required.
For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.
You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.
Base Compensation Range
$275,000—$290,000 USD
AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
Recruiting Scams and Fraud
We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:
AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.
If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering (AI)
jobs.text:
Our client is a global leader in cybersecurity for IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure. Their end-to-end platform gives enterprises and public sector organizations the critical advantage they need to protect complex networks, secure devices, and meet compliance requirements.
Over the past 20 years, a consistent commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide — cementing the company's role in protecting the world's critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
On their behalf, we are looking for a Director of Engineering ready to contribute to that mission.
This is a hands-on, technically-centric leadership role — not a pure people-management position — with full accountability for the engineering of MetaDefender Managed File Transfer: architecture, delivery, quality, and the teams that build it. You will lead engineering across multiple deployment form factors — from air-gapped and cross-domain environments to internet-connected and native-cloud deployments — operating with the rigor of a principal engineer and the clarity of an executive.
You are an AI-native engineering leader. You have personally orchestrated fleets of AI agents to architect, build, test, and ship production systems, and you have launched and released real products through a full AI-powered software development lifecycle (SDLC) — from specification and code generation to automated testing, review, and deployment. Product Management defines what to ship; you define how to build it. You own the end-to-end delivery of the roadmap Product Management sets, hold the delivery bar, and build a high-performance culture that the rest of our client's engineering portfolio will look to as a model for AI-native development. You report to the VP, Products, and lead a distributed team across Romania, Vietnam, and Hungary, while the role itself can be based anywhere, with a preference for the UK, USA.
Your Responsibilies:
Lead as an AI-first effort: make AI agents a first-class part of how the team works — orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and run reviews — while ensuring humans own and validate every line that ships. Treat automation and intelligence as the default, not the exception.
Stay hands-on: remain directly in the codebase — setting architecture patterns, writing and reviewing critical code, prototyping, and unblocking hard technical problems. You lead by doing, not only by delegating.
Own end-to-end delivery of the roadmap: take full ownership of delivering the product roadmap set by Product Management — turning the “what to ship” into the “how to build,” and owning execution sequencing, technical risk, quality, security, and release across every deployment form factor.
Set technical direction (the “how”): drive the architecture and technology choices that underpin a product serving high-assurance environments at scale. Hold a strong engineering point of view and be willing to defend it.
Build and lead a high-performance team: recruit, develop, and retain top engineers and their leads across Romania, Vietnam, and Hungary; create clear career paths and norms for code quality and review; and build a culture where strong engineers want to stay and grow.
Drive performance-based management: set clear, measurable expectations and run a rigorous, fair performance culture — recognizing and accelerating top performers, raising the bar continuously, and addressing underperformance decisively by coaching where there is a path and upgrading or exiting the role where there is not.
Hold a security-first quality bar: champion code review with a security lens for both human-written and AI-generated code, catching injection risks, insecure defaults, missing validation, and privilege-escalation vectors in file-handling and authentication paths before they ship.
Raise engineering velocity: continuously improve how the team works — CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted development workflows, incident response, and operational maturity — so the team ships faster and more reliably over time.
Codify AI-native practices for the portfolio: establish the playbooks, AI context files, coding harnesses, test frameworks, and review norms developed on this product so other product teams can adopt them.
Partner cross-functionally: work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP, Products, plus Product Management, Design, and security leaders — turning the product roadmap (the what) into engineering execution (the how), committing to scope and timelines, and pushing back clearly when trade-offs require it.

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.text:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Okta authenticates, authorizes and provisions millions of users a day. The service is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) across multiple availability zones and geographically separated regions. The service is designed for high throughput, and 99.999 availability. We're looking for a technical leader to help us to continue to scale the service with great people and reliable, cost-effective and efficient infrastructure, processes and tooling.
As the Director of Site Reliability Engineering you will oversee the SRE organization focused on Okta platform, Databases, Edge networking, K8s platform, CI/CD, Observability, FinOps, and automation platform & tooling.
Job Duties and Responsibilities:
Build and lead a high-caliber India-based SRE organization supporting Okta’s production fleet.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Engineering
jobs.text:
Solaris is Europe’s leading embedded finance platform, pioneering Banking-as-a-Service to bridge the gap between financial technology and licensed banking. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Berlin, Solaris enables fintechs, digital ecosystems, and multinationals to embed accounts, cards, lending, and payments directly into their own products, creating seamless financial experiences for their users. As a fully licensed German bank, Solaris combines the highest standards of IT security and regulatory resilience with a modular, highly scalable infrastructure.
Today, Solaris is driving the next evolution of financial services by transitioning into an AI-native banking platform, ensuring European businesses can deploy secure, adaptable financial products at scale.
Why join Solaris?
🚀 We are fundamentally redesigning banking processes around AI orchestration, standardized modular building blocks, and embedded regulatory compliance.
🎯 We combine tech and banking in dedicated hubs - driving the technology infrastructure out of Berlin and banking operations out of Frankfurt.
💡 Through our internal mobility, growth opportunities, and the Solaris Academy, we offer continuous learning tracks, AI ambassador mentorship, and upskilling to keep your skills ahead of the curve.
⚖️ We foster a workplace rooted in integrity, proactive risk management, and equality actively driving initiatives like DEI initiatives.
The Head of Product & Engineering is a dual-domain leadership role reporting directly to the Executive Director of Technology. In this position, you will be primarily responsible for driving our Product Foundations and Business Enablement initiatives. You will own both the product vision and engineering delivery for foundational capabilities - such as core APIs, developer tools, and internal automation platforms - that power our broader technology ecosystem and enable internal business units to scale efficiently.
Your Role
Dual-Domain Leadership (Product & Engineering)
Serve as the ultimate owner of both the what/why (Product Roadmap) and the how (Engineering Execution) for foundational technical products.
Lead, mentor, and scale teams composed of both Product Managers and Software Engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and engineering excellence.
Product Foundation & Core APIs
Oversee the development and scaling of our most critical technical capabilities, including Authentication services, API proxies, Policy engines, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and Webhook architectures.
Ensure these foundational tech products reliably power the entirety of Solaris's external and internal-facing API suite, maintaining high availability, security, and low latency.
Developer Productivity & Experience (DevEx)
Lead the teams responsible for developer productivity, managing tools like Backstage and defining SRE capabilities.
Create a frictionless development environment that allows Solaris engineers to build, test, and deploy securely and autonomously.
Business Enablement & Internal Automation
Drive the internal automation platform to support and scale various business units across Solaris.
Oversee the integration of internal toolings, the implementation of complex workflow systems, and the creation of robust build-automation frameworks.
Identify manual bottlenecks in business processes and deploy technical solutions to automate them, enabling the company to scale efficiently without an increase in overhead.
We'd love to see
Depending on your level of experience, your responsibilities and scope of role will range. We don’t care much about fancy titles, but rather about real personal and professional development, as laid out in our learning framework. Let’s figure together out how you can contribute to our team.
Have proven experience as a senior engineering leader with hands-on architectural experience in distributed systems, microservices, and Core APIs.
Demonstrated success in product leadership, specifically managing internal platforms, developer tools, or highly technical API-as-a-Product offerings.
3+ years of experience leading product and engineering organisation.
Experience implementing and managing internal developer portals (like Spotify's Backstage) and a deep empathy for the developer journey.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders, and vice versa.
Have successfully scaled both technology platforms and the organizational structures that support them in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
Strong understanding of IAM, authentication flows (OAuth, OIDC), API gateways/proxies, webhook infrastructure, and SRE best practices.
Track record of designing workflow systems and automation frameworks that streamline business operations.
Comfortable working with AI tools, thinking critically about AI outputs, and contributing to a culture of responsible AI use. We expect you to demonstrate comfort with AI-assisted workflows and a willingness to continuously develop their AI capabilities as the technology evolves.
Benefits
Home office budget.
Learning & development budget of €1000 per year and a transparent growth framework to support your career goals.
Competitive salary and a variable remuneration program.
Monthly meal allowance.
Deutschland ticket subsidy.
28 vacation days, increasing by 2 days after 2 years and 3 days after 3 years with Solaris.
Opportunity to work abroad for up to 12 weeks per year.
While job ads usually paint an ideal picture of a candidate, studies show that most applicants meet an average of 60% of the criteria. Unfortunately, many promising candidates tend to apply only if they meet all the criteria. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single item in the job description, please contact us anyway. We'd love to talk with you and find out if you might be a good fit for us.
At Solaris, we are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment, where all Solarians feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a diverse workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of color, ethnicity, religion, sex, origin, disability, marital status, citizenship, or gender identity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
If your application is successful, you will be required to complete pre-employment background checks through our screening provider Zinc. These include, but not limited to identity verification, educational records, references, a criminal record check, etc. The processing is based on Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR. Please see below Privacy Information for Job Applicants for details, including recipients, retention, and your rights.
Information on data processing:
DE: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr_notice_de
EN: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr_notice_en
The annual gross salary range for this position is:
€120.000—€140.000 EUR

jobs.text:
Job Title: Director of Engineering
Location: 203 Purdy Rd, Colborne ON K0K 1S0; Onsite
FLSA Status: Exempt
Position Description:
The Director of Engineering will lead the engineering design and development team, for the assigned region, for single phase and three phase distribution transformers. This role combines strategic leadership with engineering management, focusing on achieving business objectives and targets while overseeing daily engineering operations ensuring the successful design, development, and production of high-quality distribution transformers.
Strategic Leadership:
Assist in the development and execution of the engineering department's strategic goals aligned with organizational objectives.
Collaborate with other department leaders to align engineering initiatives with business priorities, budgets, and timelines.
Help drive innovation by identifying and sharing opportunities for new technologies, materials, and processes to enhance product performance and reduce costs.
Represent the engineering function in cross-functional leadership meetings, contributing to company-wide decision-making.
Develop and manage engineering budgets, ensuring optimal allocation of resources.
Engineering Management:
Manage day-to-day engineering functions including sales, production and quality support.
Maintain design compliance with applicable industry standards, government regulations, and certifications such as ANSI, ASTM, IEEE, CSA and DOE.
Manage departmental capability and capacity through skill assessment, employee training and strategic hiring to meet customer demand and sales forecast.
Periodically review and evaluate engineering practices and procedures to ensure effectiveness and implementing best practices.
Manage and scale department productivity through tracking and establishment, as necessary, of departmental OKRs and KPIs.
Team Leadership:
Manage, build and mentor a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Conduct performance reviews, provide feedback, and identify development opportunities for team members through effective coaching and goal setting.
Help drive collaboration between engineering, production, quality, and other departments to optimize workflows and resolve technical challenges.

jobs.title: Director Engineering - Investment & Pension domain (m/f/d)
jobs.text:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.
Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.
For further development and expansion of our successful business, Raisin is looking for a highly motivated, driven, and experienced Director of Engineering to lead both strategically and operationally our Investment and Pension (IPP) teams (25+ engineers)
This embraces high-quality conceptual and delivery performance of the teams, the health of the IPP engineering organization and system landscape, an efficient and compliant development process, technical and business ownership of the Raisin’s IPP platform, and vendor relationships.
At Raisin, we work in a domain driven organization with a binary-star leadership model. In this model, every Director of Engineering has a Product partner (Head of Product/ Director of Product).
The Director Engineering (DE) leads both strategically and operationally across multiple cross-functional teams.
This embraces the six impact areas (in details below):
Delivery quality and speed
Domain ownership
Team and culture
Data strategy
Process and compliance
Your Responsibilities
Delivery quality and speed
The DE is:
accountable for fulfilling the agreed team commitments to their business-owners in time, scope, and budget
responsible for the performance of their teams
resolving impediments for their teams
nurturing a culture of accountability, pragmatism, and reusability
ensuring a strong delivery oriented collaboration between the different engineering teams
leading both complex technical and important business projects
leading internal software engineering projects and initiatives
Domain ownership
The DE:
drives long-term value creation for their domain
is fostering an environment of passion and fun for the business processes in their tribe
builds resilient domain expertise in their teams
has a deep understanding of the existing system landscape of their teams
collaborates closely with their Business Owner and other stakeholders
vendor management (evaluating, onboarding, and managing vendors)
Tech Strategy
The DE:
shapes the technical strategy for their teams according to the Raisin's business needs
collaborates closely with other Sr. Engineering Leads in shaping and implementing Raisin's Tech Strategy
actively initiates and contributes to strategic technical and architectural decisions
is always considering the strategic benefits and price of:
keeping an existing technical solution
introducing a new alternative (e.g framework, tech stack, tooling, process)
Team and Culture
The DE is:
fully responsible for the health, resilience high performance, and development of their teams
offering direct leadership of engineering leads and sometimes also tech leads as well
encouraging accountability, creativity, risk-taking, and ownership by delegating responsibility
attracting, hiring, and retaining top technical talent for Raisin from around the world
proactively mentoring and coaching individual team members
ensuring a strong delivery-oriented collaboration between the different engineering teams
organizing workshops/hackathons
representing the company in external tech events advancing Raisin’s tech brand recognition
shaping and driving knowledge transfer best practices
nurturing and protecting our culture of trust
initiating, owning and nurturing tech initiatives (like guilds, workshops, regular meetups)
recognizing high performance and rewarding accomplishments within their teams
Process and Compliance
The DE:
drives, improves, and applies existing Raisin standards and policies, regulation and data privacy
contributes to an optimal toolchain with a high level of automation
develops, establishes, and continually improves documentation standards for the engineering organization
develops guidelines and best practices to ensure a lean software development process across different product teams
is responsible for the KPI-based reporting for their teams
actively monitors, analyses, and drives initiatives to continuously reduce their teams' technical debt
Your Profile
You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related fields or have equivalent practical experience
Leadership experience 10y+. You are a senior engineering leader, across projects and teams, with a natural aptitude and passion for growing and developing high-performing teams
You have at least 4y experience in FinTech
Domain knowledge of Investment products is a strong advantage
Strong business mindset
Strong AWS knowledge, Java, SQL, Kafka or other messaging solutions
You are pragmatic and can handle the balance between both taking and delegating the lead in challenging situations
You bring both strong strategic and excellent operational leadership skills
You motivate and inspire by outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal, including communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences
You possess solid engineering background and distinct hands-on mentality
You are experienced with OKR and KPI-based target agreements
You are familiar with architecturally-heavy systems, including designing, implementing, and evolving these system constraints
You are fluent in English, knowledge of German or another European language would be a plus
Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!
At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.
As part of our team, you will benefit from:
Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.
Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.
Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy
We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering - My OPSWAT Portal
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
The Platform: My OPSWAT
Every OPSWAT customer, partner, and prospect meets us here first.
My OPSWAT is the unified front door to everything OPSWAT delivers, the place where a nuclear plant operator activates an offline license, where a channel partner manages a portfolio of customer deployments, where a security engineer opens a critical support case at 2 a.m., where a new administrator earns their first OPSWAT Academy certification, and where organizations control exactly who inside their walls can do each of those things.
My OPSWAT is where OPSWAT's commercial model, customer experience, partner ecosystem, and product portfolio converge into one system. When it is excellent, every other product in the portfolio feels easier to buy, deploy, and trust.
About This Role
We are looking for a Director of Software Engineering to own the engineering of the My OPSWAT platform end to end: architecture, delivery, quality, security, and the team that builds it.
This is a hands-on, technically centric leadership role. Not a pure people-management position, and not a role that leads through status decks. You will operate with the rigor of a principal engineer and the clarity of an executive: in the codebase enough to earn your team's respect, in the business enough to make the right trade-offs, and in front of customers and partners enough to know what actually matters.
And you are an AI-native engineering leader. Not someone who has evaluated AI tools, someone who has personally orchestrated fleets of AI agents to specify, build, test, review, and ship production software, and who has shipped real products through a full agentic SDLC. You have opinions about context engineering, evals, and review gates because you have been burned and learned. Product Management defines what to ship; you define how it gets built, and at OPSWAT, "how" increasingly means humans directing AI agents, with humans accountable for every line that ships.
The patterns you establish on My OPSWAT won't stay on My OPSWAT. This platform connects and enables the company’s all products and business functions, which makes it the natural proving ground for AI-native engineering practices at OPSWAT.
What You Will Own
Lead the AI agentic transformation.
Stay hands-on, be creative and innovative.
Own the platform.
Own delivery.
Connect business, engineering, product, and people.
Build a team people want to be on.
What We Need From You
Full agentic SDLC experience.
A track record of bringing a team along.
10+ years engineering and 5+ years leading teams including managing managers or leads.
Deep technical fundamentals distributed systems, API design, data modeling.
Cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS experience in build and operation.
Business and customer instinct.
Excellent English communication.
It Would Be Nice If You Had
Domain familiarity.
AI product features, not just AI development experience.
Cybersecurity background.
Experience in a global product company with engineering and go-to-market spread across regions.
Why You'll Love Working Here
My OPSWAT touches every customer, every partner, every business unit, and every product line. The architecture and culture decisions you make now will shape it for years.
The AI-native patterns you establish here are intended to propagate across OPSWAT's engineering portfolio.
Leadership is committed to AI agentic engineering and wants a leader who will push further than the mandate, not ask permission to start.
A stable, growing international company with an exceptional customer base across 50+ countries.
Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments, and flexibility for the right candidate.
Your First 90 Days
Day 30 - Credibility and context. Know the architecture, identify the top constraints holding it back, and the health of your team. Working relationships established with Product, Support, Enterprise Applications and Engineering.
Day 60 - A point of view. Present an architecture and AI-native transformation plan with sequencing and trade-offs. Baseline the metrics below so progress is measurable, not asserted.
Day 90 - Execution underway. Agentic workflows live on at least one meaningful workstream, with context files, evals, and review gates in place. Delivery commitments made and being met.
Success Metrics (6 - 12 months)
Platform and customers
Full agentic My OPSWAT platform.
Improved usability and reliability on the flows customers and partners live in daily.
Reduced support volume on the friction points you inherited.
Positive, sustained feedback from executives, product, engineering, support, and other stakeholders.
AI agentic engineering
A majority of delivery flows through AI agentic workflows, with documented context, evals, and review gates.
Measurable lead-time reduction from spec to production.
Delivery and quality
Predictable releases: committed scope and dates met, trade-offs raised early.
Escaped-defect and production-incident rates down as AI-generated code share rises.
Zero critical security findings reaching production.
Team and influence
Strong retention and a visibly rising hiring bar.
Every engineer on the team working as an AI orchestrator, not an observer.
OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

jobs.title: Director of Product - RPG
jobs.text:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.
With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.
This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.
What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.
Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.
At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.
Mission
As a Director of Product on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with that game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles: core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
Own LiveOps end-to-end. You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
Lead your team. You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
Oversee the monetization model. Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
Drive growth, in partnership with UA. You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
Cross-functional excellence. You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
Set the bar. Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
Stay hands-on when it counts. This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.
This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy,, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

jobs.title: Director, People Partners - Product, Design & Engineering
jobs.text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
As Director, People Partners for Product, Design & Engineering (PDE), you'll be partnering with the leaders that are responsible for the teams building Figma and leading a team of highly skilled People Partners. You'll operate as a trusted advisor - coaching, challenging, and guiding the organization through rapid growth, reorganization, and change. As a member of the People team, you’ll partner closely with all of our People functions to build a best in class people function. If you’re energized by ambiguity, adept at building deep relationships, and excited to shape what great People Partnering looks like at Figma, we’d love to hear from you!
This is a full time role held from our San Francisco hub.
What you'll do at Figma:
Serve as the strategic People Partner to Figma’s CTO and Chief Design Officer, building the credibility and trust to influence how they lead, organize, and grow their teams
Lead and develop a talented team of People Partners across the Product, Design and Engineering organizations
Lead and execute our People Programs such as org design, resource management, performance, and change management through periods of rapid scaling, reorganization, and shifting priorities
Drive the core people cycles for your orgs across performance, calibration, talent reviews, succession planning while raising the bar on quality and consistency
Partner across the People function and our cross functional partners to help execute the People strategy across the PDE organization
Use data and insights to inform your point of view, measure impact, and tell a compelling story to the leaders you support
Help shape and scale the People Partner function itself - developing partners, strengthening the operating model, and modeling what great looks like
We'd love to hear from you if you have:
Significant experience as a People Partner leader in high-growth environments, including managing a team and partnering directly with executive leaders
A track record of supporting Product, Design, and/or Engineering organizations, with genuine fluency in how technical and design teams operate
Strong business and technical acumen - the ability to build deep product and technical knowledge and understand how the business operates
Demonstrated ability to challenge and advise senior leaders, influencing decisions and outcomes.
You stay grounded and resilient, even when things move quickly
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Pay Transparency Disclosure
Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location.
Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off. Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave. PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.
Annual Base Salary Range:
$235,000—$317,000 USD
At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.
Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:
Holding interviews in an accessible location
Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
Changing the mode or format of interviews
To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.
By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.
