jobs.text:
About the role
HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Product Design and Software Engineering functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.
You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.
This location-flexible position can be physically based in any of our North America corporate offices or fulfillment centers with a hybrid working model, but must be flexible with work hour scheduling as teams and solutions are dispersed globally.
The Director of WMS Product Design and Software Engineering will work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.
What you'll own
WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations
Integration Architecture & Reliability: Own WMS layer Integrations to host systems and CDC pipelines (Debezium/kafka) to Snowflake/Databricks
Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS
Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate
CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments
Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods
Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership
Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning
Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability
People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development
International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally
Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level
What you bring
Technical/Engineering Experience
10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment
3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server
3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines
Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks
Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact
Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting
Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies
Product Experience
Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties
Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization
Additionally With This Role, You will have....
The opportunity to shape global operations at a leading food technology company with significant reach and impact.
A high-ownership, low-bureaucracy environment where your work is visible and your decisions matter.
Flexible working arrangements to support your work-life balance.
Continuous development through HelloFresh Academies and access to internal mobility across 18 countries.
An egoless, collaborative culture focused on learning, growth, and building something exceptional together.
And you’ll get…
Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation
Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks
Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)
Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)
Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

jobs.title: Director of Data, Payments
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍London or UK Remote | 💰 £150,000 - £200, 000 + Equity + Benefits
About our Data Discipline
We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.
Our Data discipline is centralised, but deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Analysts work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers, Marketers and other specialists. This means Data is not a downstream service: we help shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.
Our Payments team ⭐
At Monzo, payments are more than just moving money from A to B. They are a core part of how customers experience trust, speed, and financial control every day. As a Data Director in Payments, you would help shape seamless local payment experiences, ensuring customers can pay and get paid reliably while continuing to modernise the infrastructure that powers millions of transactions behind the scenes.
The role also sits at the intersection of Monzo’s broader ambition to build truly borderless banking and expand into new markets. That means designing products and payment capabilities that work effortlessly across geographies, currencies, and customer needs, while helping Monzo scale into new markets with the same simplicity and transparency that defines the brand today.
You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, enabling revenue and customer growth with a resilient, self-serve banking platform.
To succeed, you should be excited about solving tough, ambiguous business problems with analytical rigour, commercial viability and execution effectiveness
Your day-to-day
Establish yourself as a trusted member of the Payments Leadership team, enabling better decisions across Payments and the wider Data Discipline
Co-drive Payments strategy and product decisions with Product and Engineering, bringing Data into discovery early to shape priorities and challenge thinking
Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth
Set the data strategy for Payments, including the operating model, team priorities, architecture, technical debt and key metrics and drivers
Translate between technical, product and commercial perspectives to help teams make clear, high-impact decisions
Develop and scale a high-performing team of data professionals sharing accountability for product and business outcomes.
You should apply if:
What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!
You have experience driving payments innovation and product strategy forward in a fast-growing business
You combine deep Data expertise with strong product and commercial judgement.
You can move comfortably from detailed metrics or architecture discussions to customer strategy, pricing and business outcomes
You are an empathetic people leader who can build trust quickly, raise the performance bar and retain excellent talent
You have experience growing and leading a full stack data team, including individual contributors and managers across Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering and Analytics
You have experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing and risk/control functions
The Interview Process
After an informal ~30 min recruiter call, our interview process involves 2 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!
Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our senior data leaders.
Loop Stage - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as behavioural and leadership interviews. You can have this all in one day or split these across multiple days, whichever your prefer.
Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com
How we work 💻:
Locations & Flexible Working :
Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.
We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨
Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.
Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.
At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.
You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨
Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼
What’s in it for you
💰Base salary £150, 000 - £200, 000 + Equity + Benefits
✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK
✅ We can sponsor visas
📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).
⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.
📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences
#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE
Equal opportunities for everyone
Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Field Chief Technology Officer (Field CTO)
jobs.text:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
We are seeking a highly technical, visionary, and customer-centric Field CTO to act as our premier technical ambassador. In this role, you will bridge the gap between MinIO’s engineering innovation and the strategic business needs of our largest, most complex enterprise customers.
As a Field CTO, you will engage in peer-to-peer conversations with enterprise C-suites (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs) and lead architectural discussions with principal engineers. A deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI architectures (LLMs, RAG, deep learning pipelines) and modern analytics data systems (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Trino, Spark) is mandatory. You will not only evangelize MinIO’s capabilities but also act as a trusted advisor, helping organizations architect their data infrastructure to support next-generation workloads.
What You Will Do
Executive Advisory & Evangelism: Act as a trusted technical advisor to C-level executives at Fortune 500 companies. Articulate the strategic value of high-performance object storage in the context of AI readiness and data democratization.
Architectural Leadership: Design and validate complex, large-scale architectures for enterprise customers. Guide them in integrating MinIO seamlessly into their AI/ML pipelines and modern data lakehouse ecosystems.
Industry Thought Leadership: Represent MinIO at major industry conferences, webinars, and meetups. Write technical whitepapers, reference architectures, and blog posts focusing on the intersection of object storage, generative AI, and modern analytics.
Pre-Sales & Post-Sales Strategic Support: Partner closely with enterprise sales and customer success teams on high-stakes deals. Unblock technical objections and provide strategic guidance during Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and large-scale deployments.
Product Strategy Feedback Loop: Serve as the "voice of the customer" to MinIO’s product and engineering teams. Distill market trends, customer pain points, and emerging AI/Analytics patterns into actionable product requirements.
Your Skills and Experience
10+ years of experience in technical leadership roles (e.g., Enterprise Architect, Chief Architect, VP of Engineering, or previous Field CTO).
Demonstrated experience in a customer-facing or evangelist capacity, successfully presenting to both highly technical audiences and C-level business executives.
AI & Machine Learning Architectures:
Deep architectural understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
Strong knowledge of AI/ML data pipelines and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ray, Hugging Face).
Understanding of hardware bottlenecks in AI, specifically the challenge of feeding data to GPUs (GPU data starvation) and how high-throughput storage solves this.
Modern Analytics & Data Systems:
Expertise in Open Table Formats (Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Delta Lake) and their integration with object storage.
Proficiency with modern query engines and compute frameworks (Trino, Presto, Apache Spark, Flink, StarRocks).
Solid grasp of the evolution from traditional data warehouses to modern Data Lakehouse architectures.
Infrastructure & Cloud-Native Tech:
Strong command of Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud-native orchestration.
Deep understanding of the AWS S3 API, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems design.
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Sr. Technology Partner Director - AI Code-Gen & Apps
jobs.text:
RDQ427R146
At Databricks, we are building the platform for the next generation of AI-built applications, where developers can go from idea to production using AI coding agents and app-building platforms. We partner with the leading tools developers use to generate, build, and deploy applications, connecting them directly to Databricks data, AI, and application infrastructure. With Databricks Apps and Lakebase, developers can build with their preferred code-gen tools and deploy secure, data-driven applications directly on Databricks. These partnerships are critical to making Databricks a core platform for the rapidly growing ecosystem of AI-generated applications.
Founded in 2013 by the original creators of Apache Spark, Databricks has grown from a tiny corner office in Berkeley, CA to a global organization with over 8,000 employees. Thousands of organizations, from small startups to Fortune 100, trust Databricks with their mission-critical workloads, making us one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the world and one of the top 5 move valuable private companies.
More about the Team
As the Sr. Technology Partner Director, AI Code-gen & Apps, you will be responsible for recruiting, developing, managing, and scaling our global partner ecosystem that makes Databricks the best place to build and run AI-generated applications. You will build and own strategic partnerships with leading AI coding agents, app builders, and developer platforms, creating deep product integrations, joint solutions, and GTM plays that connect these ecosystems to Databricks Apps, Lakebase, and the broader Databricks platform.
We are looking for someone with experience building and scaling strategic partnerships across AI code-gen, app-building, or developer tool ecosystems, with a strong track record of driving product integrations, joint GTM, and partner-led growth. The role requires strong technical and GTM acumen, with the ability to work across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to drive integrations, joint solutions, and go-to-market execution. Success requires deep expertise in large-scale technology ecosystems, strong communication and prioritization skills, and a scrappy, entrepreneurial mindset to build partnerships that establish Databricks as the best place to run transactional database workloads.
The impact you will have
Build and own partnership strategies for a portfolio of leading AI coding agents and app builders, spanning product integrations, joint solutions, GTM, and marketing initiatives that drive measurable customer adoption and business impact.
Lead strategic partnerships from opportunity identification and joint product planning through launch and scale, working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to bring integrations to market and drive adoption.
Drive enablement and field readiness to ensure both Databricks and partner teams can effectively position and deliver these joint offerings.
Serve as the internal voice of top partners in category, collaborating with Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership to influence our roadmap and ensure our strategy addresses the evolving needs of the Developer Tooling & Database Ecosystem landscape.
What we look for
7+ years of experience in product partnerships, business development, or partner management, including 3+ years working across AI code-gen, app-building, or developer tool ecosystems.
Proven track record of launching strategic ISV integrations and joint GTM motions with leading developer platforms, AI code-gen companies, or hyperscalers.
Deep understanding and network across Developer Tool & Database ecosystem — Postgres (big plus), Developer Marketplaces, next-gen Platform-as-a-Services, AI Coding, and CI/CD workflows, and ability to develop joint value propositions that resonate with technical and business decision-makers alike.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills — able to influence Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Business Operations teams.
Experience navigating co-opetition dynamics and sensitive partner relationships.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
Grit, humility, and the ability to operate in a high-growth, founder-led environment.
**Most of all, we look for relentless problem solvers and will consider candidates with non-traditional backgrounds.

You will build and own strategic partnerships with leading AI coding agents, app builders, and developer platforms, creating deep product integrations, joint solutions, and GTM plays that connect these ecosystems to Databricks Apps, Lakebase, and the broader Databricks platform.

We are looking for someone with experience building and scaling strategic partnerships across AI code-gen, app-building, or developer tool ecosystems, with a strong track record of driving product integrations, joint GTM, and partner-led growth. items: Build and own partnership strategies for a portfolio of leading AI coding agents and app builders, spanning product integrations, joint solutions, GTM, and marketing initiatives that drive measurable customer adoption and business impact.

Lead strategic partnerships from opportunity identification and joint product planning through launch and scale, working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to bring integrations to market and drive adoption.
Drive enablement and field readiness to ensure both Databricks and partner teams can effectively position and deliver these joint offerings.

Serve as the internal voice of top partners in category, collaborating with Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership to influence our roadmap and ensure our strategy addresses the evolving needs of the Developer Tooling & Database Ecosystem landscape.

Deep understanding and network across Developer Tool & Database ecosystem — Postgres (big plus), Developer Marketplaces, next-gen Platform-as-a-Services, AI Coding, and CI/CD workflows, and ability to develop joint value propositions that resonate with technical and business decision-makers alike.

jobs.title: Director, Product (physical) (f/m/x)
jobs.text:
Reporting Relationships
Primary Manager: COO and Co-MD
Dotted Line: CMO and Co-MD
Direct Reports: ~10 people spanning Culinary, Product Innovation, Product Strategy, Product Operations, and Product Analytics
The Opportunity
Factor is a healthy, ready-to-heat meal delivery service that has built a category-defining business in the US and Canada. Now we're building Factor in Europe — and although we have strong blueprints from North America, we have the opportunity to leverage the very rich multi-cultural environment in Europe to tailor both our physical and digital products to five different markets.
As our Director, Product, you will own the full product vision and execution for Factor Europe. You will lead a multi-layered team of ~10 people, sit on the Factor Europe leadership team, and maintain a close dotted-line relationship with our CMO to ensure product and marketing move as one.
This is a rare kind of role: senior strategic ownership and real infrastructure, with the pace and ambition of an early-stage scale up. If you are a visionary builder who leads with curiosity, earns conviction through data, and holds your team to the same high standard you hold yourself — we'd love to hear from you.
What You'll Do
Lead and Develop a High-Performance Product Team
Build, inspire, and manage a multi-disciplinary team — setting a clear vision, establishing the operating rhythms that allow the team to move fast, and investing in the people who will drive Factor Europe's next chapter.
Own and Challenge the Product Vision
Define a clear and compelling vision for what Factor's physical product must become in Europe — grounded in customer insight, commercially rigorous, and differentiated enough to win. Develop a deep, independent point of view on where the North American model translates and where European markets demand something different.
Push the team and the business to think beyond the current roadmap — challenging assumptions, interrogating trade-offs, and ensuring we are always working on the highest-leverage version of the product.
Act as the liaison to our global Digital Product team — representing Factor Europe's priorities in the feature roadmap and collaborating on shared global initiatives that benefit the wider business.
Drive Customer Retention and Commercial Performance
Own customer retention levers as your north star. Build a rigorous, evidence-based view of what drives it and rally the team around interventions that move the needle.
Make product decisions with full awareness of their P&L implications. Take calculated risks, track outcomes honestly, and move quickly to learn and adjust when bets don't pay off.
Build for Multiple European Markets
Lead our effort to find product-market fit across five distinct markets — understanding how consumer preferences vary by culture, and building a proposition that resonates locally while scaling efficiently.
Share learnings across geographies and partner with peers across the HelloFresh Group to continuously raise the bar.
Support new channel strategies, understanding and adapting products for different customer bases.
Align Product and Marketing Strategy
Work closely with the brand & marketing team to ensure product roadmap and marketing strategies are fully synchronised — so what we build, how we talk about it, and how we sell it form one coherent proposition.
Act as the product voice on the leadership team, articulating a compelling vision for where the product needs to go and why.
Who You Are
A visionary leader who executes. You set a compelling direction, bring your team with you, and roll up your sleeves to make it happen.
Customer-obsessed and analytically rigorous. Sharp instincts backed by disciplined discovery. Comfortable querying your own data and stress-testing assumptions.
Commercially minded. You understand how product decisions flow through to the P&L — and hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not just outputs.
A cross-functional influencer. You build trust quickly, drive execution through others, and get the right priorities onto other teams' roadmaps.
Internationally curious. You find the complexity of building for multiple European cultures energising, and you seek out the nuances that matter.
An exceptional communicator. You write and present with clarity and conviction — from strategy narratives to leadership updates to product briefs.
Food and/or nutrition obsessed!
Requirements
Experience: 8–10+ years in Product, Strategy, or a closely related commercial leadership role; 3+ years managing multi-disciplinary teams.
Technical toolkit: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; AI proficiency and curiosity required.
Strong preference for:
○ Experience in D2C subscription businesses — retention, lifecycle, and recurring revenue models.
○ Multi-market European experience and an understanding of how consumer preferences vary across the continent.
○ Experience in physical products or FMCG, especially food & beverage.
○ A track record of scaling a product in a new market and finding product-market fit.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing
Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.
Access the "Benefits at Work" platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA.
You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop, a €250 home office setup budget, and contribute to the Bedrijfspensioenfonds Levensmiddelen pension scheme (2025 rate 27.6%; employer pays 19.64%, employee pays 7.96%).
Health & Wellbeing
Benefit from discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland, free bootcamp classes (Amsterdam), and free subscriptions to Headspace and OpenUp.
Get a 10% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis in 2025.
Flexibility & Work-Life
Work flexibly with our hybrid setup (50% office, 50% remote), plus a €2.40 daily remote work allowance.
Receive 24 days of annual leave (pro-rated), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).
Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, plus €0.23 per km for car and bicycle travel.
Eligible employees can work from another country for up to 8 weeks per year.
Career & Development
Grow with our "Learning Never Stops" mindset: participate in Pantry Staple trainings, access internal/external opportunities, and join our cross-market mentoring program.
Culture & Environment
Enjoy fresh homemade lunches in the office (€3.00/day), weekly vrij-mi-bo (Friday drinks), quarterly strategy sessions, and team events.

jobs.title: Group Head of Product- Payer
jobs.text:
About the Role
The Head of Product- Payer Solutions leads Innovaccer’s payer product portfolio, spanning AI applications in IT, financial and clinical operations. Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, the Head of Payer Solutions is a senior leadership role with broad organizational scope — you will own the product strategy and roadmap end to end, lead a team of product managers, partner deeply with engineering, data science, design, and clinical operations, and work hand-in-hand with go-to-market teams to personally grow, mature, and scale the go-to-market strategy.
The ideal candidate is someone who has taken a product or a business from a standing start to a real, referenceable market position. You should be equal parts strategist, innovator and closer: someone who can build the plan and then walk into a room with a health plan CXOs and sell it.
A Day in the Life
Business & Product Strategy
Define and own the end-to-end strategy for Galaxy, Innovaccer's payer solution spanning risk adjustment, quality management, payment integrity, and utilization management, with agentic AI as the operating model rather than a feature layer.
Develop a differentiated point of view on where the market is heading and translate that into an AI-first product roadmap that positions Innovaccer ahead of the curve, defining where Galaxy expands next — new use cases, new payer segments, new regulatory surface area — and building the business case for each bet.
Partner with the CPO to shape Innovaccer's overall product narrative and communicate strategy to customers, investors, and internal stakeholders.
Lead a team of product leaders to develop world-class products with the agility of an early-stage startup
Go-to-Market & Commercial Ownership
Build and own the go-to-market plan for Galaxy: target segments, buyer personas, sales motion, and the proof points that move a payer CXO from interested to signed.
Be the lead seller in strategic deals — you will personally pitch, negotiate, and help close alongside sales, not hand off a deck, do demos, and step back.
Partner with sales, marketing, and customer success to build and convert pipeline, and be direct with yourself and the team about what is working and what is not.
Team & Execution Leadership
Work seamlessly with GTM and commercial teams to execute at the pace the market demands
Set a high operating cadence: fast decisions, clear prioritization, and a bias toward shipping and closing over deliberating.
Partner with engineering, data science, and clinical and regulatory SMEs to make sure what gets built is what the market will actually buy.
Own the metrics that matter to the business — pipeline, bookings, retention, and product adoption — and build a rhythm of accountability around them.
Market & Customer Engagement
Be Galaxy's most visible external voice — with customers, at industry conferences, in analyst and KLAS conversations, and in the press.
Develop deep relationships with payer CXOs, VPs of Risk Adjustment, VPs of Quality and Stars, and Medical Directors of UM, understanding their world well enough to sell into it credibly.
Represent Innovaccer in competitive evaluations against point payer vendors and payer-owned solutions, and win the room.
Turn every customer conversation into product and GTM insight, and close the loop back into strategy fast.
What You Need
This role demands a rare combination of builder instincts, commercial range, and payer domain fluency.
8+ years of experience in product, strategy, or general management, with a demonstrated track record of launching new products or new businesses into market from an early stage, including the strategy, the go-to-market plan, and the first wave of customers.
Entrepreneurial, founder-operator mindset: you have owned P&L responsibility, you have taken products from idea to market, and you have a track record of consulting with payer clients on growth and market entry.
A demonstrated ability to sell: You can personally pitch, negotiate, and close with senior executives — you do not just build the product and hand it to someone else to sell.
Payer domain fluency: in risk adjustment, quality and Stars performance, utilization management, or value-based care economics — or the speed to get fluent fast.
Comfort owning a business outcome, not just a roadmap: pipeline, bookings, and market share, in addition to product quality and adoption.
A track record of building and leading high-performing, cross-functional teams: You hire well, develop talent, and build teams from a standing start.
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills: equally credible in a boardroom, an analyst briefing, or a working session with a health plan's VP of Risk Adjustment.
Comfort operating in ambiguity: You do not wait for a fully built playbook. You build the plan as you go and create clarity for the people around you.
Nice to have
Prior experience selling to health plan or payers.
Experience competing against or partnering with payer point vendors or payer-owned solutions.
Experience scaling a health-tech or payer-tech business from early revenue to a durable, referenceable market position.
Direct P&L ownership at a startup or business unit, including pricing and packaging decisions.
Familiarity with agentic AI or AI-native product architectures in healthcare.
Here’s What We Offer
Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.
Innovaccer Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered regardless of any characteristic protected by federal, state or local law including, without limitation, race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, medical condition, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status. Innovaccer Inc. participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility of all newly hired employees based out of the U.S. and employed by Innovaccer Inc.
For any additional information, please visit the below websites:
E-Verify
Right to Work (English)
Right to Work (Spanish)

jobs.title: Director, AI & Agentic Engineering
jobs.text:
About the job
Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and marketing?
With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Samsung, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!
Who We Are
Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.
We have 2000 employees across 36 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. What you will be doing
You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.
AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.
Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.
Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.

Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.
Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.

Strong expertise in generative AI/LLM engineering — context engineering, agent harnesses, RAG, and agentic coding — and in cloud-native software architecture, with proven production deployments.
Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on command of agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor), and modern full-stack frameworks (TypeScript/React front ends; Python/Node backends).
Experience designing cloud architectures: microservices, serverless, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Solid grasp of AI system design: agents, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and LLMOps.
Experience with data & context modeling and ingestion/processing pipelines on data lakes and data warehouses, including vector and graph storage strategies (embeddings, knowledge graphs).
Deep experience with Google Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI; basic working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and supporting pre-sales: proposals, demos, and solution scoping with clients.
Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and with stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with an interest in business-facing work.
Adaptability and a start-up mentality to thrive in a dynamic environment.

jobs.text:

Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and business?
With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Sanofi, Servier, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!
Who We Are
Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.
We have 2000 employees across 26 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. Our data-driven services are built upon the deep AI expertise we've acquired with our 1000+ client base around the globe.
Find out more at artefact.com.
Our Opportunity
We are seeking a Director or Senior Director to help lead and grow Artefact's Life Sciences practice in the United States. This is a senior commercial and delivery role for someone who loves the chase of a new client relationship as much as the craft of solving complex problems.
You bring a rare combination: functional expertise in the commercial life of a drug — whether that's sales, marketing, market access, launch strategy, or pricing — and the data and analytics fluency to bring rigorous, modern solutions to those problems. You know how life sciences companies think, how they buy, and what keeps their commercial leaders up at night.
Most importantly, you are a hustler in the best sense of the word. You build relationships proactively, you spot opportunities before they're fully formed, and you thrive when you have ownership over growing a book of business.
Among your responsibilities as Director, you will:
Business Development & Commercial Growth
Build and own a pipeline of Life Sciences clients — proactively hunting new logos and expanding relationships within existing accounts
Lead pursuits end-to-end: identify opportunities, develop proposals, shape the commercial narrative, and close engagements
Engage C-suite and VP-level stakeholders (CMO, CDO, Chief Commercial Officer, VP Market Access) as a trusted thought partner
Represent Artefact externally through industry events, speaking engagements, and written thought leadership
Collaborate with Artefact's global network to bring world-class capabilities — from GenAI to data engineering — into every client conversation
Client Delivery & Practice Leadership
Lead delivery of high-impact engagements in commercial analytics, data strategy, AI use-case development, and insights transformation
Serve as the senior client relationship owner — the person clients call with their hardest problems and most strategic questions
Pilot multidisciplinary teams of consultants, data scientists, and data engineers — setting direction, ensuring quality, and developing talent
Contribute to Artefact's Life Sciences practice-building: develop offerings, refine methodologies, author POVs and research
Communicate practice successes internally and externally, reinforcing Artefact's credibility in the market
What we are looking for
Life Sciences Domain Expertise
8–10+ years of experience in consulting, analytics, or industry roles with a Life Sciences focus
Deep familiarity with at least one or more commercial functional areas: Sales Force Effectiveness, Marketing Analytics, Market Access & Reimbursement, Launch Excellence, KAM, Patient Services, or Pricing & Contracting
Strong understanding of the pharma/biotech commercial lifecycle — from pre-launch through loss of exclusivity
Familiarity with the Life Sciences data ecosystem: IQVIA, Symphony Health, Komodo, claims data, Veeva CRM, EMR/EHR, and specialty data assets
Experience engaging commercial leaders (VP of Sales, VP of Marketing, Chief Commercial Officer) as a peer and advisor
Data & Analytics Fluency
Solid grasp of modern data platforms, analytics architecture, and AI/ML concepts — enough to scope work credibly and evaluate delivery quality
Experience overseeing delivery of data and analytics solutions: dashboards, predictive models, segmentation, forecasting, or NLP/GenAI applications
Familiarity with AI and ML use cases in Life Sciences: next best action (NBA), promotional response modeling, patient identification, real-world evidence (RWE), or HCP targeting
Comfortable engaging both C-suite business stakeholders and data science/engineering teams with equal credibility
Commercial Drive & Consulting Excellence
Proven track record of winning business — you've built client relationships from the ground up and can point to your impact
Entrepreneurial, high-energy mindset: you treat business development as a core part of your identity, not an obligation
Exceptional communication skills — you simplify complexity, write with clarity, and present with authority
Structured problem-solver: strong at framing ambiguous challenges, developing hypotheses, and distilling insight into executive-ready recommendations
Strong executive presence and the ability to build trust quickly with senior stakeholders
Why you should join us
Genuine entrepreneurial autonomy — shape your own client base and practice focus; no inherited territory with no upside
Rare platform — bring a global AI and data firm with 2,000+ experts to every US Life Sciences conversation
Fast-moving culture — real decisions made quickly, no bureaucracy, your contributions are visible from day one
Competitive compensation — $200,000 - $230,000 base salary + performance bonus tied to business development and delivery outcomes and equity opportunity
Clear path to Partner — for those who grow revenue and build the practice, the trajectory is real
We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise.

Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.

jobs.text:
Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Product Engineering, the Director, Content Engineering is responsible for leading the technology organization for GHX’s Content Engineering portfolio. The role requires leading geo distributed engineering organizations to deliver key solutions in Content space focusing on Content Workbench, Price Workbench and Contract Management services.
Role Responsibilities
Lead the strategic direction, planning and execution for Content Engineering leaders and teams to deliver business and customer focused roadmaps.
Bring deep domain expertise and hands on experience with Software Engineering, Data products, AI in SLDC and System architecture, preferably in Supply Chain Domain.
Strong Experience in cloud-based SaaS services, API & UI frameworks, and Microservice architectures.
Hands on experience with GenAI and Agentic Frameworks
Leading and mentoring geo distributed leaders and building high performance cross geo organizations.
Develops relationships at all levels of the organization as a trusted leader and strong communication skills.
Excel in all areas of strategy development, including project management, analysis, problem solving, verbal and written communication, consensus building, and people development.
Understand the financial impacts and manage budgetary decisions for technology solutions and forecast future technology practices needed within the area of expertise.
Skill Requirements
Experience in building and leading geo distributed teams to deliver critical roadmap items.
Experience leading and mentoring leaders and managers to build high performance organizations.
Deep domain experience in Data, SaaS and System Architecture space.
Deep experience in building mission critical SaaS/Cloud based service
Strong communication and collaboration skills, and experience working with cross functional partners and executives.
Experience with high availability architecture and design for mission critical applications.
Experience building CI/CD pipelines that do security scans, code quality scans, unit testing, and automated testing.
Role Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or a relevant area.
15+ years of Software Engineering experience in a SaaS environment.
7+ years' experience in an Engineering Leadership role
Experience managing large teams (40+ people) and scaling a business appropriately based on available resources.
Technical Strength in cloud architectures, application architecture, engineering processes and SDLC.
Experience with offshore development

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
Director of Product Management
Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)
Shape the Future of Privacy
Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.
We are looking for a Director of Product Management to own the strategy, outcomes, and people of one of our product pillars. This is a fully accountable leadership role: you'll set the direction for your team, develop product talent, and make sure the work your team ships connects clearly to company-wide goals. You'll combine hands-on team leadership with pillar-level strategy, working closely with peers across Product, Engineering, and the broader business.
How We Work: AI-Native by Default
Usercentrics is actively pushing AI adoption across Product for real efficiency gains. This isn't background context, it's a working expectation. As a Director, you're expected to actively drive AI-native ways of working within your team: using AI to speed up research synthesis, discovery, spec writing, and prototyping, and building the judgment in your PMs to use it well rather than uncritically. jobs.title: Senior Manager / Associate Director - Data Governance
jobs.text:
Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 100 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI. Our business value and leadership have been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.
We are looking for a Senior Manager / Associate Director to lead delivery workstreams within a large-scale enterprise Data Governance, Architecture & Controls Program.
Responsibilities:
Lead pods focused on data lineage documentation (consumption through ADS to system of origin), target-state ADS landscape and architecture design, and aggregation layer controls including DQ rules, variance analysis, and anomaly detection.
Shape the data modeling and architecture decisions that underpin the target-state ADS landscape, working with enterprise architecture to evolve domain and subdomain taxonomy.
Conduct SME interviews across engineering and business data offices, translate enterprise data management policy into actionable delivery and build plans, and manage a small team of analysts through design and implementation.
Operate as the bridge between engineering, enterprise architecture, and data office stakeholders, and present findings and recommendations directly to senior client leadership.
Define and standardize repeatable playbooks, templates, and execution frameworks for data lineage harvesting and Authoritative Data Source (ADS) onboarding to ensure consistency across multiple pods.
Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture and Tooling teams to evaluate, select, and drive the adoption of data governance and lineage platforms.
Establish, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics reflecting the progress of lineage coverage, ADS compliance, and data quality improvement to senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.text:
WHY JOIN OKLAHOMA CHILLER?
This is not just another IT leadership role. This is an opportunity to build the digital backbone of a rapidly growing organization.
Oklahoma Chiller is in a high-growth phase and looking for a Director of Information Technology to serve as a strategic partner to our Executive Leadership Team. This role is critical to scaling our operations, integrating acquisitions, and modernizing how our teams work across the organization. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution of our enterprise technology stack, from ERP and CRM to cybersecurity and data visibility.
This is a hands-on leadership role where you will shape systems, teams, and processes from the ground up. You will help drive operational excellence, standardize platforms across operating units, and ensure Oklahoma Chiller is positioned for long-term scalability and success.
If you are ready to lead digital transformation in a purpose-driven organization that values trust, loyalty, courage, humility, and excellence, this could be your next chapter.
ABOUT THIS ROLE
You will serve as the senior IT leader for Oklahoma Chiller, responsible for both strategic direction and day-to-day execution of our technology infrastructure. This is a builder’s role, ideal for someone who can create structure, drive adoption, and lead through growth and change.
You will oversee internal IT operations, manage key vendor relationships, and lead technology due diligence and post-merger integrations for add-on acquisitions. Your focus will be on standardizing systems, improving visibility across the business, and enabling leadership with real-time data and insights.
You will work closely with executive leadership, operating company leaders, and external partners to ensure technology is a growth enabler.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Define and execute a long-term IT strategy aligned with Oklahoma Chiller’s growth objectives
Lead digital transformation initiatives to replace manual and fragmented processes
Oversee and optimize core enterprise systems including ERP, CRM, project management, payroll, and communications platforms
Design, implement, and maintain a strong cybersecurity posture to protect company and client data
Build and maintain unified databases that consolidate financial and operational data across operating units
Develop executive dashboards with real-time KPIs and actionable insights
Create and execute a repeatable IT integration playbook for add-on acquisitions
Lead technology due diligence during acquisition processes to identify integration risks and opportunities
Migrate acquired businesses onto standardized platforms while retiring legacy systems
Identify and implement practical AI and automation use cases to improve efficiency and decision-making
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing internal IT team
Manage vendor relationships to ensure performance, security, and scalability
Represent Oklahoma Chiller’s mission, vision, and values in every internal and external interaction
YOU MIGHT BE OUR PERSON IF…
You think strategically
You enjoy building systems, teams, and scalable processes
You thrive in fast-growing, change-driven environments
You take ownership and bring clarity where there is complexity
You are energized by integrating businesses and creating order from chaos
You believe technology should serve people — not the other way around
You value culture and understand that leadership sets the tone
You want a seat at the table and the responsibility that comes with it
WHAT WILL PUT YOU AHEAD
Proven success in senior IT leadership roles, ideally within commercial or industrial services
Experience leading digital transformation across multiple divisions or operating units
Strong background implementing and standardizing ERP, CRM, project management, and payroll systems
Demonstrated success leading IT integration for multiple acquisitions
Ability to build executive dashboards pulling data from multiple entities
Strong cybersecurity knowledge and risk management experience
Experience implementing AI or automation solutions in a real-world business environment
Strong people leadership and team-building experience
Familiarity with cloud-based platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics, Sage Intacct, NetSuite, Accumatica, Salesforce, BuildOps, ServiceTitan, or ServiceTrade

jobs.title: Director, AI & Data Consulting
jobs.text:
Artefact is a next-generation data and AI consulting firm dedicated to accelerating the adoption of data and AI to create measurable business impact across the full enterprise value chain.
We sit at the intersection of consulting, data science, AI technologies, data engineering, and digital transformation. We do not just advise — we build, implement, and deliver results our clients can measure. Our teams bring together consultants, data scientists, data engineers, AI engineers, analysts, and digital experts to solve complex business challenges with pragmatic, production-ready solutions.
As we continue to grow in the US, we are building a team of entrepreneurial data and AI talent who can help clients move beyond experimentation and into scalable, governed, value-generating AI adoption.
The Role
Artefact is looking for a Director of AI & Data Consulting to help lead our US consulting practice. Our consultants are not spectators of the AI transformation they advise on — they are builders. A Director at Artefact wins engagements with C-level executives, leads multidisciplinary teams to deliver them, and is personally fluent in the AI tools reshaping our clients' businesses. When a client asks what an agentic workflow could look like, you don't just describe it — you can open Claude Code or Gemini CLI and have a working prototype in the room by the next meeting. We need someone who is not afraid of the terminal.
This is a role for a leader who combines consulting excellence, commercial drive, and genuine AI literacy — and who can grow both a client portfolio and the people around them.
What You'll Do
Serve as the primary contact and trusted advisor for client executives — CMO, CDO, CIO, and often CEO — on data and AI transformation.
Win engagements: develop the client portfolio, grow the US commercial pipeline, and build and present winning proposals.
Lead multidisciplinary teams of consultants, data scientists, AI engineers, and analysts, and orchestrate Artefact's global offices when needed.
Ensure delivery meets Artefact's quality bar: measurable impact, not just recommendations.
Shape AI and data strategies, operating models, roadmaps, and adoption programs that survive contact with reality.
Guide clients from GenAI pilots to production-grade, governed AI adoption — including agentic AI, AI-native ways of working, and organizational change.
Bring a firm command of the data, marketing, and technology ecosystem, and keep it current as the AI landscape moves.
Bring (or build) vertical expertise — e.g., CPG, retail, financial services, healthcare, telecom.
Use AI tools daily in your own work — analysis, writing, prototyping — and set the standard for what an AI-native consultant looks like.
Prototype with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex) to make ideas tangible in pitches and workshops.
Maintain real specialization in at least one AI platform ecosystem — Google (Gemini Enterprise), Anthropic (Claude), or OpenAI — deep enough to advise credibly on platform strategy.
Understand context engineering well enough to shape how clients connect AI to their data, documents, and systems.
Lead and develop the US consulting team: recruiting, mentoring, training, and best-practice sharing across countries.
Develop others' AI literacy: make every consultant on your teams a more capable builder.
Contribute to content and thought leadership: Artefact-published research, articles, business cases, events, and PR.
Communicate successes internally and externally to strengthen Artefact's US market position.
What We're Looking For
8–10 years of demonstrated success at a consulting, technology, or media firm (or in-house in a related capacity), with robust experience managing both projects and clients.
Proven ability to win work: a business development track record, preferably having built a book of business.
Experience advising senior executives (C-level) on data, digital, or AI transformation.
Demonstrated AI literacy as a builder: regular hands-on use of AI tools to produce real work — prototypes, analyses, automations — not only slideware.
Working fluency with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or Codex, and comfort in the terminal with AI guidance.
Specialization in at least one major AI platform ecosystem — Google (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI), Anthropic (Claude Enterprise), or OpenAI — sufficient to advise on platform selection and adoption.
Outstanding communication skills: executive presence, sharp storytelling, and the ability to make complex AI topics simple without making them wrong.
Experience leading and developing consulting teams.
Thought leadership at the intersection of data, marketing, and technology
Preferred Experience
Vertical expertise in CPG, retail, financial services, healthcare, or telecom.
Experience taking clients from AI experimentation to scaled, governed adoption.
Familiarity with context engineering concepts: RAG, semantic layers, knowledge bases, MCP.
An existing network and reputation in the US data & AI market.
Why you should join us
We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise.
There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.
Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything move at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.
How We Support Our People
In addition to our values-driven culture, we offer a range of benefits and programs designed to support our employees' growth and well-being, including:
Learning and Development: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of AI, data, and consulting experts who are committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional growth.
Hybrid Flexibility: Our hybrid work model gives you the flexibility to balance collaboration, client needs, and personal commitments.
Comprehensive Benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company matching, and paid parental leave.
Time to Recharge: We believe sustainable performance matters. That's why we offer unlimited paid time off, giving you the flexibility to take the time you need.
Growth Opportunities: As a rapidly growing organization, you'll have the opportunity to expand your skills, take on new challenges, and help shape the future of the company.
The estimated base compensation for this role is $200,000 - $230,000 (NYC location). Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, this role is eligible for competitive benefits.

jobs.title: Head of Machine Learning - Aquaeye
jobs.text:
AquaEye is a fast-growing company transforming the global water rescue industry by developing rapid-deployment, intelligent sonar solutions. Our flagship product, AquaEye, is a handheld sonar device with built-in AI detection to help first responders locate drowning victims faster and more effectively. As we continue to expand our global reach and develop new product lines, we are seeking a driven, hands-on Head of Machine Learning to own and advance innovation in our product’s algorithms.
This role is central to AquaEye’s core technology and strategic vision. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading ML strategy, overseeing end-to-end development, and solving some of our most challenging embedded ML problems.
Job Responsibilities
ML Strategy and Technical Direction
Define and execute our machine learning strategy aligned with evolving product and business objectives.
Lead the design and evolution of signal processing and machine learning architectures for production systems.
Establish technical standards, best practices, and development processes for ML systems.
Evaluate emerging machine learning technologies and identify opportunities to enhance product capabilities and competitive advantage.
Provide technical leadership on architecture decisions, model selection, and system performance optimization.
Machine Learning Platform & Model Development
Oversee the development, validation, deployment, and lifecycle management of machine learning models.
Oversee the design, optimization, and scalability of our signal processing pipelines.
Define model performance metrics and continuously drive improvements through rigorous evaluation and experimentation.
Ensure robustness, maintainability, and scalability of production ML infrastructure, data pipelines, and supporting databases.
Oversee ML Ops practices, including model versioning, reproducibility, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Data Strategy & Dataset Governance
Establish standards for dataset acquisition, quality, governance, and lifecycle management.
Lead planning and execution of field data collection initiatives to ensure datasets meet product development and validation objectives.
Continually innovate on existing methodologies for data labeling, preprocessing, quality assurance, and representativeness across operational scenarios.
Oversee continuous expansion and refinement of training datasets to improve model accuracy and generalization.
Product Innovation & Cross-Functional Leadership
Work alongside Product Management, Engineering, and executive leadership to define the AI roadmap and prioritize development initiatives.
Translate customer needs and operational challenges into innovative machine learning solutions and product capabilities.
Provide technical leadership during customer demonstrations, field trials, and critical deployments.
Serve as the organization's subject matter expert for machine learning technologies, advising stakeholders on technical direction and product strategy.
Team Leadership & Organizational Development
Provide leadership and mentorship to develop a high performing machine learning team within the product development group.
Establish project priorities, resource allocation, and development plans to ensure successful delivery of strategic objectives.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive project execution through effective planning, risk management, and use of project management tools such as Jira.
Build organizational capability by defining engineering processes, conducting technical reviews, and promoting knowledge sharing across teams.
