jobs.title: Director of Operations - Data Centers
jobs.text:
About the Opportunity
Albireo Energy is investing aggressively in its Mission Critical business, with data centers representing one of the company’s largest and fastest-growing areas of opportunity. We are seeking a Director of Operations to help lead and scale this business during an exciting period of growth.
This is a high-impact leadership role for an experienced operations executive who understands the demands of mission critical environments and can translate that expertise into exceptional execution, talent development, operational discipline, and sustainable growth.
The Director of Operations will lead a geographically dispersed organization, build and develop high-performing teams, and establish the operational infrastructure needed to scale the business without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. This leader will have significant opportunity to shape the organization, build leadership capacity, strengthen technical delivery, and influence how Albireo Energy serves data center owners, operators, and partners.
Why This Role Matters
Data center investment is accelerating rapidly, creating significant opportunities for Albireo Energy and its Mission Critical division. The Director of Operations will play a critical role in helping the organization capitalize on this growth while maintaining the safety, quality, financial performance, and execution discipline expected in mission critical environments.
This role offers the opportunity to:
Help lead one of Albireo Energy’s fastest-growing businesses as investment in data centers and mission critical infrastructure continues to accelerate.
Build an organization from the ground up, hiring and developing leaders and technical delivery teams that will support the company’s growth.
Make a lasting organizational impact by establishing scalable operating practices, developing talent, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Engage with the broader mission critical community, including data center owners and operators, industry providers, seminars, conferences, and networking groups.
Work directly with senior stakeholders and executives, representing Albireo Energy with credibility, confidence, and strong executive presence.
Shape the future of Albireo Energy’s Mission Critical business at a time of significant investment and expansion.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership & Talent Development
Lead a geographically dispersed team across a rapidly growing business.
Recruit, hire, onboard, and develop the talent required to support continued growth.
Build a strong leadership bench and actively develop future leaders within the organization.
Establish clear expectations, accountability, and performance standards while maintaining an engaging and collaborative culture.
Effectively manage people, organizational dynamics, and conflict with maturity and sound judgment.
Create an environment where high performers can grow their capabilities and assume increasing leadership responsibility.
Operational Excellence & Scale
Develop and implement scalable operating processes that support rapid growth while preserving flexibility and entrepreneurial speed.
Establish consistent execution standards without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
Drive operational discipline across projects, teams, and geographies.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve productivity, quality, customer experience, and profitability.
Develop effective resource-planning practices to ensure the right people, skills, and capacity are aligned with business demand.
Navigate ambiguity and changing priorities while maintaining focus on business objectives and execution.
Mission Critical & Technical Leadership
Bring deep industry knowledge and technical credibility to the organization, with data center and mission critical experience strongly preferred.
Leverage firsthand experience executing data center or other mission critical projects and operating within demanding mission critical environments.
Understand the unique requirements of data center customers, including uptime, safety, schedule, quality, reliability, and operational risk.
Provide leadership and technical perspective to project and delivery teams.
Build strong relationships with owners, operators, providers, and other industry stakeholders.
Financial & Business Management
Manage the financial performance of a project-based business, including forecasting, resource utilization, margins, and overall operational performance.
Partner with project and business leaders to ensure disciplined financial management and execution.
Balance growth objectives with profitability, capacity, quality, and customer commitments.
Develop the operational infrastructure and management practices necessary to scale the business sustainably.
Safety & Execution
Champion a strong safety culture and ensure safety remains a fundamental component of every aspect of operations.
Maintain a calm, thoughtful, and decisive leadership presence, particularly in high-pressure situations.
Establish a culture of ownership, urgency, accountability, and follow-through.
Ensure teams consistently deliver against commitments while maintaining the high standards required in mission critical environments.
Executive & External Leadership
Demonstrate strong executive presence in internal and external meetings, communicating effectively with senior leaders, customers, partners, and industry stakeholders.
Represent Albireo Energy professionally at industry seminars, conferences, networking events, and customer engagements.
Build trusted relationships with senior customer and industry leaders.
Communicate complex operational and technical issues clearly and confidently to both technical and executive audiences.

jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.text:
Linah Group is seeking a Head of Technology to define and drive the company's technology strategy, lead digital transformation across all business sectors under the Group while enabling each business unit to innovate within its own market and manage a cross-functional IT organization spanning helpdesk support, software development, and enterprise systems (ERP).
This role will oversee Linah Group portfolio spanning Head office, agriculture sector, manufacturing sector, retail, and hospitality (the 5-star Sultan Gardens Resort in Sharm El Sheikh) and other subsidiaries.
Group-Wide Technology Leadership
Define and drive the overarching technology strategy and roadmap for Linah Group, ensuring alignment with business objectives across all sectors
Provide technology leadership and governance across Manufacturing, Head Office, Agriculture, and Hospitality, ensuring consistency in standards, security, and infrastructure while respecting each sector's specific needs
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing technology organization, including sector-level technology leads for each business unit
Oversee IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, data governance, and enterprise systems across all four sectors
Manage the Group-wide technology budget, ensuring optimal allocation of resources and timely reinvestment in upgrades across sectors
Establish technology policies, standards, and best practices to ensure consistency, security, and scalability across the Group
Act as a key advisor to the executive leadership team and Board on technology strategy, risk, and investment decisions
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all technology functions within the Group
Manufacturing
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of production systems, ERP, and plant automation
Identify and implement technologies that improve manufacturing efficiency, quality, and safety
Head Office
Oversee core corporate IT systems, networks, and enterprise software supporting all business functions
Ensure Head Office systems remain current, secure, and integrated with sector-level platforms
Agriculture
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of farming operations, including smart farming and agri-tech solutions
Evaluate and implement emerging agri-technology (IoT sensors, precision farming, automation) to improve yield and efficiency
Hospitality (5-Star Hotel)
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of guest-facing and back-of-house systems, including property management systems and service platforms
Drive technology initiatives that enhance guest experience and operational efficiency in line with 5-star service standards

jobs.title: Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering
jobs.text:
About Eridan
At Eridan we believe in the power of collaboration and communication to achieve our mission: connect the planet to empower a sustainable, shared future. That mission is possible with our patented transmitter which decreases the cost and power required to roll out 5G by 10x when deployed globally. This is all facilitated through our offices: our Sunnyvale headquarters has big windows (even in the lab!), is walking distance to downtown and the Caltrain, and fits the entire team in the cafeteria for our frequent company parties. Learn more about our mission here.
Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering
About this Job
The Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering is a senior technical leadership role that owns the systems engineering function across Eridan’s radio product lines. The role sits at the intersection of systems architecture, hardware integration, and cross-functional execution, and is responsible for ensuring that engineering outputs hold together as coherent, specification-compliant systems — not just collections of subsystems.
This role serves as the internal owner of system-level specifications and integration integrity. Requirements arrive from Solutions Engineering and Deployments; this role translates them into rigorous engineering deliverables and drives alignment across hardware, firmware, and software. The Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering is the person who is accountable when a system does — or does not — perform as intended.
The role will initially focus on Eridan’s compact and high power radio unit product lines, with scope expected to expand as additional platforms come online. Leading an RF hardware systems engineering team is a core part of the mandate from the outset.
As a Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering, You Will
Systems Engineering Ownership
Own end-to-end systems hardware engineering across active radio product lines: requirements definition, architecture, integration, and verification
Maintain and enforce system-level specifications, ensuring fidelity from requirements intake through product qualification
Drive resolution of cross-subsystem technical issues and represent systems integrity in design reviews and milestone gate decisions
Establish systems engineering processes and documentation standards appropriate for a scaling hardware startup
Oversee board-level integration and PCB development, ensuring robust RF/high-speed layout practices and design-for-manufacturability standards
Requirements Intake and Specification Ownership
Serve as the primary engineering interface for requirements arriving from Solutions Engineering and Deployments — translating operational needs into precise, actionable system specifications
Ensure that engineering priorities and trade-off decisions are grounded in validated requirements
Partner with the VP of Engineering as well as Product and Operations leadership to align specification work with program milestones and planning commitments
Team Building and Leadership
Manage and develop a team of hardware engineers aligned to active product lines
Structure the team for growth as additional product lines come online, in partnership with the VP of Engineering
Mentor developing engineers and help build the systems engineering discipline across the organization
Cross-Functional Execution
Work closely with hardware, software, and test engineering teams to align integration milestones and system-level validation plans
Coordinate with Test and Operations on qualification activities and readiness criteria
Contribute to engineering program planning and resource discussions with cross-functional leadership
Qualities of a Successful Candidate
8+ years of experience in RF hardware systems engineering or a closely related technical discipline, with at least 3 years in a people management role
B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field
Deep expertise in RF, wireless, or telecommunications hardware systems — experience at the radio unit, subsystem, or component level in any generation (4G, 5G, satellite, defense RF, or similar)
Demonstrated ability to own system-level specifications and drive integration in complex hardware/software co-development environments
Proven track record of translating operational or customer requirements into rigorous engineering deliverables
Strong communication and influencing skills across technical and cross-functional audiences
Experience transitioning technology from R&D to high volume production
Nice to Have
Experience with 5G radio hardware (O-RAN, small cell, macro radio)
Familiarity with all levels of radio unit design, including power distribution, digital motherboards, RF circuitry, mechanical design, and manufacturing considerations
Experience scaling a systems engineering function at a startup or growth-stage hardware company
Perks of working at Eridan
Work on new technology that will make a significant impact on global infrastructure
Ability to learn, develop, and advance within a flexible environment
Collaborate with smart, passionate, and helpful co-workers
Celebrate progress company-wide
Pre-IPO equity
401K with automatic match
Health, Vision and Dental insurance
Salary Range
Given our anticipated growth, we are open to hiring individuals with varying levels of experience to fill this role. Salary will be commensurate with job-related skills, experience and other relevant factors. The base salary range for the primary location of this role is between $180,000 and $210,000 plus stock options and benefits.
Eridan is an equal opportunity employer. We value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.text:
The CVO Tribe
CVO owns two of HelloFresh's largest economic levers: benefit optimization and pricing. The tribe uses machine learning, personalization, and lifetime-value prediction to replace manual, rules-based decisioning with data-driven systems.
The engineering org is globally distributed across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, and includes Frontend, Backend, Data, and ML Engineering, working closely with embedded Data Scientists. The work spans a genuinely mixed engineering profile: ML-heavy systems for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, alongside backend and distributed-systems work powering pricing infrastructure and subscription products at scale.
As Senior Director, based in Berlin, you'll lead this full spectrum, setting technical strategy across ML, backend, and data disciplines and across time zones, without relying on daily co-location.
What you'll do
Lead an organization of 25-30 engineers, data scientists, and ML practitioners across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, through a layer of Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers reporting into you.
Own ML strategy for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, as well as backend and distributed-systems strategy for pricing and subscription infrastructure.
Drive the transformation of ways of working toward fully GenAI-native, cross-functional product teams, building on teams that already ship the majority of their code with AI assistance.
Own reliability and operational excellence across both ML and backend systems: observability from model output through to customer-facing delivery, SLOs/SLIs, incident management, and MLOps practices such as retraining, rollback, and experiment tracking.
Partner with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, and adjacent engineering teams to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.
Manage and develop Engineering Managers and Data Science Leads across disciplines and geographies, holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.
What you'll bring
Range across ML and backend engineering. You don't need to be hands-on expert in both, but you need credibility in each: enough ML depth to set direction on production ML systems and partner effectively with Data Science, enough distributed-systems depth to be a trusted partner on pricing infrastructure and subscription products.
Proven leadership of globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones, without daily co-location. Comfortable with regular travel and bridging US and European hours.
Deep ML engineering expertise, including feature engineering, training/serving infrastructure, experimentation, and MLOps. Causal inference or uplift modeling experience is a plus.
Distributed systems and backend depth, including scaling backend services and data pipelines in revenue-sensitive, high-throughput environments. Subscription or billing experience is a plus.
AI-native leadership, with a track record of building or scaling AI-native engineering practices, not just adopting AI tools.
Commercial and pricing domain fluency, or strong aptitude to build it quickly, including benefit optimization, lifetime-value forecasting, and pricing elasticity.
Proven leadership at scale: 12+ years in software/ML engineering, with 5+ years managing Engineering Managers across more than one technical discipline and geography.
Operational excellence mindset, with strong grounding in SRE and MLOps practices for systems with direct financial impact.
Strong cross-functional communication, translating ML, data, and backend concepts into business terms and vice versa.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.
What we offer
Global collaboration across HelloTech's hubs in Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto.
High-leverage, technically diverse work spanning ML, backend, data, and product engineering, with a direct line to business outcomes.
A genuinely AI-native environment with a mandate to scale that approach further.
Technical and engineering leadership in an autonomous, product-led setup, with end-to-end ownership from problem definition to production.
Enjoy a discount on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.
Build for the long-term with our company pension scheme (not available for interns/working students).
Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.
Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.
Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).
Get a monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket to support sustainable commuting.
Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&D budget (remove for interns).
Work from a modern, comfortable office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and enjoy social events like team outings, Friday beers, and company runs.
Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences, so even if you don't tick every box but think you'd thrive in this role, we'd really like to hear from you.

Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.
Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.
Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).
Get a monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket to support sustainable commuting.
Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&D budget (remove for interns).
Work from a modern, comfortable office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and enjoy social events like team outings, Friday beers, and company runs.

blocks.text: Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences, so even if you don't tick every box but think you'd thrive in this role, we'd really like to hear from you.

requirements: Range across ML and backend engineering. You don't need to be hands-on expert in both, but you need credibility in each: enough ML depth to set direction on production ML systems and partner effectively with Data Science, enough distributed-systems depth to be a trusted partner on pricing infrastructure and subscription products.
Proven leadership of globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones, without daily co-location. Comfortable with regular travel and bridging US and European hours.
Deep ML engineering expertise, including feature engineering, training/serving infrastructure, experimentation, and MLOps. Causal inference or uplift modeling experience is a plus.
Distributed systems and backend depth, including scaling backend services and data pipelines in revenue-sensitive, high-throughput environments. Subscription or billing experience is a plus.
AI-native leadership, with a track record of building or scaling AI-native engineering practices, not just adopting AI tools.
Commercial and pricing domain fluency, or strong aptitude to build it quickly, including benefit optimization, lifetime-value forecasting, and pricing elasticity.
Proven leadership at scale: 12+ years in software/ML engineering, with 5+ years managing Engineering Managers across more than one technical discipline and geography.
Operational excellence mindset, with strong grounding in SRE and MLOps practices for systems with direct financial impact.
Strong cross-functional communication, translating ML, data, and backend concepts into business terms and vice versa.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.

jobs.title: Director UX, Growth
jobs.text:
Director of UX, Growth
Location: Toronto or New York
Team: UX, Growth Mega-Alliance
Level: Director (people leadership). For the right person there's a clear path to Senior Director as the alliance scales.
Reports to: Global VP of UX
About HelloFresh
Our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. We're the world's leading meal-kit provider and a global digital-native FMCG company, reaching more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of brands, from HelloFresh and Factor to Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, YouFoodz, Good Chop, and The Pets Table. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.
About the role
We're looking for a Director of UX to lead the Growth experience end to end, across the brands in our portfolio, with HelloFresh and Factor the biggest. This is the team that owns how people discover our brands, sign up, get to their first great box, and keep coming back. Most funnels are something people endure. We want ours to be something they remember. Your job is to turn each step into a moment worth having, so the journey feels effortless, true to each brand, and sticky enough that people want to stay, and to grow the business while you do it.
You'll report directly to the Global VP of UX and lead a team of 6 UX designers and collaborate closely with content design and research strategy. You set the quality bar for the alliance and work shoulder to shoulder with Growth product, marketing, lifecycle/CRM, and engineering across web and app, and across 16 markets. You care about the numbers and the experience, and you know the best growth work improves both at once.
This is a hands-on leadership role, and a build-and-scale one rather than a maintenance one. You are exceptional at craft and stay close enough to the work to lead with credibility. You're also a visionary: you bring our brands to life and express them clearly across every touchpoint, and you have a strong feel for content and how words shape an experience. You're happy in ambiguity, and you'd rather write the playbook than follow one.
What you'll own
A funnel worth remembering. You lead the experience across the full customer journey: acquisition and activation, conversion, retention, and reactivation of lapsed customers. You do more than reduce drop-off and smooth out onboarding. You make each step sticky and memorable, so people feel something at sign-up, come back because they want to, and tell a friend. You give lapsed customers a real reason to return.
Experimentation and evidence. You run a team that tests its way to the answer. You treat behavioral data as a primary design input, not just something to validate a decision after the fact. You set clear hypotheses, design experiments and A/B tests with statistical rigor alongside data science, read the results honestly, and balance quick wins with the changes that compound over time.
Strategy before screens. You decide which problems are worth solving and why, and you tie design choices to the business outcomes this role is measured on, like conversion, activation rate, and retention [confirm the exact KPIs for this role]. You set direction before design work begins.
Craft and quality. You define what excellent looks like for Growth and hold the bar. You set a high standard for craft yourself and raise it in others, and you build and evolve the systems and patterns that let the team ship consistent, high-quality work at speed across web and app.
Brand expression. You bring our portfolio of brands to life, from HelloFresh and Factor to the rest, and give each a clear, distinct voice and look in the experience. You know how to hold what makes a brand itself while keeping the funnel coherent across all of them. You have a strong understanding of content and how design and words work together to express who each brand is.
Make us AI-native. You lead a team that treats AI as an active part of how the work gets done, from insight synthesis to rapid prototyping to the path from design to code. You define the quality bar AI-assisted work has to meet, and you help rewrite how growth experiences get built in the AI era. You are a driving force in this transformation, not a passenger, and you help your team see the shift as opportunity rather than threat.
A team of generalists. You lead a team of UX Designers with a generalist profile that move across design, content, research and code. You attract, develop, and retain strong talent, coach through feedback and influence rather than authority, and build a place where people do the best work of their careers.
What you bring
10+ years in product design, including experience leading and growing teams in a consumer (B2C) or product-led environment with a track record of moving metrics like activation, conversion, retention, and reactivation.
Exceptional craft. You are a top-tier designer who sets and holds a high bar, and you stay hands-on enough to lead with credibility and a visionary eye for the brand. You can bring distinct brands to life and express them clearly and consistently across an experience.
High agency. You push for the right solution over the convenient one and make things happen without waiting for permission.
AI-native practice. You already use AI across the design workflow, for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design to code, and you have a clear point of view on scaling it responsibly at a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma and Claude is expected, and you can show your team what excellent AI-assisted work looks like.
Strong data fluency. You read behavioral data and experiment results well, know what they are and aren't telling you, and use them to sharpen design, not just defend it. You're comfortable partnering with data science on experimentation quality.
Command of experimentation: hypothesis design, A/B testing, and funnel analysis as a connected system rather than isolated moments.
A partnership mindset with Growth product, marketing, lifecycle/CRM, and engineering. You navigate constraints with engineers and shape research and synthesis with researchers.
People leadership experience: building teams, coaching designers, and setting a quality bar others rally around.
Nice to have
Experience shaping cross-channel communication strategy across app, email, push, and web, so the message a customer gets is consistent and well-timed wherever they meet us.
Experience with pricing, packaging, or monetization design.
A track record building 0-to-1 growth systems, or fixing broken acquisition and retention loops.
What success looks like
Your team consistently ships high-quality growth work at speed, and the metrics move.
You've hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and judgment.
Experience quality across the funnel is visibly higher, and customers feel it.
Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.
AI-native ways of working in your domain make the whole team faster without giving up craft.
Each brand feels distinctly itself in the experience, while the funnel stays coherent across all of them.
What we offer
Scale and impact. Shape experiences for millions of customers across our brands and 16 markets.
A craft-and-AI-first culture, championed from the top of the organization.
Real ownership of your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.
A defined leadership track and the chance to grow your scope as the alliance scales.
Global collaboration with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing
Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.
Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.
Access wellness resources including fitness discounts and mental health support.
Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings.
Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.
Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.
How we work
We're moving UX to work AI-native, and we expect our leaders to help drive that shift. You'll report directly to the Global VP of UX and partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders in the region.
Equal opportunity
We believe that sharing a meal brings people of all identities, backgrounds, and cultures together, and we're committed to celebrating every dimension of diversity in the workplace. We're an equal-opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. We provide reasonable accommodations to candidates at any stage of the process. If you need one, please let us know.
Please note that for this position employees are eligible to equity on top of the base pay.
Toronto, ON Pay Range
$143,850—$153,850 CAD

jobs.title: Director, Field Engineering (CPG & Retail)
jobs.text:
REQ ID: FEQ427R375
Mission:
As the Director of Field Engineering, you will be responsible for partnering with our enterprise Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) and Retail customers to democratize Data and AI within their organizations, leveraging Databricks solutions and expertise to address their most critical business challenges.
Reporting to the Tech GM of Field Engineering for Retail & Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), the Director, Field Engineering will lead a team of pre-sales Managers and Solutions Architects focused on acquiring new customers and expanding strategic relationships across the Retail and CPG industry. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders to drive strategy and execution against our ambitious growth goals.
You will foster a culture of psychological safety while developing and scaling a high-performing team with expertise in enterprise software, data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, and cloud technologies. Your experience partnering with Sales will help drive complex enterprise opportunities while coaching managers and field engineering teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. You will guide your team through strategic engagements, communicate complex technical solutions in terms of business value, support enterprise sales cycles, and build trusted relationships with senior business and technology leaders across the Retail and CPG industry.
The impact you will have:
Hire and manage first-line Managers and a growing team of technical pre-sales
Solutions Architects.
Build a collaborative culture within a rapid-growth team. Embody and promote
Databricks' customer-obsessed, truth-seeking, diverse culture, and first principles
mindset.
Develop trusted, long-term executive relationships with customers while maintaining a
deep understanding of the Retail and CPG industry, including key business trends,
competitive dynamics, and digital transformation priorities.
Help customers accelerate their Data and AI strategies across areas such as customer
experience, merchandising, supply chain, demand forecasting, marketing, and
operations.
Promote a solution- and value-based Field Engineering organization.
Display an understanding of customer business priorities and revenue opportunities
across the assigned region and industry.
Serve as a thought leader for Databricks and within the Retail, CPG, Data, and AI
ecosystem.
What we look for:
At least 3 years of second-line leadership experience managing teams of 30+
individuals, with 10+ years of overall leadership experience.
Proven success leading high-growth enterprise software pre-sales organizations
within Retail, CPG, cloud, data, analytics, or AI.
Experience partnering with Retail and/or CPG customers on large-scale data,
analytics, AI, or digital transformation initiatives.
Ability to elevate executive engagement, with a track record of driving large strategic
transactions and expanding high-growth enterprise accounts.
Proven leadership ability to influence, develop, and empower teams to achieve
ambitious business objectives through collaboration.
Drive operational rigor to manage a high-growth business, establishing the right
operating cadence while ensuring visibility into customer priorities, escalations, and
product feedback.
Proven track record of delivering transformational customer outcomes and
measurable business value.
Track record of building strong customer relationships and cross-functional
partnerships across Sales, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Experience positioning technical solutions within complex enterprise environments
and helping customers realize long-term value and platform adoption with Databricks.
Strong operational leadership with experience implementing scalable processes that
improve the effectiveness and productivity of technical field organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or
equivalent practical experience.
About Databricks
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
Benefits
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
Compliance
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

jobs.title: Director Engineering
jobs.text:
About the role
Chime is looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our AI & App Experience (AAX) organization — the team building the next generation of the Chime member experience. AAX owns Jade, Chime’s AI-powered financial assistant, our AI platform infrastructure as well as the core app experiences and shared design system.
In this role, you’ll own the multi-quarter strategy for AAX engineering, translating company priorities into scalable plans across these teams. You’ll build and lead a bench of TLM (tech leader managers) and senior technical staff, set the technical bar for how Chime builds AI-native, member-facing products, and partner with Product, Design, Data Science, and our Risk team to shape where AAX invests next.
This is a role for a leader who is equally comfortable setting long-range technical vision and staying close enough to the details to guide hard architectural calls — someone who has helped build or scale AI/LLM-powered consumer products and knows how to grow the engineering leaders around them.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $269,000.00 and up to $373,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
In partnership with our product team you will own the multi-quarter strategy for AAX engineering, translating company and product priorities into our roadmap plans across consumer facing AI experiences, AI Platform, App Journey, and Design Systems.
Build, lead, and hire a high-caliber leadership bench of highly technical leaders/IC’s as well as building a team culture that exemplifies a builder mindset.
Partners with your team to set technical direction for the org, driving architectural alignment across our consumer facing AI experiences, AI Platform, App Journey, and Design System.
You will continue to drive our AI-native engineering culture: setting the bar for how LLM-powered features get shipped safely at scale.
Own engineering’s strategic role in product direction, partnering with Product, Design, Data Science, and Risk leadership to shape roadmaps, challenge assumptions, and integrate platform and member value into long-range plans
Represent AAX and engineering more broadly in cross-functional and executive forums, connecting the org’s work to company-wide strategy and outcomes
Cultivate a high-performing culture across the org, modeling Chime’s values and ensuring strong talent, performance, and career development practices on every team
Ensure the org maintains strong operational practices — on-call, monitoring, and incident response — for every service/experience the team owns
Contribute to overall engineering initiatives as a member of Chime’s engineering leadership team
To thrive in this role, you have
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing managers or leading multi-team engineering organizations
A track record of building and scaling AI/LLM-powered consumer products, with the technical depth to guide future investments and technical direction.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, (Applied AI)  Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.text:
About Scale AI
Scale’s mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world’s most important decisions. We work with leading enterprises to bring generative AI safely into production—powering real-world impact through rigorous evaluation, deployment, and execution.
The Role
The Sr. Director, Forward Deployed Engineering (US East) will lead Scale’s enterprise customer engagements across the Eastern United States. This role sits at the intersection of customer leadership, applied AI, and execution—owning how Scale partners with Fortune 500 executives to design, build, and deploy AI-powered systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. As a regional leader and peer to Scale’s existing Forward Deployed leadership, you will manage and grow multidisciplinary teams of applied scientists and full-stack engineers, shape how we deliver agentic AI applications in customer environments, and set the bar for executive-level customer engagement. This is a high-impact leadership role in a period of regional expansion and organizational evolution.
You will:
Lead all US East enterprise customer engagements, serving as the senior technical and delivery executive for Scale’s most strategic accounts.
Partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering leadership to support customer acquisition, expansion, and long-term success.
Build and manage forward-deployed teams composed of applied scientists and full-stack software engineers, structured into customer-specific technical pods.
Own end-to-end delivery execution for customer deployments, ensuring reliability, rigor, and measurable business impact.
Guide teams in building production-grade, agentic AI applications for Fortune 500 enterprises.
Establish and enforce an evals-first approach to customer deployments, ensuring performance, safety, and reliability standards are met.
Lead senior-level technical conversations with customer executives, demonstrating Scale’s credibility as a trusted AI partner.
Support technical upsell conversations by articulating architectural tradeoffs, capabilities, and future-state possibilities (with commercial ownership held by AEs).
Hire, develop, and mentor forward-deployed leaders and ICs, including training teams on executive-level customer interaction and professional standards.
Help shape Scale’s regional forward-deployed strategy as part of a broader global and US restructuring.
Ideally you’d have:
12+ years of experience in software engineering, applied ML, or AI systems, with significant leadership responsibility.
Proven experience leading customer-facing technical teams delivering complex systems for large enterprise customers.
Executive presence and credibility with senior Fortune 500 stakeholders, including experience navigating high-stakes technical discussions.
Strong technical foundation in either applied machine learning or full-stack / distributed systems engineering (strength in one, fluency in the other).
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous customer needs into concrete technical solutions and delivery plans.
Experience partnering with sales and product teams in pre-sales, expansion, and delivery contexts.
A track record of building, scaling, and managing high-performing multidisciplinary teams.
Nice to have:
Experience deploying generative AI or agentic systems in production enterprise environments.
Background in consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or professional services for technical products.
Experience building evaluation frameworks for ML or AI system performance.
Prior responsibility for regional or multi-account technical leadership.
Leveling Note
This role is flexibly leveled (Director to Sr. Director) based on candidate experience, scope, and demonstrated leadership impact.
Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend.
Please reference the job posting's subtitle for where this position will be located. For pay transparency purposes, the base salary range for this full-time position in the locations of San Francisco, New York, Seattle is:
$285,200—$356,500 USD
PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.
About Us:
At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.
We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status.
We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's Know Your Rights poster for additional information.
We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.
PLEASE NOTE: We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our privacy policy for additional information.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
About 1Kosmos
1Kosmos is the leader in identity verification, providing a unified platform that combines identity verification and passwordless authentication into a single distributed identity cloud service. With 75M+ users, billions of verifications and authentications, and 3x growth, we're transforming how organizations verify and authenticate workers, customers, and citizens. We're FedRAMP High Authorized—the only FedRAMP High authorized, Kantara-certified Full Service NIST 800-63-3 digital identity wallet solution—and certified to the highest industry standards including FIDO2, ISO 27001, and SOC II Type 2. Recognized by Gartner as ranking highest for Workforce Use Cases in the 2025 Critical Capabilities for Identity Verification report, 1Kosmos is trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, government, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, and retail. As a Series B company experiencing rapid growth, we're now building critical fraud detection capabilities to protect our customers and their users from evolving identity threats.
The Opportunity
At 1Kosmos, our leaders are active, builder-first contributors. We are looking for an engineering leader who stays close to the code—someone who enjoys diving into technical challenges, understanding system internals, and driving execution from the front lines through active participation in architectural design, code reviews, and hands-on problem-solving.
You possess an "always sleeveless" mindset: no task is too technical, no bug is too small, and no architecture is too complex for you to dive into. You will step into a cloud-agnostic microservices environment, gain deep context on what we’ve built, and actively drive execution, performance, security, and system evolution.
What You’ll Do:
- Lead from the Front: Manage, mentor, and elevate a mid-sized engineering team while remaining deeply technical and hands-on in code, system design, and infrastructure.
- Master Existing Architecture First: Take full ownership of existing architectures. Deeply understand the whybehind our current design decisions before making tactical shifts or introducing new paradigms.
- Build Real Agentic Systems: Work hands-on with our agentic stack (AWS Bedrock / Python / Node), going far beyond basic LLM prompts or chatbots. Open the hood to optimize agent workflows, orchestration, reliability, and security.
- Drive Performance & Security: Maintain a relentless focus on low latency, high throughput, platform resilience, and enterprise security across our cloud-agnostic microservices topology.
- Own Delivery & Reliability: Partner with product and QA leads to ensure clean, reliable, and zero-downtime deployments.
- Foster a Zero-Ego Culture: Build a collaborative environment where ownership is non-negotiable, and execution speaks louder than slides.

jobs.title: Head of Product, Core Banking Systems
jobs.text:
About the opportunity
N26 is looking for a Head of Product - Core Banking Systems to partner with our Engineering, Treasury, Risk, and Banking Operations teams. In this role, you will own the Core Banking Systems product roadmap and lead a team of product & business managers delivering foundational capabilities that power N26 — from rapid product configuration to balance sheet infrastructure and regulatory reporting.
You will work at the intersection of Core Banking architecture, financial data integrity, and compliance on one side, and real-world banking and product challenges on the other. Your mission is to transform Core Banking Systems from a cost center into a composable platform that enables product managers to configure and launch products in days, embeds compliance by design, and lays the foundation for growth beyond N26. You will be the connective tissue between technical platform excellence and business outcomes, ensuring that our core engine powers flawless banking across N26 and eventually external financial institutions.
In this role, you will:
Own and drive the Core Systems product roadmap across Product Enablement (lending, deposits, payments gateway) and Balance Sheet Infrastructure (financial data products, treasury, books & accounting), balancing near-term execution with long-term strategic horizons.
Partner closely with N26 Product Segments and functional stakeholders across Treasury, Credit Risk, Risk Controlling, Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting on priorities, planning cycles, and shared OKRs.
Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for Core Banking initiatives — from self-service product enablement and third-party vendor in-housing through migration, platform scalability, and iteration.
Define and roll out core platform best practices across the organization — including product configuration standards (Product Factory), ledger data integrity, evaluation frameworks, and progressive rollout guardrails.
Contribute to N26's company-wide strategy to establish single sources of truth for financial data, eliminate core vendor dependencies, and reduce risk concentration across endpoints.
Support domain optimization by transitioning stable, non-core services to appropriate segment owners while maintaining operational excellence and zero material audit findings.
Manage and develop a team of Core Systems Product Managers, fostering a culture of operational rigor, precision, and platform enablement.
Act as a trusted advisor to other Product & Tech teams looking to integrate with core banking engines, sharing best practices and enabling rapid go-to-market execution.
Manage stakeholder communication across Product, Engineering, Finance, Treasury, Risk, Compliance, and senior leadership.
Define and track domain KPIs that measure product enablement speed, system uptime, compliance metrics, OPEX cost savings, and balance sheet data integrity.
What you need to be successful:
5-7+ years of product management experience, with a significant portion focused on core banking systems, ledger infrastructure, payments, or core platform products.
Proven experience partnering with Core Banking and Platform Engineering experts — you understand how transaction processing, ledgers, and accounting engines work and know how to build scalable platform products.
Strong technical literacy — you understand backend platform trade-offs, core endpoint dynamics, multi-currency ledgers, and data pipelines, allowing you to engage credibly with engineering teams.
Data-driven mindset — comfort working with complex financial datasets, defining meaningful operational and compliance KPIs, and making decisions grounded in evidence.
Financial services experience required — familiarity with regulatory requirements, audit standards, compliance considerations, and the operational realities of banking.
Agile practitioner — experience managing multiple mission-critical workstreams in fast-paced, high-availability environments.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering - Applications
jobs.text:
Seeq makes data analytics software for a big market that’s often overlooked by tech companies: industrial process data. Think pharmaceutical manufacturers, wind farms, and energy companies with tons of equipment and sensors. Our software engineers tackle hard problems in streaming calculation, storage, and distributed computing, leveraging the latest features in Java, Kotlin, React, Python, Kubernetes and many other frameworks and technologies. We believe that AI is an exciting revolution in developer tooling and features we will bring to our customers, while also presenting new and real challenges to how people interact with each other.
We are looking for an engineering leader with a proven track record of managing technical teams and taking them to the next level. We have a solid set of development squads in place with a good foundation of processes, engineering talent, and a history of delivering best-in-class software. This position will lead the end-user facing squads, roughly half the engineering team, and expand our engineering capacity as we continue to grow our customer base and market aspirations.
Our company was founded 100% remote and we're proud of it. We’ve been good at remote for over 13 years and have used that advantage to create a global team despite our modest company size. Our engineers work anywhere in a compatible time zone (our core hours are 8am-12pm Pacific). We use a variety of collaboration tools, like Zoom, Slack, and our homegrown Qube Virtual Office, which make us feel like we're in the same building together. We use agile tenets to iterate on both our product and development processes. We have a wonderful team of kind-hearted, talented engineers that love to collaborate, teach each other new tricks, and build products that exceed our customers’ expectations.
Our technology stack utilizes JVM languages (Java, Kotlin), Python, TypeScript/React and some C#/.NET. The core of our product is a full-featured calculation engine that can perform complex math and execute machine learning algorithms on streaming time series data. Our SaaS architecture is Kubernetes based, with clusters in a dozen global regions on both AWS and Azure.

jobs.title: Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development
jobs.text:
Firmus Technologies
Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.
Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.
At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.
Firmus AI Cloud
Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.
It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.
Roles & Responsibilities
As Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development at Firmus, you will lead the electrical engineering discipline across every site where Firmus is building and scaling an AI Factory. This is a principal-engineer-equivalent management role within the Build group, accountable for the consistent, high-quality implementation of Firmus's reference electrical design across our global site portfolio.
The role sits within AI Factory Development (Build) and reports to the Head/Director of AI Factory Engineering. You will lead a distributed team of site-based electrical engineers across Indonesia, Australia, and any future geography where Firmus is active. Your remit is delivery, governance, and technical assurance of the electrical design in construction, commissioning, and handover — not ownership of the reference design itself, though you will be a primary and continuous input into the reference design's evolution.
This is a central leadership role. You are the single accountable owner for electrical engineering execution across the Firmus AI Factory estate, the escalation point for electrical technical issues in the field, and the guardian of design intent from tender through energisation. You will work in tight partnership with the reference design owners, the Mechanical and Thermal, Controls, and Physical Networking Heads, and with Construction, Commissioning, and Operations to ensure every site is electrically built, tested, and handed over to standard.
What you will do
As Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development, you will own the electrical engineering function within the AI Factory Development group. You will define how the reference electrical design is interpreted, adapted for local codes and site conditions, procured, constructed, and commissioned across every Firmus site. You will set the technical bar for MV/LV distribution, UPS and standby generation, protection and coordination, earthing and bonding, power quality, and the electrical interfaces to liquid-cooled AI compute halls.
You will act as the engineering authority for electrical execution across the AI Factory portfolio — accountable for design governance in the field, deviation management, factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning readiness, and safe, reliable energisation. You will operate the change-control and design-review disciplines that keep every site aligned to the Firmus reference design, and you will be the escalation point when local realities require considered deviation or when the reference design itself needs to evolve.
You will not own the development of the reference electrical design, but you will be one of its most important customers and contributors. You will feed operational learnings, site constraints, vendor performance data, and commissioning findings back into the reference design owners, and you will co-develop the electrical standards, templates, and Basis of Design updates that keep Firmus's design ahead of the industry.
You will build, lead, and scale a geographically distributed electrical engineering team – site-based engineers embedded in Indonesia, Australia, and any additional geography where Firmus operates. You will set the operating rhythm across time zones, establish consistent engineering practice and quality standards across sites, develop the next generation of senior electrical engineers within Firmus, and represent electrical engineering in cross-functional Build, Commissioning, and Operations forums.
Skills & Experiences
You are, first and foremost, an accomplished electrical engineer for mission-critical, high-density digital infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in medium- and low-voltage distribution, UPS systems, standby and prime-power generation, static and rotary switching, protection and relay coordination, arc-flash and safety-in-design, earthing and bonding, and the specific electrical demands of dense GPU compute halls and liquid-cooled AI infrastructure. You understand power system modelling — load flow, short-circuit, motor starting, transient stability — and you have used it to make consequential design and operational decisions.
Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading tender design reviews, consultant and contractor governance, factory acceptance testing, integrated systems testing, level-1 through level-5 commissioning, and handover to operations. You have authored or materially shaped Basis of Design documents, engineering templates, global minimum standards, and change-control processes at a hyperscale operator or equivalent. You are comfortable engaging utilities, regulators, and major equipment vendors, and you know how to drive value engineering, DfMA, and sustainability outcomes without compromising reliability.
Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under construction and commissioning pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of site engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI infrastructure that works reliably from day one.
The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in electrical power engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (power systems preferred) recognised in at least one of Firmus's operating jurisdictions, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience across hyperscale or mission-critical data centre developments, industrial power systems, or comparable high-availability infrastructure. They will have deep, hands-on expertise as an electrical subject-matter expert and design manager on multi-site programmes, and a proven track record leading design governance, quality assurance, and commissioning readiness across a portfolio of concurrent projects.
This experience should include leading distributed, site-based engineering teams across multiple countries, managing external consultants and EPC contractors to global standards, and working effectively across the build-to-run interface with Construction, Commissioning, and Operations. Experience authoring or contributing materially to global electrical Basis of Design, minimum standards, or reference architecture at a hyperscale, cloud, or specialist AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia and Australia — under diverse regulatory, grid, and utility conditions.
Location & Reporting
Australia, or Singapore (with regular travel across the AI Factory portfolio)
Reporting to the Head/Director of AI Factory Engineering

jobs.title: Head of Platform Product
jobs.text:
About Us
Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Leader to join our technology leadership team, reporting directly to the CTO. This role will manage and grow the Platform Product organization and extend product ownership across the CTO-line platform product portfolio, including infrastructure-facing product lines such as AI platform, compliance infrastructure, financial cloud, and developer tooling.
This is a rare opportunity to shape the product strategy of a global crypto exchange at a pivotal inflection point — transitioning from a high-growth crypto-native platform to a regulated, AI-native financial institution.
What You'll Own
1. Platform Product Organization Leadership
Directly manage and develop the Platform Product Group — a 15+ person team spanning compliance site building, payments & assets, CRM, user/security/reach, personalization, and AI product lines
Drive team health, OKR quality, and delivery rigor across 10+ sub-teams and 200+ active requirements
Build a high-performance product culture: elevate product thinking from requirement-taking to systems-level ownership; enforce outcome-based OKRs over go-live checklists
Recruit, develop, and retain senior product talent; proactively manage succession and capability gaps
2. CTO-Line Platform Product Strategy
Own the product vision and roadmap for CTO-line platform product lines, including:
AI Platform (OpenClaw, AI Gateway, AI Sub-Account, Skills Marketplace, AI Coding infrastructure)
Financial Cloud / Compliance Infrastructure (self-service compliance platform, multi-jurisdiction site building, regulatory data export)
Developer Experience & Internal Tooling (BDOT, CI/CD product layer, AI-native R&D workflow)
Data & Intelligence Platform (knowledge distillation, MCP integration, personalization engine)
Translate CTO-level technical strategy into concrete product roadmaps with measurable business outcomes
3. AI-Native Product Transformation
Lead the platform product team's transition to AI-native product development — 100% AI documentation coverage, AI-assisted requirement analysis, and measurable AI efficiency gains
Define and drive the killing feature strategy for the AI agent platform: identify the user acquisition hook that converts infrastructure investment into real user growth
Own the product strategy for intelligent customer service evolution — from reactive article-linking to proactive, fully automated resolution (>80% resolution rate target)
What We're Looking For
Must Have
10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a senior product leadership role managing multi-team product organizations (20+ PMs)
Proven track record building and shipping platform/infrastructure products — not just consumer-facing features; experience with developer platforms, internal tooling, or B2B SaaS is highly valued
Strong systems thinking: ability to define product architecture, module catalogs, and API contracts — not just user stories
Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment (fintech, banking, crypto, or equivalent); understanding of how regulatory requirements translate into product constraints and opportunities
Demonstrated ability to drive OKR quality — moving teams from go-live metrics to outcome-based measurement
Fluency in Chinese (Mandarin) — required for internal communication with engineering teams and business stakeholders
Strongly Preferred
Experience with AI product strategy — agent platforms, LLM-powered products, or AI infrastructure products
Background in financial services technology or crypto/Web3
Experience managing product teams through organizational restructuring or rapid scaling
Familiarity with multi-jurisdiction compliance product challenges (KYC/KYB, AML, regulatory data reporting, multi-site architecture)
Track record of defining and launching platform "killing features" — not just maintaining existing product lines
Leadership Profile
End-to-end ownership mindset: bridges customer pain points, product design, system architecture, data governance, compliance, and business outcomes — not a handoff-oriented PM
Prioritization discipline: can narrow scope to the top 5 problems and communicate a clear, credible plan rather than attempting to map everything simultaneously
Honest communicator: acknowledges unknowns directly; gives specific, actionable feedback to senior engineers and PMs
Builder, not coordinator: avoids absorbing accountability for all cross-team AI products without authority; focuses on creating genuine new product value
Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.title: VP B2B Product Innovation
jobs.text:
Title: VP, B2B Product Innovation
Desired Location: US Remote
The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.
Meet Nuvei, Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.
At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!
The Vice President, B2B Product Innovation is responsible for driving the vision, development, and commercialization of innovative B2B payment solutions that accelerate growth across embedded payments, ERP integrations, and partner ecosystems. This leader will champion customer-centric product innovation, identify emerging market opportunities, and bring differentiated payment capabilities to market that enhance customer value, increase adoption, and drive revenue growth. The role serves as the bridge between customer needs, market trends, technology capabilities, and commercial outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
· Define and lead Nuvei's B2B product innovation agenda across embedded payments, ERP platforms, and indirect channel ecosystems.
· Identify emerging market trends, customer pain points, and technology opportunities to create next-generation payment solutions.
· Drive ideation, validation, and commercialization of new B2B products, features, and platform capabilities.
· Build and manage an innovation pipeline that delivers differentiated products and sustainable competitive advantage.
· Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Partners to accelerate innovation from concept through launch.
· Develop innovative payment experiences that improve customer adoption, retention, and lifetime value.
· Champion customer-centric product design through direct engagement with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders.
· Lead innovation efforts around embedded finance, automation, AI-enabled payments, ERP workflows, and emerging commerce technologies.
· Evaluate build, buy, and partnership opportunities to accelerate product innovation and market expansion.
· Drive product adoption through commercialization strategies, solution packaging, and enablement initiatives.
· Establish innovation KPIs, product success metrics, and portfolio performance reporting.
