jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Core & Ads Serving Platform
jobs.text:
About Pinterest:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
Millions of people across the world come to Pinterest to find new ideas every day. It’s where they get inspiration, dream about new possibilities and plan for what matters most. Our mission is to help those people find their inspiration and create a life they love.
We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the strategic vision and execution for Pinterest’s core and ads serving platforms, overseeing the infrastructure that enables high-scale, low-latency delivery of content and ads across all Pinterest surfaces. They will define the multi-year architecture to ensure our serving systems are reliable, performant, and cost-efficient while enabling rapid innovation for product and ML teams.
What you’ll do:
Set the long-term technical and operational vision for the Core and Ads Serving Platform, aligning infrastructure investments with business strategy.
Lead a high-performing organization of engineers and managers, fostering a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and rapid delivery.
Partner with senior leaders in Product, ML, and Infra to define priorities, resolve tradeoffs, and ensure our systems support our strategic goals for revenue, engagement, and safety.
Drive initiatives to modernize our serving stack, improving reliability, latency, and cost-efficiency while enabling faster iteration for product teams.
Establish clear metrics for platform success (e.g., latency, availability, cost-per-impression) and hold the organization accountable for delivering on these targets.
Use AI to accelerate platform analysis, design iteration, system debugging, and documentation synthesis, enabling the organization to make better decisions faster while maintaining high standards for accuracy.
What we’re looking for:
5+ years of Experience leading or managing big engineering organizations, including setting direction, driving execution, and supporting team members’ growth.
8+ years of relevant industry experience
Extensive experience leading engineering organizations responsible for large-scale serving or delivery infrastructure, with a deep understanding of distributed systems and performance tradeoffs.
Proven ability to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and deliver on complex, multi-year initiatives.
Exceptional leadership skills: you develop leaders, foster inclusivity, and maintain a high-trust, high-accountability environment.
Demonstrated experience using AI/LLM-powered tooling to improve engineering velocity and quality, with a sound approach to validating outputs.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence senior cross-functional partners and articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times per quarter and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from one of the following offices: PA or SF offices.
This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.
#LI-REMOTE
#LI-AG8
At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.
Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.
US based applicants only
$285,452—$449,541 USD
Our Commitment to Inclusion:
Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
The AI Product's Data Science org is at the center of the next generation of products at Figma, spanning Make, Figma Agent, Design Systems, and other areas. Data is critical to setting strategy and measurement across these areas. This org engages closely with AI Research and is a driving force behind our evals work and the future of product measurement at scale. With a charge to uplevel Figma’s use of data, the team works alongside other Data Scientists and Engineering to identify ways to implement and democratize new statistical methods, build data frameworks, and incorporate data within Figma’s product development process. This team contributes to the company’s goals by collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, and our finance team to uncover new opportunities, identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements through data-driven insights.
As Director, you will lead a team of data scientists and managers, setting the vision for how data shapes strategy across Figma's AI products. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and Research leadership to embed data-driven thinking and modern AI-product measurement into how we build.
This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.
What you’ll do at Figma:
Lead, support, and grow a team of data scientists and data science managers with varied strengths and expertise focused on product strategy, internal tooling, and Impact measurement
Champion data quality, accessibility, and the democratization of data across the company

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Developer Experience
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members across UK and India
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE TEAM:
The Platform Engineering team builds the tools, infrastructure and ‘golden paths’ that let Tide’s engineers ship safely and quickly. We own everything from CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling to Tide’s service catalogue, including the Developer Productivity function, and our mission is to make the right way the easy way for every engineer at Tide — human or AI agent.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
As Head of Developer Experience, you will report directly to the Director of Platform Engineering and be responsible for how every engineer at Tide builds, tests and ships software. You will:
Own the Developer Experience strategy for Tide, setting the vision and roadmap for developer tooling, CI/CD and the internal platform.
Lead the design, build and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling, reducing friction and lead time across the software delivery lifecycle.
Define, track and report on DevEx and engineering productivity metrics (e.g. DORA, SPACE), using data to identify bottlenecks and prioritise investment.
Own and evolve Tide’s service catalogue (Backstage), establishing it as the single source of truth for the ICT Asset Register and driving adoption across engineering.
Manage the Developer Productivity function, responsible for building and maintaining Java/Spring and Python ‘paved road’ templates that give product teams a fast, secure and consistent way to start new services.
Own the internally developed libraries for authentication and other common functionality, ensuring they are well documented, kept up to date, and widely adopted across product teams.
Build, lead and mentor a team of platform, developer experience and developer productivity engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, craftsmanship and continuous improvement.
Prepare Tide’s engineering platform for agentic development, ensuring our tooling, paved roads and guardrails allow AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) to contribute safely and effectively alongside human engineers.
Define the platform, tooling and operating model for running AI-developed applications in production, covering observability, security, testing and governance for agent-authored code.
Partner closely with engineering leaders, security and compliance stakeholders across Tide’s product and platform teams to identify friction points and shape the platform roadmap.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Tide is seeking an experienced Head of Developer Experience to lead our efforts in making our engineers as productive and effective as possible. The ideal candidate will have:
A proven track record leading Developer Experience, Platform Engineering or DevOps/SRE teams at scale.
Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling in a modern cloud environment.
Experience with Backstage, or a comparable internal developer portal / service catalogue tool, including rollout and adoption.
Experience running a developer productivity or paved-road function, including building and maintaining project templates (e.g. Java/Spring, Python) and shared libraries (e.g. authentication, common functionality) used by product teams.
Working knowledge of engineering productivity frameworks such as DORA metrics or SPACE, and experience using them to drive improvement.
Familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), and a point of view on the guardrails, governance and infrastructure needed to run AI-developed applications safely in production.
Strong people leadership skills, with a track record of building, growing and developing high-performing engineering teams.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to influence engineering leaders across multiple teams and locations.
Experience in financial services or another regulated, technology-driven scale-up environment is a plus.
OUR TECH STACK
Our platform and developer experience tooling includes: Terraform, Helm, Crossplane, Kubernetes (K8S), GitHub, AWS, GCP, Claude, and Backstage as our developer portal and service catalogue. Our product teams build on Java/Spring Boot and Python.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.text:
Funding Societies | Modalku is the largest SME digital finance platform in Southeast Asia. We are licensed and operating in Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and Vietnam, and backed by Sequoia India (Peak XV), Softbank Vision Fund, Khazanah and SMBC bank amongst many others. Funding Societies | Modalku provides business financing to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), which is funded by individual and institutional investors, as well as payments solutions to SMEs and consumers.
Here at Funding Societies | Modalku we live by our core values GETFS:
Grow Relentlessly: Strive to become our best, most authentic selves.
Enable Teamwork, Disable Politics: Only by forging togetherness, we help each other succeed.
Test Measure Act: Stay curious and reinvent ourselves, through innovation and experimentation.
Focus on Impact: Create impact through bias for action and tangible results.
Serve with Obsession: Build win-win relationships for the long-term by having a customer obsession.
Role Overview
We are seeking a passionate and strong leader in Data Analytics and Data Science to lead the strategy, development, and implementation of data-driven solutions across the organisation. You will oversee and manage the end-to-end process, from data collection and analysis through solution deployment and business integration.
Key Responsibilities
Data Strategy & Vision: Understand key company priorities and translate them into an actionable data strategy that drives data maturity across the organisation, enabling business growth, improved risk management, and enhanced customer experiences.
Team Leadership: Lead and mentor the Data Analytics and Data Science domain leads and their respective reportees to build a high-performing data team.
Stakeholder Influence: Partner with cross-functional teams such as Data Engineering, Product, Marketing, Sales, Risk, and Finance to drive data-driven initiatives, align on objectives, and ensure effective execution.
Data-Driven Business Impact: Initiate new opportunities and continue existing projects where data can deliver analytics recommendations that drive key business metrics, and develop the processes and frameworks to enable this.
Capability & Tooling Uplift: Identify and adopt new tools and methods that keep the team's analytics and reporting capabilities current.
Risk & Data Governance Oversight: Ensure data practices and reporting meet internal and regulatory standards across markets.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
DataVisor is a next-generation SaaS company that protects the world’s largest enterprises from fraud and money laundering.
Our award-winning AI decision platform combines industry-leading unsupervised machine learning (UML) with advanced supervised models to stop fraudulent activity across financial transactions, mobile growth, social networks, and e-commerce. We partner with leading global brands, delivering solutions built on top of our highly scalable platform.Behind these innovations is a world-class team of experts in big data, security, and distributed infrastructure, thriving in a culture that is open, collaborative, and results-driven.
Join us and help push the boundaries of what’s possible in fraud detection.
Role Summary
We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our Platform Engineering team. This team is at the heart of DataVisor’s detection capabilities, building the AI-based fraud and risk decision platform that powers real-time and batch unified decisioning at enterprise scale.
You will lead and grow a high-performing engineering organization, set technical direction, and drive execution across a critical part of DataVisor’s platform. Working closely with product, data science, infrastructure, and executive leadership, you will help shape our next-generation AI agent driven infrastructure and enable our customers to detect and stop complex fraud patterns in real time.
What You’ll Do
Define Strategy & Roadmap: Set the technical vision and execution roadmap for the Platform Engineering team in alignment with company priorities and long-term product strategy.
Lead at Scale: Build, manage, coach, and grow a high-performing team of engineers and engineering leaders, fostering technical excellence, strong execution, and career development.
Architect & Deliver: Oversee the design and delivery of a large-scale, AI-based fraud and risk decision platform that supports enterprise-grade real-time and batch decisioning.
Drive Innovation in Fraud Detection: Partner across engineering and data science to apply unsupervised, supervised, and agentic AI methods to uncover and stop fraudulent behavior.
Unify Decisioning: Lead the development of a real-time and batch unified decision platform that powers enterprise-scale fraud prevention.
Scale Infrastructure: Guide the evolution of distributed, real-time data systems for low-latency, highly reliable decisioning.
Leverage Big Data: Drive adoption and effective use of Spark, Flink, Cassandra, Kafka, and related technologies to support high-throughput ML and data pipelines.
Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with product, infrastructure, security, customer-facing teams, and executive leadership to align engineering delivery with business needs.
Raise the Bar: Establish strong engineering processes, operational rigor, architecture reviews, and high-quality development practices across the organization.
Hire & Develop Talent: Attract top engineering talent and build an inclusive, high-accountability culture that supports growth, ownership, and innovation.

blocks.text: DataVisor is a next-generation SaaS company that protects the world’s largest enterprises from fraud and money laundering.

Our award-winning AI decision platform combines industry-leading unsupervised machine learning (UML) with advanced supervised models to stop fraudulent activity across financial transactions, mobile growth, social networks, and e-commerce. We partner with leading global brands, delivering solutions built on top of our highly scalable platform.Behind these innovations is a world-class team of experts in big data, security, and distributed infrastructure, thriving in a culture that is open, collaborative, and results-driven.
Join us and help push the boundaries of what’s possible in fraud detection.
Role Summary

We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our Platform Engineering team. This team is at the heart of DataVisor’s detection capabilities, building the AI-based fraud and risk decision platform that powers real-time and batch unified decisioning at enterprise scale.

You will lead and grow a high-performing engineering organization, set technical direction, and drive execution across a critical part of DataVisor’s platform. Working closely with product, data science, infrastructure, and executive leadership, you will help shape our next-generation AI agent driven infrastructure and enable our customers to detect and stop complex fraud patterns in real time.
What You’ll Do

items: Define Strategy & Roadmap: Set the technical vision and execution roadmap for the Platform Engineering team in alignment with company priorities and long-term product strategy.
Lead at Scale: Build, manage, coach, and grow a high-performing team of engineers and engineering leaders, fostering technical excellence, strong execution, and career development.
Architect & Deliver: Oversee the design and delivery of a large-scale, AI-based fraud and risk decision platform that supports enterprise-grade real-time and batch decisioning.
Drive Innovation in Fraud Detection: Partner across engineering and data science to apply unsupervised, supervised, and agentic AI methods to uncover and stop fraudulent behavior.
Unify Decisioning: Lead the development of a real-time and batch unified decision platform that powers enterprise-scale fraud prevention.
Scale Infrastructure: Guide the evolution of distributed, real-time data systems for low-latency, highly reliable decisioning.
Leverage Big Data: Drive adoption and effective use of Spark, Flink, Cassandra, Kafka, and related technologies to support high-throughput ML and data pipelines.
Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with product, infrastructure, security, customer-facing teams, and executive leadership to align engineering delivery with business needs.
Raise the Bar: Establish strong engineering processes, operational rigor, architecture reviews, and high-quality development practices across the organization.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Technology (m/f/x)
jobs.text:
Cara Care is a leading German digital therapeutics company and part of Bayer, combining the agility of a growth-stage health tech company with the backing, scale, and credibility of a global healthcare leader. We build DiGA-listed products that deliver measurable clinical outcomes for patients and integrate deeply into the German healthcare system. Our ambition is to become a category leader in digital care by bringing together evidence-based medicine, outstanding user engagement, and scalable, compliant technology - while shaping how digital therapeutics connect to national health infrastructure and care delivery.
We are looking for a Head of Product & Technology (m/f/x) to support us in our mission with immediate effect. In this role, you will be a key member of the Cara Care leadership team and report directly to the Managing Director of Cara Care. You will own the combined product and technology agenda across our DiGA products for IBS and GERD as well as our R&D portfolio. Your mission is to build a clinically effective, user-centric, compliant, and scalable digital therapeutics platform that strengthens Cara Care’s position as a category leader in digital care.
You combine product leadership, technical depth, and regulated healthcare expertise. You set direction, create focus, build strong teams, and ensure that product discovery, engineering delivery, data/AI capabilities, and compliance requirements work together effectively.
🚀 Your Mission
Product and technology strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and execution across existing and future digital therapeutic offerings
End-to-end product lifecycle from discovery and delivery to optimization, engagement, and measurable patient impact
Engineering architecture across mobile/web frontend, backend services, data, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, security, and integrations
Data and AI capabilities, including analytics, personalization, automation, experimentation, and responsible AI-enabled product features
Translation of clinical, regulatory, reimbursement, privacy, and security requirements into pragmatic product and technology solutions
Software-as-a-medical-device lifecycle practices, including risk management, documentation discipline, change control, audit readiness, and post-market considerations
Operating model, delivery rhythms, decision rights, and ownership across Product, Engineering, Design, and Data/AI
Team leadership, hiring, coaching, and development of a high-performing, accountable, and learning-oriented organization
Senior stakeholder management across Cara Care, Bayer interfaces, external partners, healthcare ecosystem stakeholders, and relevant infrastructure initiatives
What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months
A focused product and technology roadmap is aligned with business, clinical, regulatory, and patient outcomes
Engineering delivery is more predictable, scalable, and transparent, with clear ownership and operating rhythms
The platform foundation supports multiple indications, future integrations, and compliant product evolution
Product engagement, therapy adherence, prescription activation, and patient impact are improved through data-informed iteration
Teams have clear roles, decision rights, and development paths, and are able to operate with speed and accountability in a regulated environment
Cara Care is prepared for audits, certification requirements, security reviews, and quality expectations by design rather than through late-stage remediation

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
About TMGM
TMGM is a leading global CFD trading provider with a strong international presence across three continents. As the Official Regional Online Forex and Trading Partner of Chelsea FC in Asia Pacific, we are committed to strengthening our global brand through strategic partnerships, innovation, and exceptional client experiences.
We are looking for a bilingual Product Director to lead our Sales and Client Portals across APAC. You will drive product strategy, cross-functional delivery and data-led growth while exploring AI opportunities to improve client and internal user experiences. Experience in financial services or trading is highly valued.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Strategy and Delivery
• Own the product roadmaps for the Sales Portal and Client Portal, prioritising initiatives to maintain alignment with business objectives and evolving user needs.
• Develop a strong understanding of data flows and functional integrations across the Sales Portal, Client Portal, CRM, middleware and data platforms; identify experience gaps and optimisation opportunities.
• Translate growth objectives and user insights into clear product specifications and executable delivery plans.
2. Requirements Definition and Product Delivery
• Conduct in-depth research into the needs of retail trading clients and internal teams, including Sales, Customer Service, Operations and Marketing, and produce high-quality PRDs and functional specifications.
• Partner closely with Design, Engineering, QA and Data teams to manage the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery to launch, ensuring delivery quality and momentum.
• Lead backlog management and prioritisation decisions, and coordinate sprint planning, iteration reviews and releases across teams.
3. Data-Driven Product Growth
• Establish core metrics across product modules and regularly review user behaviour, conversion funnels, retention and lifetime value.
• Lead A/B testing and product experimentation, using data to continuously optimise features and user experience.
• Advance data-product capabilities supporting BI reporting, user segmentation, personalisation and recommendation use cases.
4. AI and Emerging Technology
• Identify and validate AI and machine-learning opportunities in trading products, such as intelligent notifications, risk-support tools, customer-service automation and personalised market information.
• Collaborate with technology teams to understand the boundaries of web, mobile and data platforms, ensuring product designs are feasible, scalable and maintainable.
5. Cross-Functional Leadership and Communication
• Act as the key product representative across Business, Compliance, Technology and Marketing, establishing clear communication mechanisms and aligning cross-functional goals.
• Understand how regulatory requirements, including ASIC, MAS and FSA obligations, affect product design and delivery.
• Communicate effectively in English and Chinese and support product collaboration across APAC markets and cultures.

jobs.title: Director of AI & Data Platform
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
The Position
OPSWAT is building the internal AI & Data platform that will power every non-engineering function at the company — Finance, HR, Legal, Sales Ops, Marketing, CX, IT, Security, and Supply Chain. We are not buying our way out of this problem with off-the-shelf SaaS; we are building it ourselves, with AI-accelerated development, and we need a leader to own the foundation.
As Director of AI Platform & Data, you will own the AI Platform pillar end-to-end and be accountable to executive leadership for its outcomes. You will run the connective tissue that makes company-wide AI enablement real: the MCP servers and gateway, the agent runtime and orchestration layer, the AI-native data platform that feeds them, the analytics layer that surfaces insight through conversation rather than dashboards, and the governance framework that keeps it all safe. You will lead a multi-team organization, make the platform decisions, set the technical and product direction, and represent this pillar to the CEO, COO, and senior leadership. This role is for someone who thinks like a founder, builds like an engineer, and leads like an operator — someone ready to run an org, not assist in running one.
What You Will Be Doing
Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the AI Platform & Data pillar end-to-end: MCP servers, agent runtime and orchestration framework, AI-native data platform, analytics products, and governance.
Scale and lead a multi-team organization spanning Orchestration, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Governance; recruit, mentor, and develop engineering managers and technical leads — and raise the bar on the leaders you inherit.
Build the AI-native data platform — a foundation with CDC pipelines, a semantic layer designed for LLM consumption, lineage, freshness SLAs, and a quality framework that makes agent outputs trustworthy by default.
Reinvent the analytics function. Move the company from static dashboards to agent-driven insights: natural-language analytics, autonomous deep-dives, anomaly detection, and proactive surfacing of business signals to the teams that need them.
Define and enforce the architectural patterns that let product teams across Finance, HR, Legal, CX, Supply Chain, and GTM Systems ship AI-powered internal workflows on the shared platform — without rebuilding plumbing every time.
Own OPSWAT’s private LLM strategy and operating model, including model selection, fine-tuning and post-training, secure deployment, inference infrastructure, evaluation, observability, and lifecycle management. Build private models that can power internal agents, AI-assisted SDLC, and sensitive-data workflows where public or externally hosted models are not appropriate.
Establish the architecture and decision framework for routing workloads between OPSWAT-hosted models and approved external foundation models based on data classification, security requirements, latency, quality, and cost.
Build and govern the training and evaluation data pipelines required to improve OPSWAT’s private models, including dataset curation, anonymization, access controls, versioning, benchmarking, red-team testing, and protection against data leakage.
Partner with Security, Engineering, Legal, and Product teams to define private-model use cases across secure coding, internal knowledge retrieval, cybersecurity analysis, operational agents, and regulated or customer-sensitive workflows.
Eliminate shadow IT by making the platform the obvious choice: design MCP servers, data connectors, and agent primitives that are faster, safer, and easier than DIY alternatives.
Establish the governance framework — model access, data classification, audit, evaluation, cost controls — that lets the company adopt AI broadly without compromising security or compliance.
Drive a development culture that runs ahead of the industry curve on agentic coding, AI-assisted SDLC, and internal tooling velocity — the platform team should be the most productive engineering team in the company.
Represent the pillar to executive leadership, business function heads, and external partners; own the narrative, the roadmap, and the results.
What We Need From You
10+ years in software, data, or platform engineering, with 6+ years leading engineering teams and at least 2 years managing managers.
Demonstrated track record building and shipping platform products at scale — internal developer platforms, AI/ML infrastructure, modern data platforms, or equivalent.
Deep hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack: LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), MCP, prompt engineering, and evaluation/observability.
Hands-on understanding of private LLM deployment and optimization, including open-weight models, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, quantization, inference serving, GPU infrastructure, model evaluation, and secure model operations.
Experience designing hybrid AI architectures that intelligently route requests between private models and commercial foundation models while maintaining security, quality, latency, and cost controls.
Strong data engineering and analytics foundation: lakehouse architectures (Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake), CDC, streaming, dbt-style transformation, semantic layers, and analytics-grade data quality. You have built data platforms that serve both humans and machines.
Security and governance mindset — you have built systems that needed to pass audit, not just demos.
Proven ability to partner with non-technical business functions and translate ambiguous requirements into platform capabilities.
An innovator’s instinct paired with an operator’s discipline: you bring ideas to the table proactively, then ship them with rigor.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you can hold the room with the CEO and pair-program with an IC in the same week.
It Would Be Nice If You Had
Background in cybersecurity, critical infrastructure, or another regulated industry.
Experience fine-tuning or post-training open-weight models for enterprise, cybersecurity, software engineering, or domain-specific use cases.
Familiarity with private inference platforms and tooling such as vLLM, SGLang, Hugging Face, NVIDIA NIM, Kubernetes-based GPU serving, or equivalent technologies.
Experience automating revenue operations, finance, HR, or legal workflows through AI.
Familiarity with SugarCRM, Salesforce, or comparable enterprise system metadata and integration patterns.
Experience standing up MCP servers, agent infrastructure, or AI gateways in production.
A point of view on how AI is changing the way internal engineering teams ship software, and how to bring that perspective to a 700+ person company.
OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Physical AI
jobs.text:
Director of Engineering, Physical AI
Role Overview
The Director of Engineering will report to the General Manager of Physical AI, and will be responsible for leading a multi-disciplinary engineering organization. In this senior leadership role, you will own the execution of the Physical AI Data Engine — the platform powering the next generation of Physical AI/Embodied AI. You will collaborate closely with Operations and GTM to guide product direction and help solve the data bottleneck that stands between today's robotics research and real-world deployment.
This role requires significant ownership in a fast-paced environment and you will motivate internal teams to set the pace for business growth. Travel will come into play.
Key Responsibilities:
Set and drive the technical vision across data collection infrastructure, teleoperation systems, ML training pipelines, model evaluation frameworks, annotation tooling, and research
Lead a multidisciplinary engineering organization—spanning engineering managers, software engineers, ML engineers, and ML research scientists—while designing the organizational structure, talent strategy, and culture required to scale rapidly without compromising on quality or strategic alignment
Maintain exceptional technical and operational excellence by deeply understanding team deliverables, asking incisive questions, identifying slipping standards early, and knowing precisely when to step in
Drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Operations, and GTM on platform architecture, release processes, and shared priorities
Collaborate with researchers and clients to architect and deliver scalable, production-grade data infrastructure tailored for complex robotics workloads
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related technical field
8+ years of engineering experience in fast-paced environments, including 4+ years direct people management demonstrated history of recruiting, mentoring, and developing high-performing technical teams through rapid growth and change
Experience leading technical execution for complex hardware-software systems, with deep domain knowledge in Robotics, Autonomous Vehicles, Computer Vision, and/or Machine Learning strongly preferred
Deep fluency in the ML development lifecycle — training pipelines, data flywheels, and evaluation frameworks as systems you've built and owned
Comfortable leading teams across Python, C++, and TypeScript/Node stacks, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes), and workflow orchestration (Temporal, Airflow)
Proven ability to independently navigate, execute effectively amidst ambiguity, and strong attention to detail
Strong operator and communicator to create tight feedback loops between teams, surface problems early, and drive decisions with clarity across technical and executive audiences
Nice to Have
MS or PhD is a plus, though strong practical experience is equally valued.
Hands-on experience with teleoperation systems (ALOHA, UMI, hand tracking), robotic hardware platforms, or imitation learning
Background in sensor fusion, SLAM, or 3D data processing
Experience scaling data collection systems globally
Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend.
The base salary range for this full-time position in the location of San Francisco is:
$302,400—$378,000 USD
PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.
About Us:
At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.
We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status.
We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's Know Your Rights poster for additional information.
We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.
PLEASE NOTE: We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our privacy policy for additional information.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data Products
jobs.text:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.
We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our Data Products pillar, serving as the technical engine for Counterpart Health's (CPH) clinical-data foundation. You will own the technical strategy and execution for the Data Products roadmap—encompassing clinical data ingestion, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability—while building scalable, reusable data capabilities that serve as a foundational platform for driving clinical insight generation. You will own the technical strategy for our Data Products platform—ensuring our clinical data foundations (using standards like FHIR, LOINC, and RxNorm) effectively drive business outcomes. You will serve as a critical leader and partner to the VP of Engineering and cross-functional leaders in Product, Data Science, and Design.
As a Director of Engineering, Data Products, you will:
Own the Data Products technical roadmap, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability.
Manage and optimize the clinical data ingestion pipeline.
Oversee the scaling of customer data onboarding processes and the continuous improvement of data hygiene, canonical storage standards, and observability and monitoring of the data pipelines.
Enable shared funnel visibility across the organization and support the development of a robust enterprise reporting framework.
Drive the adoption of an AI-powered Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), leveraging AI tools to accelerate coding, testing, and deployment processes while maintaining stringent code quality and security standards.
Success in this role looks like:
Successfully achieving improved clinical data coverage and freshness targets across all patient populations.
Predictable and repeatable multi-customer scaling with standardized playbooks for rapid data readiness.
Broad adoption of the Data Products platform and its capabilities
Data infrastructure is robust, stable, and serves as a reliable source of truth during rapid organizational growth and customer expansion.
You should get in touch if:
You possess 10+ years of engineering experience with a deep focus on building high-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR, CCDA).
Proven track record in managing and scaling engineering teams that handle data-heavy workloads and complex clinical data pipelines.
Proven experience leading cross-functional teams of engineers to deliver complex software in regulated environments.
Experience implementing and scaling AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., AI code assistants, automated testing, or AI-driven SDLC) to improve engineering productivity.
Demonstrated experience building and managing engineering systems in highly regulated healthcare environments, with a strong operational understanding of HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance requirements.
Passionate about the healthcare sector and committed to utilizing technical expertise to drive meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.
Deeply familiar with the inherent complexities and lack of standardization in clinical datasets, with a proactive focus on enhancing data integrity.
Motivated by intricate technical challenges and dedicated to architecting pragmatic, high-quality engineering solutions through continuous intellectual exploration.
Thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments, demonstrating the ability to navigate ambiguity and align technical priorities with overarching strategic objectives.
Action-oriented leader who assumes full ownership of system sustainability, willing to address operational gaps to ensure the team achieves its delivery milestones.
Engineering Leadership Skills:
Proven track record of directly hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering managers, Tech Leads (TLs), and Principal Engineers (PELs).
Demonstrated ability to cultivate a high-performance engineering culture focused on velocity, quality, and psychological safety.
Experience leading organizational change, including structural re-orgs and process evolution.
Strong proficiency in strategic resource allocation, capacity planning, and managing technical debt in a fast-paced product environment.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear, actionable business strategies (e.g., impact on HEDIS/RADV outcomes) for non-technical leadership.
Benefits Overview:
Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
Professional Development: We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.
Additional Perks:
Reimbursement for office setup expenses
Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
Paid parental leave for all new parents
And much more!
About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.
Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.
With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.
Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.
A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is:
$223,100—$290,000 USD

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
🌍 Global SaaS | $28M Series B Investment
📍 Remote in Europe
The Mission
As the Director of Product, you will lead the product organization to move with conviction, speed, and evidence. You are responsible for leading a team of Product Managers, Designers and Product Operations to ensure we are solving high-impact problems and building the leanest, most impactful solutions for our customers and the business.
You will act as the primary strategic force for the executive team, front-running strategy and managing stakeholder expectations, owning the tactical translation of strategy into a coherent, high-velocity roadmap, so that the roadmap remains proactive, data-driven, and aligned with our commercial goals. Your goal is to be a "Player-Coach" who deep-dives into the domain with PMs to ensure excellent execution habits. You are the final gatekeeper who resolves blockers and scope disputes before they ever reach the CEO or CPTO, which will provide you and the teams with a level of autonomy in which to thrive.
You drive efficiency through an AI-First approach, while embracing SVPG style experimentation and pragmatic execution, and inject these principles into your teams. This allows you to closely align with the Director of Engineering and make Dual Track Agile a standard across the organization.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Elevating Product Discovery & Conviction
Advancing Empowered Squads: You will work to continually increase the level of empowerment within our squads. Moving beyond execution, you coach PMs to take deeper ownership of business outcomes, ensuring they are positioned to solve complex problems rather than just deliver features.
Continuous Discovery: You own the standard for modern discovery. You ensure squads are in constant contact with users to (in)validate hypotheses before significant engineering resources are committed.
Bias to Action with Knowledge: You move with high urgency but high conviction. Decisions must be rooted in user insights and market data, ensuring we are always "building the right thing."
2. The Product-Engineering Partnership (Dual-Track Agile)
Strategic Duo: You work in a tight, peer-level partnership with the Director of Engineering to lead the "R&D engine." Together, you are responsible for the total health, culture, and output of the R&D organization.
Discovery vs. Delivery Alignment: While you own the Discovery Track (validating value and usability), you collaborate daily with the Director of Engineering, who owns the Delivery Track (feasibility, scalability, and execution). You ensure these two tracks are synchronized and never siloed.
Resource & Trade-off Management: You partner with Engineering leadership to manage capacity. You lead the difficult conversations regarding trade-offs between new feature discovery, technical debt, and maintenance, ensuring the business is always focused on the highest ROI activities.
3. Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management
The "Final Answer": You are the primary gatekeeper for the product roadmap. You provide clear, definitive "Yes/No" decisions to executive stakeholders underpinned with knowledge of our customers and the necessary trade-offs.
Vacuum Prevention: You identify misalignments early and resolve them across all swimlanes of the business.
Commercial Realism: You translate high-level business goals (Retention, Revenue, Strategic Growth) into actionable priorities while aligning with the company’s core Key Results and Business Objectives.
4. Operational Excellence & People Leadership
Product Operations Mastery: You view Product Ops as a strategic lever. You standardize discovery documentation and research databases across the organization to create a transparent, low-friction environment.
Outcome Accountability: You manage the Product Scorecard and Rolling Roadmap. These must be high-integrity, automated "Sources of Truth" providing executive-level visibility.
Radical Candor: You practice direct challenge combined with personal care. You are responsible for raising the "Product IQ" of your team—coaching PMs to think like owners and act with strategic independence.
5. Product Advocacy & Representation
Product Voice to the Company: Serve as the primary representative of the Product organization in company-wide meetings (All Hands, Town Halls). You must be able to translate complex technical roadmaps into compelling narratives that inspire and align the entire business.
Evangelizing the Vision: Actively advocate for the "Why" behind our product strategy. You ensure that Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success clearly understand our product direction, value propositions, and upcoming releases.
Presentation Excellence: You possess elite presentation skills, utilizing the Pyramid Principle to deliver high-impact, succinct, and visually clear updates to both internal and external audiences.
6. Aggressive Scope Management & Lean Execution
The "Slicer": You coach PMs to avoid "heavyweight" features. You have a relentless focus on building the leanest possible MVP, MSP, CMF, ILS solutions based on the need or pain. If a solution is over-scoped, you are the one who cuts it back to the core value.
Pushback & Scrappiness: You teach PMs to find their “appetite” for investment into a solution and how to find "cheaper" ways to validate hypotheses. You empower them to push back on high-effort requests by proposing creative, lower-cost alternatives.
Deep-Dive Problem Solving: You don’t stay at the surface. You sit with PMs to help them deeply understand core user problems to avoid building "to cover all bases" and relentlessly focus on solving the actual customer pain.
The Ideal Profile:
The High-Agency Leader: You don't wait for permission; you identify gaps and fill them. You have a natural "bias to action" but are always grounded in data.
The SVPG & Cagan Practitioner: You live and breathe modern product principles and know how to coach others to do the same.
The Elite Communicator: You are a master of the Pyramid Principle. You can command a room, whether it’s a 3rd-person Exec meeting or a 200-person All Hands.
The Systems Thinker: You look at the "R&D Engine" as a whole and work with your Engineering counterpart to optimize for both speed and quality.
Operational Source of Truth: The Scorecard and Roadmap are automated and accurate, serving as the definitive guide for the executive team and the business.
The B2B SaaS Operator: You have built and led product in a B2B SaaS environment — ideally with a sales-assisted and PLG motion and an ARR-driven commercial model.
Success Metrics (First 90 Days):
R&D Sync: Established a seamless rhythm with the Director of Engineering; joint ownership of delivery velocity and discovery outcomes.
Strategic Visibility: The "Rolling Roadmap" and "Scorecard" are live, automated, and being used by the Executive team without manual intervention.
Empowerment Baseline: Documented "Discovery to Delivery" workflows for all 6 squads with clear KPIs for hypothesis validation.
Stakeholder Trust: A measurable reduction in "Roadmap bypass" incidents; stakeholders rely on your "Final Answer."
About CloudTalk:
CloudTalk is THE global AI-powered business calling platform, trusted by 30,000+ professionals at companies like Nokia, Revolut, Glovo, and Uber.
We’re building the world’s most capable AI business calling software available in 160+ countries — helping businesses have more and better calls every day. Backed by $35.3M in funding from leading investors, including KPN Ventures, Point Nine, and HenQ, we're investing in making AI native to every conversation.
We're a ~200-person team that values growth, innovation, teamwork, customer focus, and human connection. We move fast, build for the future, and care deeply about creating products — and a culture — that people genuinely love.
Why you’ll love being a CloudTalker
Unlimited PTO that people actually take. Fully remote with four European hubs. A coach you can book, a career path in writing, and equity when you deliver. Here's the full package.
Get better, faster
💬 A coach you can actually book. Recurring 1-on-1 sessions with our resident coach. A real conversation about your career, on company time.
🪜 Promotions without guesswork. Our job-leveling framework is transparent: every level and its expectations, in writing. You'll always know what the next step requires and where you stand.
Work the way you work best
🌴 Unlimited PTO, and we mean it. Taking 30 days a year is normal here. Deliver beyond expectations, and you've bought yourself room for more.
🌍 The right setup for your role. Depending on the team, you’ll either work from one of our hubs four days a week or have the option to work fully remotely. Our offices are fully equipped and centrally located.
⏰ Flexible hours, built around your team. No clocking in, no clocking out. Be there for your team, clients, and the meetings that matter. The rest is yours.
💻 Gear that doesn't fight you. A MacBook for work, plus a home-office allowance for remote roles to build a setup you like sitting at.
Rest like you mean it
🔋 Recharge Fridays: 4 extra all-company days off a year. Once a quarter, everyone is off at the same time. You come back to zero pings, not a doubled backlog. That's the point.
🏃 Fitness allowance. Gym, climbing, yoga, whatever keeps you moving. You choose, we pay.
People worth staying for
💸 Up to €5,000 per referral. You know great people. When we hire one of them, you get paid for it.
✈️ Two offsites a year worth packing a bag for. The all-company offsite (last year: Tuscany 🇮🇹) plus a dedicated function-specific offsite, both somewhere remote enough that people actually talk.
👕 Fresh CloudTalk swag every year!
Apply now and be part of our journey to $100M ARR!
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Cloudtalk will process your personal data based on Cloudtalk’s legitimate interest in finding the most suitable candidate and a pre-contractual relationship with you. For more information on how Cloudtalk processes your personal data, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Data Policy, Manager/Snr Manager/Assistant Director, Data Governance, GDD, SNDG
jobs.company: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI)
jobs.text:
The Smart Nation Group – Digital Government (SNDG), under the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI), is at the forefront of the Singapore Government’s digital transformation. We shape and implement strategies and policies to achieve our vision of a Digital Government that is Digital to the core, and serves with heart. This includes building long-term digital capabilities for the public sector, driving innovation across Government agencies, and ensuring digital services are user-centric, secure and resilient.
The Government Data Division (GDD) within SNDG plays a central policymaking role in advancing data governance excellence across the public sector. Its responsibilities include:
(a) formulating and implementing whole-of-government (WOG) data policies that guide the strategic management, sharing, and utilisation of data as a national asset;
(b) identifying and driving new initiatives to improve the exchange of data within Government agencies, and sharing of Government data with commercial partners and the public; and
(c) strengthening data governance by developing policies relating to responsible use of data, as well as driving the development of capabilities, institutionalizing structures and standardising tools for WOG.
We want a change maker who has experience in policymaking, and is collaborative in stakeholder management. Experience in data management, governance or related domains will also be helpful.
You must be ready to roll up your sleeves and rally different teams across Government agencies to achieve SNG’s vision of a public sector that is ‘data driven to the core’. This includes enabling Government agencies to use data to create solutions that benefit citizens and businesses, while ensuring the responsible use of data.
You will be part of a team at the forefront of transforming Government data and driving the next bound of the whole-of-Government data ecosystem, through policy formulation and development of key systems and structures. Your work will involve one or more of the following areas:
Policy Development and Implementation. Formulate and implement key data policies across whole-of-Government, that cover data governance, data sharing policies, data classification frameworks, treatment and protection of personal data, as well as the accompanying legislative frameworks.
Stakeholder Engagement. Work closely with agencies to understand their use cases and governance context, and drive implementation. Provide advice on policies and measures, including arbitrating between competing needs where necessary.
Ecosystem Development. Design and implement the next bound of the Government data ecosystem, to supercharge data sharing and usage across whole-of-Government to enable agencies’ use cases in policy, operations and service delivery, while ensuring good data governance. This entails the following work:
Conceptualising a whole value chain perspective of the data ecosystem, including how the pieces should come together to best facilitate the sharing and usage of data underpinned by proper governance frameworks.
Developing the system-level roles and responsibilities that agencies need to play, as part of the broader data value chain perspective.
Capability building for effective implementation (e.g. establish centres of excellence to drive though leadership, establish funding principles and resource allocation).
Integrating the Policy-Tech “handshake” with Government Technology Agency colleagues to ensure the ecosystem architecture and data products support policy objectives.
This role offers a unique opportunity to shape policy and drive change implementation across the public sector, with significant impact on how Government agencies access and use data effectively and responsibly for policy analysis, service delivery and operations.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) - Octopus by RTG
jobs.text:
We are looking for an experienced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the technical vision, architecture, and technology strategy for a next-generation digital wealth management platform. The platform includes native iOS and Android applications, a web-based administration portal, and an AI-powered investment and advisory engine.
As CTO, you will be responsible for defining the platform's long-term technology direction, architecture, security, and governance while partnering closely with the Engineering Director, AI Engineering team, Product, and business stakeholders. This is a strategic leadership position focused on technology vision, technical governance, and business alignment rather than day-to-day software development.
Key Responsibilities
Technology Strategy & Architecture
Define and own the end-to-end architecture for mobile applications, web platforms, AI services, backend systems, and cloud infrastructure.
Establish technology standards, architectural principles, and engineering best practices.
Lead architectural decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and real-time data platforms.
Drive technology roadmaps, architecture evolution, scalability, and technical debt management.
Define non-functional requirements including scalability, performance, availability, resilience, and security.
AI & Innovation
Define the organization's AI strategy and oversee the integration of AI-powered capabilities.
Guide the development of LLM-powered services, conversational AI, and intelligent automation.
Establish AI governance frameworks covering model quality, explainability, monitoring, bias mitigation, auditability, and regulatory compliance.
Ensure AI solutions meet business objectives while operating within regulated financial environments.
Security & Compliance
Own the platform's security architecture, including authentication, authorization, encryption, API security, and identity management.
Ensure compliance with financial regulations, data privacy laws, and security standards across all markets.
Oversee disaster recovery, business continuity, and platform resilience strategies.
Establish governance for audit trails, compliance reporting, and regulatory readiness.
Engineering Leadership
Provide technical leadership across engineering teams and resolve complex architectural challenges.
Lead architecture reviews, technical governance, and engineering decision-making.
Define engineering standards, technical hiring criteria, and technology best practices.
Identify technical risks and ensure mitigation strategies are implemented throughout the product lifecycle.
Executive Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary technology advisor to executive leadership, clients, investors, and strategic partners.
Translate complex technical concepts into business-focused recommendations.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Project Management teams to align technology delivery with business goals.
Support client engagements, pre-sales activities, RFP responses, and investor presentations.

jobs.title: Medical Director, Clinical Product
jobs.text:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare by building technology that clinicians actually love to use. Our flagship platform, Counterpart Assistant, is a cloud-based, value-based care enablement AI platform designed to empower primary care providers to detect, manage, and prevent chronic diseases earlier. We believe that better technology supporting PCPs at the point of care leads to better clinician experiences and better patient outcomes.
We are seeking a Medical Director of Clinical Product to serve as a clinical voice and provider advocate within our product organization.
In this role, you won't just be advising from the sidelines; you will be a key partner and guiding force for cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, and Design. Drawing on deep, real-world primary care experience, you will help shape how our software integrates into the daily rhythms of busy practice environments. You will ensure our technology solves real clinical pain points for primary care providers, driving clinical care outcomes that enhance the patient-provider relationship.
As a Medical Director, Clinical Product, you will:
Lead Clinical Product Development: Serve as a key clinical voice across cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics), ensuring every feature built reflects the reality of everyday practice and drives clinical utility.
Translate Clinical Reality to Product Design: Bridge the gap between clinical practice and software development. Translate complex care workflows, documentation needs, and value-based care levers into clear, actionable clinical requirements.
Be the Voice of our Clinician Users: Work alongside user research and analytics to synthesize provider feedback, champion the end-user experience, and hold product teams accountable to high standards of clinical usability and safety.
Drive Quality & Pre-Launch Standards: Establish pre-launch clinical QA standards and validation processes to guarantee that new platform tools are intuitive, safe, and efficient before they reach clinicians.
Monitor Industry Trends: Stay ahead of emerging technologies and evolving practices in primary care and value-based care to identify unmet user needs and future product opportunities.
Success in this role looks like:
Uncompromising Clinical Voice: Cross-functional teams actively look to you for clear clinical direction, trusted clinical insight, and clear prioritization of provider needs.
Adding to a Seamless Cross-Functional Alignment: A collaborative, high-execution environment where clinical, product, and engineering teams operate with shared clarity and mutual accountability.
You should get in touch if:
Clinical Degree: Active MD or DO with board certification in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Geriatrics, or a related primary care field.
10+ Years of Primary Care Practice: At least 10 years of direct patient care experience in primary care settings, with strong preference given to deep experience in community-based practice settings.
Health Tech Integration: Proven track record (3+ years) participating in health technology product, integration, EHR optimization, or clinical informatics within a practice setting.
Clinical Leadership: Demonstrated capability to command respect, lead cross-functional discussions, and guide non-clinical teams toward sound clinical decisions.
Execution & Accountability: A decisive, execution-focused mindset with the ability to set high performance standards and hold cross-functional partners accountable.
Preferred:
Value-Based Care Expertise: Deep familiarity with value-based care workflows, risk adjustment, quality metrics (HEDIS/Stars), and care management levers in primary care.
Product Collaboration: Prior experience partnering directly with product management, UX designers, and software engineers in a healthtech or digital health environment.
Benefits Overview:
Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.
Additional Perks:
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
Reimbursement for office setup expenses
Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
Paid parental leave for all new parents
And much more!
About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.
Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.
With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.
Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.
#LI-REMOTE
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company.
Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.
A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is:
$253,800—$330,000 USD
