jobs.title: Associate Director, Maintenance and Reliability Engineering
jobs.text:
Associate Director, Reliability (MRE)
As the Associate Director, Reliability (MRE), you will oversee the team of reliability engineers, the reliability planner/scheduler, CMMS systems, Quality Engineering, and industrial SMEs in refrigeration, kitchen equipment, and other critical utilities. You'll also take direct ownership of all life-cycle maintenance projects across US sites — including utility expansion/modification, new equipment installation (in coordination with engineering), and refrigeration system projects. You'll lead hands-on, engaging, motivating, and coaching your team members directly. Partnering with M&RE senior leadership, you'll define, develop, and deliver the facilities maintenance roadmap and set the standard for operational efficiency at your fulfillment center.
You will…
• Oversee MRE-related projects, including facilities maintenance across electrical, refrigeration, building, and grounds
• Asset Performance: Implement Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), root cause analysis (RCA), and failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) to reduce downtime.
• Motivate, engage, coach, and inspire a team of specialists — building a positive team dynamic that encourages feedback and drives change from within
• Manage outside vendors and facilitate planned and unplanned Life cycle repairs/replacements
• Ensure maintenance regulations are followed
• Maintain a current list of contractors to ensure emergency repairs are handled promptly
• Identify problems and brainstorm improvement ideas for the fulfillment center/s
You are…
• Customer Centric: You're passionate about delivering on commitments to your customers
• Bold: You have passion and grit; you're not afraid to give feedback to your team and your manager
• Agile: You roll with the punches, adapt quickly to change, and deliver results in a fast-paced, autonomous environment
• Decisive: You know when making a decision is as important as the time it takes to make it
• Problem-solver: You know there's no one-size-fits-all approach; you think outside the box and enjoy deep-diving issues to find solutions
You have…
• 10+ years' experience managing facilities maintenance/operations and reliability within the Food/Beverage/Perishables/Distribution industry
• Bachelor's degree is preferred, in Mechanical, Electrical, or another related engineering field
• Interested in spending most of your time on the shop floor, working directly with all levels of staff
• High level of integrity and ethics with excellent follow-through
• Excitement for working in a start-up environment with high ambiguity and change
• Effective communication skills across employees, direct reports, cross-functional teams, and senior leadership
• Well-versed in OSHA regulations and compliance; OSHA certification a plus
• Exposure to mechanical, electrical, automation, and refrigeration systems
• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, manuals, and schematics
• Comfortable working in cold environments (some areas as low as 0°F)
• Flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and/or nights
You’ll get…
Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation, & team bonus opportunities
Generous PTO and flexible attendance policy
Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)
Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

jobs.title: Head of Data(Data Engineering + Machine Learning)
jobs.text:
About Easyship:
Easyship is a leading global shipping software and API platform trusted by 100,000+ eCommerce merchants to compare couriers, automate fulfilment, and simplify cross-border shipping, taxes and duties. A top-rated Shopify Certified Technology Provider, eBay preferred fulfilment partner, and Amazon preferred multi-channel integrator, Easyship is the G2 category leader (April 2026), offering 550+ courier services worldwide. We believe in accelerating borderless commerce through innovative solutions, and we're proud that brands of all sizes from small business to enterprise trust Easyship for all their shipping needs.
Who We’re Looking For:
We are looking for a Head of Data to join our leadership team and define the future of data at Easyship, from strategy and infrastructure to AI innovation and business enablement. This role is pivotal in transforming how we use data to make decisions, innovate, and scale. You'll lead the charge in unlocking the value of data across the business, driving operational efficiency, product intelligence, and long-term strategic advantage.
What you additionally need to know:
This is a full-time, onsite role based in our Bengaluru (MG Road) office. The role follows UK collaboration hours (11:00AM–8:00PM IST) to support seamless cross-regional execution.
What would be you be responsible for:
Owning and defining our company-wide Data & AI strategy, ensuring it's tightly aligned with Easyship’s business goals.
Leading and scaling a high-performing data team across analytics, data engineering, and (eventually) data science.
Championing AI and machine learning initiatives, supporting the company’s evolution toward a smarter, more automated product.
Collaborating with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to ensure data is accessible, actionable, and impactful.
Guiding architectural decisions, including analytics platforms, infrastructure, and tooling — even if not hands-on day-to-day.
Ensuring data quality, governance, and compliance, fostering trust in the data we use to make critical decisions.
Prioritising based on ROI, helping the company focus on initiatives that move the needle.
Enabling self-serve analytics, giving stakeholders the tools and knowledge to answer their own questions.
Driving a culture of experimentation, insight, and continuous improvement.
You Might Be a Good Fit If…
You have 7+ years of experience as a Head of Data or senior data leadership role.
You are a strategic thinker who understands how data drives business growth and operational excellence.
You have excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills, capable of aligning leadership and technical teams around a shared vision.
You have a deep understanding of AI/ML concepts and application, with a proven ability to deliver PoCs and pilots.
You have experience scaling and managing data teams, including hiring, mentorship, and team development.
You are familiar with modern data architecture and pipelines; bonus points if you've worked with GCP and tools like BigQuery, Looker, or DBT.
You possess resourcefulness, resilience, self-motivation, and the ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial, team-based environment, balancing long-term vision with short-term delivery needs.
You have a "Data-First" approach and strong analytical skills, using ROI assessment methodologies to prioritize initiatives.
You are skilled in influencing and collaborating with distributed global teams, willing to roll up your sleeves when needed and unblock teams to move quickly.
If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you.
What we bring to the table as an employer:
Generous remuneration and stock units
Comprehensive health coverage
We reimburse gym and wellness expenses so you can invest in your health
Zomato digital meal credits and pantry full of wholesome snacks to keep you fueled through the workday
The freedom to‘Work from Anywhere’ for 4 weeks in a year
Generous vacation policy, plus duvet days and mental health days to truly recharge
How we value inclusion in our recruitment practices:
Easyship is an equal opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions—recruiting, hiring, pay, benefits, training, promotion, leave, and separation—based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, veteran or military status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.
How did the story of Easyship start? Find out below.

jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.text:
Do you want to love what you do at work? Do you want to make a difference, an impact, transform peoples lives? Do you want to work with a team that believes in disrupting the normal, boring, and average?
If yes, then this is the job you're looking for ,webook.com is Saudi's #1 event ticketing and experience booking platforms in terms of technology, features, agility, revenue serving some of the largest mega events in the Kingdom surpassing over 2 billion sales.
Role Overview
Own webook’s data function end-to-end strategy, team, platform and delivery and be the single person accountable for data at webook. Turn our first-party data into trusted decisions today and a monetisable asset within two to three years, in a regulated environment (PDPL / GDPR / NCA ECC) where data we cannot trust or lawfully use is worthless. Build and lead the team, make the platform reliable, and set webook up to sell data and insight, not just tickets.
What You’ll Own
1. Data Strategy & Roadmap
Produce webook’s first documented data strategy and a phased, costed roadmap within 60 days of start, endorsed by the VP Architecture, Platform & AI and the CTO.
Define the target operating model for the data function engineering, analytics, governance and the sequence in which it is built.
Own the data platform direction. Lead the managed-vs-self-hosted decision and present a costed recommendation within 90 days, with a clear cost-control model.
Align every data initiative to a measurable business outcome; re-prioritise the roadmap quarterly as the economics move.
2. Team Leadership & Building the Function
Assess, develop and where needed strengthen the existing team; set a clear performance bar and build the capability to meet it.
Set quarterly OKRs for each direct report; hold fortnightly 1:1s with written notes; run a monthly team standup with a rolling 90-day delivery view shared with VP Architecture and the CTO.
Be a genuine people leader: develop talent and career paths, mentor, and build an engaged, high-performing team. Retention and engagement are explicit success measures, not afterthoughts.
3. Data Platform & Engineering
Be accountable for reliable, tested, observable pipelines client-facing dashboards accurate and current, with stale or broken data caught before a client ever sees it.
Own the platform direction across the modern data stack warehouse / lakehouse, transformation (dbt), orchestration, BI and serving — making pragmatic build/buy and managed/self-host calls across open-source (ClickHouse, Superset) and major managed platforms (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks).
Institute FinOps discipline: a clear monthly platform budget with alerting; own the platform budget and keep cost predictable and under control.
Establish infrastructure-as-code, data observability, and clear SLAs for data delivery.
4. Analytics, Insight & Data Products
Establish a single source of truth and a governed metrics / semantic layer; eliminate conflicting metric definitions across the business.
Raise the bar on analytical quality for internal decisions and for client-facing insight.
Build the muscle to ship data products: embedded client analytics, benchmarking, and insight services.
Partner with product and commercial to define webook’s first paid data / insight product within 12 months, with a credible commercial case.
5. Data Governance, Quality & Privacy
Ensure data handling meets PDPL, GDPR and NCA requirements classification, access control, residency, and cross-border transfer.
Stand up a data catalog and data-quality standards with named ownership across data domains.
Define the lawful-basis and controls framework required before any data product ships — webook’s “licence to monetise.”
Coordinate closely with the Director of InfoSec & Cybersecurity and the GDPR Delivery Lead on data privacy and security.
6. Data Monetisation & Commercial Partnership
Own the path from internal analytics → embedded client insight → productised data, sequenced so trust is earned at each step.
Work with commercial leadership to size, package and price data and insight products.
Build the reliability and governance foundations that make external monetisation possible — and defensible.
7. Stakeholder Management & Data Culture
Be the trusted data partner to the executive team; translate technical work and data risk into commercial language.
Drive data literacy and a “data as a business enabler” culture; remove silos and shift data out of being treated as an IT by-product.
Represent data credibly with clients where insight is part of webook’s offering.

jobs.title: Platform & Data Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.
We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.
We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.
Role
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.
You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on
Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS.
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery.
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint.
Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like.

jobs.title: Tech Modernisation, Enterprise Architecture - Vice President
jobs.text:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honouring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do
Our Technology Advisory team provides independent, senior-level expertise that enables executives to drive value from Technology and enhancing business performance. We leverage extensive expertise to deliver rapid and sustainable impact across:
Digital and Technology strategy development, operating model, capability and governance design.
Technology and Product strategy and innovation, assisting our clients with the strategy and execution.
Defining and planning target architectures and roadmaps aligned to business objectives and plans including Data, Application/Integration and Technical/ Infrastructure architecture
Technology cost reduction, outsourcing and end to end Transformation.
Platform/systems/infrastructure assessments, re-platforming, rationalization and consolidation activities.
Technology due diligence, carve-out, and merger integration planning and execution.
IT crisis management, interim leadership roles, and project turnaround.
Central to our expertise is the technology strategy, organisation, applications and infrastructure which underpins any successful end-to-end transformation. We are looking for someone who has experience in Enterprise Architecture and how to define and design target state solutions, transition strategies and roadmaps, capability needs and the associated risks. This should ideally be coupled with prior consulting experience.
At AlixPartners, you will work closely with our clients to address strategic, operational, and technological challenges. Your skill in bridging the gap between technology and business will be crucial for delivering measurable results and driving business value.
This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.
What you’ll need
Preferably you will have a mix of consulting and industry experience, with an ability to deliver small projects and/or working across multiple workstreams of larger projects.
Previous practical experience as an Enterprise Architect, with proven experience in designing enterprise-wide technology solutions working with business and technology teams
A good understanding of software delivery, infrastructure, operations and governance.
Experience conducting rapid digital diagnostics and maturity assessments to assess technological capabilities and identifying maturity gaps.
Ability to define pragmatic steps and roadmaps to drive business value.
Experience of architecting target states and complex solutions in a variety of environments, using different methodologies, frameworks, tools and software
You demonstrate a keen personal interest in Technology and remain up to date in the latest trends, tools and impacts of Technology on industry.
You are passionate about driving IT effectiveness and enabling clients to achieve their business objectives.
Excellent communication and presentation capabilities, comfortable speaking to senior non-technical clients.
Outstanding analytical and critical thinking skills along with strong financial literacy.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday
Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organisation.
The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.
The benefit type and level differ per location.
AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

jobs.title: Director - AI Engineering
jobs.text:
About V2
V2 is an AI-native consultancy of 100+ people helping enterprises move from AI ambition to production. We hold Anthropic Select partner status alongside AWS and Databricks partnerships, and we build with Claude at the core of everything we deliver: agentic AI, Claude Code, AI-native software delivery (AI-DLC) and enterprise platform modernisation. We are scaling across ANZ and APJ, with Singapore as the beachhead for regional expansion.
About the Role
We are looking for a Director, who is deeply technical with strong lived experience across software engineering, cloud-native architecture, AI systems, and AWS ecosystems. You are also very comfortable in pre-sales and have a deep understanding of professional services.
This is a leadership role responsible for helping customers modernise platforms, accelerate software delivery, and operationalise AI at enterprise scale.
You will lead technical strategy sessions, shape complex solution architectures, and oversee the successful delivery of customer engagements. You are equally comfortable discussing software engineering patterns, cloud architecture, platform modernisation, GenAI applications, and enterprise delivery models with technical teams and C-level stakeholders.
As a Director, you are both a technical and people leader, with credibility across the engineering community, customer executive stakeholders, and the AWS partner ecosystem. You bring a strong balance of pre-sales, delivery leadership, commercial acumen, and thought leadership, helping customers move from strategy to production outcomes.
You will have broad expertise across:
Software Engineering, AI & GenAI, Cloud-Native Architecture, AWS, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Modern Application Development, AI Engineering, Security, and Enterprise Transformation.
What You'll Own
Advising customers on software, platform, cloud, and AI strategy
Leading solution architecture and technical design workshops
Designing and overseeing delivery of enterprise-scale software and AI solutions
Acting as a trusted technical advisor across AWS, software engineering, and AI transformation
Leading the successful delivery of engagements and mentoring teams on those engagements
Driving technical pre-sales, solution shaping, and opportunity qualification
Scoping complex programs of work and providing realistic estimations, delivery models, and commercial guidance
Building strong relationships across the AWS partner ecosystem and customer stakeholders
Collaborating with marketing and practice leads to produce external-facing thought leadership, accelerators, blogs, demos, and technical collateral
Acting as a public-facing technology leader, speaking at conferences, meetups, podcasts, and customer events
Helping attract, interview, and mentor future technical talent into the business
Contributing to the development of internal engineering standards, reusable accelerators, AI capabilities, and delivery IP
Requirements
Leadership & Commercial
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise software, cloud, and AI transformation programs
Strong leadership & mentorship capability with experience guiding high-performing technical teams
Demonstrated success in technical pre-sales, solution shaping, and enterprise customer engagement
Experience scoping, estimating, and structuring complex Statements of Work (SOWs) and delivery programs
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders from engineering teams through to C-level executives
Technical Expertise
Demonstrable expertise designing and implementing modern software engineering and cloud-native architectures
Deep hands-on experience across AWS services and ecosystem, including modern application architecture and cloud platform design
Strong understanding of AI engineering and Generative AI, including enterprise adoption patterns, LLM-based systems, agentic workflows, APIs, RAG, MCP, orchestration, and production AI considerations
Proven ability to architect and implement scalable, secure, enterprise-grade solutions
Strong background in software engineering practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, testing strategies, platform engineering, observability, and secure-by-design approaches
Experience modernising enterprise platforms and legacy systems through cloud migration and software transformation
Understanding of security, governance, compliance, and operational excellence in enterprise environments
Growth & Industry Presence
Strong professional network across the software, AI, and AWS ecosystem
A track record of contributing to thought leadership, customer engagement, blogs, presentations, conferences, or community events
Continuous learner mindset with a commitment to certifications, emerging technologies, and industry trends
Apply Now:
If you’re passionate about leading AI-powered full stack projects, building scalable applications, and shaping the future of AI consulting, APPLY NOW and join V2 AI!

jobs.title: Director UX Design
jobs.text:
About HelloFresh
HelloFresh Group reaches more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of 8 consumer brands — from meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to pet food and specialty products. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America: the apps, the personalization, the discovery moments, and everything in between that turns food into something people genuinely look forward to.
Design is core to how we compete. Our Consumer UX team designs end-to-end experiences across all 8 brands, and we hold a high quality bar — internally, our “zest-appeal” framework defines design excellence from baseline usability through to best-in-class, surprise-and-delight craft. We are also moving fast to an AI-native way of working, where AI rethinks discovery, prototyping, and the path from design to code. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.
About the role
This year we are doubling down on craft, execution, and design leadership. In a world where it is easier than ever to get software to 75% built, it is the last 25% — the polish, the motion, the detail customers actually feel — that decides whether a consumer experience is merely useful or genuinely loved. Millions of people open our apps every week to feed themselves and their families; the final 10% is the difference between a transaction and a habit.
This is a build-and-scale role, not a maintenance one. We are hiring a design leader to own a consumer experience domain within the Consumer mega alliance, raise the quality bar across it, grow a high-performing team, and build the design-technology and AI-native capability that turns ambitious ideas into beautifully executed, shipped products. We need a maker and a leader who leads through the work — not a strategy-only or people-management-only role.
The level — Director or Senior Director — will be set by the candidate’s experience and the final scope of the domain. We are open to both.
What You’ll Do: The Recipe
Lead from the front. Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary team — UX, UI, content, and localization — across multiple consumer surfaces. Stay hands-on in the work: review designs, jump into critiques, and drive clarity.
Turn ambiguity into clarity. Solve problems from first principles, not templates. Help your team make hard decisions, focus on outcomes over process, and install just the right amount of structure and rigour to ship great work at speed.
Set and uphold an extremely high craft bar. From UX flow to polished UI — layout, typography, motion, micro-interaction, and visual storytelling. Be the design-quality amplifier who notices the details others miss and pushes work to where it needs to be, coaching the team to our quality tenets.
Own a consumer experience domain end-to-end. Take accountability for the quality and delivery of experiences across the customer journey, from problem framing to shipped product across our brands and 16 markets. Drive design excellence through every detail.
Build design-technology capability. Champion and scale our design system (Zest) and modern UI foundations. Close the gap between design and engineering through prototyping, design-to-code workflows, and component quality — making design and engineering faster together.
Make us AI-native. Treat AI as an active part of how design gets done — accelerating discovery, generating and validating prototypes, and shortening design-to-delivery. Define the quality bar AI-assisted workflows must meet, and help the company rewrite how consumer products get built in the AI era.
Partner deeply with Product and Engineering. Align on priorities, make tradeoffs, unblock delivery, and move fast. Advocate clearly and persistently for the right experience, and raise the ambition of the partners around you.
What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients
Team leadership. A track record of leading and growing high-performing design teams in product-first, consumer (B2C) companies — hiring, coaching, and developing designers at all levels, from IC to managers.
High agency. You thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, push for the right solution rather than the convenient one, and lean in to make things happen without waiting for permission.
A bias to ship. Demonstrated success driving teams to ship great software at scale, not just making decks about it — owning execution across a product line and a portfolio of features.
Exceptional craft and product taste. Strong visual and interaction sensibility and a high personal bar for detail. You know what great looks like for a consumer audience, and you can help teams get there — across hierarchy, motion, and micro-interaction.
Design-technologist mindset. Fluency at the design–engineering boundary: design systems, component architecture, prototyping in code or advanced tools, and a practical grasp of front-end constraints.
AI-native practice. You already use AI across the design workflow — for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design-to-code — and have a point of view on scaling it responsibly with a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma, Claude, and similar is expected.
Scale and systems thinking. Experience designing and maintaining quality across a multi-brand or multi-market consumer ecosystem, balancing consistency with brand-specific character.
What Success Looks Like
Your team consistently delivers high-quality consumer product work at speed.
You have hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and execution maturity.
Experience quality in your domain is visibly higher — the last 10% is sweated, and it shows in what customers feel.
Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.
Design systems and AI-native workflows in your domain make the whole team faster without sacrificing craft.
You are a key player in shaping how HelloFresh builds consumer product in the AI era — writing new playbooks, not following old ones.
What We Offer: The Toppings
Scale and impact. Shape experiences for 6+ million customers across 8 brands and 16 markets.
A craft-and-AI-first culture. Leadership that champions experience quality, innovation, and AI-native ways of working from the top of the organization.
Real ownership. End-to-end accountability for your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.
Growth. A defined leadership track and the chance to expand scope as the alliance scales.
Global collaboration. Work with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech’s international teams.

jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.text:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.
As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.
Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI): Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.
Amplitude is moving fast, from product analytics to an AI-native platform with agents embedded across the product, used by over 4,700 companies. We are looking for a strong design leader with a builder mindset to lead a 15-person design team through the next phase of growth.
This is a player-coach role. You manage and grow the team. You also stay in the actual work: elevating quality through feedback, pairing with designers on the hardest UX puzzles, and asking the right questions to unlock the crux of the problem. You'll know every product surface well enough to raise its quality — even if you don't own any single one end-to-end.
Designers are embedded in autonomous pods and need to keep shipping fast. Maintaining speed without compromising on coherence and quality is the job. If that tension sounds like an exciting problem to solve rather than a contradiction to complain about, keep reading.
What you'll do
Build the team. Hire, grow, and retain a high-performing design team, identifying people who will thrive and raise the bar at Amplitude. Develop them through direct, specific feedback. Help someone who's stuck get moving again.
Set direction. Drive the design strategy for Amplitude's product suite: Core Amplitude, Statsig, and Wave (a proactive agent that helps teams build self-improving products). Help define how agents and humans work together in the same workflows.
Champion craft. Strong visual design builds trust, clarity, and delight in the era of AI. Lead by example, elevating the quality of the product through exceptional design execution.
Hold a high bar. AI makes it cheap to ship UI changes, which makes it easy for quality to erode quietly. Set a clear standard for what good looks like and enforce it without becoming an approval bottleneck.
Stay in production. You believe that “the design” is what ships. Code is the material that brings the design to life. Push on the details, the papercuts, the edge cases.
Speak for the customer. Show up in leadership conversations as the voice of the customer, pushing for solutions that genuinely serve their needs and reduce complexity.
What we're looking for
You've managed senior, independent IC designers and earned their respect through product and craft judgment.
You've shipped products that moved real customer and business metrics, fast.
You've created (not inherited) structure inside of a messy, high-growth organization.
You've shipped AI-native experiences and use AI tools in your own practice today (we'll ask what you built and what you learned).
Your portfolio shows both systems-level thinking and pixel-level craft.
Bonus: You’ve designed for both technical and non-technical users, and can hold that tension without compromising the experience for either.
Bonus: Experience with Analytics, Experimentation, or Developer tools.
What this is not
Not an executive role that manages up and delegates down. You're deep in the work.
Not a pure IC role. You're accountable for a team of 15.
Not design ops. Your job isn't to add rituals, templates, or governance.
Not the approval committee. Pods keep moving; you create coherence without becoming the bottleneck.
Our values:
At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:
Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.
Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.
Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.
Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.
We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.
Some of our benefit programs include:
Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans
401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually
Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more
Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more
Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support
Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions
Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)
Other fun facts about Amplitude:
Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.
We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.
We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.
We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.
We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.
We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.
Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
This role is eligible for equity, benefits and other forms of compensation.

By applying for this job, you acknowledge that Amplitude processes your personal data in accordance with the Amplitude Applicant Privacy Notice.
Staying Safe - Protect Yourself From Recruitment Fraud
We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Amplitude recruiters and/or hiring managers. Amplitude will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Amplitude recruiting team will come from an @amplitude.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

jobs.title: Head of Data Center Logistics Practice
jobs.text:
About Flexport:
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
Help Win New Business
The Opportunity:
We are scaling our dedicated Data Center practice, and we are looking for the person who will lead it. This is a founding commercial role. You will start as a team of one, owning the full sales motion end-to-end, and you will build the team around you as the practice grows. You will define how Flexport goes to market with hyperscalers, hardware OEMs, and the broader ecosystem. You will set the playbook, win the first marquee accounts, and hire the people who scale what you build. Reporting directly to the Regional General Manager, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy and direct access to executive leadership.
This role features a 50/50 compensation model (Base + Uncapped bonus, with accelerators), with OTEs of $500k+, designed for strong leaders who take bets on themselves.
Why This Role Is Different:
The data center logistics market is not a standard freight problem. A single AI compute rack can cost more than $1 million and weigh up to 4,000 pounds. Racks contain Class 9 dangerous goods (lithium-ion batteries) and liquid cooling systems requiring specialized handling. Construction sequencing failures delayed 57% of data center projects in 2025, meaning late freight isn’t just expensive, it can stop an entire build.
Flexport has built the capabilities this market demands:
98%+ air on-time performance for Fortune 500 data center customers, achieved through dedicated ground setups that pick up directly from the tarmac at major hubs.
White glove project management for complex deliveries—including Next Flight Out (NFO), 747-400F charter solutions for oversized equipment, and highly orchestrated last-mile delivery to active construction sites.
TAPA Level A, CTPAT, and Dangerous Goods certifications, with full CCTV warehouse coverage and shock, tilt, and temperature monitoring across all major hubs.
$900M+ saved in tariff exposure for customers over five years, with an AI-powered customs auditor that error-checks 100% of filings prior to submission—achieving a 0.2% error rate, roughly ten times better than the industry average.
A 24/7 digital control tower giving customers and their supply chain partners real-time visibility, milestone tracking, and proactive exception management.
You Will:
Own the full commercial motion for Flexport’s Data Center practice: from pipeline generation through close and expansion.
Build, inspire, and ultimately lead a high-performing sales team as the practice scales, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and developing Account Executives.
Define and execute a go-to-market strategy targeting hyperscalers, co-location providers, OEM hardware manufacturers, and EPC contractors across North America.
Establish and drive specific, targeted revenue goals and quotas; monitor and manage key performance metrics to ensure consistent performance.
Partner closely with Flexport’s operations teams and product teams to design and deliver mission-critical solutions.
Represent Flexport externally as a subject-matter authority in data center logistics: at industry events, in RFP processes, and in senior customer conversations.
Take an entrepreneurial approach: you are building something new inside a company with global scale, and you will bring both the vision and the execution.
You Should Have:
10+ years of overall professional experience, including direct experience selling complex, high-value logistics or supply chain solutions to Fortune 500 customers.
Deep familiarity with the data center, hyperscaler, co-location, or critical infrastructure ecosystem, either through direct sales, account management, or operational roles.
A demonstrated track record as a top-performing individual contributor and, ideally, early-stage team builder: you know what it takes to close, and you know how to build a team that closes.
The instincts and resilience to operate as a team of one while building toward scale.
Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving procurement, operations, logistics, and executive leadership.
Excellent analytical and commercial judgment: you can build and manage a pipeline, forecast accurately, and make strategic tradeoffs.
Exceptional communication skills and the ability to earn trust at every level, from AE to C-suite.
A “compliance first” attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.
You Will Get:
A 50/50 compensation model (base + uncapped bonus and accelerators) built for closers who bet on themselves.
Equity grants and comprehensive benefits.
Founding-level autonomy and direct access to executive leadership.
The mandate to build and lead the team as the practice scales.
#LI-onsite
The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base salary for the position in the posting's respective region. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range displayed, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and / or training. Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at Flexport, which also includes bonus, equity, and comprehensive benefit offerings such as medical, dental, and flexible time off.
The US base salary range for this position (this does not include bonus, equity and benefits):
$175,000—$250,000 USD
Commitment to Equal Opportunity
At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants
Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Job Purpose
Building world-class products like Cardano, Midnight and RealFi requires not just brilliant engineers, but a living ecosystem where standards, habits and ways of working compound over time. The CTO is the person who builds that ecosystem.
Working at the intersection of strategy and code, the CTO partners with the CEO to define the engineering direction, align the CPO and COO to keep the roadmap sound and moving at pace, and work with IO Labs to bring the most promising ideas from research into reality. They shape how IOG builds in an AI-first world, embedding an agentic programming philosophy that makes AI a genuine force multiplier across every team. And they grow the people who make all of this possible, through a Centre of Excellence that sets the technical standard for every product and venture IOG builds next.
CTO Accountabilities
Work with the CEO to define the future engineering strategy for IOG.
Own enterprise technology and architectural direction.
Shape the developer ecosystem: the standards, culture, tooling, and working practices that determine how IOG builds software.
AI-first engineering: developing and embedding an agentic programming philosophy across IOG - establishing how engineers and AI agents work together to build and ship at pace in an agent-driven world.
Working closely with the COO and CPO to ensure the roadmap is technically sound, resourced appropriately, and delivered at velocity.
Venture viability: partnering with IO Labs and ventures to assess whether new ideas are technically feasible, advising on build approach, and ensuring promising concepts can move quickly from research to reality.
Respect the autonomy of advanced ventures, while ensuring they remain aligned with the wider ecosystem.
Technical direction and architecture: the technology thesis, the standards all teams follow, and the decisions that keep IOG’s platforms coherent, scalable, and secure.
The engineering bench: attracting and developing world-class engineers through a Centre of Excellence model - setting the technical standard and ensuring it propagates across product and venture teams.
Holds enterprise-level budget responsibility within the technology function, including infrastructure, tooling, AI compute, and strategic technology investments.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Tax Platform (Bangkok-based)
jobs.text:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Founded in 2005 by two entrepreneurs passionate about making it easier for everyone to explore the world, we are now part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) with a diverse team of more than 7,000 people from over 90 nationalities working in offices across the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences through millions of accommodation options, flights, and activities worldwide.
Data and technology sit at the heart of how we work. We run thousands of experiments a year, ship fast, and use insights to drive decisions at scale. If you are excited to help build the future of travel for the world, Agoda is the place to do it.
Get to know our team
In Product, ideas come alive. We are a product-centric organization where teams have end-to-end ownership and minimal bureaucracy. Our Product Managers move fast, test and learn, and are empowered to change any system in the company if it improves outcomes for our customers, partners, or people.
The Tax product team sits within the FinTech product organisation, which owns platforms which power payment processing, financial operations and compliance for Agoda. These platforms are critical for Agoda to be able to launch new business models and products for our customers efficiently and in a compliant way.
The opportunity
This role is BANGKOK-BASED, RELOCATION PROVIDED, reporting into the VP of Product, FinTech.
As Director of Product - Tax Platform, you will directly manage a team of senior product managers and have end-to-end ownership of Agoda’s proprietary tax platform, which powers indirect tax for our business worldwide. You will define and drive Agoda's product strategy to rapidly evolving global tax regulation, and oversee the multi-year transformation of our tax platform to be ready for the future needs of the business.
This is a high stakes, high visibility role sitting within the FinTech leadership team, with expected frequent engagement with Agoda’s leadership team and other Booking Holdings brands’ executives.
In this role, you’ll get to
Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Agoda’s global tax platform covering tax master data, tax determination, invoicing/e‑invoicing, reconciliation, tax reporting, and indirect tax controls.
Partner with Group Tax to translate regulatory, audit, and business requirements into clear product outcomes and platform capabilities.
Lead product teams on large multi-year transformation initiatives to deliver a tax platform that can support multiple products, business models, and brands at Agoda and within the wider Booking Holdings Group.
Make buy‑vs‑build decisions for tax engines, e‑invoicing providers, and related services, and own the long-term integration strategy with external vendors and internal platforms.
Work closely with engineering leads to shape architecture, prioritize technical investments and ensure the platform can operate reliably for our business’ scale
Design and champion strong governance for tax configuration and change management,
Drive clear success metrics and reporting for tax platform initiatives and regularly communicate progress to senior leadership.
What you’ll need to succeed
10+ years in product management or similar roles, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (Director, Head of Product, or equivalent).
Proven track record building or transforming in-house tax platforms at large-scale digital businesses (ecommerce, marketplace, OTA, mobility, or similar) in regulated and time-sensitive environments
Deep command of indirect tax for digital businesses — VAT/GST, marketplace and deemed-supplier regimes, withholding tax — and how these translate into system and data requirements.
Hands-on experience across the core tax platform stack: tax master data, rules configuration, tax determination, invoicing/e-invoicing, reconciliation, and reporting controls.
Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous, multi‑year problems into a clear sequence of product milestones, with strong judgment on where to start, what to defer, and how to manage risk.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex tax and platform topics in simple terms to senior non‑technical stakeholders, and to drive alignment across diverse teams.
Comfortable working from our Bangkok office (hybrid model) and collaborating with globally distributed teams.
It’s great if you have
Experience integrating or working with leading indirect tax engines, e‑invoicing providers, or tax content vendors, and understanding their typical strengths and limitations.
Familiarity with large-scale financial and data platforms (for example ERP, consolidation/reporting tools, and financial data pipelines) and how tax systems interact with them.
Background in a quantitative or technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or similar), or relevant professional qualifications in Tax or Accounting combined with strong product and systems exposure.
Experience working in multicultural, high-growth environments and navigating the complexity of operating across many countries and tax jurisdictions.
Equal Opportunity Employer

We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications.
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering — Engineering Acceleration
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
The platforms in our Engineering Acceleration org dictate how thousands of Roblox engineers ship, and how every backend service gets built, deployed, and kept reliable at scale. They sit on the critical path for production reliability, developer velocity, and security posture. Reporting to Andrew Swerdlow, you will rethink the entire engineering toolchain from the ground up to be agentic-native, creating a world where AI agents are first-class participants in software development and humans set direction and supervise. This is a unique opportunity to define what modern engineering infrastructure looks like at one of the largest platforms in the world.
You will:
Reimagine the engineering toolchain as agentic-native, designing the platforms, guardrails, and feedback loops that let AI agents safely drive migrations, validation, and routine operational work.
Set a bold technical direction for AI-driven quality, including agent-generated tests, automated coverage of untested paths, intelligent verification, and continuous-deployment workflows.
Make software quality and SEV prevention a measurable property of the platform by investing in safe-change mechanisms, automated verification, progressive rollout, and fast, reliable rollback.
Drive down operational toil through automation, transforming manual, repeat work like patching and large-scale migrations into self-serve or agent-driven workflows.
Own and drive the roadmap, aligning cross-pod plans and execution against company goals for safe rollouts.
You have:
Experience leading and growing engineering teams (including managing managers and/or senior ICs), with a strong people-development track record.
Strong technical depth in backend/distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, enabling you to engage credibly on system design and technical decisions.
A track record delivering internal developer platforms, CI/CD, or deployment systems at scale for many internal customers and services.
A strong point of view on how AI/agentic tooling changes engineering workflows, coupled with hands-on familiarity with the modern AI engineering stack, AI coding tools, eval design, and open-weight models.
Demonstrated cross-organizational collaboration and excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous, multi-system problems into concrete, executable plans.
(Preferred) Backend proficiency in C# and/or Go, and familiarity with Kubernetes/Nomad (Hashistack), Temporal, and AWS.
(Preferred) Hands-on experience applying AI/agents to engineering workflows, with a background in safe/staged rollouts (canary, feature flags) and incident prevention/automated verification.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$399,420—$457,970 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: VP Product Managment
jobs.text:
We are making the future of Mobility come to life starting today.
At Autofleet, we empower the world's largest vehicle fleet operators and transportation providers to optimize existing operations and launch innovative, dynamic business models that drive efficiency and maximize utilization.
We are seeking an experienced VP Product Management to lead and grow our product management team. This leadership role will be crucial in defining and executing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap while fostering customer-centric innovation. The VP will work cross-functionally with engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success to deliver impactful products that transform the mobility industry.
Key Responsibilities:
Define and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy aligned with company goals.
Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of product managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Prioritize product roadmaps based on customer needs, market trends, and business impact.
Partner closely with engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams to ensure successful product delivery and adoption.
Engage with key customers and stakeholders to gather insights and validate product direction.
Drive data-informed decision making and track key performance metrics to measure success and identify opportunities.
Champion Agile product development methodologies and best practices across the organization.

jobs.title: Director, Corporate & Product Communications
jobs.text:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.
THE WORK:
Ripple is looking for a Director of Communications to lead the external narrative across several of its business lines. This is a senior, high-visibility role for a communications leader who can operate at the level of strategy and sharpen Ripple's voice with the institutional audiences – corporates, asset managers, and capital markets participants – that are imperative to our next phase of growth.
Sitting at the intersection of TradFi and digital assets, you will shape how the market understands Ripple's prime brokerage, treasury management and liquidity platforms. You’ll drive product announcements, own and implement the thought leadership that positions Ripple as the infrastructure layer for institutional finance, all through building strategic narratives hand in hand with senior company leaders.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Own the communications strategy across prime brokerage, treasury management and capital markets related products and partners – setting the narrative, managing the calendar, and driving consistent positioning across these product lines
Lead announcements end-to-end: partnerships, product launches, market infrastructure integrations, and capital markets milestones, with a keen eye for what moves media
Build and own Ripple's thought leadership program in corporate treasury and capital markets – placing executive bylines, managing high profile speaking opportunities for senior spokespeople, and establishing Ripple as the authoritative voice on the convergence of traditional finance and digital assets
Develop core messaging architecture that cuts across these product lines in service of the broader company mission and vision, clearly articulating Ripple's differentiation to corporates, asset managers, prime brokerage clients, and financial press
Build and maintain strong relationships with financial and institutional media across Bloomberg, Reuters, FT, WSJ, and other key capital markets and crypto trade press
Lead rapid-response and issues communications, ensuring Ripple's position on market events and regulatory developments is fast, accurate, and consistent
Partner closely with legal, compliance, product, marketing and others to integrate communications into the broader go-to-market strategy for Ripple's institutional platform
WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
8+ years in communications or PR, with substantial experience in financial services, capital markets, institutional fintech, and/or a major digital asset firm
Consistent track record placing stories at top-tier financial media and managing sophisticated, multi-product communications programs
Experience preparing and managing C-suite spokespeople across media and speaking engagements
Deep understanding of capital markets – prime brokerage, fixed income, FX, derivatives, and/or treasury – and how to communicate them to sophisticated audiences
Strong existing relationships with financial and crypto press; credibility in both TradFi and digital asset circles
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; sharp judgment and the ability to adapt quickly without losing precision
A self-starter AND great teammate – someone who wants to push boundaries, try new ideas, shake up the classic comms playbook, and have fun doing it. We don’t take ourselves too seriously – you shouldn’t either!
For positions that will be based in NY, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.
NY Annual Base Salary Range
$196,000—$240,000 USD
WHO WE ARE:
Do Your Best Work
The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!
Take Control of Your Finances
Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
Employee giving match
Mobile phone stipend
Take Care of Yourself
R&R days so you can rest and recharge
Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events
Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Structured Products
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Team
Our Trading Product Group leads the design of all the products on OKX's derivatives trading exchange, including spot trading, spot margin, futures, trading options, etc. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager/Product director to join our Structured Products team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the development and delivery of structured products, including defining and executing product strategy, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring that our products meet the needs of global traders in the opportunity discovery phase.
What You’ll Be Doing
Lead the planning and design of structured products, including principal-protected products, yield enhancement strategies, and custom payoff structures tailored to diverse user segments.
Develop short and medium-term product iteration plans and roadmaps, taking into account market situation, product life cycle, competitive landscape, and available resources.
Oversee project progress and cooperate with developers, designers, quantitative analysts, risk management, marketing, operations, and other departments.
Use data-driven thinking to explore the core logic that affects AUM growth and user growth; formulate and implement growth and operation strategies.
Responsible for managing user life-cycle (acquisition, retention, conversion, etc.) and enhancing the user journey experience across structured products.
Monitor and analyze market trends in crypto structured products, identify new opportunities and competitive threats, and translate insights into actionable product initiatives.
Collaborate with quantitative and risk teams to define product parameters, pricing models, and risk frameworks for new structured offerings.
What We Look For In You
Demonstrate a keen interest in blockchain and the financial industry, with a solid understanding of derivatives and structured finance concepts.
3+ years of product manager experience with a bachelor's degree or above; background in mathematics, economics, or related quantitative fields preferred.
Exhibit strong skills in product design and project management, with a particular proficiency in identifying user needs through data analysis and implementing growth strategies.
Showcase rigorous logical thinking, exceptional teamwork abilities, and effective communication skills; capable of orchestrating resources across various departments to address challenges and meet objectives.
Display a proactive, enthusiastic, and responsible attitude towards users and the team.
Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal); ability to work in a global, cross-timezone environment.
Nice-To-Haves
Possess a strong understanding of the structured products landscape.
Experience in trading or designing options, structured products, or related derivatives at a financial institution or crypto exchange.
CFA, FRM, or equivalent financial certification.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.
