jobs.title: Director, Engineering - Platform
jobs.text:
Reports to: Vice President, Engineering
Location: Remote US
Compensation: $240,000 to $300,000 base with bonus and equity
What We Do:
Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.
Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.
Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 14M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.
What You’ll Do:
Huntress seeks an experienced leader to elevate our platform engineering teams and deliver the underlying foundation for purpose-built products that protect the 99%. In this role, you’ll be responsible for teams that develop our product platform, which powers our 5 (soon to be 6 and beyond) industry-leading security products. We’re seeking a passionate, inclusive engineering leader who can bring state-of-the-art engineering practices and deep experience in developing teams and people to accelerate our next growth phase. You will lead multiple teams of high-performing engineers, equipped with the latest AI tooling.
At Huntress, we work with low walls between disciplines because we believe good ideas are everywhere and the best products come from teams working to deeply understand our customers, experiment, and validate our products.
Responsibilities:
Deliver performant, scalable products iteratively, helping your teams balance incremental customer value delivery with long-term product evolution
Drive the technical roadmap and best practices for our product platform to enable scalability that will accommodate rapid growth and increased user demand
Innovate new uses for AI development tooling and tune current use to be more efficient over time
Attract, recruit, and retain top engineering talent
Hire and coach engineering managers to continue to build and enable great teams
Set clear expectations with your leaders, provide regular feedback, and conduct regular performance conversations to foster a high-performing engineering team
Clearly measure engineering performance to make necessary adjustments to team structure and/or processes to increase throughput and efficiency
Identify opportunities and implement improvements to both the product and engineering practices and processes to optimize efficiency, quality, and time-to-market
Partner with other engineering leaders, product leaders, and architects to ensure our teams and technology are in sync and meet customer needs
Collaborate with Huntress’s Architecture, Product Management, and Threat Operations teams to integrate their expertise and needs into our products
What You Bring To The Team:
10+ years of experience in engineering leadership building SaaS products in a modern SaaS environment
5+ years of experience at the director level or higher
Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar AI development tools
Experience and knowledge of best practices for scalable delivery, core platform systems, site reliability engineering, and developer experience
Experience developing, evolving, and maintaining high-volume, scalable solutions
Deep understanding of organizing engineering teams to deliver customer value iteratively
Skilled at hiring, building teams, leading, and coaching managers, and performance management
Demonstrated success working with architecture and product management leaders to develop and execute a shared product and technical vision
Experience in a fully remote environment
What We Offer:
100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans
401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution
Life and Disability insurance plans
Stock options for all full-time employees
One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office
Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance
$75 USD/month digital reimbursement
Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth
Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.
We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.
We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.
Accommodations:
If you require reasonable accommodation to complete this application, interview, or pre-employment testing or participate in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to accommodations@huntresslabs.com. Please note that non-accommodation requests to this inbox will not receive a response.

These AI tools support our human recruiters in the initial review process, but do not make final hiring decisions without human involvement. By submitting your application, you acknowledge this use of AI in our recruitment process. Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice for more details on our practices and your data privacy rights.

jobs.title: Head of Brokerage, Product & Commercial Legal Department
jobs.text:
About us
Freedom Finance Europe Ltd is a regulated European online broker headquartered in Cyprus, providing access to US, European and Asian capital markets and a broad range of investment services and financial products. We operate in a fast-moving, highly regulated environment where product speed, client trust, marketing accuracy, regulatory discipline and legal architecture must work together. We are now strengthening our Legal Unit and looking for a senior legal leader to head one of its key expert departments.
About the role
The Head of Brokerage, Product & Commercial Legal Department will lead legal support of brokerage and commercial agreements, product launches, client-facing documentation, marketing materials, client complaints, GDPR/data and sanctions-related scenarios, MiFID-related matters, disclosures, prospectus-related work, and repeatable legal standards for the business.
This role is for a senior in-house lawyer who can combine financial services expertise, practical business judgement, leadership, speed of execution and the ability to build legal systems rather than only solve individual tasks
Responsibilities:
Working closely with the CLO - Lead, the legal support of the Company’s brokerage, product, commercial, client-facing, and marketing activities.
Own the department portfolio, priorities, workload allocation, quality control, escalation discipline and legal standards.
Act as the main escalation point for complex, high-risk, time-sensitive or strategically important matters within the department perimeter.
Provide senior legal assessment of new products, client journeys, sales channels, distribution models, marketing campaigns, client communications and commercial initiatives.
Translate MiFID II/MiFIR, CySEC requirements, applicable EU financial services rules, GDPR, sanctions, DORA and other relevant regulations into practical business requirements, red flags and execution routes.
Lead or supervise drafting, review and negotiation of brokerage, product and commercial agreements with clients, partners, counterparties, providers, data providers, banks, payment institutions, introducing brokers, sales channels, vendors and other third parties.
Own the legal quality and consistency of Terms of Business, disclosures, product terms, client forms, prospectus-related materials, website/platform wording, disclaimers and other client-facing documentation.
Set the legal review framework for marketing campaigns, claims, presentations, landing pages, sales materials and other regulated communications.
Lead legal strategy for complex client complaints, pre-dispute matters, reputationally sensitive cases, sanctions/restriction scenarios and asset-unblocking matters.
Build and maintain scalable legal tools: templates, playbooks, standard clauses, fallback positions, checklists, decision trees and escalation rules.
Work closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Client Support, IT, Document Management, Legal Operations and senior management.
Manage, mentor and develop Senior and Mid Legal Counsels within the department.
Coordinate with external legal advisers where needed and ensure their advice is converted into practical internal
standards and actions.

We are now strengthening our Legal Unit and looking for a senior legal leader to head one of its key expert departments.
About the role

The Head of Brokerage, Product & Commercial Legal Department will lead legal support of brokerage and commercial agreements, product launches, client-facing documentation, marketing materials, client complaints, GDPR/data and sanctions-related scenarios, MiFID-related matters, disclosures, prospectus-related work, and repeatable legal standards for the business.

This role is for a senior in-house lawyer who can combine financial services expertise, practical business judgement, leadership, speed of execution and the ability to build legal systems rather than only solve individual tasks
Responsibilities:

items: Working closely with the CLO - Lead, the legal support of the Company’s brokerage, product, commercial, client-facing, and marketing activities.
Own the department portfolio, priorities, workload allocation, quality control, escalation discipline and legal standards.
Act as the main escalation point for complex, high-risk, time-sensitive or strategically important matters within the department perimeter.
Provide senior legal assessment of new products, client journeys, sales channels, distribution models, marketing campaigns, client communications and commercial initiatives.

Translate MiFID II/MiFIR, CySEC requirements, applicable EU financial services rules, GDPR, sanctions, DORA and other relevant regulations into practical business requirements, red flags and execution routes.

Lead or supervise drafting, review and negotiation of brokerage, product and commercial agreements with clients, partners, counterparties, providers, data providers, banks, payment institutions, introducing brokers, sales channels, vendors and other third parties.

Own the legal quality and consistency of Terms of Business, disclosures, product terms, client forms, prospectus-related materials, website/platform wording, disclaimers and other client-facing documentation.
Set the legal review framework for marketing campaigns, claims, presentations, landing pages, sales materials and other regulated communications.
Lead legal strategy for complex client complaints, pre-dispute matters, reputationally sensitive cases, sanctions/restriction scenarios and asset-unblocking matters.
Build and maintain scalable legal tools: templates, playbooks, standard clauses, fallback positions, checklists, decision trees and escalation rules.
Work closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Client Support, IT, Document Management, Legal Operations and senior management.
Manage, mentor and develop Senior and Mid Legal Counsels within the department.
Coordinate with external legal advisers where needed and ensure their advice is converted into practical internal
standards and actions.

jobs.title: Head of Technology Practice
jobs.text:
Who we are:
Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.
WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com
For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
Burson France is seeking an accomplished and visionary Head of Technology Practice to lead and grow our dynamic technology portfolio. This pivotal leadership role is responsible for driving the strategic direction, growth, and operational excellence of Burson's Technology practice across France. Reporting directly to the CEO/Managing Director of Burson France, you will be critical in identifying and securing new business opportunities, ensuring high-quality client delivery, fostering team development, and championing innovation within the Burson brand. You will play a key role in protecting and promoting Burson's distinct approach to technology communications, directly contributing to the practice's revenue targets and elevating our reputation as a market leader.
What You'll Do:
Strategic growth and business development:
Own and drive technology revenue growth across France, identifying, securing, and expanding high-value client relationships.
Lead market-facing new business development, proactively originating opportunities, opening doors with net-new clients, and personally leading major pitches and conversions.
Build Burson’s technology proposition in France, expanding our footprint with existing clients, scaling multi-market engagements, and integrating broader Burson capabilities to deliver greater client value.
Client leadership and financial management:
Serve as a trusted senior advisor to France's most influential technology clients, providing strategic counsel to C-suite and senior stakeholders on complex communication challenges and program implementation.
Be accountable for overall profitability, quality, relationship management, and client satisfaction for all technology accounts.
Manage practice finances, including budget development, management, resourcing, and forecasting for the technology practice.
Team leadership and talent development:
Build, lead, and inspire a high-performing Technology team in France, creating a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and excellence.
Ensure the right capabilities are in place to support growth, providing mentorship, identifying development gaps, and implementing training initiatives.
Thought leadership and innovation:
Champion innovation and modern delivery, embedding emerging technologies, AI-enabled solutions, and new IP into client offerings to enhance impact, efficiency, and differentiation.
Possess an excellent understanding of the evolving media landscape and demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively with multiple internal stakeholders, including Burson’s regional and global network.
Experience that contributes to success:
A strong track record of building, growing, and leading a technology practice or significant technology portfolio in France (or a similar mature European market), ideally within a communications, consulting, or professional services environment.
Senior client advisory gravitas, with the ability to counsel, influence, and build trust with C-suite and senior government or enterprise stakeholders.
Demonstrable success in new business origination and growth, with experience winning complex, high-value mandates in competitive and fast-evolving markets.
Deep understanding of the French business and cultural landscape, with the credibility and networks to operate effectively across diverse markets and client environments.
Excellent interpersonal communication skills and proven people leadership experience.
Expertise and curiosity within the technology sector, with a clear view of emerging trends, innovation, and disruption shaping client needs.
Native-level fluency in French (written and spoken) and professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential.

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.
For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
#LIAB1,20
You belong at Burson:
Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.
At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Serko is a cutting-edge tech platform in global business travel & expense technology. When you join Serko, you become part of a team of passionate travellers and technologists bringing people together, using the world’s leading business travel marketplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, we embrace the richness of diversity, showing up authentically to create a positive impact. There's an exciting road ahead of us, where travel needs real, impactful change.
With offices in New Zealand, Australia, North America, and China, we are thrilled to be expanding our global footprint, landing our growing and established hub in Bengaluru, India. Strategic Alignment: Collaborate closely with the Director of Product and peer Directors of Engineering to execute a cohesive engineering strategy.
Pioneering AI-Native Solutions: Drive a core focus on Agentic Engineering, delivering scalable platform services that establish the team as an elite, highly credible delivery partner.

jobs.title: Product Director, Internal HR & Finance Systems
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for a Product Director to unify and lead OKX's internal HR and Finance system product lines. This is a leadership role designed to bring strategic coherence to two critical domains: Human Resources systems (covering compliance, safety, and risk management) and Internal Finance systems (covering financial reporting, data integration, and automation). Your core mandate: build a unified, scalable, and audit-ready internal systems product organisation.
What You’ll Be Doing
Own the product strategy and roadmap for both HR and Finance internal systems, driving end-to-end planning and execution across both product lines
Lead and grow a cross-functional team, coordinating across HR, Finance, Engineering, Data Warehouse, and regional business stakeholders
Act as the internal product owner for company employees as end users — proactively collect, triage, and act on feedback from internal users across regions to continuously improve the product experience
Drive enterprise compliance capability building — data privacy, international regulatory compliance, internal audit enablement
Establish a disciplined requirements management and delivery process, including PRD ownership, prioritisation, and milestone tracking
Manage multiple parallel projects, proactively surface and resolve risks, and report progress and key decisions to senior leadership
Track industry trends and continuously improve both systems' functionality, pushing toward greater digitisation and automation
What We Look For In You
8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years simultaneously owning both HR systems and Finance systems in a large organisation (500+ headcount)
Deep product knowledge of HRIS platforms (e.g. Workday, SAP HCM) and Finance systems (e.g. ERP, reporting platforms, automation tools)
A good understanding of the internal data compliance, data security, and compliance culture construction process of the enterprise. Be able to improve enterprise compliance and security with an in-house system
Solid understanding of enterprise data compliance, data security, and international regulatory frameworks
Basic finance/accounting literacy — financial statements, chart of accounts, booking rules
Demonstrated empathy for internal end users; experience building feedback loops and translating employee needs into product improvements
Proven track record leading cross-functional projects across multiple departments and time zones
Team management experience (3+ people)
Fluent in both Chinese and English (working languages)
Nice-To-Haves
Experience in Fintech, digital assets, or crypto finance
SQL proficiency and experience with data products or reporting systems
Prior experience with audit or compliance-related products
Cross-timezone team collaboration experience (APAC, EMEA, Americas)
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
#LI-ONSITE
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director - Gaming & Esports Innovation Product Strategy
jobs.text:
Overview:
Responsible for shaping the product vision, innovation strategy, and future experience roadmap for Gaming and Esports assets across Qiddiya. The role focuses on identifying emerging trends, technologies, content formats, and experiential concepts that enhance guest engagement and differentiate asset propositions.
The Director will define future-state product and experience opportunities, evaluate innovative solutions from global providers, and formulate strategic recommendations that inform asset planning, investment decisions, and long-term growth ambitions. The role acts as a bridge between asset teams, strategic partners, and enabling functions to ensure the delivery of Qiddiya’s Gaming and Esports ambitions.
Key Responsibilities:
•Translate experience and business requirements into high-level product and technology considerations.
•Assess emerging technologies, digital platforms, and product solutions to determine their strategic relevance and potential application.
•Define future-state product and experience requirements that inform subsequent technology planning and delivery activities.
•Provide strategic guidance on technology-enabled experiences, digital products, and innovation opportunities.
•Evaluate solution concepts, platforms, and product ecosystems from a customer, commercial, and experience perspective.
•Formulate recommendations on technology and product investment opportunities to support asset differentiation and long-term growth.
•Engage with technology providers, gaming platforms, content creators, and innovation partners to understand emerging capabilities and market developments.
•Develop concept-level requirements and experience frameworks that can be translated into detailed delivery plans by specialist technology teams.
•Provide strategic product and innovation inputs into governance forums, investment reviews, and key asset decision-making processes.
•Support technology and delivery teams by defining concept-level requirements, strategic priorities, and desired experience outcomes for future initiatives.
•Review and challenge proposed technology solutions, roadmaps, and innovation initiatives to ensure alignment with asset objectives and guest experience ambitions.
•Contribute to the development of standards, principles, and governance frameworks for technology-enabled products and experiences across Gaming and Esports assets.

jobs.title: Corporate Finance - VP - Portfolio Analytics
jobs.text:
Abu Dhabi Investment Council (ADIC) is an institutional investment organization focused on managing and evaluating investments across asset classes, including private equity and infrastructure, while supporting portfolio analytics and corporate functions. Operating in the investment management sector, ADIC combines analytical rigor with practical decision support to help teams work from robust, dependable insight.
This role sits at the intersection of engineering, analytics, and portfolio insight. As Corporate Finance - VP - Portfolio Analytics, you will play a key role in strengthening the systems and analytical capabilities that support liquidity analysis and broader portfolio decision-making, working closely with investment and support stakeholders to ensure outputs are dependable, scalable, and fit for purpose.
Responsibilities

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, POS Application Platform
jobs.text:
Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Spain
Some of our most mission-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, POS Apps to join us in Spain.
About the role
More than 6 million businesses run their financial lives through Moniepoint - and the primary way they interact with us every single day is through a POS device. For most of our merchants, that device is their business. It is how they accept payments, how they access credit, and how they track their finances. Everything those devices are capable of, in terms of speed, reliability, and developer quality, flows from the engineering platform this role leads.
We are building a dedicated POS Application Platform function: the foundational Kotlin-based engineering layer that sits beneath every POS product at Moniepoint. Think of it as the operating system for our POS engineering organisation - the standards, frameworks, tooling, and architectural backbone that every POS engineer across the business builds on top of. This is not a feature team. It is a platform team in the truest sense, and the Head of Engineering for POS Application Platform is the technical owner of that layer.
We currently operate across five POS device types from multiple OEM manufacturers, all running on Android. The engineering challenges here span device governance, developer experience, platform reliability, foundational frameworks, and adoption across a distributed set of POS engineers working in separate product squads.
And the scope is growing. We have a UK entity live, a cross-border payments product in market, and a microfinance bank acquisition which just finalized in Kenya. The platform you build will become the foundation for tens of millions of businesses across multiple markets to accept payments, access financial services, and grow. If you have spent your career going deep on POS systems and you want to build the platform that underpins one of Africa's most consequential fintech businesses during its expansion, this is the role.
What you'll get to do
Own the technical strategy and architecture for the POS Application Platform, acting as the domain CTO for everything that runs on our POS devices.
Build and govern the four core platform pillars across the organisation: developer experience (tools, libraries, SDKs), platform reliability (observability, uptime, quality standards), foundational frameworks (architecture, coding standards, testing and release pipelines), and squad adoption (driving uptake of platform tooling across all embedded POS engineers).
Define and enforce engineering standards across all POS device types and OEM manufacturers, ensuring architectural consistency and quality across a heterogeneous device fleet.
Functionally lead POS engineers embedded across Payments, Onboarding, VAS, Savings, and Loans squads - setting the bar for engineering quality and providing the platform layer above all of them.
Own POS observability end-to-end: monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks that ensure platform health across all devices and squads.
Drive the architecture for how Moniepoint supports multiple POS device types, including defining how new devices are onboarded, governed, and integrated with the platform.
Collaborate with OEM partners and the POS hardware team when new device types are introduced, ensuring the application layer is ready to support them from day one.
Build and scale the POS platform team, including hiring, mentoring, and structuring for growth as the platform expands internationally.
Translate platform decisions into business impact, working closely with Product, Payments, and Business leadership across markets.
Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, tooling standards, CI/CD pipelines, and developer productivity metrics across the POS engineering community.
To succeed in this role, we think you should have
A minimum of 10 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 6 years leading engineering teams through meaningful growth phases, ideally in multi-national or large VC-backed companies.
Direct, hands-on experience building software that runs on Point-of-Sale terminal devices. This means engineering on the device itself — the application layer — not server-side integrations with POS systems. This is a non-negotiable requirement and candidates without it will not be considered.
Strong working knowledge of EMV standards (Europay, Mastercard, Visa) and experience navigating payment certification processes such as PCI DSS and P2PE. Candidates without this will not be considered.
Deep Android engineering expertise in Kotlin and Java. The POS application layer at Moniepoint is Android-based and there are no exceptions to this requirement.
Proven experience building internal engineering platforms, shared libraries, developer tooling, or foundational frameworks used by other engineering teams — not just consumer-facing feature products.
Experience governing or architecting across multiple POS device types from different hardware manufacturers, with an understanding of how OEM integrations and device management work at scale.
Experience building or maturing platform engineering functions, including establishing engineering processes, tooling strategies, and cross-squad governance structures.
Demonstrated ability to scale engineering teams and build the organisational layer beneath you — leaders who can grow into and around the role you are hiring into.
Experience at a company processing high volumes of financial transactions in a regulated environment. Fintech background is strongly preferred.
Familiarity with terminal management systems and device observability tooling is a strong advantage.
Backend engineering experience in Java or Spring Boot is a strong plus given the breadth of the platform and the integration surface it sits on.
Experience working directly with OEM vendors on hardware specification and integration is a bonus.
Exposure to C or C++ is a plus — one of our device variants uses C.
Experience at Series A or B stage startups alone is unlikely to reflect the scale and complexity required for this role.
Cultural Alignment
We assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
Some of the technologies you'll work with
Android (Kotlin, Java) - primary platform for all POS application development
EMV payment standards and PCI/P2PE certification frameworks
Multiple POS device types and OEM manufacturers, including Topwise and Telpo
Terminal management systems and device observability tooling
Java, Spring Boot — backend services and integration layer
Docker and Kubernetes
PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch
Microservices architecture on AWS
What we can offer you
Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You will receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.
What to expect in the hiring process
Stage 1: A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
Stage 2: Technical Round focused on core technical strengths and depth in Android/Kotlin
Stage 3: System Design - You will be asked to solve complex system design problems to assess your technical and architectural skills, with a particular focus on POS and mobile platform architecture and payment systems.
Stage 4: Technical and Architectural Leadership - An interview with one Head of Engineering focused on leadership skills and attributes.
Stage 5: CTO Interview - A conversation with our CTO assessing first-principles thinking, problem-solving under ambiguity, clarity of thought, and cultural alignment.
How to apply: Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile via our career website.
Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates!
#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, User Growth
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
Our mission is to drive user growth and engagement by delivering innovative campaign features, building robust task platforms, and unlocking growth through diversified channel strategies — including SEO, ASO, affiliate, referral, and paid acquisition.
As a senior PM, you will play a key role in shaping product direction, driving cross-functional collaboration, and elevating the team's capabilities to new heights.
What You’ll Be Doing
Drive Product Development
Develop ToC growth activities (campaigns) and consumer task products to boost user engagement and retention.
Enhance ToB platform and data analytics functionalities to streamline internal operations and maximize efficiency.
Channel Growth Strategy
Define and execute channel growth strategies spanning SEO, ASO, referral, affiliate, and paid channels to maximize user acquisition and organic reach.
Collaborate with channel owners to align platform capabilities with channel-specific growth levers and funnel requirements.
Identify high-potential channel opportunities and build product features that amplify channel performance at scale.
Analyze and Strategize
Evaluate growth activities (campaigns) and task performance metrics to identify actionable insights.
Continuously innovate and prioritize product capabilities to align with global markets' user growth strategies.
Leverage AI tools and automation to accelerate experimentation cycles, surface insights faster, and scale growth operations.
Collaborate Across Teams
Work closely with Paid Ads, Content, Affiliate, Referral, Trading, and Listing teams to create synergies for user growth.
Stay Ahead of Industry Trends
Keep up with market trends and emerging technologies to inform product strategy and ensure competitiveness.
What We Look For In You
3+ years of expertise in growth activity, mega sale, personal task, loyalty system, and platform products, with a proven track record of driving growth through innovative product solutions.
Decent understanding of data analysis, user research, and campaign performance metrics.
Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and lead cross-functional projects.
Proven ability to deliver large-scale projects and navigate cross-team dependencies in a dynamic organization.
High learning velocity — Able to rapidly internalise new domains, connect dots across product, data, and market signals, and translate them into actionable strategy.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience with SEO and/or ASO strategy, including keyword optimization, app store listing optimization, and organic growth levers.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, New Subjects
jobs.text:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!
At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems, running countless experiments (300+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that’s both fun and meaningful.
Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
About the role...
Over the last few years, Duolingo has expanded beyond language learning into entirely new subjects: Math, Music, and Chess. These products reach millions of daily active users, are growing quickly, and represent a CEO-level bet that Duolingo can become a platform for learning anything.
We're looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to co- lead our newest subjects, responsible for building and scaling products ranging from early stages through to some of the company’s fastest-growing initiatives.
This is a role for a builder. You'll make decisions about which subjects to invest in, how to allocate engineering resources across bets at different stages, where to continue investing and where to pivot.
You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to shape the future of the pillar while building the organization that delivers it.
This role is based in our New York, NY office on a hybrid (4+1) work schedule.
🧠 You will...
Drive the product and technical strategy across Math, Music and Chess, balancing short-term product impact with long-term strategic goals.
Partner strategically with Product, Design, Learning and AI to evolve our strategy, including decisions on when and how to expand to additional subjects.
Lead multiple engineering directors and their teams as they tackle some of the most interesting technical challenges in industry: AI-based content creation at scale, neural bots, and Unity-based gameplay.
Drive operational excellence across Duolingo’s engineering org, including reliability, performance, developer productivity, and efficient execution at scale.
Contribute to Duolingo’s engineering hiring bar and talent systems, playing a central role in hiring decisions, leveling, and organizational design to maintain a high-performance, high-density team.
Lead an organization that moves quickly, runs high-quality experiments, and translates product insights into measurable business impact.
Build and develop a strong leadership bench capable of bringing ambitious new products to market.
✅ You have...
Experience leading consumer product engineering organizations (100+ engineers), ideally across multiple high growth product experiences.
Product instincts and experience partnering closely with senior product leadership to define strategy, not just execute against it.
A track record of driving measurable impact on business outcomes, including growing early product development through significant company scale.
Experience building or scaling LLM-powered product features, with a strong interest in building engineering cultures that embrace AI-first ways of working.
Deep experience building and scaling high-velocity, experiment-driven product organizations, leading through multiple layers of leadership (senior directors, directors, EMs).
A track record of building high-performance, inclusive teams, and making thoughtful, high-judgment talent decisions.
Ability to influence senior executives and drive clarity in ambiguous, cross-functional situations.
Ability to work from our New York, NY office on a 4+1 hybrid work schedule.
The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!
Salary Range:
$296,000—$444,000 USD
Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here.
Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here.
Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com.
Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.
By applying for this position your data will be processed as per the Duolingo Applicant Privacy Notice.

Over the last few years, Duolingo has expanded beyond language learning into entirely new subjects: Math, Music, and Chess. These products reach millions of daily active users, are growing quickly, and represent a CEO-level bet that Duolingo can become a platform for learning anything.

We're looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to co- lead our newest subjects, responsible for building and scaling products ranging from early stages through to some of the company’s fastest-growing initiatives.

This is a role for a builder. You'll make decisions about which subjects to invest in, how to allocate engineering resources across bets at different stages, where to continue investing and where to pivot.
You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to shape the future of the pillar while building the organization that delivers it.
This role is based in our New York, NY office on a hybrid (4+1) work schedule.
🧠 You will...

items: Drive the product and technical strategy across Math, Music and Chess, balancing short-term product impact with long-term strategic goals.
Partner strategically with Product, Design, Learning and AI to evolve our strategy, including decisions on when and how to expand to additional subjects.

Lead multiple engineering directors and their teams as they tackle some of the most interesting technical challenges in industry: AI-based content creation at scale, neural bots, and Unity-based gameplay.
Drive operational excellence across Duolingo’s engineering org, including reliability, performance, developer productivity, and efficient execution at scale.
Contribute to Duolingo’s engineering hiring bar and talent systems, playing a central role in hiring decisions, leveling, and organizational design to maintain a high-performance, high-density team.
Lead an organization that moves quickly, runs high-quality experiments, and translates product insights into measurable business impact.
Build and develop a strong leadership bench capable of bringing ambitious new products to market.

blocks.text: ✅ You have...

items: Experience leading consumer product engineering organizations (100+ engineers), ideally across multiple high growth product experiences.
Product instincts and experience partnering closely with senior product leadership to define strategy, not just execute against it.
A track record of driving measurable impact on business outcomes, including growing early product development through significant company scale.
Experience building or scaling LLM-powered product features, with a strong interest in building engineering cultures that embrace AI-first ways of working.
Deep experience building and scaling high-velocity, experiment-driven product organizations, leading through multiple layers of leadership (senior directors, directors, EMs).
A track record of building high-performance, inclusive teams, and making thoughtful, high-judgment talent decisions.
Ability to influence senior executives and drive clarity in ambiguous, cross-functional situations.
Ability to work from our New York, NY office on a 4+1 hybrid work schedule.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, VIP Growth & Operations
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
About The Opportunity
OKX is seeking an experienced VIP Growth & Operations Leader to focus on creating exclusive product experiences and service solutions for high-net-worth individuals, institutional clients, market makers, and other VIP customer segments.
You will spearhead the overall strategy and product planning for the VIP Growth & Operations line, driving customer lifecycle management, personalized services, and continuous optimization of system functionalities to enhance customer retention and platform AUM (Assets Under Management).
What You'll Be Doing
Own the day-to-day VIP Growth & Operations execution for high-net-worth individual clients, ensuring VIP lifecycle programs are planned, launched, and iterated effectively.
Build and run a VIP lifecycle operations framework: define segments, triggers, and journeys; set weekly/monthly operating rhythms; and ensure consistent execution with Local Markets.
Partner with Local Market teams to to co-create market plans, align goals and timelines, and drive follow-through, while ensuring global consistency and scalable playbooks.
Plan and execute VIP offsites and online events (e.g., product sharing sessions, community/engagement touchpoints), including end-to-end coordination, stakeholder alignment, and post-event performance review.
Develop and scale VIP growth programs and tools (e.g., VIP trial cards and similar programs) that improve conversion, deepen engagement, and increase VIP contribution to trading activity and AUM.
Establish a data-driven growth operating model with clear measurement, experimentation, and continuous optimization to improve VIP contribution to revenue and AUM.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Engineering, Operations) to deliver workflows, tooling, and process improvements that support VIP operations at scale.
Track performance and continuously optimize: define KPIs, monitor results, gather market feedback, and refine programs based on data and learnings.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor’s degree or higher with 5+ years of product management or product strategy experience.
Deep understanding of the Web3/Crypto industry, particularly exchange products such as institutional services, API trading, and VIP incentive programs.
Prior experience in CEXs, brokerages, financial institutions, or high-net-worth client-related products is preferred.
Strong cross-team communication and coordination skills, with systematic thinking and sharp user insights.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and data-driven decision-making.
Fluency in English and Chinese; Multi-market collaboration experience is a plus.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director, Supplier Development
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
Job’s mission
As Director, Supplier Development at ASM, you will lead a strategic function focused on building and scaling supplier capabilities across critical commodities. This role will oversee the Advanced Materials and Machining pillars and partner closely with sourcing, engineering, and business units to ensure the right suppliers, processes, and controls are in place to support new product development and long-term growth.
What you will be working on
Lead Supplier Development for Advanced Materials and Machining, driving capability, scalability, and supplier readiness for critical categories.
Manage and develop a team of ~6 supplier development engineers, providing clear direction, prioritization, and leadership.
Partner with sourcing and business unit engineering teams to identify critical components and define supplier strategies for key parts and processes.
Evaluate supplier technical capabilities, manufacturing processes, capacity, and growth plans to meet current and future demand.
Drive a strategic, forward-looking supplier development approach focused on capability building and supplier selection (vs. tactical quality escalation).
Establish robust supplier process flows and controls, and transition ongoing monitoring to Supplier Quality once stabilized.
Ramp quickly on ASM products and supplier landscape to support NPI, scaling initiatives, and margin improvement efforts (e.g., should-costing).
What we are looking for
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or related discipline required).
Strong experience in supplier development, manufacturing, sourcing, or technical operations within complex industrial environments.
Deep understanding of manufacturing processes, supplier capability assessment, and design-to-manufacturing considerations.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across sourcing, engineering, and product development teams.
Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing experienced technical teams.
Ability to operate strategically - assessing supplier capability, capacity, and alignment to long-term business needs.
What sets you apart
Master’s or PhD in Engineering.
Semiconductor industry experience or similar fast-paced, high-tech manufacturing environment.
Experience supporting advanced materials, specialty chemicals, or machining-focused supplier categories.
Strong commercial mindset, with experience driving supplier scalability, cost optimization, and margin improvement initiatives.
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across global operations, sourcing, and engineering teams.
Background from larger, established semiconductor or high-tech manufacturing organizations.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Lending
jobs.text:
About us
N26 is Europe’s leading digital bank with a full German banking license. Headquartered in Berlin and operating across more than 20 markets, we are now entering our next stage of maturity. Our focus is on our growth engine while we strengthen robustness, scalability, and operational excellence. With new senior leaders joining to guide this phase, we are sharpening how we build, ship, and sustain products at scale.
As we continue to keep a strong product pulse. Our growth is driven by expanding into adjacent services like mobile connectivity and recently launching cards designed for kids. Our core strategy focuses on empowering customers to switch to N26 as their primary account. By embedding financial tools that are reliable and resilient, we ensure N26 is an essential part of everyday life. To lead this, we need a Director of Marketing [Paid] who understands how to communicate the value of a top-of-wallet banking experience.
About the role
With the financial sector facing significant digital transformation and heightened competition, N26 is seeking a focused leader to spearhead the expansion of our strategic Lending division.
As Head of Lending, you will assume management of the Lending vertical, supervising the end-to-end lifecycle of our retail lending products operations, which currently cover consumer loans, overdraft facilities, and installment products.
This product is critical to the banking business and the role empowers you to operate your own business vertical: designing the long-term Lending strategy & roadmap, driving product adoption and growth, and ensuring strong P&L performance in alignment with N26 Bank risk appetite and policies. You will build, nurture, spearhead a group of 4–6 direct reports, fostering a resilient and high-performing team that integrates seamlessly with the broader strategic ambitions of N26. Additionally, you will work closely with Engineering, Credit, Data Science, Design and senior management to identify new opportunities, optimise current portfolio performance and deliver with high standards and high velocity.
Based in Berlin or Barcelona.
Your impact
Drive Sustainable Product Growth: define and execute the long-term retail lending strategy to expand the customer base, unlock new opportunities, and sustainably increase product adoption.
Own the Roadmap and P&L: take full ownership of the consumer lending product roadmap, from defining product future direction, priorities and product timeline and features to ensuring the cross-functional team meets deliverables and deadlines. You will own the outcomes of the P&L and work closely with Credit Risk teams to shape and grow the lending portfolio.
Team Management and Leadership: architect and scale an efficient lending organization, design high-performing team structures, establish clear governance, and embed success metrics across all areas of responsibility.
Strengthen Cross-Functional Collaboration: become a connective tissue between Product, Credit Risk, Operations and Data Science, deeply understanding underlying credit risk models to ensure robust, compliant, and data-driven lending decisions.
Market Development and Acceleration: scale market penetration and portfolio growth by identifying systemic levers that expand customer adoption of N26 lending products.
What you bring
Strategic Product & Business Leadership: a proven track record in senior Product Management leadership, P&L ownership, demonstrating a balance of a strong product mindset and high-level business acumen. You are proficient in translating complex product strategies into scalable commercial success and measurable P&L growth.
Lending Domain Expertise: proven experience in banking, fintech, or the broader lending space (e.g., credit lines, BNPL, loans, mortgages etc).
Team Leadership: you possess proven ability to build, nurture and grow high performing teams and you can create an innovative environment where top-tier talent can thrive and deliver exceptional business results.
Data & P&L Fluency: you are deeply data-driven, possess a strong understanding of P&L management, and know how to use data to make sharp product decisions that move the needle for the business.
Stakeholder Management and Cross-functional Collaboration: you are comfortable working closely with different areas of the organization. Navigating between Product, Engineering, Credit Risk Management, Data Science and Operations, you can communicate effectively, manage expectations and balance human and operational resources.
What you can expect
We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.
We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com.
Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at N26.

jobs.title: Head of Data Analytics and Insights
jobs.text:
Angkas is the Philippines' leading motorcycle ride-hailing platform. We move millions of Filipinos through traffic every day while building real livelihoods for our driver partners.
We're hiring a Head of Analytics to own the data function end-to-end. You'll lead a team, get your hands dirty with the data, and work directly with leadership to shape how we think about our business — not just report on it.
JOB DETAILS:
You'll be responsible for the analytics roadmap and making sure the team is working on what actually matters. That means driver incentive programs, supply-demand dynamics, pricing, retention, unit economics, and others. You'll build the team's skillset, set up the right processes, and make sure we're tracking the metrics that actually matter.
On a daily basis, expect a mix of strategic work (presenting to executives, aligning with product, operations and finance) and technical work (reviewing analyses, debugging logic, writing your own queries when needed). It's a lean setup—expect to work closely with people across levels.
You'll also own data governance—working with engineering on pipeline reliability, pushing for better documentation, and establishing data lineage so people actually trust the numbers.

jobs.title: Data Planning Director
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
Who we’re looking for:
VML is seeking a Data Planning Director to be a trusted partner to our clients, navigating their business, understanding their challenges and connecting across VML, as well as WPP at large, to ensure we are setup to deliver success with world-class services and solutions.
This role is part of an integrated Data & Analytics team across measurement & reporting, predictive modelling, data strategy solutions, covering media, CX, CRM and more. The focus is to act as the glue between clients, WPP teams on all things data. As such, you will need to organise, motivate and inspire to connect all (data and non-data) disciplines in delivering success for our clients. Gravitas and strong collaboration are essential.
What you’ll be doing:
Team direction and oversight
Direct a team of data, technology and business consultants, analysts and engineers, overseeing client briefs and managing team workload.
Direct and motivate the team to help them achieve their goals and deliver brilliant work for VML’s clients.
Data & Analytics leadership
Act as strategic partner and advisor, helping clients to leverage the power of data, martech, analytics and AI to achieve their goals and drive effectiveness and efficiency.
Develop proposals and methodologies for
Data Planning; encompassing data-driven journey design, targeting personalisation, test and learn
Analytics & Data Science solutions; encompassing customer analytics (e.g. customer segmentation, predictive modelling), digital analytics (e.g. journey analysis, web/app, media analysis), business intelligence (e.g. dashboard reporting) and AI (e.g. conversational BI)
Data & Analytics consulting; encompassing data, marketing technology, AI and operations (process, skills, culture, business change etc.). Includes data, AI, martech and adtech transformation roadmaps, measurement frameworks and associated operating model development.
Inspire our clients and all of VML with thought-leadership and best practice.
Work closely with our clients to help diagnose and solve their challenges, support their data & AI vision, and make it happen.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Talent 360 is seeking a highly technical and hands-on Head of Engineering to lead engineering excellence across all teams.
This role is responsible for solution architecture, code quality, engineering standards, and technical execution. This role is not focused on high-level strategy alone — it requires deep involvement in code, architecture decisions, and technical problem-solving on a daily basis.
Solution Architecture & System Design
Own and drive solution architecture across all projects and products
Design scalable, high-performance, and maintainable systems
Lead architecture decisions, including frameworks, integrations, and platforms
Conduct architecture reviews and enforce quality, scalability, and security standards
Define and enforce architectural patterns (Microservices, DDD, Event-Driven, CQRS)
Evaluate build vs. buy decisions with strong technical justification
Hands-On Coding & Code Review
Actively participate in code reviews across all engineering teams
Ensure high standards in code quality, performance, and maintainability
Enforce best practices, design patterns, and coding standards
Contribute directly to critical and complex implementations when needed
Identify and resolve technical debt and code quality issues proactively
Mentor engineers through structured and constructive code reviews
Engineering Standards & Best Practices
Define and enforce engineering standards across the organization, including:
Coding standards and style guides
API design and integration standards
Database design and performance optimization
Testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E)
Documentation practices
Establish quality gates for code, releases, and deployments
Drive adoption of automated code quality tools and best practices
Ensure consistency across Backend, Frontend, and Mobile teams
CI/CD & DevOps Excellence
Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines across all projects
Ensure fully automated build, test, and deployment processes
Drive DevOps best practices, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Automated testing within pipelines
Blue-green and canary deployments
Environment and configuration management

jobs.title: Assistant Director of Information Technology
jobs.text:
Why USA Clinics Group?
Founded by Harvard-trained physicians with a vision of offering patient-first care beyond the hospital settings, we’ve grown into the nation’s largest network of outpatient vein, fibroid, vascular, and prostate centers, with 170+ clinics across the country. Our mission is simple: deliver life-changing, minimally invasive care, close to home.
We’re building a culture where innovation, compassion, and accountability thrive. While proud of our growth, we’re even more excited about what’s ahead, and the team we’re building to get there. We look forward to meeting you!
Why You'll Love Working with us:
🚀 Rapid career advancement 💼 Competitive compensation package
🤝 Positive, team-oriented environment 🏥 Work with cutting-ed technology
🌟 Make a real impact on patients’ lives 📈 Join a fast-growing, mission-driven company

Compensation: $90,000 - $105,000

Support IT strategy, infrastructure, and daily operations

Oversee cybersecurity monitoring and compliance support
Manage vendors, systems, and IT service performance
Identify and implement AI-driven solutions across departments
Develop automation workflows for IT support and business processes
Assist in building enterprise AI governance standards
Serve as backup to IT Director
Additional duties as assigned

Must actively identify opportunities to automate manual IT and business processes
Must implement AI tools for ticketing, monitoring, reporting, and system optimization
Responsible for integrating AI into IT operations and cross-functional workflows
Expected to evaluate and deploy emerging AI technologies to improve efficiency and reduce operational workload

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Safety
jobs.text:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
Discord only works at our scale if people feel safe showing up — and building the systems that make that possible is exactly what our Safety engineering org does.
We classify content, route reports, make and audit enforcement decisions, and build the tools our operations partners use to handle everything automation doesn't. The work is a mix of deep backend infrastructure, AI-driven automation, and tight collaboration with the people who do nuanced review. As Discord grows into new surfaces like commerce and ads, the platform we build matters more.
We're hiring a Director of Engineering to lead Safety Infrastructure Engineering at Discord. The org is roughly 20 engineers across two teams with two EM direct reports. You'll report to the senior Director of Safety and work closely with T&S Operations, Safety ML, Safety Product, Legal, Policy, Security, and Core Tech.
What you'll do
Lead and grow two engineering teams covering our safety backend: the decision platform, classification systems, content understanding, intake and routing pipelines, and observability
Drive the automation roadmap with Safety ML. Decide where AI belongs in the loop, where humans still win, and hold the line on quality, latency, and cost
Own the queue routing and internal tooling our ops teams and vendor partners rely on, and partner with T&S Operations on golden sets, QA, appeals, and evals that turn operational signal into better systems
Consolidate fragmented systems onto infra and set the bar for engineering quality: on-call, incident response, technical review, and ownership
Hire, coach, and grow senior leaders
Who you are
5+ years as a software engineer with a strong backend and distributed systems background, and 5+ years as an EM including 2+ years managing managers. Experience running 20+ engineers through multiple EMs
Strong infrastructure instincts. You can hold your own in architecture discussions on event-driven systems, service migrations, and platform design
Fluent in AI and ML systems enough to partner credibly with an ML org and make good calls about where automation belongs in a decision pipeline
Experienced working closely with ops or human-in-the-loop teams. You get the rhythm of QA, calibration, appeals, and ground-truth work, and build tools that respect the people using them
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a history of partnering effectively across engineering, ML, data science, policy, legal, and product teams.
Practical about throughput, vendor management, and unit economics
An empathetic and experienced recruiter and coach. People you've managed want to work with you again
Bonus
A strong passion for Discord and/or gaming, and an appreciation for the communities we serve.
Trust & Safety, fraud, integrity, or abuse engineering at a consumer platform
Building ML platforms, MLOps, or automated decisioning at scale
Managing vendor-based ops (BPO, content review, third-party tools), or building internal tools where ops or review teams are the primary user
Payments, fraud, or commerce infra
Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.
The US base salary range for this full-time position is $450,000 to $550,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.
Why Discord?
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!
Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.
Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking HERE.
