jobs.title: Head of Product and Quality Assurance
jobs.text:
About the Role
EnrollHere is seeking a highly driven Head of Product & Quality to lead product execution, customer engagement, quality assurance, and delivery across our platform. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for ensuring we build the right products, deliver them quickly, and maintain the highest standards of quality and customer satisfaction.
This individual will serve as the bridge between customers, product, engineering, data, compliance, and executive leadership. They must be equally comfortable meeting with customers, writing requirements, testing features, prioritizing roadmaps, and holding teams accountable for execution.
Why this Role Matters
At EnrollHere, product quality and customer experience are competitive advantages. We are building technology that powers critical business operations for our customers. The right person in this role will directly influence product innovation, customer satisfaction, platform adoption, and company growth while helping ensure we continue to deliver at a pace that sets us apart from the market.
About the Culture
EnrollHere is not a slow-moving corporate environment.
We move fast. We make decisions. We execute. We are obsessed with delivering value to our customers and continuously improving our platform. We believe speed matters, accountability matters, customer engagement matters, and results matter.
The ideal candidate thrives in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities evolve, customer feedback drives innovation, and every team member is expected to take ownership.
This role is for someone who enjoys being in the trenches, solving problems, engaging with customers, and helping teams deliver exceptional outcomes.
Core Values:
Customer First
Ownership Mentality
High Accountability
Bias for Action
Continuous Improvement
Team Before Self
Relentless Execution
Attention to Detail
Strong Communication
Positive Energy and Engagement

jobs.text:

- Open to expatriates currently living in Southeast Asia (Malaysia preferred)
Why you should apply
- Steer the regional growth and execution of a massive Southeast Asian data center portfolio from a strategic Kuala Lumpur hub.
- Partner directly with a technical leadership team with over 20 years of mega-project experience.
- Join a privately owned, high-growth Project Management Consultancy (PMC) backed by a secure pipeline of global technology clients.
What you will do
- Provide senior governance and key client oversight across multiple hyperscale data center developments in Southeast Asia.
- Manage high-level client accounts and drive regional business development to capture new sector growth.
- Lead diverse, multi-national teams from initial site procurement through to active commissioning phases.
What you will need
- Strong leadership experience managing multiple active data center builds across Southeast Asia.
- Demonstrated client-facing capability and a successful track record in sector business development.
- Strong technical understanding of mission-critical facility requirements.
About the company & team
- Premier global consultancy delivering project controls, quantity surveying, and EPCM services across 500+ landmark projects in 10+countries.
- Operates with a flat, agile, multi-national management group.
- Values data-driven project execution and direct commercial accountability over corporate bureaucracy.
About you

jobs.title: Sr. Manager / Associate Director - Commercial Data Product (Pharma/ Life science
jobs.text:
Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 1000 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.
We are seeking a Senior Manager / Associate Director with a strong Life Sciences background and hands-on commercial analytics experience to launch Commercial Data Product to support an upcoming pharma launch. This role will lead a small, dedicated pod to design and build a Snowflake-native, Power BI–aligned data product from the ground up. The position gives an opportunity to focus on data product ownership, metric design, and stakeholder alignment. The candidate should have strong experience and domain knowledge in gene therapy, with exposure to relevant processes, workflows, and industry applications.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with Life Sciences stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions
Own the end-to-end commercial data product for a kidney launch, from vision to execution.
Translate launch strategy into segmentation frameworks, KPIs, and data products used by commercial leadership.
Drive stakeholder alignment across Marketing, Sales, Market Access, and Analytics
Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with launch milestones. Partner with the engineering team to design Snowflake-native data models optimized for scalability and reuse.
Ensure strong Power BI semantic model understanding (measures, relationships, performance).
Enable self-service analytics through well-designed datasets—not dashboards alone.
Establish KPI governance, adoption tracking, and success metrics for the product.
Lead a small cross-functional pod (data engineers, analysts).
Operate in an agile delivery model with clear sprint outcomes and executive visibility.
Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders and the technical team.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍London / UK Remote | 💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits ✨
⭐ Our Design team
We’re a team of 115+ Product Designers, User Researchers, and Brand Designers led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design is the largest discipline within the design organisation, with designers working in tight-knit squads alongside researchers, product managers, and engineers to solve real customer problems at scale.
We design for the “magic moments.” We’ve built a bank that feels deeply human, not just functional, shaping how millions of people experience money every day. Our product is our personality. We combine research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.
Now, we’re entering our next phase of growth and looking for exceptional design leaders to help define not only Monzo’s future, but the future of banking itself. There’s significant opportunity to shape the product, influence the organisation, and leave a lasting mark on millions of customers.
🔎 About the role
We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead design across Payments, one of Monzo’s most important and fast-evolving multi-market business areas.
You’ll partner closely with senior leaders across Product and Engineering to shape strategy, set direction, and drive exceptional execution across your area. You’ll play a key role in influencing the direction of both the product and the broader customer experience.
You’ll lead and grow a team of Product Designers, helping them do the best work of their careers while strengthening design thinking, collaboration, and craft across Monzo. As a senior leader within the Design organisation, you’ll raise the quality bar and expand design’s impact, influence, and effectiveness across Monzo.
🔑 You’ll play a key role by...
Setting the strategic direction and design vision for your area, inspiring teams to think bigger and bolder, whilst aligning with Monzo goals and mission.
Partnering with the leadership team for your area to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and turn strategy into impactful execution.
Building and nurturing a high-performing design team - investing in their growth, wellbeing, and long-term success.
Maintaining an exceptional quality bar across all design work through clear feedback and coaching, helping designers and teams consistently deliver best-in-class experiences.
Creating an environment where feedback is open, craft is celebrated, and design quality continues to evolve across the organisation.
Acting as a champion for design at Monzo, influencing how design thinking shapes our products and culture.
🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...
You’ve led design strategy and vision across complex product areas, helping teams navigate ambiguity and deliver meaningful customer and business impact.
You’re comfortable operating at multiple altitudes, from defining long-term direction to driving high-quality execution.
You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Research and Commercial, and know how to influence senior stakeholders through clarity, insight, and craft.
You have a strong point of view on product design and consistently raise the bar for quality, systems thinking, and customer experience.
You’ve built and led high-performing design teams, creating environments where people can grow, do exceptional work, and have meaningful impact.
You know how to scale design influence across an organisation, shaping product direction, ways of working, and culture beyond your immediate team.
You’re energised by Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone, and excited to help shape the next generation of payments experiences through thoughtful, magical and innovative design.
🙌 What’s in it for you
💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits
✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK
✅ We can sponsor your visa
📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)
⏰ Flexible working hours and trust-based work culture
📚 £1,000 annual learning budget for books, training, and conferences
🏡 Full remote setup support, including equipment and workspace essentials
➕ Plus lots more!
This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!
We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.
We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.
#LI-TR1
#LI-Remote
Equal opportunities for everyone
Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Associate Director, CRM Analytics
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
This role is responsible for the measurement, reporting, and audience strategy of a Salesforce-powered CRM ecosystem, spanning lifecycle marketing programs across acquisition, retention, loyalty, off-lease, in-market owner, and vehicle-launch communications. The role also supports broader customer experience measurement initiatives across CRM and digital touchpoints, partnering with BI, media, CRM, and client teams to translate CRM performance data into insights and recommendations that inform campaign optimization and audience decisions.
The ideal candidate combines Salesforce Marketing Cloud reporting and analysis experience with strong statistical and testing capabilities, an understanding of digital measurement and customer journey analytics, and can present findings to senior client stakeholders in the language of business decisions.
CRM Measurement & Reporting
Own measurement and reporting for Mazda's CRM program across email and push channels.
Maintain the CRM measurement framework, including KPIs, customer journey stages, and attribution methodology, in alignment with agency and client stakeholder teams.
Build and maintain data visualizations that make CRM performance clear and actionable for stakeholders.
Develop reporting automation that streamlines recurring deliverables and improves reporting efficiency and consistency.
Deliver recurring performance reporting and ad hoc analysis to client CRM and CX stakeholders.
Partner with digital analytics teams to connect CRM engagement metrics with website behavior and customer journey outcomes.
Salesforce Ecosystem & Audience Analytics
Navigate Salesforce Marketing Cloud for reporting and analysis, including locating and working with Data Extensions to source campaign and audience data.
Build SQL-based reporting automation from Marketing Cloud data to support recurring measurement and audience analysis.
Support CDP-related measurement, including behavioral triggers, audience expansion, and activation reporting.
Lead customer segmentation, lifetime-value, and loyalty/defection (churn) analysis to inform audience prioritization.
Testing & Experimentation
Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across CRM and digital programs, from hypothesis through readout.
Design and run holdout and incrementality tests, using control-group methodology to isolate CRM-driven lift.
Apply statistical methods, including regression, hypothesis testing, and forecasting, to validate performance drivers and forecast customer behavior.
Maintain the account's test-and-learn roadmap and translate results into optimization recommendations.
Business Intelligence & Stakeholder Reporting
Partner with BI and engineering teams on executive dashboards in Domo, Tableau, and Power BI serving stakeholders across agency and client teams.
Identify insights through analysis of CRM, customer, and website behavioral data, surfacing trends, opportunities, and performance drivers for stakeholders.
Translate analytical output into commercially framed recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Present findings in recurring client meetings and executive readouts.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate cross-functionally with CRM strategists, developers, and creative teams to inform campaign planning and optimization with data.
Partner with analytics, CRM, media, CX, and technology teams across agency and client organizations.
Guide analytical priorities and delivery standards across supporting analyst resources.
Partner with the Group Director, Customer Experience Measurement & Analytics, to support measurement initiatives across CRM, customer journeys, and digital experiences.
Required Qualifications
5-7+ years of experience in CRM analytics, marketing analytics, digital analytics, or customer analytics.
Experience navigating Salesforce Marketing Cloud for reporting and analysis, including working with Data Extensions.
Advanced SQL, including building automated reporting workflows; working proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis.
Experience designing and executing A/B, multivariate, and holdout/incrementality tests and applying statistical methods (regression, hypothesis testing, forecasting).
Experience with customer segmentation, CLV, and churn/loyalty analysis.
Proficiency with BI platforms such as Domo, Tableau, or Power BI, including data visualization and reporting automation.
Familiarity with web analytics and customer journey measurement platforms such as Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Google Analytics, or similar solutions.
Strong communication skills, including presenting analysis to senior client stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in automotive or another complex customer-lifecycle business.
Familiarity with CDP measurement and activation reporting.
Experience with attribution modeling and paid media measurement.
Experience analyzing website, CRM, and customer journey data to support optimization recommendations.
Agency experience with executive client stakeholders.
What Success Looks Like
Within the first 12 months, this leader will:
Deliver reliable, decision-ready CRM measurement and reporting across all lifecycle programs.
Maintain a consistent test-and-learn cadence, including holdout and incrementality testing, with documented results feeding campaign optimization.
Help keep segmentation and audience logic accurate, current, and aligned to client campaign needs.
Serve as the day-to-day analytics point of contact trusted by client CRM stakeholders.
Help evolve the CRM program toward best-in-class measurement, testing, and audience intelligence practices.
Contribute to a more connected view of customer performance by integrating CRM and website engagement insights into ongoing reporting and optimization recommendations.
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.

$70,000—$140,000 USD
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. jobs.title: Senior Director of Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
We are the world’s leader in one of the fastest growing segments in the industry, Thermal Atomic Layer Deposition systems. We are also recognized as the technology leader in the fast growth Epitaxial Si deposition market and have far exceeded the growth of any of our competitors in this space.
In this role, you will lead ASM’s Asia Manufacturing Engineering team based in ASM’s state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Singapore and Korea, Dongtan. This team further structures the Bill of Materials for sourcing and purchasing, makes detailed assembly and test procedures and criteria, and ensures successful delivery to our customers, while helping to enable the high-volume manufacturing teams within ASM and into our contract manufacturing base transition products into high volumes with high quality standards.
Key Responsibilities:
Collaborate with the Business Units Design Engineering and Global NPI (New Product Introduction) Engineering teams to develop build and test procedures to ensure tool’s functionality standards are met.
Responsible for establishing priorities and plans to manage business unit-focused manufacturing engineering teams with the primary responsibility to Engineer Manufacturing Processes necessary to ensure Safe, Quality deliveries of systems, spares and retrofit kits in Singapore operations sites.
Establish engineering strategic project plans for and leads the implementation of key programs and activities in accordance with ASM Global Operations strategic goals.
Establish a change management process to roll out proposed changes in manufacturing.
Drive solutions to problems/ opportunities within the Internal Factory and at Contract Manufacturing Outsource Partners.
Responsible to identify, commit & implement process and system needed to achieve MFG safety improvements, quality improvements, labor hours reduction and cycle time reduction.
Responsible for the shipped quality of products through continuous improvement using Lean six sigma tools like PFMEA, DMAIC, DOE, SPC and data analytics.
Manage timely execution of Engineering Change Orders (ECO). Influence peer group to make the Engineering change beneficial for effective and productive outcome.
Manage tooling and test equipment requirements. Innovation and automation in implementing tooling and test equipment to manufacturing efficiency and customer quality
Lead the innovative process in implementing changes in the business process to deliver excellence and value-add from the Engineering team
Be the key driver for continuous improvement within the Internal Factory and at Contract Manufacturing Outsource Partners
Responsible for generating and maintaining employee development and training to build an effective and future ready team
Lead the NPI engineering team in providing technical support for new product builds in pilot sites or high-volume manufacturing sites.
Functional Knowledge:
A strong understanding of quality processes and best practices.
Experience with Team Center, SAP and/or major ERP/MRP systems and processes.
Demonstrated/ proven knowledge in creating and implementing manufacturing processes in a highly complex assembled systems business.
Experience in improving existing business processes for a smooth transition from New Product to High Volume Manufacturing at a very rapid pace.
Experience with Assembly and Test automation execution.
Experience in enabling internal manufacturing teams and contract manufacturers to ramp to high volumes.
Exceptional communication and relationship building skills.
Semiconductor industry experiences with deep knowledge of Equipment Manufacturing Engineering are a plus.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree/ Masters in relevant Engineering discipline.
Lean Six sigma green belt.
Effective management of a highly technical, global team.
Competency development within the team.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively from the working level to the executive levels across many functions.
Proficiency in identifying project risks and influencing the direction of projects to mitigate those risks.
Preferred Qualifications
Lean Six sigma black belt/ master black belt.
Experience with manufacturing of high complexity Capital Equipment.
Vacuum system and high-power systems experience i.e. DC (controlling digital signals and modules), as well as 220vAC, and 480vAC (providing distribution to various functional blocks).
Experience with complex Bill of Materials (BOM) with high level modules highly preferred.
Experience with high level modules should reflect an understanding from a BOM perspective, of functional blocks such as Wafer processing chambers, factory interfaces, gas delivery solutions, power distribution and control units, vacuum systems, and software.
Experience with modular design of BOMs thereby enabling better control and management of the configuration and allowing global operations to better deploy manufacturing and supply chain strategies.
Solid knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Advanced Variant Configuration.
Experience engaging in early design stages to influence direction on DfX.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director Technology - Data Platforms
jobs.text:
Director Technology - Data Platforms
London, UK
We are looking for a senior data leader to join Simple Machines in London as part of our Global Data Practice leadership team.
This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role focused on helping shape the future direction of our data platform capability across the UK and Europe. The individual will play a key role in defining our propositions, strengthening our technical capability, and helping clients modernise their data ecosystems for an AI-native future.
The role requires someone equally comfortable operating at executive, architectural, commercial, and delivery levels. We are looking for a leader who understands where enterprise data platforms are heading over the next five years, not where they were five years ago.
Key Responsibilities:
- Part of the Global Data Practice leadership team
- Helping define and evolve Simple Machines’ data platform propositions, technical direction, and strategic positioning
- Advising enterprise clients on modern data platform strategy, architecture, operating models, and AI readiness
- Supporting organisations as they evolve from traditional centralised data platforms toward AI-native, real-time, and data product-oriented operating models
- Working closely with Engagement Managers and senior leadership across major strategic initiatives
- Leading architecture and technical direction for complex enterprise data platform and transformation programs
- Acting as a senior technical counterpart across strategic client engagements and partner relationships
- Pre-sales, proposal development, technical solution shaping, and executive stakeholder engagement
- Building trusted relationships with strategic technology partners and staying current with emerging platform capabilities and market direction
- Supporting recruitment, mentoring, capability uplift, and practice development across the broader engineering organisation
- Leading major client initiatives across data engineering, platform modernisation, AI enablement, and operational data systems
- Contributing to thought leadership, market positioning, and growth initiatives across
the UK and Europe

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the role,
the Head of engineering has both a strategic and a technical role inside the company. The strategic aspect includes setting goals for the team, hiring engineers, and prioritizing projects. The technical aspect is about getting actively involved in developing new products, identifying requirements, and setting timelines.
Before they can get this position, the head of engineering should have extensive experience as an engineer, they should have managed complex tech projects and know how to build products and features from scratch.
About the team,
Our technology/engineering is a group of 100+ talented people. Together with the Product teams, the gist of our role is to create innovative and scalable solutions to help Amartha grow its business.
Responsibilities
Oversee front-end and back-end development teams and their projects
Monitor reliability and performance of all internal systems to suggest improvements
Ensure compliance with relevant regulations
Manage software development projects by setting requirements, goals, and timelines
Design strategies for future development projects based on the company’s overall objectives and resources
Hire engineers and coordinate their training
Implement innovative technologies
Coordinate with stakeholders for new integrations and tools

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Trading Infrastructure
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
You will have the opportunity to join a team responsible for designing the industry's leading Crypto trading system, including Spot, Margin, Perpetuals, Futures, Options, and various risk control models such as simple account, single-currency margin, multi-currency margin, and portfolio margin.
This system supports daily trading volumes of over ten billion USD for both retail and institutional clients.
What You’ll Be Doing
The plumbing of the exchange. Order management, matching, margin, risk engine, lending/borrowing — across both spot and derivatives. When you ship, millions of trades route through your work the same day.
Infrastructure that holds up where others can't operate. You'll work directly with Legal, Compliance, and local market teams — not to check boxes, but to design systems that clear the highest regulatory bar in finance. That bar is our moat.
Outlearning the competition. Talk to traders, take apart competing systems, and decide where we lead vs. fast-follow — across crypto and TradFi.
The instruments that show us the market first. Build the data and monitoring layer that gives us situational awareness of our own stack and the broader industry. If something's drifting, breaking, or shifting — you know before anyone else.
The 3–12 month direction. Decide what we build next, and when, based on product lifecycle, competitive landscape, and what our capacity actually is — not what makes the deck look good.
Shipping through. From spec to launch, you're the person who gets it out the door — pulling engineering, design, ops, and marketing into alignment without becoming the bottleneck.
The AI harness and agent architecture for your domain. Design and ship multi-step agent workflows — tool use, retrieval, evaluation, human-in-the-loop checkpoints — that power how Core Trading operates. Spec agents the way you spec products.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor's degree or above in mathematics, physics or computer science major.
5+ years experience in building sophisticated backend systems in either crypto or Traditional Finance industry.
AI native skillset that allow you to ship at 10x because you automate the work flow first.
Possess rigorous logical thinking, excellent teamwork, communication skills and be able to coordinate resources to solve problems and achieve goals between different departments.
You possess a strong interest in trading, blockchain and the financial industry.
You are proactive, enthusiastic and sensitive to customers' feedback from a product lens.
Fluent in English and Mandarin (to communicate with Mandarin speaking clients / cross-teams).
Nice-To-Haves
Trading experience in sophisticated institutions.
Excel in quantitative research with various mathematics tools.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Institutional Growth
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for Senior Product Managers to drive institutional client growth, manage market maker and VIP programs, and deliver credit and lending products for OKX's institutional client base — including hedge funds, trading firms, asset managers, and financial institutions.
Depending on background, the role may focus on: (a) Institutional client management — VIP programs, market maker programs, and fund/asset manager operations; (b) Institutional credit products — VIP Loan, Credit Line, Post-Trade Settlement; or (c) Growth strategy and cross-team initiatives — Driving quarterly growth plans in partnership with Core Trading, Retail, and Earn teams.
This is a strategic and hands-on role where you'll collaborate closely with engineering, risk, compliance, sales/BD, and relationship management teams to deliver secure, scalable, and client-centric solutions that power OKX's institutional offerings.
What You’ll Be Doing
Product Strategy and Delivery
Understand the institutional market landscape by analysing client needs, competitor offerings, and market trends. Identify differentiation opportunities in partnership with Sales/BD and Relationship Management teams.
Design and optimize VIP fee tier programs, market maker incentive structures, and institutional client retention strategies. Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned product lines (e.g. VIP Loan, Credit Line, Delayed Settlement, MM programs, or fund management tools).
Gather and prioritise product and client requirements using data-driven analysis. Manage the institutional client lifecycle: onboarding, activation, engagement, upsell, and retention — Translating client pain points into roadmap priorities with clear business impact.
Work closely with engineering, risk, and product teams to drive both technical and financial product requirements. Build and maintain products with end-to-end risk management and operational workflows.
Develop financial and non-financial metrics and KPIs to track progress and alignment to firm’s overall strategy and goals. Solicit both internal and external client feedback, understand the various challenges and opportunities and re-prioritise the roadmap iteratively to optimise results. Manage technical backlogs and prioritise new features vs technical debt to eliminate workflow friction.
Client Engagement and Growth
Develop strategic partnerships and maintain relationships with key institutional clients. Coordinate with RM/BD teams on client onboarding, tier management, and retention strategies.
Drive quarterly growth strategies in collaboration with Core Trading, Retail Growth, and Earn teams, including cross-sell initiatives, incentive program design, and institutional product bundling.
Build business cases for product and partnership investments with clear ROI frameworks. Quantify the revenue and AUM impact of product features to drive prioritisation decisions. Own the commercial logic of assigned institutional product lines.
What We Look For In You
Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product launch throughout its lifecycle. Adept at translating product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes. Experience with institutional credit products (margin lending, secured financing, delayed settlement, or credit line structures) is preferred.
Proven experience engaging directly with institutional clients — Conducting business reviews, gathering requirements on-site, and translating client pain points into product roadmap priorities. Experience working with sales/BD/relationship management teams in a B2B institutional environment.
Ability to think logically, work in a team and communicate effectively. Strong written and verbal skills for producing high quality documents, plans, roadmaps and presentations with impact. Comfortable working across time zones and cultural contexts.
Understanding of institutional crypto market dynamics — Fee structures, market making, prime brokerage models, and custody solutions.
Deep understanding of crypto exchange products (spot, margin, futures, perpetual swaps, options) and institutional trading workflows. TradFi experience in FX, Equities, or Fixed Income covering trading and middle/back office is a strong plus.
Hands-on experience leveraging AI/LLM tools for product operations, e.g. building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features. We value PMs who actively use AI to multiply their output and embed it into business processes.
A Bachelor's degree in business, technology, finance or related discipline.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

Solicit both internal and external client feedback, understand the various challenges and opportunities and re-prioritise the roadmap iteratively to optimise results. Manage technical backlogs and prioritise new features vs technical debt to eliminate workflow friction.
Client Engagement and Growth
Develop strategic partnerships and maintain relationships with key institutional clients. Coordinate with RM/BD teams on client onboarding, tier management, and retention strategies.
Drive quarterly growth strategies in collaboration with Core Trading, Retail Growth, and Earn teams, including cross-sell initiatives, incentive program design, and institutional product bundling.

Build business cases for product and partnership investments with clear ROI frameworks. Quantify the revenue and AUM impact of product features to drive prioritisation decisions. Own the commercial logic of assigned institutional product lines.
What We Look For In You

Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product launch throughout its lifecycle. Adept at translating product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes. Experience with institutional credit products (margin lending, secured financing, delayed settlement, or credit line structures) is preferred.

Proven experience engaging directly with institutional clients — Conducting business reviews, gathering requirements on-site, and translating client pain points into product roadmap priorities. Experience working with sales/BD/relationship management teams in a B2B institutional environment.

Ability to think logically, work in a team and communicate effectively. Strong written and verbal skills for producing high quality documents, plans, roadmaps and presentations with impact. Comfortable working across time zones and cultural contexts.
Understanding of institutional crypto market dynamics — Fee structures, market making, prime brokerage models, and custody solutions.

Deep understanding of crypto exchange products (spot, margin, futures, perpetual swaps, options) and institutional trading workflows. TradFi experience in FX, Equities, or Fixed Income covering trading and middle/back office is a strong plus.

Hands-on experience leveraging AI/LLM tools for product operations, e.g. building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features. We value PMs who actively use AI to multiply their output and embed it into business processes.
A Bachelor's degree in business, technology, finance or related discipline.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package

jobs.title: Sr. Manager/Associate Director, Data Cloud Applications
jobs.text:
Zeta Global is seeking a Senior Manager / Associate Director to join the Data Cloud Applications team and lead the development, planning, and delivery of next-generation Intelligence Solutions within the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP). Zeta’s Data Cloud transforms billions of data signals into actionable intelligence that drives meaningful marketing and advertising outcomes for enterprise brands.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role focused on building visualization-driven, AI-powered intelligence applications that serve as critical assets in enterprise engagements and drive platform adoption and usage. The ideal candidate is a seasoned SaaS product leader with strong execution discipline, cross-functional leadership capabilities, and a deep understanding of how large-scale data and intelligent automation can be translated into intuitive, decision enabling experiences.
Responsibilities:
Lead the end-to-end development of high-visibility Data Cloud intelligence applications within ZMP, transforming large-scale, multi-source data signals into intuitive, enterprise ready visualization and decision experiences.
Define product vision and MVP scope aligned to business objectives and platform adoption goals; plan phased releases that continuously enhance client value and user engagement.
Author clear and comprehensive PRDs, scope functional and non-functional requirements, and manage execution across the full product development lifecycle — from ideation through release and iteration.
Partner closely with global cross-functional teams including Design, Front-End Engineering, Backend/Data Engineering, Analytics, Automation, AI, and QA to architect scalable, high-quality applications within ambitious timelines.
Drive the integration of AI-native capabilities powered by Athena by Zeta™, such as automated intelligence generation, contextual summaries, and conversational data exploration — ensuring outputs are accurate, explainable, and grounded in governed data.
Own execution discipline across concurrent initiatives by proactively managing dependencies, mitigating risks, and ensuring timely delivery in coordination with scrum and program management functions.
Act as a liaison between cross-functional teams and senior leadership, providing transparency into progress, trade-offs, and release plans while advocating for resources and removing roadblocks.
Support post-launch adoption and usage by partnering with GTM teams, participating in client demonstrations, tracking performance metrics, and incorporating stakeholder feedback into iterative enhancements.
Help prioritize application development in alignment with the broader roadmap, while mentoring junior team members and fostering accountability, quality standards, and execution rigor within the team.
Qualifications/Skills needed:
7+ years of experience managing SaaS products, preferably in B2B or enterprise environments.
High-agency leader with the ability to make sound, data-informed decisions in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
Strong growth mindset with a track record of identifying gaps, driving improvements, and delivering measurable impact.
Proven ability to operate with agility, effectively re-prioritize, and adapt to evolving business needs and technology trends.
Hands-on experience building and managing technology products across the full development lifecycle.
Solid understanding of data analysis and data visualization principles, with experience guiding teams on analytical approaches and delivering compelling data-driven storytelling.
Familiarity with AI-enabled product experiences such as automated insight generation and conversational interfaces, and an understanding of responsible AI integration within enterprise applications.
Strong knowledge of the digital marketing and advertising ecosystem and how data and technology drive customer engagement and outcomes.
Strong leadership and mentoring skills.
About Zeta
Zeta Global is a leading AI-powered marketing technology company that enables enterprise brands to acquire, grow, and retain customers through intelligent, data-driven engagement. At the center of its innovation is the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), which unifies customer data, identity, and advanced analytics to transform billions of data signals into actionable marketing intelligence and measurable business outcomes.
Publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: ZETA), Zeta is redefining modern marketing with Athena by Zeta™, a superintelligent, conversational agent embedded in ZMP that personalizes the marketer’s workspace, surfaces platform-generated insights through natural dialogue and recommends next-best actions to help brands accelerate and optimize their marketing outcomes.
Know more about Zeta: https://zetaglobal.com/press-news/
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/
ZETA IN THE NEWS!
https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

jobs.title: Salesforce Field CTO
jobs.text:
About the Role
We're hiring a Field CTO to be the most trusted technical voice in our company, the leader our customers call when the stakes are highest and the executive our field rallies behind when complex deals demand vision. This role blends strategic technical leadership with hands-on customer impact, spanning the full lifecycle from first conversation through enterprise-wide adoption.
If you've ever wanted a mandate to shape how customers architect, govern, and scale on the Salesforce platform, while influencing product direction and elevating the technical bar across an entire go-to-market organization, this is that role.
What You'll Own
Serve as the senior-most technical authority in the field, partnering with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and Salesforce Centers of Excellence at Fortune 500 customers.
Shape and execute our technical field strategy across discovery, architecture, validation, and executive alignment.
Drive adoption and time-to-value across the customer lifecycle, ensuring every deployment translates into measurable business outcomes.
Lead executive business reviews, governance frameworks, and technical roadmap conversations that turn customers into long-term champions.
Influence renewal and expansion outcomes by identifying adoption gaps, removing friction, and architecting paths to enterprise-wide rollout.
Build repeatable technical playbooks for discovery, validation, enablement, and value realization.
Act as the loudest voice of the customer with Product and Engineering, translating field insight into roadmap influence.
Represent the company externally through keynotes, analyst briefings, Dreamforce sessions, executive roundtables, and thought leadership.
Mentor and elevate technical talent across the organization, raising the bar for craft, customer empathy, and commercial acumen.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Consumer Frontend
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox users expect and deserve a modern, standardized and coherent user experience across all platforms we support (mobile, desktop, console, VR, web, etc.). The role of Director of Product, Consumer Frontend is to up-level Roblox UI both directly, with a Core UI team, and, indirectly, through capabilities provided by our Design Systems team. Your goal is to measurably raise the quality of our UI/UX across all surfaces, and unlock greater UI/UX capabilities for the company from a centralized, platform position.
You’ll report to the Senior Director of Product for Apps. This role is based at HQ (no remote option open).
You will:
Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Consumer Frontend team which consists of Core UI and Luau architecture and Design System with tooling teams.
Be the leader for common UI paradigms in the Roblox Consumer Application, providing thought leadership on Roblox UI for both end users and Creators.
Invest heavily in relationship building and stakeholder management in order to drive UI standardization and design system adoption.
Help define what success looks like for your teams and measure their progress towards it.
Personally PM critical projects when required (hands on PM skills as well as management experience required).
Grow the PM skills of the team under you, hire when required, represent your team at external events with Creators.
Communicate updates, milestones, and priorities effectively to stakeholders across the organization.
Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies in user interface design and gaming to inform product decisions.
Research and deploy AI to drive efficiency and innovation at scale.
You have:
10+ years of Product Management experience with expertise in shipping high-quality consumer products across multiple platforms.
Experience defining, managing, or driving adoption of design systems, UI platforms or platform-wide UI changes.
Expertise in navigating platform product development where internal engineers/designers are your primary customers.
Deep experience in internal stakeholder management and alignment.
Experience leading cross-functional execution with various teams including engineering, data science, design, marketing, partnerships, legal, and policy, to conceptualize, develop, test, and launch impactful UI changes.
Experience running complex, platform-wide AB tests and managing resultant trade-off conversations.
The ability to clearly communicate roadmaps, priorities, experiments and decisions across a wide spectrum of audiences from partner teams to executive levels.
Strong design sensibilities and a history of strong product to design working relationships.
Demonstrated technical proficiency and effectiveness working closely with engineers. Experience with Luau, similar languages, and/or the React framework would be beneficial but are not required.
A passion for gaming and a deep understanding of game UI or multi-platform UI delivery would be beneficial but is not a requirement.
You are:
A Product leader with a history of delivering high quality UI/UX work either directly or through a design system.
Experienced, with 10+ years of product management experience or equivalent and a history of delivering across multiple platforms at scale.
Analytical, with experience running complex AB tests to conclusion.
Design-orientated with a passion for high quality user experiences.
An excellent communicator and documenter, with fantastic listening, verbal, and written communication skills. You’re at home understanding and communicating an overarching vision at the 30k-foot level and diving into technical specifications, individual tradeoffs, and priorities.
Entrepreneurial, having worked in a fast paced environment, with competing resources and priorities, through the product life cycle from planning, development, through to launch and continuing support. You love to get things done.
Organized, understanding that the best way to build something great is through the joint efforts of many people.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$383,120—$439,280 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Data Analytics Customer Experience Group (Bangkok based, relocation provided)
jobs.text:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Overview:
We are looking for an Associate Director to join the largest and fastest growing online hotel booking platform in Asia based in Bangkok, Thailand. Agoda is a strongly data driven organization: as an Associate Director, your insights will impact strategic and tactical decisions driving business growth.
Responsibilities:
As a pivotal leader in Data Analytics, you will drive transformative business impact by leading a team to deliver strategic, action-oriented insights. Your role is crucial in shaping data-driven decisions that enhance Agoda's competitive edge and operational efficiency.
Strategic Leadership:
Spearhead analytical projects that align with stakeholder needs, from problem definition to insightful communication of results, influencing key areas like Marketing, Product, and Partner Services.
Lead initiatives such as predictive modeling to optimize customer wait times and call demand, customer segmentation for personalized service, and the creation of innovative dashboards for business intelligence.
Business Impact:
Collaborate with stakeholders to uncover business opportunities, leveraging data to inform strategic decision-making.
Proactively prioritize business strategies through insightful data analysis, driving growth and efficiency.
Ensure timely, error-free delivery of analytical outputs, enhancing decision-making processes across the organization.
Team Excellence:
Guide your team in defining business problems, extracting and analyzing data, and presenting findings through compelling visualizations.
Balance multiple priorities, maintaining clear communication with stakeholders on progress and delivery timelines.
Strengthen team resilience, mitigating risks of process or system failures.
Mentor and develop team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and career growth.
Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, statistics, data science, computer sciences, engineering or a related degree program with outstanding academic results
8+ years of relevant experience, including 4+ years of experience as a people manager
SQL proficiency: can extract data from large databases using SQL to develop data queries
Excellent problem-solving skills including the ability to analyze and resolve complex problems
Strong business sense
Excellent communication and comprehension skills: confident communicating with people of differing levels of seniority, analytical understanding and from a wide variety of backgrounds
Organized and structured: can manage multiple, competing priorities and deliver results under tight deadlines
Fluent in English both spoken and written – additional languages are a plus
Attitude
Curious, proactive, practical and solution-oriented with “Get it done!” attitude
Data savvy and love crunching numbers: love the idea of working in an international and multicultural company, analyzing billions of actions from millions of travelers choosing from thousands of hotels
Interested in telling an impactful story with analysis and smart data visualization, not just number crunch
Able to work in a highly multi-cultural team
Attentive to detail and committed to data integrity
Aware of the importance of discretion, confidentiality, and ethical behavior
What we offer
Be part of a dynamic and exciting data-driven multinational team in a successful and fast-growing tech company
A clearly defined career path will help you to continuously develop your skills.
The chance to propose ideas to improve operations based on data and have an impact on the customer experience
Benefit:
Relocation package for employees joining from abroad
International health insurance
Annual performance bonus
Parking fees reimburse
Discount for Agoda employee booking on Agoda.com
Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.
Discover more about working at Agoda
Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda
YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife
Equal Opportunity Employer
At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.
We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.
Disclaimer
We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency’s representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

jobs.title: Director, Analytics, Commerce Platform
jobs.text:
About the Team
The Commerce Platform team builds products that help merchants grow, operate, and monetize their business with DoorDash. Our portfolio spans 0→1 bets, early-stage products, and rapidly scaling offerings, which means our work sits at the intersection of product innovation, commercialization, and long-term platform strategy. The team’s analytics and data science work helps define the right metrics, guide product and go-to-market investments, and turn new product ideas into durable business outcomes.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Director of Data Science to lead a broad and high-impact portfolio supporting Commerce Platform. In this role, you will shape how we measure success, guide product and commercial strategy, and build the data foundations that help teams move quickly and make better decisions across products at different stages of maturity. Success in this role means building a high-performing team, raising the quality and speed of decision-making, and helping DoorDash identify and scale the highest-ROI opportunities across the portfolio. You will report into a Senior Director on our Merchant Analytics team in our Analytics organization.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Lead and grow a team of data science and analytics leaders and practitioners across a portfolio that spans 0→1 products, products still being shaped and commercialized, and businesses already scaling quickly.
Own the analytical direction for the portfolio, including experimentation, KPI design, forecasting, decision support, funnel analytics, and foundational measurement.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Strategy & Operations, and Go-to-Market leaders to influence roadmap, commercialization, and investment decisions.
Build the operating system for decision-making by improving instrumentation, creating single sources of truth, and connecting short-term execution with long-term business outcomes.
Operate with broad scope and high autonomy in a startup-like environment while benefiting from the support and talent density of a scaled analytics organization.
We’re excited about you because…
You have 10+ years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or a related quantitative field, including significant experience leading senior teams and developing managers.
You have strong product and business analytics judgment, with a track record of defining metrics, building decision frameworks, and influencing strategy in ambiguous environments.
You have deep expertise in experimentation and causal inference, and you are comfortable making decisions in settings with imperfect data, evolving products, and small or noisy samples.
You bring hands-on technical fluency in SQL and statistical analysis, and you can go deep enough to raise the technical bar for the team while operating effectively at a leadership level.
You have experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and business leaders, and can translate complex analysis into clear recommendations that drive action
Compensation
The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.
In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.
DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.
To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.
See below for paid time off details:
For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$255,000—$375,000 USD

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Head of Data & Analytics (AI Native)
jobs.text:
Who we are
Intrepid Asia is a leading Ecommerce and Digital Solutions Provider in South East Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce, plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state-of-the-art in-house Technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven, growth-focused services, enabled by the industry's strongest team, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.
We are growing rapidly, and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.
The team you will be part of
Our Tech Team is the engine behind our digital capabilities—designing and building the platforms, tools, and systems that power our services across the eCommerce ecosystem. From automation to optimization to data integration, the team turns complex challenges into seamless solutions, enabling scale, speed, and smarter decision-making. With innovation at its core, Tech drives the digital backbone of our business and empowers every function to perform at its best.
Our Data & AI Vision
We are building an AI-native data platform that:
Unifies data across ecommerce, marketing, creators, and operations into a real-time, governed data foundation
Moves beyond dashboards to deliver proactive, predictive, and prescriptive insights
Enables AI-driven self-serve analytics for business users via natural language, copilots, and agents
Powers autonomous decision-making and optimization across pricing, campaigns, inventory, and content
Embeds machine learning and generative AI into core workflows (forecasting, recommendations, anomaly detection, content insights)
Acts as the intelligence backbone of our internal tech platforms
Our current stack includes Google BigQuery, StarRocks, Airflow, DBT, Cube.dev (semantic layer), Looker Studio, and Apache Superset—and we are evolving this into a modern AI + data platform with real-time, ML, and agentic capabilities.
Role Overview
We are looking for a hands-on Head of Data & Analytics to lead the transformation from a traditional BI and data platform into an AI-driven intelligence platform.
You will:
Own the end-to-end data, analytics, and AI strategy
Build a platform that shifts the company from reporting → insights → actions → autonomous optimization
Enable both internal teams and external clients with self-serve, AI-powered decision-making tools
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to embed intelligence into every workflow
This role requires someone who is equally comfortable:
Defining data + AI strategy at the leadership level
Designing modern data and ML architectures
Driving real business impact through insights and automation
Key Responsibilities
1. Data, Analytics & AI Strategy
Define and execute the roadmap for an AI-native data platform aligned with Intrepid’s product and business strategy
Evolve the organization from dashboarding → proactive insights → autonomous intelligence systems
Identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities across ML, GenAI, and agentic workflows in ecommerce, marketing, and social commerce
Drive adoption of AI-powered self-serve analytics and copilots across business teams
2. Data Platform, Architecture & Governance
Own the design and evolution of the modern data stack, including:
Data warehouse/lakehouse (BigQuery, StarRocks)
Data pipelines (Airflow, DBT)
Semantic layer (Cube.dev)
BI tools (Looker Studio, Superset)
Extend the platform to support:
Real-time and streaming data use cases for social commerce
Vector databases, MCP, and LLM integration layers
Establish strong foundations for data governance, privacy, security, quality, lineage, and cataloging
Ensure platform scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency
3. AI, Machine Learning & Intelligent Systems
Lead the development and deployment of:
Anomaly detection and automated insight systems
Generative AI use cases (copilots, automated reporting, content insights)
Recommendation systems (product, pricing, targeting)
Predictive models (forecasting, ROAS optimization, churn, inventory planning)
Drive adoption of LLM-powered analytics (NL2SQL, conversational BI, insight generation)
Build foundations for agentic AI systems that can autonomously analyze, recommend, and act
4. Business Impact, Self-Serve & Team Leadership
Transition from pull-based dashboards → push-based, actionable insights
Enable business teams with:
Proactive alerts, recommendations, and decision support tools
Scenario simulation and planning capabilities
Build AI-powered self-serve analytics experiences, reducing dependency on central teams
Drive semantic layer adoption and metrics standardization across the organization
Define and track impact metrics (e.g., GMV uplift, marketing efficiency, cost reduction, automation rates)
Build and lead a high-performing data organization (Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Data Science, BI)
Foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, and AI-first thinking, partnering closely with tech and business functions
