jobs.title: People Business Partner Director, Engineering
jobs.text:
Why join us
Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
People at Brex
The People Team at Brex keeps our company and culture growing. We’re curious, optimistic, and pragmatic, and we work across all parts of Brex to solve organizational challenges for years to come. We focus on bringing great people to the company and providing the tools and resources to empower individual and team success. Above all, we help build an authentic, inclusive environment where our team members can grow and make an impact.
What you’ll do
As the People Business Partner Director supporting Engineering, you will serve as a trusted partner to our CTO and Engineering leadership team, shaping the organization, leadership, and talent strategy that enables Brex to scale its technical capabilities. You will operate as a mini CPO for your client group, ensuring we are building a high-performing, durable engineering organization as we scale.
Where you’ll work
This role will be based in our San Francisco or New York Office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
Responsibilities
Serve as a thought partner and advisor to the CTO and Engineering Managers, helping shape long-term organizational design and health
Translate business and technical strategy into clear people and org implications, proactively identifying risks and opportunities
Coach leaders on building high-performing teams, including hiring profiles, succession planning, and internal mobility
Lead org design efforts including defining structure, driving communication plans, and owning execution through rollout
Drive clarity around roles, scope, and leveling, ensuring consistency and rigor across Engineering
Act as a connector across functions to drive alignment and execution at scale
Proactively scope and drive programs in partnership with Comp, Talent Management, and other functions, ensuring Engineering's context and input shapes the right decisions and that leaders stay informed of changes that affect them
Actively experiment with and champion AI-powered approaches to people processes, helping Brex pioneer more effective and efficient ways of working across the HR function
Requirements
8+ years of experience across People Business Partnering or related functions, with significant experience supporting Engineering or technical organizations
Proven experience partnering with C-level or senior executives (CTO, VP Eng, or equivalent)
Demonstrated ability to lead org design and transformation efforts in high-growth or complex environments
Strong track record of influencing senior leaders and driving change in ambiguous and high-stakes situations
Deep understanding of what great looks like in engineering organizations (structure, talent, leadership, and scaling challenges)
Exceptional judgment, business acumen, and ability to connect people strategy to business outcomes
Clear, concise communicator who can simplify complex topics and drive alignment across stakeholders
Active interest in and experimentation with AI tools in HR contexts; ability to identify where AI can meaningfully improve people processes
Bonus points
Experience supporting rapidly scaling fintech or product-led organizations
Familiarity with technical org design challenges (platform vs. product teams, infra scaling, global engineering footprints)
Experience operating through major company inflection points (hypergrowth, restructuring, M&A, or public company transition)
Track record of deploying AI or automation in people workflows at scale
What success looks like
Engineering has a clear, scalable org structure aligned to company priorities
Leaders are operating at a higher bar, making better decisions faster and with greater accountability
Talent density improves, with stronger hiring, clearer expectations, and proactive talent management
The CTO and leadership team view you as a trusted advisor
You influence not just Engineering, but how Brex thinks about building and scaling high-performing organizations overall
Compensation
The expected salary range for this role is $247,470 –$309,338. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.
Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Director - City Technology Governance & PMO
jobs.text:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced and strategic Director for City Technology Governance & PMO to lead and enhance the technology governance framework across the Qiddiya city development. The successful candidate will oversee the Project Management Office (PMO) related to technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with the company’s overall vision and strategic goals. This leadership role involves driving best practices in technology governance, risk management, and compliance while facilitating cross-functional collaboration among multiple stakeholders.
The Director will be responsible for establishing and strengthening IT governance policies, standards, and procedures; driving technology project delivery excellence; and managing the portfolio of technology projects with an emphasis on quality, timelines, and budgets. Operating at the intersection of technology and city planning, this role demands a visionary leader who can effectively manage complex technology programs and influence decision-making at senior levels to support the successful deployment of innovative technology solutions in line with Qiddiya’s unique vision.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, implement, and maintain robust technology governance frameworks tailored to city-scale smart infrastructure and digital services.
Lead the Technology PMO, overseeing project planning, execution, resource allocation, risk management, and performance tracking for all technology initiatives.
Ensure compliance with internal policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements concerning technology deployments.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including IT, engineering, operations, and external partners to align technology projects with the broader city development objectives.
Advise senior leadership on governance and project management best practices, providing clear reports and recommendations for decision-making.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize project delivery processes and governance mechanisms.
Manage stakeholder communication and expectations to facilitate transparency and accountability throughout the project lifecycle.
Champion innovation by identifying emerging technologies and governance trends applicable to smart city environments.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Delivery
jobs.text:
BlackStone eIT is seeking a strategic and results-driven Head of Product & Delivery to lead our product development and delivery teams. This leadership role will be responsible for overseeing the entire product lifecycle, from ideation to launch and ongoing improvement, while ensuring efficient delivery and high-quality outcomes. The successful candidate will align product strategy with business goals, foster collaboration across teams, and drive innovation to meet customer needs.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and manage the product and delivery teams, providing vision, motivation, and support.
Develop and execute product strategies that align with company objectives and market demands.
Oversee project delivery processes to ensure timely, high-quality product releases.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define product roadmaps, priorities, and success metrics.
Implement best practices in Agile and other delivery methodologies to optimize performance.
Establish and monitor KPIs to assess product and delivery team effectiveness.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and customer satisfaction.
Manage resource allocation and budgeting to maximize efficiency and outcomes.
Maintain strong communication across departments, fostering a collaborative and innovative culture.
- Programme delivery across all active workstreams: executive portal, data platform, governance, AI agents, crisis management systems
- Sprint execution: planning, backlog management, Definition of Done, mid-sprint check-ins, sprint reviews with live demos
- External vendor coordination: tracking classification vendor milestones against your integration needs; tracking agentic platform delivery against your data readiness timeline
- Stakeholder management: milestone reports to senior leadership, weekly status updates, requirements conversations with internal business owners
- Scope discipline: deciding what gets cut when time is at risk, deferring gracefully, tracking deferred work
- Resource management: contractor onboarding, work package definition, daily task allocation, quality review
- User acceptance testing: designing and facilitating UAT with non-technical end users and senior leadership
- Delivery risk management: identifying risks before they become blockers, maintaining a cleared backlog that proceeds when external dependencies are slow
- Office representation: authorized to represent the Data & AI Office at all levels when technical leadership is unavailable

jobs.title: Technology Modernization Director (Performance)
jobs.text:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do
We are seeking a Director with technical credibility, strong commercial instincts, and a track record of delivering transformation across Retail or Financial Services sectors. This role is ideal for individuals who blend industry and consulting experience, who can influence stakeholders at all levels, and build long-lasting trusted client relationships.
You will drive high‑impact engagements that sit at the intersection of business value, technology strategy, and execution – providing independent, senior-level expertise that enables executives to drive value from Technology and as a result to improve business performance. The depth of our colleagues’ experience enables us to exert a rapid and sustainable impact across:
Digital and Technology strategy development, operating model, capability and governance design.
Technology and Product strategy and innovation, assisting our clients with the strategy and execution.
Technology investment roadmaps and value creation plans.
Technology cost reduction, outsourcing and end to end Transformation.
Technology assessments leading to possible re-platforming, rationalization and consolidation activities.
Technology due diligence, carve-out, and merger integration planning and execution.
IT crisis management and project turnaround.
You will lead and/or co-lead our small, focused teams in delivering projects. They work closely with PMDs to ensure the successful delivery of all elements of client engagements and often collaboratively with the Directors across other areas of AlixPartners. They will sometimes work across a small number of projects at any given time bringing a flexible and adaptable approach to the following:
Lead large and high complexity projects from inception to completion, via small teams in a highly collaborative nature with the client.
Deliver advanced technical and consulting expertise in the following Technology areas:
Strategy, due diligence, general technology assessments, strategic architecture, operating model, cost modelling and cost reduction, turnaround of large scale “troubled” projects and company separation (carve-out) or integration (merger) projects.
Be recognized as a go-to person for specific technical/industry/functional knowledge. Continuously develop individual skills, capabilities, and knowledge.
Continuously improve and innovate internally and externally. Stay ahead of client, Firm, and market demands. Develop intellectual capital and compelling service offerings. Improve processes, create practical tools and build infrastructure
Develop business opportunities and build sustainable relationships and external networks. Maintain a market presence and support AlixPartners in the market.
Serve as an ambassador of the AlixPartners brand. Demonstrate a service mentality. Work diligently to anticipate client needs, develop and implement solutions, and exceed expectations.
This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.
What you’ll need
MBA or Master’s degree an advantage, but valid experience in conjunction with a Bachelor’s degree is required.
Preferably you will have a mix of consulting and industry experience, with an ability to deliver small projects and/or working across multiple workstreams of larger projects.
Strong Retail or Financial Services sector experience.
Knowledge and practical experience within Technology or IT in at least 2 of the following areas: IT strategy, IT cost optimisation, software delivery, infrastructure and operations, architecture, governance, project management and target operating models.
Experience of implementing projects in a variety of environments, using different methodologies and frameworks.
You demonstrate a keen personal interest in Technology and Digital and remain up to date in the latest trends and potential impacts on industry.
You are passionate about driving IT effectiveness and enabling clients to achieve their business objectives.
Excellent communication and presentation capabilities and ability to communicate effectively at CXO and Senior levels.
Outstanding analytical and critical thinking skills along with strong financial literacy.
Fluency in English is essential; knowledge of an additional language would be advantageous.
You are confident when collaborating with clients and stakeholders, with the ability to build relationships, influence and provide advice to key decision makers.
Experience leading or contributing to business-led technology transformations, digital growth initiatives, or value creation programs.
Ability and willingness to travel across EMEA.
Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday.
Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization.
The firm offers a comprehensive benefits program including health, vision, dental, disability, tuition reimbursement, identity theft protection, and mental wellness support. Employees will also receive a generous paid leave policy.
AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

#LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Director - Project Design - SDU - 20012794 - HS8
jobs.text:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a highly experienced Senior Director - Project Director Design to lead the design aspects of our Strategic Development Unit (SDU). This pivotal role requires a visionary leader who can oversee and manage the design process for large-scale projects, ensuring their successful delivery while maintaining alignment with Qiddiya’s overall strategic objectives and brand vision.
The Senior Director provides leadership in establishing and maintaining design and consultancy management framework, governance and operating model for QDC HQ team. Ensures the design processes are developed and rolled out to all Business units / sectors, supports delivery in BUs when required. Provides leadership for assigned HQ special projects accountable for meeting quality, time, budget and HSSE requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Establish/update design and project management framework for all delivery methods (including Self-Delivery, Delivery partner, CM, traditional etc.)
Develop / update policies, processes, procedures, manuals and templates for design and consultancy (including PMC) for all projects and delivery methods
Define governance process including detailed RACI matrix for all projects for Stages
Support / coordinate with HQ Operations Director and Project Director (Delivery) in establishing governance and operational model for the complete program lifecycle
Develop Design Strategy requirements and template to be applied for all projects and delivery methods.
Coordinate Technical / Peer review design management process and requirements with the Technical Director.
Develop/Update Health Safety Security and Environmental management requirements for the design phase including Design HSSE Reviews, co-ordinate with HSE and Security Managers.
Develop/Update Sustainability management requirements for the design phase. co-ordinate with Sustainability Managers.
Support MMC Director in establishing and overall MMC strategy and design integration process for all delivery models
Support Procurement Director in establishing design and consultancy requirements and standards for prequalification and RFP processes. Participate when required in consultant selection process.
Support HQ Executive director in presentations and submittal for business line, project and budget approvals.
Accountable for delivery of special/assigned HQ projects including all approvals, reporting, management of internal and external stakeholders, financial closure and handover.
Accountable for compliance of special/assigned HQ projects with all QDC policies, processes, procedures and requirements, ensuring that the project meets HSE, budget, schedule and quality standards and requirements.
Support Business units in project delivery with peer reviews, consultant selection and management (when required), project audits to ensure compliance with established processes, procedures and standards for design and consultancy (including PMC)
Coordinates input from Business units on the HQ management and governance framework processes and standards, updates documentation as part of the continuous improvement cycle.
Leads/support preparation of training materials required for the implementation of policies, processes and procedures, participates in training or presentations when required
Participates in QDC Mentoring and Capability Building programs.

jobs.title: VP of Automation Engineering
jobs.text:
About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.
About the Company
Our client is an operator-led, AI-powered revenue systems company building next-generation go-to-market (GTM) infrastructure for scaling businesses. They design automation-first revenue engines that transform real-time market signals into predictable pipeline growth.
With a deeply AI-native stack—including workflow automation, LLM-powered systems, and custom-built internal products—they support companies scaling from $1M to $100M+ ARR. Engineering is not a support function here—it is the company’s competitive advantage.
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Job Summary
We are hiring a VP of Automation Engineering to act as the foundational technical leader and strategic partner to the CEO. This is a hands-on executive role where you will architect and scale automation systems, build internal products, and lead a high-performing engineering team.
You will operate in an AI-first environment, where tools like Claude Code are part of daily development workflows—not optional add-ons.
Key Responsibilities
Automation Architecture & Infrastructure
Own and scale end-to-end automation systems using n8n and API integrations
Architect orchestration layers for complex, multi-client environments
Build resilient systems with monitoring, alerting, and self-healing capabilities
Integrate tools like Clay, CRMs, and outbound platforms into a unified infrastructure
Product Development
Build internal and client-facing products using Node.js, TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Own the full product lifecycle—from architecture to deployment
Develop scalable automation products and operational dashboards
Establish engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, and documentation
AI Systems & Intelligence Layer
Design and deploy production-grade AI/LLM systems (Claude, OpenAI, etc.)
Use Claude Code as a core development accelerator across the team
Build intelligent pipelines for classification, enrichment, and decision-making
Optimize prompt engineering, evaluation systems, and reliability at scale
Leadership & Technical Strategy
Build, manage, and mentor a high-performing engineering team
Define and execute the technical roadmap aligned with company growth
Partner directly with the CEO on product and engineering strategy
Lead sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery execution

jobs.title: Director, Electrical Engineering Mission-Critical & Data Centres
jobs.text:
Director, Electrical Engineering (Mission-Critical & Data Centres)
Location:
- Singapore (Southeast Asia Gateway)
Reporting to:
- Senior Leadership
Company Type:
- Global Engineering Design Consultancy (Founding Team)
The Opportunity:
A globally recognized engineering consultancy, consistently ranked as a leader in critical facilities and data centres, is establishing its Singapore office as a strategic hub for Southeast Asia. We are seeking a Director, Electrical Engineering to join our founding team. This is a rare, high-impact role for a registered Professional Engineer (PE) who aspires to lead complex technical designs while shaping a new regional practice from the ground up.
Key Responsibilities:
Engineering Design Delivery
- Lead the end-to-end design of electrical building services, including LV/HV power distribution, UPS systems, standby generators, and lightning protection.
- Prepare and review advanced electrical engineering calculations, short circuit and coordination studies, and technical specifications.
- Act as the Qualified Person (QP) for electrical submissions, signing and stamping drawings as a PEB-registered Professional Engineer.
- Manage all statutory submissions to EMA, BCA, SCDF, and SP Group.
- Lead technical coordination and quality assurance across multi-disciplinary project teams to ensure global standards are met.
Practice & Team Leadership
- Mentor junior engineers and play a pivotal role in recruiting and developing the future electrical engineering team in Singapore.
- Contribute to the creation of internal engineering standards, design guidelines, and QA frameworks for the regional office.
Project & Client Engagement
- Serve as the lead technical advisor for clients, architects, and regulatory authorities on complex electrical engineering matters.
Requirements:
Professional Qualification
- Registered Professional Engineer (Electrical) with the Professional Engineers Board (PEB), Singapore is mandatory at the point of hire.
Consultancy Experience
- Minimum 10-15 years of experience exclusively within M&E design consultancies (e.g., Arup, AECOM, WSP, Meinhardt, RED Engineering, Jacobs, Beca, etc.).
Design Focused
- Strong emphasis on hands-on design and engineering consultancy.
- Candidates with a primary background in installations, facility management, or maintenance will not be considered.
Sector Expertise
- Proven track record in Data Centre or Mission-Critical electrical design, including redundancy configurations (N+1, 2N) and high-reliability systems.
Technical Tools
- Proficiency in Revit MEP (highly preferred), AutoCAD, and analysis tools such as ETAP or DIALux.
Standards
- Deep knowledge of SS 638 and Singapore regulatory requirements (EMA/SCDF/BCA).
Why Join Us:
- Be part of the core team establishing a global firm’s presence in Southeast Asia.
- Work on the world’s most complex data centre and mission-critical projects.
- Hybrid working arrangement and a compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.

jobs.title: AVP, Data Cloud Applications
jobs.text:
WHO WE ARE
Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
Overview
The AVP, Data Cloud Applications serves as the strategic and operational lead, responsible for ensuring the successful development, enhancement, and delivery of applications built from Zeta’s Data Cloud.
This role bridges client needs, product strategy, and application execution, ensuring that enhancements and net new applications are delivered with quality, speed, and clear business impact. The AVP will work cross-functionally across Zeta teams to translate client problems and industry opportunities into scalable application solutions while leading and mentoring a global Applications team.
The ideal candidate combines product leadership, technical fluency, client empathy, and operational rigor, with a strong ability to coach teams, prioritize effectively, and drive execution across complex initiatives.
This role requires a highly hands-on leader who operates as a player-coach, working closely with the team in the details of application development while providing strategic guidance and leadership. The AVP is expected to deeply understand how applications are built within the Data Cloud ecosystem to effectively guide the team, remove obstacles, and ensure high-quality delivery.
This role operates across both internal execution and external engagement, with approximately 60% focused on leading and working hands-on with internal teams to enhance and develop applications, and 40% dedicated to client-facing activities, including solutioning, demos, and incorporating client feedback into the application roadmap.
Key Responsibilities
Client Engagement & Problem Solving
Partner with the EVP, Data Cloud Applications in top-tier client discussions to identify application gaps, enhancements, and new solution opportunities.
Translate client challenges into actionable application development initiatives.
Coordinate communication across clients, the Applications team, and internal Zeta stakeholders to ensure alignment and progress.
Act as a trusted internal voice for client-driven innovation.
Application Roadmap Ownership
Oversee and ensure execution of the application roadmap across enhancements and net new applications.
Continuously prioritize initiatives based on business objectives, client demand, industry trends, and business impact vs. development effort
Review and finalize Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) to ensure completeness and clarity and validate new ideas through testing before roadmap inclusion.
Generate and evaluate new application concepts based on market opportunities.
Communicate roadmap timelines and launch plans with the Project Management team and the Product Ops team to ensure sufficient training, enablement, and marketing resources are available for each launch.
Execution & Delivery Leadership
Lead program reviews, track milestones, and proactively manage risks and dependencies.
Hold teams accountable for quality and timelines.
Remove blockers across Data Cloud teams and broader Zeta business units.
Serve as the final checkpoint ensuring robust delivery of applications and enhancements.
Coordinate alpha and beta testing cycles and support product readiness for launches, PR moments, and industry events
Team Leadership & Development
Lead the Data Cloud Application development team, including:
Business application leads
Design teams
Front-end UI teams
Coach, mentor, and guide team members to strengthen execution and ownership, fostering a culture of accountability, initiative, and high-quality delivery.
Ensure the team is structured and supported to deliver end-to-end application development successfully.
Vertical Strategy & First-to-Market Initiatives
Support the development of vertical-specific application strategies and solutions.
Work with the EVP to develop subject matter expertise across key industries.
Coordinate requirements across data, applications, activation, and go-to-market teams.
Incorporate client feedback and market signals into positioning and roadmap decisions.
Train internal teams on vertical-specific messaging and use cases.
Data Cloud & Cross-Organization Partnership
Maintain deep expertise in Zeta’s identity graph and signal ecosystem; serve as a key internal and external resource.
Support cross-functional issue resolution impacting applications.
Review application-related changes and product marketing materials.
Represent application priorities and roadmap in Customer Advisory Board discussions.
Qualifications
Experience
10+ years of experience in product management, applications development, or data-driven platforms.
Experience building or leading data, identity, martech, adtech, or SaaS platforms.
Proven ability to translate client needs into scalable product solutions.
Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and design.
Skills
Strong understanding of identity graphs, data ecosystems, and signal-based marketing technologies.
Exceptional product strategy and roadmap management capabilities.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.
Strong leadership and mentoring skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Leadership Profile
Highly accountable and execution-oriented.
Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with evolving priorities.
Strong problem solver with the ability to unblock teams and drive progress.
Naturally collaborative with the ability to influence across teams and functions.
BENEFITS & PERKS
Unlimited PTO
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
Employee Equity
Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!
SALARY RANGE
The salary range for this role is $170,000 - $190,000, depending on location and experience.
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/
ZETA IN THE NEWS!
https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

jobs.title: Engineering Director, Frontend Business Lead
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
What You’ll Be Doing
Business & Team Leadership Own the overall frontend team across core business verticals including Trading and Payment, covering hiring, development, and pipeline building. Partner effectively with Product, Backend, Security, and Compliance — driving cross-functional outcomes through technical judgment, not just execution.
Product Delivery & Technical Execution Lead technical design and delivery for core business features including trading system frontend experience, wallet and asset management, AI-powered trading products, payment gateway integrations, and KYC/AML frontend implementation. Stay deeply sensitive to business metrics and user experience, making sound trade-offs between speed and quality.
Product & Engineering Thinking in the AI Era Demonstrate deep understanding of how AI is reshaping product paradigms — changing user expectations, product form factors, and R&D efficiency. Integrate AI into product decisions and design, not merely as a productivity tool.
Technical Judgment & Standard-Setting Drive tech stack alignment and evolution. Proactively identify and address technical risk. Establish high engineering quality standards in complex crypto security contexts — private key security, frontend attack prevention, compliance auditing, and more.
Cross-Team Influence Build dual technical and business influence at the company level. Communicate technical value and business judgment clearly to engineers, product managers, and senior leadership alike. Participate in industry engagements to attract high-potential talent who are genuinely passionate about crypto.
What We Look For In You

jobs.title: Head of Value Engineering - Nordics
jobs.text:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
The Team:
The Celonis Value Engineering (VE) team is focused on managing the entire customer value lifecycle, from sales through value realization, renewal and expansion. As a Head of Value Engineering, you will lead a dynamic team who come from a variety of backgrounds to identify, frame and deliver value to our customers.
The Role:
As the Head of Value Engineering for the Nordics, you will lead a team of Value Engineers and drive end-to-end customer value journeys, landing and expanding existing customers (ACV growth) and renewals (renewal rate). You will work closely with the Celonis GTM Leadership Teams and be responsible for the end-to-end value journey for all customers within your region/vertical, supporting customers to achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. You are a trusted advisor to the Celonis Executive Team, supporting their engagements with strategic customers and senior stakeholders.
As a leader in one of the fastest-growing tech companies globally, you will bring together deep process and industry knowledge with a proven consulting skill set and strong analytical abilities. You will foster a positive and supportive work environment for your teams, promoting employee satisfaction and career growth.
The work you’ll do:
Identify & Frame Value For Prospects/Customers
Own the end-to-end customer value journey, including responsibility for landing, expanding, adoption and renewing accounts
Translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases and evangelize Process Intelligence across prospects and customers
Communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executives in partnership with sales leadership and Celonis executives
Serve as an executive sponsor across the customer portfolio and solidify Celonis as a strategic business transformation platform for our customers
Create & Scale Value Across The Portfolio
Lead customers through the Celonis Value Journey, support the deployment of new features, apps, and products across the customer base, and advance strategic growth programs in pursuit of value creation
Ensure customer success and architect improvement measures and manage change within the customer base, while pioneering new methodologies within Celonis’ Value Engineering organisation
Direct Celonis Value Engineering, Services and Ecosystem resources through the Celonis Customer Value Journey, creating durable value for our customers
Take ownership and build strategic customer relationships as an executive sponsor
Host QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews) and EBRs (Executive Business Reviews) to communicate results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives
Grow & Lead Celonis Talent
Recruit the next-generation of Celonis Value Engineers, while setting a high-standard for candidate excellence
Develop world-class talent through hands-on engagement, continuous feedback, and active mentorship
Lead by example and consistently demonstrate the Celonis Leadership Principles (lead with purpose, facilitate greatness, embrace difference, and cultivate balance)
Effectively allocate Celonis resources to deliver on company sales, renewals, value, and adoption targets
Communicate success and risks proactively within the organization
The qualifications you need:
Domain Expertise: Demonstrate your business domain expertise, such as in Finance or Supply Chain as well as experience in strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation) and ability to build a compelling value roadmap for the customer
Industry Expertise: Demonstrate a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic challenges of the C-Suite and build an integrated Celonis Process Intelligence roadmap
Product Expertise: Experience with guiding customer’s IT teams throughout their Celonis Process Intelligence journey, demonstrating hands-on the power of Process Intelligence and proven ability to accelerate value realization by building dashboards, Apps, Action Flows
Project Management: Plan and manage project scope, expectations and timelines. Leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.
Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally.
Value Selling Methodology: Demonstrate experience of following the Celonis value selling methodology alongside the customer journey: including discovery, qualification, value assessment and PoV’s, and demonstrate the full value potential of Celonis Process Intelligence
Value Realization: Proven track record of identifying and prioritizing use cases, implementing improvement measures and becoming a change agent for the customer by establishing an operating model and training users for the customer to realize value and renew/expand their subscription with Celonis
Sales & Commercial Acumen: Demonstrate ability to qualify all VE engagements, do discovery with customers directly, steer/allocate resources efficiently, and champion our value selling methodology with our customers.
Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead by example, including being on the front line with your teams, hands-on in all aspects and a role model for the organization.
What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.
About Us:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
Celonis Inclusion Statement:
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
Your Privacy:
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

jobs.title: Director of Automation Engineering
jobs.text:
About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Job Summary
We’re hiring a VP of Automation Engineering for a senior, hands-on leadership role at the intersection of automation architecture, product engineering, and AI systems.
This is not a traditional management-only role. You’ll be expected to operate as a technical leader who still ships code, designs systems, manages engineers, and partners directly with the founder on strategy. You’ll own and scale the automation infrastructure that powers delivery across multiple clients while also building internal and external products that turn operational know-how into software.
This role is ideal for someone with deep n8n, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and Claude Code / LLM systems experience who has previously built automation infrastructure in a fast-scaling startup, agency, or services environment.
Key Responsibilities
Automation Architecture & Infrastructure
Own the company’s end-to-end automation ecosystem, including workflow design, orchestration, monitoring, versioning, and scaling.
Build reliable, queue-based and event-driven automation systems that can support increasing client complexity without breaking under load.
Architect multi-client automation infrastructure that supports different workflows, channels, cadences, and configurations across shared systems.
Design and maintain integrations across tools such as n8n, Clay, Airtable, Slack, HubSpot, EmailBison, HeyReach, and other operational platforms.
Implement robust error handling, alerting, and self-healing workflows to improve reliability and reduce downtime.
Establish scalable standards for workflow documentation, deployment, credential management, and system governance.
Product Development
Build internal products that transform operating processes into repeatable software, including dashboards, reporting tools, signal engines, and AI-powered workflow systems.
Lead the full product engineering lifecycle from architecture and implementation through testing and deployment.
Develop client-facing tools and automation products that extend the company’s value beyond services.
Set best practices for code quality, documentation, CI/CD, review processes, and release management.
AI Systems & Intelligence Layer
Design and deploy production-grade AI systems using Claude, OpenAI, and other LLM infrastructure.
Build intelligent workflows for classification, generation, summarization, decision support, and operational automation.
Determine where AI adds leverage versus where deterministic systems are the better architectural choice.
Improve the quality and reliability of AI systems through prompt design, evaluation, validation layers, fallback logic, and cost-aware implementation.
Team Leadership & Technical Direction
Build, mentor, and manage a growing automation engineering team.
Set engineering priorities, run sprint planning and retrospectives, and establish a high-performance delivery culture.
Partner directly with the CEO/Founder as a senior technical counterpart on roadmap, systems design, and build-vs-buy decisions.
Help shape the long-term technical organization, with clear progression toward a CTO-level leadership path.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
About Us
First Circle is a fast-growing, profitable, credit-led SME neobank in the Philippines, backed by shareholders including the World Bank Group (IFC). Thousands of SMEs use our Business Credit Line and Business Bank Accounts to run and grow their businesses. Our product velocity continues to accelerate, with upcoming launches including SME Corporate Cards, Payroll, Invoices, and Solar Financing - redefining the SME neobank category through software, financial products, and exceptional risk models.
Our culture emphasises building, problem solving, ownership / responsibility, and personal & professional growth. We balance a collegiate atmosphere with free & direct communication which enables us to move very quickly and avoid politics or toxicity. Our team continues to level up quickly, necessary for business to compound more than 100% per year, which we achieve through individual growth and bar-raiser hiring.
Stage:
Profitable
150% YoY growth
$25-50m revenue
Responsibilities
As VP of Engineering, you will be the most senior technical leader in the business, reporting directly to the CEO. You will own engineering output end-to-end: from system design and domain architecture to delivery velocity, team culture, and the platform decisions that define the next chapters of our journey.
This is not a role for a detached engineering executive. We are looking for a technically excellent leader who understands that solving the hardest problems means being hands-on, not someone who manages through process and delegation. The ideal candidate raises the bar on every dimension of engineering quality, and builds the engineering organisation which will enable us to become the dominant SME NeoBank across Southeast Asia.
Product Velocity & Quality
Evolve the engineering delivery framework - sprint cadence, definition of done, code review standards, and release processes
Drive meaningful improvement in lead time, deployment frequency, and change failure rate (DORA metrics)
Balance feature velocity against technical debt with rigour and transparency
Partner with Product to co-own the technical roadmap, sequencing build decisions against architectural dependencies
Architecture & System Design
Define and enforce domain boundaries across a microservices landscape, including cross-service messaging patterns, event contracts, and data consistency models
Own data modelling standards and schema governance across services
Lead design reviews for significant architectural decisions: ledger design, transaction state machines, reconciliation, and authorisation flows
Build the architecture review process - lightweight enough to not slow teams down, rigorous enough to prevent expensive mistakes
Regulatory, Security & Non-Functional Requirements
Own the technical implementation of MAS TRM Guidelines and/or HKMA SPM on IT
Lead PCI-DSS compliance engineering and scope management
Drive adoption of the Azure Well-Architected Framework across all workloads
Define and maintain SLA/SLO frameworks, on-call rotation design, and post-mortem culture
Own cloud cost governance, capacity planning, and tooling budget
AI in Engineering
Evolve and implement out the firm's AI-assisted development strategy
Stay close to the emerging agentic engineering landscape and make deliberate adoption decisions
Provide architectural guidance on model integration, data pipelines, and inference infrastructure
API, Integration & Vendor Strategy
Own the API design philosophy for internal and external-facing services
Hold the technical relationship with key infrastructure partners - issuer processors, core banking providers, cloud vendors
Define the integration pattern library and partner onboarding standards
Data Platform
Accountability for data infrastructure: pipelines, warehouse, and models feeding BI and regulatory reporting
Ensure data lineage, quality, and governance standards are fit for a regulated entity
Team Leadership & Hiring
Hire, develop, lead & manage engineering team leaders: own the org design as the team scales from 25+ to 100+
Drive hiring at all levels - define the bar, run structured processes, attract senior talent
Develop engineering culture: ways of working, documentation standards, incident response norms
Develop career pathways and performance frameworks oriented around A-players
Represent engineering to the board, in investor due diligence, and in regulatory interactions

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Finance Systems
jobs.text:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.
HYBRID in BOSTON
At Klaviyo, we know that building a great company starts with building a great team. We welcome candidates from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we care as much about your trajectory and potential as we do about direct, one‑to‑one matches with every requirement.
About the team
Klaviyo went public in 2023 and is scaling fast. This is a rare chance to architect the Finance systems foundation for a company at this inflection point. The Finance Technology Systems team is part of G&A Systems within Global Technology Solutions (GTS). This group designs, operates, and continually improves the applications and workflows that power how Klaviyo manages money, risk, and financial reporting at scale.
The team partners closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Procurement, and Internal Audit, as well as adjacent technology teams like Corporate IT, Data, and GTM Systems, to ensure our back‑office stack is reliable, well‑integrated, compliant, and ready for a public, AI‑forward SaaS business. We own the roadmap, health, and governance of platforms including our ERP and financial systems (e.g., NetSuite/Oracle), procure‑to‑pay (e.g., Coupa), revenue and billing systems, and related integrations and automation.
This role reports to the Senior Director, G&A Systems and leads the team responsible for Finance Technology Solutions across Klaviyo.
What You'll Do
As the Head of Engineering, Finance Systems, you will be the accountable technology leader for Klaviyo’s Finance application landscape and core financial workflows. You will define and execute the multi‑year vision for our Finance systems, lead a high‑performing team, and partner with senior Finance and GTS leaders to deliver automation, control, and insight across our procure‑to‑pay, record‑to‑report, and order‑to‑cash processes.
Own the Finance systems vision and roadmap
Define and maintain the multi‑year strategy and roadmap for Klaviyo’s Finance technology stack (ERP, procure‑to‑pay, revenue and billing, treasury, close and reconciliation tooling), aligned to the CFO’s agenda and the company’s financial plan.
Translate Finance, Accounting, Tax, and FP&A objectives into clear systems investments and sequencing, balancing foundational platform work with high‑impact automation and analytics use cases.
Lead and develop the Finance Technology team
Manage and grow a team of application owners, business systems analysts, administrators, and integration specialists who collectively own the Finance systems portfolio and its integrations.
Set clear expectations around domain ownership, service reliability, partnership with Finance stakeholders, and measurable business outcomes; build strong succession and leadership bench strength within the team.
Drive AI-native transformation across Finance
Lead Klaviyo's push to make Finance one of the most automated, insight-driven functions in the company. You'll identify and deliver high-value AI use cases across the Finance workflow.
You'll partner directly with Klaviyo's AI and data platform teams to embed AI into core Finance processes with clear guardrails, measurable productivity gains, and the rigor expected of a public company. This isn't a future-state vision, it's work already underway, and you'll own it.
Design and optimize core Finance processes and systems
Partner with Controllership, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Procurement leaders to design and continuously refine end‑to‑end Finance workflows across procure‑to‑pay, record‑to‑report, and order‑to‑cash, ensuring systems and processes are tightly aligned.
Ensure our ERP and Finance applications are configured, integrated, and operated to support accurate, timely close, scalable revenue and billing, and high‑quality financial data that downstream teams can trust.
Own SOX, controls, and audit readiness for Finance systems
Own the design, implementation, and operation of IT General Controls (ITGCs) and other key controls across Finance applications, in partnership with Internal Audit, Security, and external auditors.
Continually simplify and automate controls and evidence collection so audits are reliable and predictable, with fewer deficiencies and lower friction for Finance and GTS teams.
Manage the Finance systems portfolio and vendors
Own the Finance systems portfolio budget (applications, services, and related programs), including vendor selection, contract evaluation, and ROI analysis for major investments.
Rationalize overlapping tools, simplify the application landscape, and ensure Finance systems integrate cleanly with G&A, GTM, and data platforms.
Act as a strategic partner and communicator
Serve as the primary technology partner for the CFO, Controller, and Finance leadership team on systems, data, and process topics; translate business strategy into clear technical decisions and trade‑offs.
Represent Finance Technology Systems in executive forums, planning cycles, and cross‑functional initiatives, ensuring Finance needs are anticipated and built into wider GTS and company roadmaps.
Who You Are
You've spent your career at the intersection of Finance and technology and you've moved beyond just keeping systems running. You think in roadmaps, outcomes, and partnerships. You know what a well-run Finance technology function looks like, and you know how to build one.
You've led teams through real complexity: ERP and other transformations, SOX audits, billing system overhauls, or the messy work of integrating Finance systems across a growing company. You don't need a perfect environment to do great work, you create structure where there isn't any, and you bring Finance and engineering stakeholders along with you.
Specifically, you likely bring:
15+ years in enterprise or business systems, with meaningful ownership of Finance technology at a tech or SaaS company
4+ years leading teams, including managers, responsible for order-to cash, record-to-report, procure-to-pay, revenue/billing, and financial close systems
Deep, practical SOX ITGC experience and a clean track record working with Internal Audit and external auditors
Solid understanding of enterprise-led growth and system features required to enable moving upmarket
Fluency in ERP and Finance application architecture (NetSuite/Oracle, Coupa, Avalara, Zip, Zuora, or similar), integration patterns, and how Finance data flows across a modern tech stack
Led strong engineering team with AI build-first mentality coupled with engineering excellence
Personally built or scaled AI and automation in Finance workflows - reconciliations, invoice processing, forecasting prep and can speak to what worked and what didn't
A reputation as a trusted partner to engineering and finance leadership; someone who translates complexity into clear decisions and earns credibility with CFOs, CAOs, Controllers, Revenue Operations, and auditors alike

blocks.text: At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.
HYBRID in BOSTON

At Klaviyo, we know that building a great company starts with building a great team. We welcome candidates from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we care as much about your trajectory and potential as we do about direct, one‑to‑one matches with every requirement.
About the team

Klaviyo went public in 2023 and is scaling fast. This is a rare chance to architect the Finance systems foundation for a company at this inflection point. The Finance Technology Systems team is part of G&A Systems within Global Technology Solutions (GTS). This group designs, operates, and continually improves the applications and workflows that power how Klaviyo manages money, risk, and financial reporting at scale.

The team partners closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Procurement, and Internal Audit, as well as adjacent technology teams like Corporate IT, Data, and GTM Systems, to ensure our back‑office stack is reliable, well‑integrated, compliant, and ready for a public, AI‑forward SaaS business. We own the roadmap, health, and governance of platforms including our ERP and financial systems (e.g., NetSuite/Oracle), procure‑to‑pay (e.g., Coupa), revenue and billing systems, and related integrations and automation.
This role reports to the Senior Director, G&A Systems and leads the team responsible for Finance Technology Solutions across Klaviyo.
What You'll Do

As the Head of Engineering, Finance Systems, you will be the accountable technology leader for Klaviyo’s Finance application landscape and core financial workflows. You will define and execute the multi‑year vision for our Finance systems, lead a high‑performing team, and partner with senior Finance and GTS leaders to deliver automation, control, and insight across our procure‑to‑pay, record‑to‑report, and order‑to‑cash processes.
Own the Finance systems vision and roadmap

items: Define and maintain the multi‑year strategy and roadmap for Klaviyo’s Finance technology stack (ERP, procure‑to‑pay, revenue and billing, treasury, close and reconciliation tooling), aligned to the CFO’s agenda and the company’s financial plan.
Translate Finance, Accounting, Tax, and FP&A objectives into clear systems investments and sequencing, balancing foundational platform work with high‑impact automation and analytics use cases.

blocks.text: Lead and develop the Finance Technology team

items: Manage and grow a team of application owners, business systems analysts, administrators, and integration specialists who collectively own the Finance systems portfolio and its integrations.

Set clear expectations around domain ownership, service reliability, partnership with Finance stakeholders, and measurable business outcomes; build strong succession and leadership bench strength within the team.

blocks.text: Drive AI-native transformation across Finance

items: Lead Klaviyo's push to make Finance one of the most automated, insight-driven functions in the company. You'll identify and deliver high-value AI use cases across the Finance workflow.

You'll partner directly with Klaviyo's AI and data platform teams to embed AI into core Finance processes with clear guardrails, measurable productivity gains, and the rigor expected of a public company. This isn't a future-state vision, it's work already underway, and you'll own it.

blocks.text: Design and optimize core Finance processes and systems

items: Partner with Controllership, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Procurement leaders to design and continuously refine end‑to‑end Finance workflows across procure‑to‑pay, record‑to‑report, and order‑to‑cash, ensuring systems and processes are tightly aligned.

Ensure our ERP and Finance applications are configured, integrated, and operated to support accurate, timely close, scalable revenue and billing, and high‑quality financial data that downstream teams can trust.

blocks.text: Own SOX, controls, and audit readiness for Finance systems

items: Own the design, implementation, and operation of IT General Controls (ITGCs) and other key controls across Finance applications, in partnership with Internal Audit, Security, and external auditors.
Continually simplify and automate controls and evidence collection so audits are reliable and predictable, with fewer deficiencies and lower friction for Finance and GTS teams.

blocks.text: Manage the Finance systems portfolio and vendors

items: Own the Finance systems portfolio budget (applications, services, and related programs), including vendor selection, contract evaluation, and ROI analysis for major investments.
Rationalize overlapping tools, simplify the application landscape, and ensure Finance systems integrate cleanly with G&A, GTM, and data platforms.

blocks.text: Act as a strategic partner and communicator

items: Serve as the primary technology partner for the CFO, Controller, and Finance leadership team on systems, data, and process topics; translate business strategy into clear technical decisions and trade‑offs.
Represent Finance Technology Systems in executive forums, planning cycles, and cross‑functional initiatives, ensuring Finance needs are anticipated and built into wider GTS and company roadmaps.

blocks.text: Who You Are

You've spent your career at the intersection of Finance and technology and you've moved beyond just keeping systems running. You think in roadmaps, outcomes, and partnerships. You know what a well-run Finance technology function looks like, and you know how to build one.

You've led teams through real complexity: ERP and other transformations, SOX audits, billing system overhauls, or the messy work of integrating Finance systems across a growing company. You don't need a perfect environment to do great work, you create structure where there isn't any, and you bring Finance and engineering stakeholders along with you.
Specifically, you likely bring:

items: 15+ years in enterprise or business systems, with meaningful ownership of Finance technology at a tech or SaaS company
4+ years leading teams, including managers, responsible for order-to cash, record-to-report, procure-to-pay, revenue/billing, and financial close systems
Deep, practical SOX ITGC experience and a clean track record working with Internal Audit and external auditors
Solid understanding of enterprise-led growth and system features required to enable moving upmarket
Fluency in ERP and Finance application architecture (NetSuite/Oracle, Coupa, Avalara, Zip, Zuora, or similar), integration patterns, and how Finance data flows across a modern tech stack
Led strong engineering team with AI build-first mentality coupled with engineering excellence
Personally built or scaled AI and automation in Finance workflows - reconciliations, invoice processing, forecasting prep and can speak to what worked and what didn't

A reputation as a trusted partner to engineering and finance leadership; someone who translates complexity into clear decisions and earns credibility with CFOs, CAOs, Controllers, Revenue Operations, and auditors alike

jobs.title: Director of Product - Secure File Gateway and ICAP
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
Why This Role Matters
At OPSWAT, protecting the world’s critical infrastructure is not an abstract mission. It is real, urgent, and growing. Our ICAP product is a proven, high-impact solution that is trusted by customers who depend on us to secure their most critical systems. We are now ready to take ICAP to the next level.
This Director role is a rare opportunity to shape the future of ICAP, including the evolution toward a next-generation Proxy, while scaling commercial impact and deepening customer value. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and go-to-market success, with clear ownership and visible impact. If you are energized by building success, driving innovation, and owning outcomes, this role was designed for you.
What You Will Be Doing
As Director of AI Product Management, you will be the end-to-end owner of ICAP’s product strategy and growth trajectory.
You will:
Set and own the ICAP product vision and roadmap, including the strategic evolution into a Proxy-focused solution.
Translate market signals, customer needs, and competitive insights into clear product direction and prioritized investments.
Partner deeply with Engineering, ensuring fast, high-quality execution and scalable architecture.
Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to drive bookings, pipeline, and customer adoption.
Serve as a strong, visible product leader across regions, with a close partnership with our Vietnam-based teams.
Balance innovation with operational excellence, ensuring ICAP continues to deliver reliability, performance, and trust at scale.
Represent ICAP with confidence to customers, partners, and internal leadership.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 12–18 months, success will look like:
A clear, compelling ICAP roadmap aligned to market demand and customer value.
Measurable growth in bookings and pipeline tied directly to product strategy.
Strong, trust-based partnerships with Engineering and GTM teams.
Progress toward a Proxy-focused architecture that positions ICAP for long-term growth.
A product organization that moves with urgency, clarity, and accountability.
Who You Are
You are a product leader who blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
You bring:
Proven experience leading enterprise or security products at scale.
Deep hands on experience building with AI.
Strong understanding of proxy technologies, ICAP, networking, or adjacent security domains.
A track record of partnering effectively with Engineering to deliver complex products.
Commercial acumen and experience supporting bookings, pipeline, and customer conversations.
Comfort operating in a global, distributed environment, including close collaboration with teams in Vietnam.
Clear, confident communication and the ability to influence across functions.
A mindset rooted in ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.
Director-level experience is preferred, but we value demonstrated leadership altitude, judgment, and impact above title alone.
Why OPSWAT?
OPSWAT is a fast-growing cybersecurity company with a strong culture of ownership and innovation. We build products that matter, support leaders who take initiative, and invest in those who want to grow.
In this role, you will:
Own a successful, revenue-generating product with a meaningful runway.
Shape the future of ICAP and Proxy innovation.
Work with smart, committed teams across the globe.
Have direct visibility and influence within Product leadership.
If you are looking for a role where your decisions matter, your leadership is visible, and your work protects what matters most, we would love to meet you.
OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.
