jobs.title: Director, Value Engineering - Financial Services
jobs.text:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
The Team:
Value Engineering operates at the heart of Celonis, bridging the gap between our Go-to-Market strategy, our Product roadmap, and our customers' realized value. In Financial Services, our team comprises a blend of Industry Executives, Technical Principals, and Value Engineers dedicated to transforming the operating models of the world's largest Banks, Insurers, and Asset Managers.
The Role:
As the Director of Value Engineering (FSI), you will lead the Financial Services practice for North America. You will serve as the strategic leader for the vertical, partnering with Sales Leadership to define the regional value agenda and orchestrating a multi-disciplinary team to drive end-to-end customer value journeys.
You will lead a diverse organization—ranging from strategic Industry Partners to technical execution teams—to translate high-level institutional goals (e.g., Capital Efficiency, Operational Resilience, Combined Ratio optimization) into realized P&L impact. You will serve as the Executive Sponsor for our most strategic accounts, ensuring Celonis is embedded as the default transformation platform across the Office of the COO, CIO, and Chief Digital Officer.
The work you’ll do:
Identify & Frame Strategic Value
Translate Institutional Strategy: Partner with C-Level executives (COO, CIO, Heads of Lines of Business) to map bank and carrier strategic goals across Banking and Insurance —such as T+1 Settlement Readiness, Regulatory Compliance, or Claims Modernization—to specific Celonis capabilities.
Drive the COO & CTO Agenda: Bridge the gap between technical innovation and operational reality. Ensure the team designs solutions that solve critical business problems (e.g., Reducing Manual Touchpoints, Modernizing Legacy Systems) while wrapping every proposal in a robust ROI model that validates the investment.
Commercial Strategy: Partner with FSI Sales Leadership to scrutinize pipeline health, qualify strategic engagements, and effectively allocate resources (deploying Industry Partners vs. Execution Teams) to maximize ARR growth.
Realize Value (Program Execution)
Orchestrate the "Digital Twin": Guide the delivery of complex transformation programs that link siloed divisions. You will oversee execution across value chains such as targeting Trade Lifecycle (Front-to-Back), Client Onboarding (KYC/AML), and Insurance Claims (Triage/Settlement).
Solve Systemic Challenges: Leverage your team’s deep domain expertise to tackle implementation hurdles in complex environments, defining standards for Straight-Through Processing (STP), Exception Management, and Legacy Mainframe vs. Cloud interaction.
Executive Sponsorship: Serve as the escalation point for the customer portfolio. Facilitate high-stakes steering committees to present realized value to senior management and ensure programs hit their strategic milestones.
Scale Value & Practice Innovation
Codify FSI Best Practices: Turn our successes into reusable assets to scale the practice. You will drive the creation of industry-specific playbooks
Product Feedback Loop: Act as the senior "Voice of the Customer" to Product & Engineering. You will advocate for specific development needs regarding data lineage, security, and regulatory reporting required by G-SIBs and Carriers.
Grow & Lead Talent
Lead a Multi-Tiered Organization: Manage and mentor a diverse FSI team structure, including Client Value Partners (CVPs) and Value Engineering leaders.
Develop World-Class Talent: Coach your direct reports on distinct tracks—helping Managers refine their leadership of execution teams, while helping CVPs sharpen their executive presence and domain authority.
Resource Management: Effectively allocate resources across the North American portfolio to deliver on sales, renewals, and adoption targets, balancing high-touch strategic consulting with scalable value delivery.
The qualifications you need:
Executive Leadership Experience: 12+ years of relevant experience, with at least 5+ years in a people-management role within Management Consulting, Value Engineering, or Financial Services Operations.
FSI Domain Fluency: Deep, granular understanding of the Financial Services value chain including:
Banking: Retail and Institutional Operations, Finance, Risk & Compliance, and Payments
Insurance: Claims (Loss Ratios), Underwriting (Risk Selection), and Policy Servicing
Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated ability to qualify complex engagements and drive commercial strategy. You understand the "buying center" of a financial institution and how to navigate procurement, IT security, and business stakeholder requirements.
Technical Context: Understanding of the modern FSI technology stack and how to articulate the value of Process Intelligence within a legacy vs. modernization landscape.
Value Realization Track Record: Proven history of leading large-scale transformation programs that impacted the P&L through operational efficiency or risk mitigation.
Stakeholder Management: Extensive experience presenting to C-Level executives (COO, CIO, CDO). You can navigate complex, matrixed organizations and use data to persuade senior stakeholders
Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.
The base salary range below is for the role in the specified location, based on a Full Time Schedule.
Total compensation package will include base salary + bonus/commission + equity + benefits (health, dental, life, 401k, and paid time off). Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and that the actual total compensation offer will be determined based on various factors, including, but not limited to, applicant's qualifications, skills, experiences, and location.
The base salary range below is for the role in New York, based on a Full Time Schedule.
$195,000—$265,000 USD
What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.
About Us:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
Celonis Inclusion Statement:
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
Your Privacy:
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Ensure the team designs solutions that solve critical business problems (e.g., Reducing Manual Touchpoints, Modernizing Legacy Systems) while wrapping every proposal in a robust ROI model that validates the investment.

Commercial Strategy: Partner with FSI Sales Leadership to scrutinize pipeline health, qualify strategic engagements, and effectively allocate resources (deploying Industry Partners vs. Execution Teams) to maximize ARR growth.

blocks.text: Realize Value (Program Execution)

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
Role Overview
As Director of Software Engineering, you will lead ASM’s global software engineering strategy and execution across multiple product lines and technology platforms. You will be responsible for shaping the future of semiconductor equipment software, driving innovation, and enabling scalable, high-performance solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers.
This role requires a visionary leader who can align software development with business goals, foster cross-functional collaboration, and build high-performing teams across geographies. You will play a critical role in ASM’s transformation into a software-driven organization, ensuring our products remain competitive and future-ready.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the global software engineering strategy aligned with ASM’s business objectives.
Develop and maintain a multi-year software roadmap across product lines and technology platforms.
Champion software innovation and architectural excellence to support long-term scalability and performance.
Organizational Development
Build and lead a world-class software engineering organization across multiple global sites.
Mentor and develop senior engineering leaders and managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
Drive talent acquisition, retention, and career development strategies to support organizational growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Product Management, Hardware Engineering, Process Engineering, and Quality teams to deliver integrated solutions.
Ensure alignment between software development and customer requirements, market trends, and business priorities.
Lead cross-functional initiatives to improve development velocity, quality, and customer satisfaction.
Operational Excellence
Oversee execution of multiple concurrent software programs, ensuring timely delivery and high quality.
Implement best practices in software lifecycle management, including CI/CD, DevOps, and Agile methodologies.
Establish and monitor KPIs for software performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
Technology Leadership
Guide software architecture decisions to support modularity, reuse, and future extensibility.
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends to inform strategic decisions.
Promote a data-driven approach to decision-making and continuous improvement.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 8 years in leadership roles.
Proven track record of leading large-scale software organizations and delivering complex products.
Strong background in C++ and modern software development practices.
Experience with software architecture, release planning, and baseline management.
Demonstrated ability to lead globally distributed teams and manage cross-functional initiatives.
Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in the semiconductor capital equipment industry.
Familiarity with technologies such as ALD, PECVD, epitaxy, and vertical furnaces.
Experience in fast-paced, customer-driven environments.
Proficiency with tools like Jira, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong understanding of software quality assurance and regulatory compliance.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.
Our Engineering Directors are highly technical: you will need to be a domain expert in one or more areas of distributed systems, online security, and machine learning. Responsibilities include building and leading teams ensuring engineers are productive, and shipping what our customers need while maintaining high code quality, security, and service availability standards.
Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines.
What you’ll do:
Recruit, motivate, lead, and manage highly technical teams focused on delivering online security and machine learning products at scale.
Act as a liaison between product, engineering, customers, and sales to articulate and translate both complex business requirements and technology solutions into useful products.
Maintain a high level of assurance and software quality standards while maintaining development velocity: availability is core to nearly every requirement.
Define, drive and govern automation and instrumentation to ensure we maintain high observability and automate break-fix as much as possible.
In partnership with sales and product teams, model go-to-market strategies for new offerings, oversee architecture, boost client acquisition capabilities, and improve delivery.
Put in place effective hiring and onboarding strategies.
What we’re looking for:
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience leading engineering teams of 20-60 people with a strong background in security products and machine learning.
Familiarity with high availability and high security development processes, supported by strong knowledge of Python, NodeJS, and Go or Rust.
Experience and demonstrated success with DevOps/systems integration, lightweight development practices, meeting strong SLAs, test-driven design in large scale internet-facing systems.
Familiarity with distributed systems design on orchestration platforms like Kubernetes: queue-first architectures, sharding, etc.
Strong interpersonal skills, ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated architecture and business/product need mapping expertise (gather requirements, problem solve, and reason about the best way forward given needs, timeline, and available resources).
What we offer:
Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.
Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.
High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting edge R&D.
Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.
We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online!
Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
Rockstar is recruiting for a nonpartisan nonprofit organization that leverages technology to equip the next generation of Americans with the skills to bridge divides. The client primarily works with college campuses, offering a comprehensive, evidence-based suite of products and services for stakeholders at every level—from college presidents to incoming students. Since launching in 2017, the organization has partnered with hundreds of campuses across the country. The organization was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation. This is a pivotal moment to join the team, as the organization is growing rapidly and advances in AI are creating new possibilities for how technology can help people engage in better dialogue across differences. In this role, the selected candidate will be at the forefront of shaping how these tools are leveraged to expand reach and impact.
About the Role
As the software product leader, this individual will report to the Co-Founder and Executive Director. The selected candidate will own the technical vision, strategy, and execution for the e-learning platform, and will be responsible for developing a product roadmap, ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and accessible. While the initial focus will be the flagship e-learning platform, Perspectives, the product leader will also drive technical innovation across the full suite of offerings, using emerging technologies (including AI) to expand impact, efficiency, and scale.
This individual will serve as a player-coach: managing one product team member (a Product Specialist), while partnering closely with an external development agency to deliver high-quality releases on time and on budget.
Responsibilities
Technical Product Leadership & Strategy
- Serve as the Executive Director’s technical thought partner, shaping how and what is built in alignment with the overall product strategy.
- Stay current on trends and emerging technologies in EdTech, AI, and related fields to inform product strategy and innovation.
- Lead the technical strategy to ensure scalability, stability, security, accessibility, and responsible AI integration across all products.
- Translate product priorities into a clear, actionable technical roadmap.
- Set and track product OKRs and KPIs.
Product Health & Scalability
- Own system monitoring, data pipeline integrity, and risk tracking to safeguard product performance and stability.
- Prototype, validate, and deliver AI-powered features and new AI-driven products that advance the organization’s mission.
- Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and accessibility standards.
Team & Vendor Management
- Manage a Product Specialist, fostering professional growth and high performance.
- Lead relationships with all tech vendors — including development agency, platform hosting providers, and accessibility/security partners.
- Manage the technical product budget, negotiate vendor contracts, and ensure high performance from all technical partners.
- Maintain effective agile rituals for a hybrid internal/agency model, in partnership with the Product Specialist.
Cross-Functional Execution
- Collaborate with Education and Implementation teams to ensure products support effective content delivery and meet partner and user needs.
- Work with Partnerships (Sales) to fulfill technical contract requirements, including integrations and security/privacy documentation.
- Partner with Operations on privacy, security, and AI guardrails.
- Ensure cross-functional alignment on product development, launches, and feedback loops.
Job Requirements
About You
- 7+ years of B2B SaaS product management experience, including 3+ years leading or mentoring other product team members.
- Experience in EdTech or a related field, with knowledge of data privacy/security and accessibility requirements; higher ed compliance experience preferred.
- Proven success delivering products on a modular platform or third-party LMS.
- Hands-on experience building AI-driven products; LLM experience strongly preferred.
- Skilled in product discovery and learning methods, including A/B testing, user research, and analytics.
- Track record of successfully managing budgets, vendor contracts, and delivery schedules.
- Strong communicator, able to translate technical complexity for executives, developers, and non-technical stakeholders.
- Deeply aligned with the organization’s mission and excited to help bridge divides and promote constructive dialogue.
- Experience in startup or scaleup environments, comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous contexts.
Benefits
- Compensation — $155,000-$170,000
- A Mission-Driven Culture — the organization practices what it preaches, so the work culture is characterized by intellectual humility, continuous improvement, and open-mindedness
- Remote-First — the organization was founded as a remote-first organization, and works hard to maintain a strong team culture across vast distances
- Unlimited PTO — as well as 13 company holidays
- Other Benefits — employer-supported health, vision and dental plans, subsidized parental leave, 3% 401k match, short- and long-term disability insurance, life and AD&D insurance, $1,000 annual professional development budget.

jobs.text:
As one of Canada’s largest and fastest growing cryptocurrency trading platforms, Ndax has set the bar high for the country’s fintech industry and is constantly leading the way in terms of security and innovation. We are on a mission to empower more Canadians to unlock the full potential of digital finance.
To address the various needs in the Canadian cryptocurrency space, Ndax has assembled a multidisciplinary team with diverse backgrounds, including finance, technology, engineering, compliance, marketing, and more.
We are proud to have been recognized as one of Canada’s Best Workplaces by Great Place to Work®.
Role Overview
The Head of Product Management is a key member of the executive team. You will own the full product strategy and execution across Ndax. You will define the vision, lead a multi-disciplinary product organization, and deliver products that strengthen Ndax’s position as the most trusted platform for digital asset trading in Canada.
Responsibilities
Own the entire product lifecycle: discovery, design, development, launch, adoption, and optimization.
Lead all teams under the product scope, including Product Management, Design, UX Research, and Product Data.
Build, coach, and scale a high-performing product team with clear KPIs and accountability.
Drive user growth, engagement, and retention through customer-centric product decisions.
Partner with Engineering, Compliance, Marketing, and Operations to deliver seamless and secure experiences.
Ensure all products meet Canadian regulatory standards.
Monitor performance, analyze data, and use insights to drive product improvements.
Develop partnerships and integrations that strengthen Ndax’s ecosystem presence.
Represent Ndax’s product vision with the executive team, board members, and external stakeholders.
Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with company goals.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
(P-1384)
About the Team
At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer-obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.
In this role, you will work closely with leaders across the company, within engineering, as well as with product management, field engineering, recruiting and HR. You will lead critical initiatives that enhance developer productivity and drive innovation in the developer platform space. You will be at the forefront of integrating AI tools into the developer workflow, shaping the future of AI-assisted development.
The impact you will have:
Solve real business needs at a large scale by applying your software engineering
Ensure consistent delivery against milestones and strong alignment with the field working "two-in-a-box" with product leadership
Evolve organizational structure to align with long term initiatives, build strong "5 ingredient" teams with good comms architecture
Manage technical debt, including long term technical architecture decisions and balance product roadmap
Leading and participating in technical, product, and design discussions
Building, managing, and operating a highly scalable services in the cloud
Growing leaders on the team by providing coaching, mentorship, and growth opportunities
Partnering with other engineering and product leaders on planning, prioritization and staffing
Creating a culture of excellence on the team while leading with empathy
What we look for:
15+ years of industry experience building and supporting large-scale distributed systems
Building, growing, and managing high-performance teams
Ability to attract and hire engineers who meet the Databricks hiring principles
Existing experience building and running cloud platforms -or- demonstrated ability to quickly learn new concepts in the SaaS space (e.g technical background and fast learner).
Experience working cross-functionality with product management and directly with customers; ability to deeply understand product and customer personas.
BS in Computer Science or Masters or PhD
About Databricks
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
Compliance
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Product Director, Copy Trading / Trading Bot
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
About The Opportunity
The trading bot domain has emerged as one of OKX's most critical and rapidly growing sectors over the past two years. It constitutes a significant share of our platform's daily active traders and trading volume. With this swift growth, escalating user demands, and a promising future for this business, we are committed to allocating more resources to this sector. Our aim is to build top-tier products and ultimately grow this line into a billion-dollar enterprise.
What You’ll Be Doing
Develop strategies to boost trading bot volume and user acquisition. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including design, engineering, and data analysis.
Based on trading users' needs, design trading bots efficient for particular market situations.
Conduct user research and competitor assessments to identify potential opportunities for product innovation and optimization, enhancing user conversion and retention.
Advocate for robust engineering solutions and scalable product/system architecture designs, ensuring efficient new product development.
Manage projects with efficient scope, timeline, and stakeholder coordination, prioritizing quick iterations and impactful outcomes.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience, preferably in Financial Engineering, Mathematics or Engineering.
5+ years of product management experience, particularly within the crypto or internet industry.
Strong grasp of strategy design and backend logic.
Passion for problem-solving and delivering exceptional user experiences.
Self-motivated, independent, persistent, objective, with strong logical thinking, capable of project ownership.
Curious with a strong ability for self-learning, open to exploring innovative projects for driving product growth.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to influence and present ideas effectively.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience in Crypto/FX/Stocks trading, including quant trading, bot trading, or technical analysis.
Strong understanding of the industry and market dynamics.
Fluency in Mandarin will be a plus to work with cross tech teams based in Greater China Region.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Company
Satsuma.ai (Formerly MealMe.ai) is building the infrastructure layer that connects merchants to the new world of AI agents and conversational interfaces. As AI systems like ChatGPT, Alexa, and others begin to search, recommend, and transact on behalf of users, Satsuma ensures products are visible, accessible, and monetizable in real time.
We partner directly with merchants to make their products and services searchable and orderable by AI. Through our API and Merchant Gateway, we enable real-time access to structured data—like product catalogs, menus, pricing, and availability—while giving merchants full control over access, pricing, and usage through their Merchant Console.
Whether it’s a grocery chain, restaurant group, or large retailer, Satsuma transforms AI traffic into revenue by routing it through merchant-owned infrastructure. Our platform unlocks two major value streams: high-margin data monetization and increased order volume from AI-native channels.
Satsuma is backed by leading investors such as Mercury Fund, Palm Drive Capital, Quiet Capital, Slow Ventures, AIX Ventures, and more. We are growing rapidly as we help merchants own their presence in the era of AI commerce.

jobs.title: Corporate Director, Product Unit - Surface Modification
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
Position Overview
As the Corporate Director of Surface Modification, you will lead and evolve a strategic business and technology vertical within ASM. This role is accountable for advancing Surface Modification capabilities—including pre-clean, post-treatment, and standalone platforms—by driving innovation, execution excellence, and cross-functional alignment across a broad, global engineering and product ecosystem.
Responsibilities
Executive leadership for the Surface Modification (SM) Group, managing a high-performing, multidisciplinary organization of ~25–30 professionals across hardware engineering, process development, product support, and product management.
Define and execute the strategic vision and growth roadmap for Surface Modification technologies, including emerging standalone products and enabling modules for integrated pre-clean and post-treatment.
Collaborate closely with Key Product Unit (KPU) and Global Product Marketing (GPM) leadership to align technology innovation with overall business objectives and market opportunities.
Ensure operational excellence and delivery across all development programs, meeting quality, cost, and timeline commitments while enhancing competitiveness and customer value.
Cultivate a customer-centric organization by partnering with key customers and the Key Account Technology (KAT) team to understand evolving needs and secure successful product qualifications.
Serve as the executive sponsor for complex cross-organizational initiatives, aligning R&D, marketing, and operations on shared goals.
Drive organizational development by building and scaling leadership capacity, including direct management of seasoned managers and development of future leaders.
Contribute actively to ASM’s long-term strategic planning and play a pivotal role in shaping the company’s product and technology portfolio in advanced materials engineering.
Qualifications
Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
13+ years of progressive experience in the semiconductor industry (capital equipment preferred), with significant leadership roles spanning surface engineering, process technology, or adjacent domains (CVD, PVD, plasma treatment, etc.).
Proven track record in incubating and delivering new product platforms from concept through commercialization in a global, fast-paced innovation environment.
Demonstrated success leading managers and senior technical professionals, with a strong emphasis on talent development and organizational scalability.
Strategic thinker with exceptional execution discipline and the ability to influence across functions and cultures.
Strong customer orientation and experience navigating technical engagements with global semiconductor manufacturers.
Familiarity with product lifecycle management (PLC), operational efficiency frameworks, and go-to-market strategies.
Effective decision-maker with a pragmatic and collaborative leadership style
Exceptional communicator and problem solver with strong interpersonal and organizational skills
Committed to developing talent, fostering collaboration, and building high-performance cultures
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
About The Opportunity
OKX is seeking an experienced VIP Product Lead to focus on creating exclusive product experiences and service solutions for high-net-worth individuals, institutional clients, market makers, and other VIP customer segments.
You will spearhead the overall strategy and product planning for the VIP product line, driving customer lifecycle management, personalized services, and continuous optimization of system functionalities to enhance customer retention and platform AUM (Assets Under Management).
What You'll Be Doing
Oversee the overall planning and iteration of OKX VIP-related products, including but not limited to VIP benefits systems, personalized campaigns, exclusive offerings, and customized customer services.
Collaborate closely with VIP sales, institutional account managers, and market-making teams to identify VIP customer needs and translate them into actionable product features.
Lead the design and optimization of VIP customer lifecycle management solutions to improve retention and engagement rates.
Coordinate cross-departmental collaboration, including R&D, design, operations, and risk control, to ensure timely and high-quality project delivery.
Monitor global market trends and industry developments to formulate localized product strategies that cater to VIP clients in different regions.
Leverage data analysis and customer feedback to continuously optimize user experience and drive platform trading volume and AUM growth.
Establish competitor analysis mechanisms to evaluate VIP service differentiators in the industry and enhance OKX’s competitive edge.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor’s degree or higher with 5+ years of product management or product strategy experience.
Deep understanding of the Web3/Crypto industry, particularly exchange products such as institutional services, API trading, and VIP incentive programs.
Prior experience in CEXs, brokerages, financial institutions, or high-net-worth client-related products is preferred.
Strong cross-team communication and coordination skills, with systematic thinking and sharp user insights.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and data-driven decision-making.
Fluency in English and Chinese; Multi-market collaboration experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Director, Content and Product Operations (Bangkok-based, relocation provided)
jobs.text:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
About Agoda
Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration.
We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.
Our Purpose – Bridging the World Through Travel
We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn, and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding, and happiness. We are a skillful, driven, and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.
The Opportunity
As Director, Content and Product Operations, you will play a key leadership role in analyzing customer and product data to determine business value and priorities, setting the strategy, roadmap and KPIs to deliver efficient and effective operations. You will build and manage multiple large teams in a fast-paced, international environment.
You will lead your teams in execution, collaborate closely with product managers and IT on A/B experiments and reporting, and coordinate with accommodation supply, connectivity, strategic partnerships, and customer support teams to ensure operational excellence.
This position is based in Bangkok, Thailand, reporting to the VP of Product, and is open to candidates worldwide. We will assist you with visa and relocation, ensuring a smooth transition to working and living in Bangkok.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute content and product operations strategies to support Agoda’s business goals.
Set content and data priorities based on customer needs and business value.
Establish and track KPIs to measure business impact and operational performance.
Create and manage roadmaps and project plans for key initiatives.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product, Technology, and Supply, to deliver effective content solutions.
Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team, fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
Monitor and improve content systems and processes for efficiency and quality.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the content supply chain.
Experience Required
10+ years of experience in driving Operations for large organizations
At least 6 years of direct management experience, including leading teams of 20 or more
Experience managing teams in the e-commerce or technology/internet space
Proven ability to set and execute content or operational strategy to drive business results
Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making; SQL expertise a plus
Demonstrated experience optimizing operational workflows and resourcing, both automated and manual, to achieve business goals

jobs.title: Associate Director - Healthcare Communications (DATA)
jobs.text:
Who we are:
Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.
WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com
For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
More about the role
We are hiring a Healthcare communications Associate Director with Data experience or a keen interest in this area!
We are a diverse team of 45+ healthcare communications specialists who thrive on curiosity, the thrill of a challenge, good old-fashioned fun and working in partnership with clients to improve the health of the world, one brilliant idea at a time.
We deliver global, EMEA and UK integrated marketing communications solutions for many of the world’s leading healthcare companies.
Our breadth of work is limitless, as we challenge ourselves to innovate in all that we do and really make a difference. If it’s led by solid-insight or data, nothing is out of reach; from traditional media campaigns, data communications and brand launches, to multi-channel digital and social media programmes, to influencer campaigns and disease awareness initiatives, to patient apps or patient advocacy partnerships, to multi-award-winning corporate re-positioning videos and crisis management, the list is endless.
We believe that working here is a chance to change lives, including your own. We’re a super supportive team with a warm, friendly and social culture. Through our solid PDP process and ongoing training and support, we pride ourselves on nurturing our people to be their very best.
What you’ll do
Support the strategic development and delivery of integrated, insight-led communications programmes for pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.
Act as a day-to-day lead across projects, ensuring high-quality delivery, alignment with client goals, and consistent performance against KPIs.
Translate complex healthcare data (e.g. clinical trials, real-world evidence, HES data) into compelling narratives that support client messaging and engagement.
Lead and inspire account teams, providing mentorship, fostering collaboration, and ensuring continued professional growth.
Partner with senior leadership to shape strategic proposals and pitch documents, contributing to business development and organic account growth.
Cultivate strong, trusted client relationships by demonstrating sector expertise, strategic counsel, and proactive problem-solving.
Collaborate across Burson's network, including creative, digital, and strategy teams, to deliver bold, integrated campaigns that challenge the status quo.
Contribute to the broader agency culture by actively participating in forums, operational initiatives, and thought leadership efforts.
Experience that contributes to success
Proven experience delivering UK, EMEA, and global communications programmes for pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.
Strong track record in building and maintaining trusted client relationships, with hands-on leadership of integrated campaigns.
Skilled in data and brand communications, including digital, social media, disease awareness, and advocacy initiatives.
Confident in managing project financials, forecasting, and reporting, with experience contributing to successful new business pitches.
Demonstrated people management skills, including team leadership and direct line management.
Known for being collaborative, curious, and committed to delivering high-quality, insight-led work.
Brings a growth mindset with enthusiasm for learning, development, and tackling challenges positively.
Values an inclusive, open-minded, and supportive team culture where individuality is embraced.
#LI-SF1
You belong at Burson:
Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.
At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Vice President - Local Engineering Head / Local CTO
jobs.text: We are seeking a seasoned technology leader to serve as our Remote CTO/VP – Local Engineering Head based in Malaysia/India. You will report to the US-based CTO and take ownership of all engineering teams and provide technical leadership to our Level 1 and 2 Support teams, who reside in our Malaysia office (approximately 100 staff). You will provide input to definition of and execute the technical vision for our AdTech products, ensuring high-quality architecture and on-time delivery. The role involves close collaboration with the global leadership team: you’ll partner with the CTO, US based Technology and Product leadership to refine the roadmap and drive product development and with Global Operations to ensure Technical Support Level 1 and Level 2 teams are aligned with engineering. This position requires a strong strategic mindset, excellent communication skills, and hands-on involvement in both technology and people management.

jobs.title: Engineering Director, DBA
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer/Engineering Director who will be responsible for the design, deployment, optimisation, and full lifecycle management of enterprise-level cloud database platforms. Lead the implementation of multi-cloud architectures for Alibaba Cloud and AWS databases, ensuring high availability, high performance, and cost optimization.
What You'll Be Doing
Database Architecture Design & Optimization
Design, deploy, and optimize cloud databases on Alibaba Cloud (RDS, PolarDB, Redis, MongoDB) and AWS (RDS, Aurora, ElastiCache, DynamoDB).
Select appropriate database types (relational/NoSQL/NewSQL) and service models (managed services vs. self-built clusters) based on business requirements.
Operations & Monitoring
Implement high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) solutions, such as Alibaba Cloud cross-zone deployments, AWS Multi-AZ, and cross-region replication.
Monitor database performance and health using cloud-native tools (Alibaba Cloud CloudMonitor, AWS CloudWatch) and third-party tools (Prometheus, Grafana).
Performance Tuning & Incident Resolution
Analyze slow queries, lock conflicts, and resource bottlenecks (CPU/IO/memory), optimizing SQL statements and index designs.
Rapidly resolve production database incidents (e.g., replication lag, connection pool exhaustion, storage scaling).
Security & Compliance
Manage database access controls via Alibaba Cloud RAM policies and AWS IAM roles to ensure data security.
Perform regular database upgrades and audit log analysis to comply with GDPR, Multi-Tier Cloud Security Certification (MLPS), and other regulations.
Automation & Cost Management
Automate database deployment and operations using Terraform, Ansible, or cloud-native tools (Alibaba Cloud ROS, AWS CloudFormation).
Optimize cloud costs via auto-scaling, reserved instances, and storage tiering (e.g., AWS S3 Glacier).
Cross-Team Collaboration
Support development teams in database design reviews, SQL code standardization, and DevOps processes (e.g., database change management in CI/CD).
Team Management
Manage a team of DBAs to ensure timely completion of projects and efficient resolution of incidents.
What We Look For In You
Technical Skills
Expertise in database services of at least one major public cloud (Alibaba Cloud or AWS), with familiarity in the other.
In-depth understanding of core principles of mainstream databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis) and advanced SQL optimization/troubleshooting skills.
Experience with database migration tools (AWS DMS, Alibaba Cloud DTS) and cross-cloud synchronization solutions.
Experience Requirements
5+ years of DBA experience, including at least 2 years managing public cloud databases.
Hands-on experience with large-scale (TB-level) databases, sharding, and read/write splitting.
Experience leading cloud database migrations, DR drills, or hybrid cloud projects is preferred.
Soft Skills
Strong documentation skills for creating SOPs and contingency plans.
Excellent communication skills to coordinate development, operations, and business teams.
Certifications & Education
Alibaba Cloud ACP/ACE (Database) or AWS Certified Database – Specialty certifications preferred.
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Head of Infrastructure Technology
jobs.text:
About Your Tasks
Infrastructure Management
Oversee the design, deployment, and maintenance of IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, storage systems, and other hardware and software components.
Develop and implement strategies for infrastructure capacity planning, performance optimization, and disaster recovery.
Ensure high availability and reliability of IT services through proactive monitoring and maintenance practices.
Team Leadership
Lead and manage a team of IT professionals, including network engineers, system administrators, and support staff.
Foster a collaborative and innovative team environment, encouraging professional development and continuous learning.
Set performance goals, conduct regular performance evaluations, and provide coaching and mentorship to team members.
Security and Compliance
Implement and enforce security policies and procedures to protect the organization's IT infrastructure from threats and vulnerabilities.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, standards, and best practices, such as GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO/IEC 27001.
Conduct regular security assessments, audits, and penetration testing to identify and mitigate risks.
Vendor and Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with external vendors and service providers, negotiating contracts and ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including executives, department heads, and project managers, to align IT infrastructure initiatives with business objectives.
Communicate infrastructure status, issues, and recommendations to senior management in a clear and concise manner.
Project Management
Lead infrastructure projects from initiation to completion, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and meet quality standards.
Develop and manage project plans, budgets, and timelines, coordinating resources and stakeholders as needed.
Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement corrective actions to keep projects on track.
Innovation and Improvement
Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating their potential impact on the organization's IT infrastructure.
Identify opportunities for infrastructure improvement and innovation, driving initiatives to enhance performance, scalability, and efficiency.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging the adoption of best practices and new technologies.

jobs.title: Director of Product - Storage Security
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
The Position
OPSWAT is on the lookout for a talented and experienced Director of Product to enhance our Storage Security offerings and bolster our market position. As the head of this division, you will assume full responsibility for managing our Storage Security product line, overseeing both technical and business dimensions. This pivotal role involves shaping product roadmaps, developing solutions, establishing pricing strategies, and managing overall cost structures. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams to ensure that product requirements are met and that deliverables align with expectations. We seek an engaged leader who is actively involved in the execution of daily operations, with a strong background in managing a business line, including budget oversight, and ensuring that strategic initiatives are converted into actionable tasks. Your responsibilities will encompass both on-premises solutions and cloud-native SaaS products. Additionally, you will coordinate product launches in partnership with global sales, corporate marketing, and creative teams.
Join OPSWAT and spearhead the evolution of our Storage Security business, ensuring our products not only fulfill but surpass customer expectations while driving strategic initiatives and achieving overall business success.
What You Will Be Doing
Shape the strategic direction for OPSWAT’s Storage Security products by assessing emerging security challenges, understanding the competitive landscape, and aligning OPSWAT’s strengths with innovative product goals.
Collaborate with engineering teams to clearly define product requirements, develop roadmaps, and establish exit criteria for core offerings, ensuring a match between technical capabilities and business objectives.
Guide product development by incorporating both functional and non-functional customer requirements into practical plans.
Improve pre- and post-sales processes by providing technical insights and solutions that enhance customer engagement and support business development activities.
Manage the comprehensive go-to-market strategy for this business line, including sales enablement for direct sales and channel partners, website content, blogs, presentations, and business proposals.
Cultivate and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across various go-to-market functions, including sales teams, channel partners, and technology alliances to enhance product adoption and visibility.
Participate in sales calls to assist with proof-of-concept demonstrations and manage customer escalations effectively.
Enjoy flexible working hours as OPSWAT serves critical infrastructure clients globally.
Be prepared for occasional international travel to engage with internal teams and customers.
What We Need From You
At least 5 years of experience in a B2B Product Management role, with a minimum of 3 years focused on the Storage Security domain.
Deep hands on experience building with AI.
Deep understanding of cloud-native infrastructure and architectures, with experience in a leadership capacity within a cloud development team; capability to effectively navigate and drive engineering processes.
Strong storytelling skills with excellent written and verbal communication abilities, capable of transforming complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Comprehensive knowledge of IT technology systems, including data protection solutions, encryption technologies, and frameworks for storage security.
Excellent interpersonal and customer-facing skills, showcasing effective people management abilities.
Proven project management skills, thriving in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
Experience in developing and implementing cybersecurity solutions for critical infrastructure or enterprise clients.
A demonstrated history of meeting and exceeding business goals.
A strategic, innovative, and proactive mindset, willing to take calculated risks to foster advancement.
OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.
Our Engineering Directors are highly technical: you will need to be a domain expert in one or more areas of distributed systems, online security, and machine learning. Responsibilities include building and leading teams ensuring engineers are productive, and shipping what our customers need while maintaining high code quality, security, and service availability standards.
Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines.
What you’ll do:
Recruit, motivate, lead, and manage highly technical teams focused on delivering online security and machine learning products at scale.
Act as a liaison between product, engineering, customers, and sales to articulate and translate both complex business requirements and technology solutions into useful products.
Maintain a high level of assurance and software quality standards while maintaining development velocity: availability is core to nearly every requirement.
Define, drive and govern automation and instrumentation to ensure we maintain high observability and automate break-fix as much as possible.
In partnership with sales and product teams, model go-to-market strategies for new offerings, oversee architecture, boost client acquisition capabilities, and improve delivery.
Put in place effective hiring and onboarding strategies.
What we’re looking for:
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience leading engineering teams of 20-60 people with a strong background in security products and machine learning.
Familiarity with high availability and high security development processes, supported by strong knowledge of Python, NodeJS, and Go or Rust.
Experience and demonstrated success with DevOps/systems integration, lightweight development practices, meeting strong SLAs, test-driven design in large scale internet-facing systems.
Familiarity with distributed systems design on orchestration platforms like Kubernetes: queue-first architectures, sharding, etc.
Strong interpersonal skills, ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated architecture and business/product need mapping expertise (gather requirements, problem solve, and reason about the best way forward given needs, timeline, and available resources).
What we offer:
Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.
Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.
High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting edge R&D.
Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.
We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online!
Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

jobs.title: Principal Technologist / Field CTO
jobs.text:
This role can be based remotely in India.
Position Summary
We are seeking an exceptional Principal Technologist to join our team in India. This pivotal role will work closely with our account teams to engage with C-suite executives and senior technical leaders at MongoDB’s most strategic customers. You will bridge the gap between complex data architectures and AI to power business transformation, positioning MongoDB as the premier platform for modernizing legacy systems and building next-generation AI applications. As a recognized technical thought leader, you will shape industry perspectives through regular activities including high-impact technical evangelism and thought leadership, executive roundtables, presentations delivered to customers, keynotes at MongoDB and industry events, and regularly briefing tier-1 press, media, and analysts as a credible and trusted company spokesperson.
Qualifications
10+ years of experience in customer and market-facing roles at the principal or Field CTO level
Recognized technical leader with deep hands-on experience with enterprise-scale applications
Influence & Scalability: Demonstrated success in scaling your technical influence and earned credibility. Experience speaking at major tech conferences, hosting technical webinars, or contributing deeply to the developer community (via technical blogs, open-source contributions, or whitepapers) is highly desired
Deep portfolio and history of published content, presentations at events, interviews or quotes in the the press and media
Executive Presence: Exceptional ability to command a room with credibility, deliver compelling keynote presentations, and influence technology strategies with a CxO audience
Strong understanding of database architectures, distributed systems, and cloud computing concepts, with experience in distributed systems design, including scalability, fault tolerance, and consistency models
Familiarity with modern application development frameworks and hands-on proficiency with state of the art AI capabilities
Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
What We Offer
Extensive travel (up to 50%) may be required, but can be offset by a strong existing digital footprint and community influence within the region
Ability to exert broad industry influence and build your personal brand
The chance to go deep on MongoDB, learning the most successful next generation database platform and seeing first-hand how the world's biggest companies use it for their most demanding applications
Opportunity to influence technical direction and strategic decisions and some of the world's largest companies
Competitive salary and benefits package
Focused, high-performing team and close collaboration with your peers across the organization
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform, the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 60,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Engineering
jobs.text:
GAQ125R25
As Head of Corporate Engineering, you will be responsible for Enterprise engineering and operations globally. You will be responsible for building and managing a highly technical enterprise engineering team, developing first principled-based strategies, and enabling strong enterprise security. Key responsibilities include engineering, securing and optimizing cloud infrastructure, Identity and Access Management, Endpoints, Collaboration tools, and ensuring compliance with SOX, PCI DSS, and FedRAMP compliance. The Head of Corporate Engineering will work closely with R&D on managing engineering tools like Jira, Confluence, and GitHub, driving efficient adoption and integration. Strong technical and influencing leadership principles coupled with the ability to manage a complex, scaling, and fast-moving enterprise environment are essential.
This role reports directly to the Vice President, Infrastructure and Operations
Responsibilities:
In this influential role, you will be responsible for:
Securing the Enterprise: Working closely with Enterprise Security organization to harden and secure our cloud environments, secret management, collaboration tools, endpoints, SaaS environments, IAM tools, and more. Success measured in continuous improvement of our enterprise security hardening standards
Building and Scaling our Cloud Infrastructure: Your team will be responsible for establishing and implementing enterprise cloud infrastructure including establishing Infrastructure Provisioning, SRE services, 24/7 on-call support, Infra as Code, observability, and more. In addition, you will be responsible for managing cloud budgets, vendor management, and establishing cost optimization initiatives. jobs.title: Creative Project Manager/ Director (3D Design - Creative Agency)
jobs.text:
Responsibilities:
Lead and manage the creative team in developing and executing 2D and 3D experiential creative projects.
Conceptualize and design creative concepts and solutions for various projects, including exhibitions, events, and installations.
Collaborate with clients to understand their objectives and deliver impactful and innovative designs.
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior designers and artists.
Oversee the entire creative process, from concept development to final execution.
Ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Stay updated on design trends and technologies in the experiential creative industry.
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including production, marketing, and operations.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize workload.
Present design concepts to clients and stakeholders.
